jenjo: E ifɨ ihyãnɨng tswe nɨhyã e vĩ e nɨngnɨ Fi tswekə sɨ bɨ nɨ yang.
english: Since many have undertaken to set in order a narrative concerning those matters which have been fulfilled among us,

jenjo: E vĩ e nɨngnɨ bɨ likə sɨ e ifɨ nɨ bəkə be nɨng le nɨ. Dɨ e ifɨ de pəsɔ pɨ tenwa nɨng nɨ Fi tswekə nɨ.
english: even as those who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and servants of the word delivered them to us,

jenjo: N pĩ dɔsɔ bi de n bə yang pikang bɨ, bɨn bə hĩkwã n vĩ mə lə chĩhywa, Tiyofilus ihyãfɨ, pəsɔ sɨ nɨng nyi wə.
english: it seemed good to me also, having traced the course of all things accurately from the first, to write to you in order, most excellent Theophilus;

jenjo: N tswe male nɨ hɛbələ a yi kəsɛ̃sɛ̃ bi anɨng və e nɨng nɨ e nyi mə kə nalə nɨ.
english: that you might know the certainty concerning the things in which you were instructed.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ Hiridus ku kəzɛ̃ Yahudiya nɨ, ihyɔ̃nɨng və Fi akə lə sen dzu wə Zakariya. Wə təngsə e ifɨ hyɔ̃nɨng və Fi pɨnyi Abija fə he wə dɨ pɨnyi Haruna. Dzung he wə de Alisabatu.
english: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the priestly division of Abijah. He had a wife of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.

jenjo: Le bwayung nɨ, e ku kə kulɨ a pikang pɨpi Fi, fə e mwə nyi hywi bi nɨ hɛ̃ Itwebɨ Fi tsa e ifɨ o tswekə nɨ.
english: They were both righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord.

jenjo: E ywang be yɨw bisɨ Alisabatu hona, fə wə be Zakariya hɛ̃ e kywi yang.
english: But they had no child, because Elizabeth was barren, and they both were well advanced in years.

jenjo: Vi akə lə ikwang, sapɨnɨ Zakariya sɨn tswe nwatũ hyɔ̃nɨng nɨ, bɨ vi bwadzwa və pɨnyi wə tswe bisɨ tswelɨ a nwatũ Kwə Fi.
english: Now while he executed the priest’s office before God in the order of his division,

jenjo: Ma tswelɨ və e ihyɔ̃nɨng və Fi, e gbə nɨngbibɨng o ku Zakariya, dɨ wə bɨ on ko ywi Kwə Fi.
english: according to the custom of the priest’s office, his lot was to enter into the temple of the Lord and burn incense.

jenjo: E ifɨ kə dzungdzung tsɨ pɨfa sen kũ Fi sapɨnɨ son ko ywi a lalɨ nɨ.
english: The whole multitude of the people were praying outside at the hour of incense.

jenjo: Bɨ ikwətũ Dzwe hu ji sɨ wə, wu tsɨ pu hywe ko ywi Tangkwə və Fi kya a nali.
english: An angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing on the right side of the altar of incense.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ Zakariya bə wə kə nɨ, o yabwi fə sɨbi mwə wə.
english: Zacharias was troubled when he saw him, and fear fell upon him.

jenjo: Bɨ ikwətũ dzwe de tsɨ wə, “Zakariya! Bi man bibi yɛ, Fi li pɨkũpɨ mə yang. He mə Alisabatu yin chi mə yɨ a ibwi lə, man tə dzung wə Yohana.
english: But the angel said to him, “Don’t be afraid, Zacharias, because your request has been heard, and your wife, Elizabeth, will bear you a son, and you shall call his name John.

jenjo: Chilɨ və imwə nɨ yin tə mə lalɨ. Bisɨ chilɨ o, e ifɨ kə dzungdzung yin li lalɨ.
english: You will have joy and gladness; and many will rejoice at his birth.

jenjo: On myɛkə ifɨ a kã pɨpi Itwebɨ Fi, fə bi on nwa mɨng inəbi, alo mi yɛ. Pa en chi wəlɨ, Kwang Fi yin wu ku wə.
english: For he will be great in the sight of the Lord, and he will drink no wine nor strong drink. He will be filled with the Holy Spirit, even from his mother’s womb.

jenjo: On myɛ pwəchi e ifɨ Israila on e sɨ Itwebɨ Fi və le.
english: He will turn many of the children of Israel to the Lord, their God.

jenjo: On ochi Itwebɨ be Kwang Fi, be sambe, ma və Iliya ilinwa. O myɛ nyi e ta on e sɨ e yɨ le, e ifɨ tsatswi, on fə be le on wukə nɨhyã və e ifɨ a pikang nɨng Fi. Mambɨ on mə e ifafɨ on tsɨ bisɨ wulɨ və Itwebɨ.”
english: He will go before him in the spirit and power of Elijah, ‘to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children,’ and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to prepare a people prepared for the Lord.”

jenjo: Bɨ Zakariya tsɨ Ikwətũ dzwe de tsa, “Mɨn tswe nwu min yipɨ bi nɨ nwa mə nɨ yin tswetswe mambɨ? Bɨmpo mi be he mi bɨ kywi yang.”
english: Zacharias said to the angel, “How can I be sure of this? For I am an old man, and my wife is well advanced in years.”

jenjo: Bɨ Ikwətũ dzwe de tsa, “Dɨ mi Jibrailu nɨ sɨn tsɨkə pɨpi Fi nɨ. Fi tũ mi wun nə mə bi alalɨ nɨ lə.
english: The angel answered him, “I am Gabriel, who stands in the presence of God. I was sent to speak to you, and to bring you this good news.

jenjo: Bisɨ a la pɨ kwə bi nɨ n nə mə lə nɨ, kə bi a mi yin tswetswe mambɨ hywa wə. A pa fə a nəbiw, tɛmə bi nɨ myɛkə bi anɨng yang hĩ.”
english: Behold, you will be silent and not able to speak, until the day that these things will happen, because you didn’t believe my words, which will be fulfilled in their proper time.”

jenjo: E ifɨ nɨ sɨn kũkə Fi pɨfa nɨ bə Zakariya ji nyikwə və Fi lo, bɨ bi de yɨlə le hɛ̃. E yi nɨng nɨ mwə wə tsɨkə nɨ lo.
english: The people were waiting for Zacharias, and they marveled that he delayed in the temple.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ o la wu o hu o jikə nɨ, nwa wə fe yang, son nəbi be kəna. E ifɨ bəkə nɨ, bɨ e tsɨ a le o bə dɨ yɨng tang Kwə Fi de.
english: When he came out, he could not speak to them, and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple. He continued making signs to them, and remained mute.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ vi nwatũ o tɨngkə Tangkwə və Fi nɨ, Zakariya fə tə və wə.
english: When the days of his service were fulfilled, he departed to his house.

jenjo: Vi tswəni tswa wə, bɨ he wə Alisabatu dɨ ywa. O tswe hywĩhywĩ bwahmə o ji fa lo.
english: After these days Elizabeth, his wife, conceived, and she hid herself five months, saying,

jenjo: Bɨ o tsa, “Itwebɨ Fi bə shi mi o tswe mi nɨng akəng lə yang. O tɨng suku yang nɨng mi bɨngsə e ifafɨ.”
english: “Thus has the Lord done to me in the days in which he looked at me, to take away my reproach among men.”

jenjo: Ywa Alisabatu kã tə hywĩhywĩ hywĩtsung nɨ, bɨ Fi tũ ikwətũ Jibrailu və akə sen dzu wə Nazarat tangsə hywa Galili.
english: Now in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,

jenjo: O wu sɨ mwəhe akə kə kɨngwɛ iye, sen dzuwə Maryamu. Pɨnyi Dauda akə sen dzu wə Yusufu tə kəta ku wə.
english: to a virgin pledged to be married to a man whose name was Joseph, of David’s house. The virgin’s name was Mary.

jenjo: Ikwətũ Dzwe de tə sɨ wə bɨ tsɨ wə tsa, “Səko mə iye! Itwebɨ Fi tsung be mə, o tə mə parkə yang.”
english: Having come in, the angel said to her, “Rejoice, you highly favored one! The Lord is with you. Blessed are you among women!”

jenjo: Pɨtsapɨ və ikwətũ dzwe nɨ yɨlə Maryamu yang. O kyɛ̃ dɨ pɨ tsapɨ və bə ho?
english: But when she saw him, she was greatly troubled at the saying, and considered what kind of salutation this might be.

jenjo: Male nɨ, bɨ ikwətũ dzwe de tsɨ wə tsa, “Maryamu, bi sɨbi tswe mə yɛ. A chi kutswəmə yang sɨ Fi.
english: The angel said to her, “Don’t be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.

jenjo: Man dɨ ywa, man chi kə yɨ a ibwi, man tə dzung wə Yeso.
english: Behold, you will conceive in your womb, and give birth to a son, and will call his name ‘Jesus.’

jenjo: On myɛkə ifɨ kãlɨ, fə en dzu wə Yɨ Fi Ipenyɔnɨng Hɛ̃. Fi yin tə wə kəzɛ̃ ivə və papa o Dauda.
english: He will be great, and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give him the throne of his father, David,

jenjo: Fə on lwe ivə ku e ifɨ və Yakubu kə a itsɨng. Ivə o nyitɨngku wə ywang.”
english: and he will reign over the house of Jacob forever. There will be no end to his Kingdom.”

jenjo: Bɨ Maryamu tsa, “Bi le nwa mə le, yin tswetswe mambɨ? Kə n mɛdi pɨ lwe ibwi lo wɛ.”
english: Mary said to the angel, “How can this be, seeing I am a virgin?”

jenjo: Bɨ ikwətũ Dzwe de tsɨ wə tsa, “Kwang Fi yin wu ku mə, fə sambe Ipenyɔnɨng Hɛ̃ wun ki mə. Bisɨ mambɨ yɨ nɨ man chikə nɨ dɨ yɨ a kĩlɨ, fə en dzu wə Yɨ Fi.
english: The angel answered her, “The Holy Spirit will come on you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. Therefore also the holy one who is born from you will be called the Son of God.

jenjo: Lənyɔ mə Alisabatu nɨ e tsa o hokə na nɨ, wə be ywa hywĩhywĩ hywĩtsɨng be kwilɨ o hɛ̃.
english: Behold, Elizabeth, your relative, also has conceived a son in her old age; and this is the sixth month with her who was called barren.

jenjo: Nɨng a shilɨ ywang sɨ Fi.”
english: For nothing spoken by God is impossible.”

jenjo: Bɨ Maryamu tsa, “Mi dɨ shə və Fi.” Bɨ ikwətũ dzwe de ho tə yə wə.
english: Mary said, “Behold, the servant of the Lord; let it be done to me according to your word.” The angel departed from her.

jenjo: Hywapɨ de, Maryamu yi pəpi tə dzwəwɛ o tə və akə bɨng te tangsə hywa Yahudiya.
english: Mary arose in those days and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Judah,

jenjo: O tə tangvə Zakariya. Bɨ o tsa he wə Alisabatu.
english: and entered into the house of Zacharias and greeted Elizabeth.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ Alisabatu likə pɨtsapɨ və Maryamu nɨ, yɨ nɨ ywa wə nɨ, chi wə. Nabi bɨ Kwang Fi tə sɨ wə.
english: When Elizabeth heard Mary’s greeting, the baby leaped in her womb, and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.

jenjo: Be wi kɔ̃kɔ̃ o tsa, “Mə dɨ ifɨ parkə, bɨngsə e sə iye hɛ̃. Fə yɨ nɨ man chikə nɨ, dɨ imwə parkə.
english: She called out with a loud voice, and said, “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!

jenjo: Dɨ kang bə n chi bɨ na və Itwebɨ wu sɨ mi?
english: Why am I so favored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ n li kə pɨtsapɨ mə nɨ, yɨ nɨ ywa mi nɨ chi mi bisɨ bɛlɨ.
english: For behold, when the voice of your greeting came into my ears, the baby leaped in my womb for joy!

jenjo: Mə dɨ ifi parkə, nɨ a kwə nɨng nɨ Itwebɨ Fi nəkə ku mə yin tswe mambɨ nɨ.”
english: Blessed is she who believed, for there will be a fulfillment of the things which have been spoken to her from the Lord!”

jenjo: Maryamu tsa, “Hũlɨ mi sɨn tə Itwebɨ Fi kãlɨ,
english: Mary said, “My soul magnifies the Lord.

jenjo: fə kwang mi sɨn bɛ Fi nɨ wa mi le kə nɨ.
english: My spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior,

jenjo: Bisɨ nɨng wə tsɨlə sɨ shə o nɨ dɨ nɨng akə lo nɨ. Dɨlə sɨswenɨ təkə chi, e pɨnyi hɛ̃ yin dzu mi kə ifɨ parkə,
english: for he has looked at the humble state of his servant. For behold, from now on, all generations will call me blessed.

jenjo: bisɨ Ipenyɔ nɨng tswe mi nɨng bisɨ lə yang. Kə akang, dzung wə dɨ nɨng a kĩlɨ.
english: For he who is mighty has done great things for me. Holy is his name.

jenjo: Bəshi o, le ku e ifɨ nɨ sɨn bibi o nɨ, dɨlə pɨnyi təkə ku pɨnyi.
english: His mercy is for generations of generations on those who fear him.

jenjo: O tswe nɨng a kã be sambe o, o bwi e ifɨ nɨ ku sɨn dɨ ku le dɨ nɨng akə nɨ, o yatə yang.”
english: He has shown strength with his arm. He has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.

jenjo: O dɨ e ivə o yə ku kəzɛ̃ və le, bɨ e ifɨ nɨ dɨ nɨng akə lo nɨ, o tə le kãlɨ.
english: He has put down princes from their thrones. And has exalted the lowly.

jenjo: O tsə ywa e ifɨ nɨ hwə sɨn yə le nɨ be e nɨng a pikang, o nyə e ifɨ nɨng chinɨng o e tə be na anfa.
english: He has filled the hungry with good things. He has sent the rich away empty.

jenjo: O pələ shə o Israila yang, nyi wə sɨn chĩ lo sɨ bəshi o ku,
english: He has given help to Israel, his servant, that he might remember mercy,

jenjo: Ibrahim be e pɨnyi wə kə achɛ̃, ma nəlɨ o nə e ta və bɨ lə nɨ.”
english: As he spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and his offspring forever.”

jenjo: Maryamu ku be Alisabatu hywĩ hwyĩ bwatə, bɨ fə o tə və.
english: Mary stayed with her about three months, and then returned to her house.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ vi chilɨ və Alisabatu tswekə nɨ, o chikə yɨ a ibwi.
english: Now the time that Elizabeth should give birth was fulfilled, and she gave birth to a son.

jenjo: E ifɨ kwang ki o, be e lənyɔ o bɛ tsung be wə bisɨ chilɨ o chikə yɨ nɨ. E li lalɨ bisɨ parkə nɨ Itwebɨ Fi tswe wə lə nɨ.
english: Her neighbors and her relatives heard that the Lord had magnified his mercy towards her, and they rejoiced with her.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ imwə tswekə vi ji nwakwə nɨ, e wu pɨ pyɛ̃ chi wə, ma nwa nɨng hywinɨng və le. E yidi pɨ dɨ dzung ta o Zakariya e tə wə.
english: On the eighth day, they came to circumcise the child; and they would have called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.

jenjo: Bɨ na o tsa, “Oho! Dzung wə a Yohana.”
english: His mother answered, “Not so; but he will be called John.”

jenjo: Bɨ e tsɨ wə tsa, “Ifɨ akə ywang tangsə e lənyɔ mə be dzung nɨ.”
english: They said to her, “There is no one among your relatives who is called by this name.”

jenjo: Bɨ e nyi ta və imwə be kəna o nə dzung nɨ o yidi pɨ təkə yɨ wə nɨ.
english: They made signs to his father, what he would have him called.

jenjo: Bɨ o nyi na, e tə lɨ nɨng vĩ nɨng, bɨ o vĩ, “Dzung wə Yohana.” E ifɨ nɨ tsikə pɨbi nɨ. E chi kənwa nəbi lo. E gã e tsɨhywa yinfa.
english: He asked for a writing tablet, and wrote, “His name is John.” They all marveled.

jenjo: Lelang, nwa wə be o pəsɔ pɨ nəbi son yənwa sɨ Fi.
english: His mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue freed, and he spoke, blessing God.

jenjo: Bɨ sɨbɨ mwə e ifɨ kwangki o. Fə e ifɨ bɨngte hywa Yahudiya hɛ̃, sen nəbi ku nɨng nɨ tswekə pɨ nɨ.
english: Fear came on all who lived around them, and all these sayings were talked about throughout all the hill country of Judea.

jenjo: Ifɨ nɨ likə bi nɨ hɛ̃ nyibi sɨn tsa, “Dɨbə imwə nɨ yin myɛ kə?” Bisɨ e bə sambe və Itwebɨ Fi lə ku wə.
english: All who heard them laid them up in their heart, saying, “What then will this child be?” The hand of the Lord was with him.

jenjo: Ta o Zakariya yɨlə be Kwang Fi, o nə nwa pɨtũpɨ və Fi o tsa,
english: His father, Zacharias, was filled with the Holy Spirit, and prophesied, saying,

jenjo: “Bɨ yənwa sɨ Itwebɨ, Fi və Israila, bisɨ wu o gba e ifɨ o o le na yang.
english: “Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, for he has visited and redeemed his people;

jenjo: O tə bɨ Iwalena a tsalɨ yang tang və shə o Dauda.
english: and has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David

jenjo: Tswe ma nɨng nɨ o nəkə e Ilinwa o a kĩlɨ ha kə dzungdzung nɨ pekə nɨ.
english: (as he spoke by the mouth of his holy prophets who have been from of old),

jenjo: On wa bɨ on le na sɨ e mbwe və bɨ be e ifɨ nɨ la bi və bɨ nɨ.
english: salvation from our enemies, and from the hand of all who hate us;

jenjo: Fi yin tswe nɨng nɨ bisɨ son bəshi və e papa və bɨ, fə nyi wə o sɨ bi a kĩlɨ nɨ o kwəsələ be le kə nɨ,
english: to show mercy towards our fathers, to remember his holy covenant,

jenjo: be nɨng hywinɨng nɨ o hywikə ta və bɨ Ibrahim lə nɨ.
english: the oath which he swore to Abraham, our father,

jenjo: Fi tsa lɨn wa bɨ lɨn le, na e mbwe və bɨ. Hebilə bɨ mwə nyi wə bi abilɨ ywang.
english: to grant to us that we, being delivered out of the hand of our enemies, should serve him without fear,

jenjo: On myɛ bɨ kə e ifɨ a kĩlɨ be tswelɨ a nɨng akəng pɨpi wə nyɔ vi bɨ hɛ̃.
english: In holiness and righteousness before him all the days of our life.

jenjo: “Mə, yɨ mi, en dzu mə ilinwa və Ipenyɔnɨng Hɛ̃. Man ochi Itwebɨ fə man mə nɨhyã bisɨ wə.
english: And you, child, will be called a prophet of the Most High, for you will go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways,

jenjo: Man nə e ifɨ lə man tsa, Fi yin wa le yin lena, fə on enyi hywa sɨ nɨng abe və le.
english: to give knowledge of salvation to his people by the remission of their sins,

jenjo: Bisɨ kãlɨ bəshi və Fi və bɨ, pɨkəpɨ o yin wa bɨ le na, on wu dzwe wu on kəpɨ tsɨ sɨ bɨ.
english: because of the tender mercy of our God, whereby the dawn from on high will visit us,

jenjo: On kəpɨ sɨ e ifɨ nɨ kukə bɨng tangkuchi nɨ, fə be e ifɨ nɨ kukə nwa ku və bwa nɨ. On ochi bɨ on ta bɨ nasɨ nɨhyã a tã.”
english: to shine on those who sit in darkness and the shadow of death; to guide our feet into the way of peace.”

jenjo: Tswa wə, imwə kã, fə kwəng wə tsa. Bɨ o ku nyi hu təkə vi nɨ o ji o nə e Israila bi və Fi lə nɨ.
english: The child was growing, and becoming strong in spirit, and was in the desert until the day of his public appearance to Israel.

jenjo: Ha akə lə, Kaisar Agustus tenwa tsa e sa e ifafɨ nɨ kukə hywa və Roma nɨ.
english: Now in those days, a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be enrolled.

jenjo: Dɨ pɨsapɨ a na nwachi ho, sapɨ nɨ Kiriniyus ku kəzɛ̃ hywa Suriya nɨ.
english: This was the first enrollment made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.

jenjo: Bɨ e ifafɨ hɛ̃ fə tə və le bisɨ e sa le.
english: All went to enroll themselves, everyone to his own city.

jenjo: Yusufu yi yə Nazarat tangsə hywa Galili, bɨ tə və a kã Betalami tangsə Yahudiya, hywa nɨ e chikə Dauda lə nɨ. Yusufu yi tə pɨ de bisɨ wə dɨ pɨnyi Dauda.
english: Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judea, to David’s city, which is called Bethlehem, because he was of the house and family of David;

jenjo: O tə tsung be Maryamu nɨ o təkə kətə ku wə nɨ, bisɨ tə e sa le tsung. Hywapɨ de, vi nɨ on chikə nɨ dɨpɨ tsɨ yang.
english: to enroll himself with Mary, who was pledged to be married to him as wife, being pregnant.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ le pɨbi nɨ, dɨbɨ vi chilɨ a o tswe.
english: While they were there, the day had come for her to give birth.

jenjo: O chi yɨ nwachi o, kə yɨ a ibwi. Bɨ o hwə wə be nɨngji, o ke wə tangsə ji nɨngtang və e nɨngtsa, bisɨ e chi kwə lwelɨ lo.
english: She gave birth to her firstborn son. She wrapped him in bands of cloth, and laid him in a feeding trough, because there was no room for them in the inn.

jenjo: Tangsə hywa de, e igbənɨngtsa akə lə lwe fa hu pəsəpi be və, sen tsɨ nɨng sɨ nɨngtsa və le be nvi.
english: There were shepherds in the same country staying in the field, and keeping watch by night over their flock.

jenjo: Pa en yalɨ, ikwətũ dzwe hu ji sɨ le, fə chwĩyiyi və Fi kəpɨ tsɨ sɨ le, bɨ e bibi.
english: Behold, an angel of the Lord stood by them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.

jenjo: Be ikwətũ dzwe de tsɨ le tsa, “Bi ban bibi yɛ. N wu be bə bi a lalɨ lə, nɨ yin tswe e ifɨ hɛ̃ bɛ ihyãnɨng nɨ.
english: The angel said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy which will be to all the people.

jenjo: Jɛnɨ tang və a kã və Dauda, e chi bə Iwalena lə yang, dɨ wə kə ifɨ nɨ Fi gbə sɔ sɨ wə, tũkə sɨ bə nɨ.
english: For there is born to you today, in David’s city, a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.

jenjo: Dɨ nɨng nɨ yin ta na lə ban yikə pɨ ho nɨ. Tə ban chi yɨ ahyɛ̃ e hwə wə be nɨngji, fə e ke wə tangsə kwang nɨngtang və e nɨngtsa.
english: This is the sign to you: you will find a baby wrapped in strips of cloth, lying in a feeding trough.”

jenjo: Nabi, e ikwətũ dzwe kə dzungdzung hu ji wu tsɨ be ikwətũ dzwe a nanwachi nɨ, sen yənwa sɨ Fi sen tsa,
english: Suddenly, there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly army praising God, and saying,

jenjo: “Kãlɨ dɨ a və Fi dzwe, fə tãlɨ dɨ a və e ifɨ nɨ chikə kuhyi sɨ Fi tangsə fangwa nɨ.”
english: “Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men.”

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ e ikwətũ dzwe yə e igbənɨngtsa fə tə dzwe nɨ, e igbənɨngtsa de nəsələ tsa, “Bɨ tə Betalami, tə bɨ bə nɨngnɨ tswekə pɨ, nɨ Itwebɨ nə bɨ lə nɨ.”
english: When the angels went away from them into the sky, the shepherds said to one another, “Let’s go to Bethlehem, now, and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has made known to us.”

jenjo: Bɨ e tə lelang tə e chi Maryamu be Yusufu be yɨ ahyɛ̃ nɨ e kekə tang kwəngnɨng nɨngtang və nɨngtsa nɨ.
english: They came with haste, and found both Mary and Joseph, and the baby was lying in the feeding trough.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ e igbənɨngtsa bəkə yɨ ahyɛ̃ de nɨ, bɨ e nə nwabi nɨ e nə le lə ku imwə de nɨ.
english: When they saw it, they publicized widely the saying which was spoken to them about this child.

jenjo: Fə e ifɨ nɨ likə bi və e igbənɨngtsa de nɨ, sɨbi tswe le hɛ̃.
english: All who heard it wondered at the things which were spoken to them by the shepherds.

jenjo: Be Maryamu pɔ e bi de hɛ̃ nyinyi wə, son kyɛ̃ bi ku le.
english: But Mary kept all these sayings, pondering them in her heart.

jenjo: Bɨ e igbənɨngtsa de mwə nya sen tə Fi kãlɨ fə sen yənwa sɨ wə, bisɨ nɨng nɨ e likə fə nɨng le bəkə nɨ. Tswe ma nɨngnɨ e ikwətũ dzwe nə le kə lə nɨ.
english: The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, just as it was told them.

jenjo: Vi ji nwakwə, sapɨnɨ en pyɛ̃kə chi imwə de bɨ e tə dzung wə a Yeso. Dzung nɨ ikwətũ və Fi təkə pəko dɨ lɨ a ywa o nɨ.
english: When eight days were fulfilled for the circumcision of the child, his name was called Jesus, which was given by the angel before he was conceived in the womb.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ vi we mɨng tɨngkə ma nɨngnɨ lenwa və Musa nəkə nɨ. Bɨ Yusufu be Maryamu dɨ wə təkə Urushalima pɨpi Fi.
english: When the days of their purification according to the law of Moses were fulfilled, they brought him up to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord

jenjo: Hɛbələ e tswe ma nɨng nɨ e vĩkə tangsə Dəro və Fi tsa, “Ke yɨ nwachi a ibwi hɛ̃, en tə Itwebɨ Fi.”
english: (as it is written in the law of the Lord, “Every male who opens the womb shall be called holy to the Lord”),

jenjo: Fə pɨ tswe nwa nɨng hywinɨng ma nɨngnɨ e nəkə tang Dəro və Fi tsa, “E ko alo e yɨ kovə bwayung bɨ en hyɔ̃lɨ.”
english: and to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, “A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.”

jenjo: Sapɨde, Ibwi akə lə Urushalima sen dzu wə a Simiyon. Wə dɨ ifɨ a pikang nɨng Fi, fə son mwə ku wə. Son midzwi ijiku və e Israila. Kwang Fi lə ku wə.
english: Behold, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon. This man was righteous and devout, looking for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was on him.

jenjo: Kwang Fi ta wə na lə yang o bwiw bang o bə Ifɨ nɨ Fi yin gbə wə sɔ tũkə nɨ yang hĩ.
english: It had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he should not see death before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ e ichilɨ və Yeso dɨ wə wukə Kwə Fi pɨ tswe nwa nɨng hywinɨng nɨ, bɨ Kwang Fi dɨ Simiyon təkə Kwə Fi.
english: He came in the Spirit into the temple. When the parents brought in the child, Jesus, that they might do concerning him according to the custom of the law,

jenjo: Simiyon dɨ yɨ ahyɛ̃ na wə, bɨ o yənwa sɨ Fi o tsa,
english: then he received him into his arms, and blessed God, and said,

jenjo: “Itwebɨ sɨswenɨ nɨng nɨ a nəkə nɨ tswe yang. Bisɨ mambɨ a yə shə mə tə be a tãlɨ.
english: “Now you are releasing your servant, Master, according to your word, in peace;

jenjo: N bə Ijiku mə yang be nɨng mi,
english: for my eyes have seen your salvation,

jenjo: nɨ a təkə nɨng e ifafɨ hɛ̃.
english: which you have prepared before the face of all peoples;

jenjo: Imwə de yin ta e Ywavə na sɨ pɨ akəlɨ mə, fə e ifɨ a mə Israila yin chi kãlɨ bisɨ wə.”
english: a light for revelation to the nations, and the glory of your people Israel.”

jenjo: Na və imwə de be ta o likə bi nɨ e nəkə ku wə nɨ, bɨ sɨbi tswe le.
english: Joseph and his mother were marveling at the things which were spoken concerning him,

jenjo: Bɨ Simiyon tə le parkə fə tsɨ na o Maryamu tsa, “Imwə nɨ yin wukə olɨ be yilɨ və e ifafɨ kə dzungdzung tangsə Israila, on myɛkə nɨng tswasə nwa.
english: and Simeon blessed them, and said to Mary, his mother, “Behold, this child is set for the falling and the rising of many in Israel, and for a sign which is spoken against.

jenjo: Bisɨ on ji be nɨng nyi e ifɨ dzungdzung, mə a mə man chi bi a shilɨ nyi mə lɛ.”
english: Yes, a sword will pierce through your own soul, that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.”

jenjo: Iye akə lə kə ilinwa dzung wə Hana, yɨ Fanuwe pɨnyi Asher. O kywi yang o tsəvə be ha hywĩyung bɨ bwa yə bu wə,
english: There was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher (she was of a great age, having lived with a husband seven years from her virginity,

jenjo: o kukə hebwi ha nwunyə ji bwanyə son ku na Kwə Fi, son hyɔ̃ Fi fə son hywifi son pinwa kəvivi.
english: and she had been a widow for about eighty-four years), who didn’t depart from the temple, worshiping with fastings and petitions night and day.

jenjo: Be wulɨ o sɨ le, sapɨde bɨ o yənwa sɨ Fi, fə nəbi ku imwə de sɨ e ifɨ nɨ tsɨnyi le sɨ gbalɨ və e ifɨ a Urushalima le na nɨ.
english: Coming up at that very hour, she gave thanks to the Lord, and spoke of him to all those who were looking for redemption in Jerusalem.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ e tswe nɨngnɨ Lenwa və Itwebɨ nəkə nɨ hɛ̃, bɨ Yusufu be Maryamu fə tə Nazarat hywa Galili.
english: When they had accomplished all things that were according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city, Nazareth.

jenjo: Imwə de kã o myɛkə ifɨ a tsalɨ be hywĩku, fə hyĩkang və Fi lə ku wə.
english: The child was growing, and was becoming strong in spirit, being filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was upon him.

jenjo: Ha hɛ̃ e ichɨlɨ wə ku sɨn tə Nɨnglang Hyãlɨ Urushalima.
english: His parents went every year to Jerusalem at the feast of the Passover.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ ha wə təkə bwahywə ji bwayung nɨ, bɨ e tə pɨ Nɨnglang, nwa nɨng hywinɨng və le de.
english: When he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem according to the custom of the feast,

jenjo: Tswa Nɨnglang de, e ichilɨ wə fə sɨn təkə və nɨ, bɨ Yeso ku a wə Urushalima, e yipɨ lo.
english: and when they had fulfilled the days, as they were returning, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem. Joseph and his mother didn’t know it,

jenjo: Sen tsa a le o lə tangsə e ifafɨ nɨ sen hokə dzwəwɛ tsung nɨ. E ho fi tə pə ku le, bɨ e pəsɔ pɨ bapɨ wə tangsə e lənyɔ be e tswə le.
english: but supposing him to be in the company, they went a day’s journey, and they looked for him among their relatives and acquaintances.

jenjo: E chi wə lo, bɨ fə e tə Urushalima pɨ bapɨ wə.
english: When they didn’t find him, they returned to Jerusalem, looking for him.

jenjo: Pu le a nɨng bwətə a bapɨ wə, bɨ tə e chi wə Kwə Fi. O ku be e inyinasɨ lenwa son li le, fə son bi le bi.
english: After three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the middle of the teachers, both listening to them, and asking them questions.

jenjo: Ke e ifɨ nɨ li wə hɛ̃, sɨbi tswe le be yinagang bi be kwəlɨ a bi o.
english: All who heard him were amazed at his understanding and his answers.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ tə e chi wə kə nɨ, sɨbi tswe le. Na o tsɨ wə tsa, “Yɨ mi, nwu a tswe bɨ mambɨ? Mi be ta mə bɨ wanchə sɨ bɨn bapɨ mə.”
english: When they saw him, they were astonished, and his mother said to him, “Son, why have you treated us this way? Behold, your father and I were anxiously looking for you.”

jenjo: Dɨbɨ Yeso bi le tsa, “Dɨ bə tswe sɨ ban bapɨ mi? Ba yipɨ dɨ pɨ kulɨ mi ho tang və ta mi lɔ?”
english: He said to them, “Why were you looking for me? Didn’t you know that I must be in my Father’s house?”

jenjo: Be e yi chi bi de son nə le lə nɨ lo.
english: They didn’t understand the saying which he spoke to them.

jenjo: O tə Nazarat tsung be le ku son li nwa le. Lehɛ̃ na o pwɔ bi de hɛ̃ nyi wə.
english: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth. He was subject to them, and his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.

jenjo: Bɨ Yeso wu myɛkə ifafɨ, o yuyulɨ o chi kuhĩ sɨ Fi be e ifafɨ hɛ̃.
english: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and men.

jenjo: Fi nə bi be Yohana yɨ Zakariya nyi hu. Hywapɨ de, Kaisar Tibariya tswe ha bwali ku kəzɛ̃ Roma, Buntus Bilatus ku kəzɛ̃ Yahudiya, Hiridus Antipas ku Galili, dɨ hywĩ wə Filibu ku Ituriya be Tarakunitas, bɨ Lisaniyas ku Abilenes. Hywa pɨ de dɨ Hanana be Kayafa kə e ivə və e ihyɔ̃nɨng və Fi.
english: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of the region of Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene,

jenjo: Yohana tə hywa nwa mɨng Urdun be nyɔ̃ hywa sɨ wə hɛ̃, son tenwa, o tsa, “Ba myɛ ba yə nɨng abe və bə, ba tswe Bɔtismɔ bisɨ Fi e nyi hywa sɨ e nɨng abe və bə.”
english: He came into all the region around the Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for remission of sins.

jenjo: Ma nɨng nɨ Ishaya Ilinwa və Fi vĩkə tang dəro nɨ tsɨkə, “Wi ifɨ akə sɨn dzupɨ nyi hu, ‘Ba mə nɨhyã bisɨ wulɨ və Itwebɨ, ba mə pɨ holɨ o chĩ hywa.
english: As it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet, “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make ready the way of the Lord. Make his paths straight.

jenjo: Ke nvɔ hɛ̃ en e hywa yɨlə, ke te hɛ̃ en gba yə ku hywa. Nɨhyã a kwalɨ en chĩ hywa, ke pɨ nɨ kə gugu hɛ̃, en mwə en gba losə.
english: Every valley will be filled. Every mountain and hill will be brought low. The crooked will become straight, and the rough ways smooth.

jenjo: E ifɨ hɛ̃ yin bə jiku və Fi.’ ”
english: All flesh will see God’s salvation.’”

jenjo: E ifɨ nɨ sɨn wukə sɨ Yohana bisɨ o tswe le bɔtismɔ lə nɨ, o tsɨ le tsa, “Bə e yɨ chilɨ və tso abe! Yə dɨ wə tsɨ bə, ba hywi sɨ za'a nəlɨ nɨ sɨn wukə nɨ?
english: He said therefore to the multitudes who went out to be baptized by him, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

jenjo: Ba tswe e nɨng nɨ yin ta nalə, ba myɛ ba yə tswelɨ ayibe və bə yang. Be bi ban nyi bi ban tsa, bɨ dɨ e pɨnyi Ibrahim yɛ. Fi pa myɛ e te nɨ tsɨkə nɨ, kə e yɨ Ibrahim myɛ.
english: Therefore produce fruits worthy of repentance, and don’t begin to say among yourselves, ‘We have Abraham for our father;’ for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones!

jenjo: E pə nwa tswə yang sũnyi e kə, te kə nɨ chikə yɨ a pikang lo hɛ̃, en kwɛ wə en gbətə dzwa.”
english: Even now the ax also lies at the root of the trees. Every tree therefore that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down, and thrown into the fire.”

jenjo: E ifafɨ bi Yohana tsa, “Mambɨ yang, yə dɨbə a yidi bɨ tswe?”
english: The multitudes asked him, “What then must we do?”

jenjo: Yohana kwə nwa le tsa, “Ifɨ nɨ be sayikə bwayung yang, o tə ifɨ nɨ ywang kə lo nɨ tsɨng. Ifɨ nɨ lə be nɨngtang yang, o tswe mambɨ.”
english: He answered them, “He who has two coats, let him give to him who has none. He who has food, let him do likewise.”

jenjo: E ifɨ dɨ sede gbaku wu bisɨ e tswe le bɔtismɔ lə, dɨbɨ e bi wə e tsa, “Inyi nasɨ nɨng, dɨbə de bɨn tswelɨ?”
english: Tax collectors also came to be baptized, and they said to him, “Teacher, what must we do?”

jenjo: O kwə nwa le o tsa, “Bi ban dɨ nɨng na e ifɨ pe sɨ nɨng nɨ e tũ bə pɨ dɨlɨ nɨ yɛ.”
english: He said to them, “Collect no more than that which is appointed to you.”

jenjo: E itabwi akə bi wə tsa, “Yə bɨ a bɨ, dɨbə bɨn tswelɨ?” Yohana kwə nwa le tsa, “Bi ban dɨ sede na e ifɨ be sambe yɛ, bi ban wəbi ku e ifɨ kə nwanyɔ yɛ. Ba tsɨ sũnu və bə ku nɨngnɨ sen fə bə nɨ, lo bə ləyang.”
english: Soldiers also asked him, saying, “What about us? What must we do?” He said to them, “Extort from no one by violence, neither accuse anyone wrongfully. Be content with your wages.”

jenjo: E ifɨ hɛ̃ tsɨ nyi le sɨ wulɨ və ifɨ nɨ Fi gba wə sɔ nɨ, dɨbɨ e nyadi sen yidi pɨyipɨ lakə dɨ Yohana kə ifɨ de.
english: As the people were in expectation, and all men reasoned in their hearts concerning John, whether perhaps he was the Christ,

jenjo: Bɨ Yohana tsɨ le tsa, “Min tswe bə bɔtismɔ be mɨng yinfa, ifɨ akə lə sɨn wulɨ nɨ pe mi be kãlɨ, busɨ be hũ o n pa pĩlɨw bisɨ kãlɨ mi tə lo. On tswe bə bɔtismɔ be Kwang Fi be dzwa.
english: John answered them all, “I indeed baptize you with water, but he comes who is mightier than I, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to loosen. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit and fire,

jenjo: O lə be ji yenɨng o na, on ye e wəng hɛ̃ on jikə sɨ e nɨngnɨng, on pwɔ e nɨngnɨng de on e tang pa. E wəng hɛ̃ on e le tangsə dzwa nɨ sɨn tswə̃kə nyitɨngkuwə ywang nɨ.”
english: whose fan is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor, and will gather the wheat into his barn; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”

jenjo: Yohana tswe təbəle ihyãnɨng bisɨ o nə e ifafɨ bi alalɨ və Fi lə, e pwə sɨ le tsa, bisɨ e yə pale və le nɨ hyĩkə lo nɨ.
english: Then with many other exhortations he preached good news to the people,

jenjo: Vi akə lə nɨ, Yohana tswe e ifafɨ bɔtismɔ, tswa wə, bɨ Yeso be ku wə wu o tswe wə bɔtismɔ lə. Sapɨnɨ son pĩ ngwa nɨ, bɨ dzwe be, Kwang Fi pĩ hywa ku wə, jisə be ko. Wi akə kwə dzwe tsa, “Dɨ mə kə yɨ mi akang nɨ sɨ min yidi kə nɨ. Min li lalɨ a mə.” Yohana go Hiridus Antipas nɨ ku kəzɛ̃ Galili nɨ, bisɨ o tsə Hirudiya he hywĩ wə Filibu. Be nyɔ e nɨng ihyãnɨng o tswekə hywiwə lo nɨ. Dɨbɨ Hiridus yiku ayibe o, bisɨ o mwə Yohana o tsə kwəsɨnang.
english: but Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias, his brother’s wife, and for all the evil things which Herod had done,

jenjo: Yeso be ha nwutsɨng ji hywə, bɨ o pəsɔ nwatũ və Fi tangsə e ifafɨ. E ifɨ ku sen tsɨ a le wə dɨ yɨ Yusufu. Yusufu və Heli
english: Jesus himself, when he began to teach, was about thirty years old, being the son (as was supposed) of Joseph, the son of Heli,

jenjo: Heli və Matat Matat və Lawi Lawi və Malki Malki və Yanna Yanna və Yusufu
english: the son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melchi, the son of Jannai, the son of Joseph,

jenjo: Yusufu və Matatiya Matatiya və Amos Amos və Nahum Nahum və Azaliya Azaliya və Najaya
english: the son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,

jenjo: Najaya və Maata Maata və Matatiya Matatiya və Shimeya Shimeya və Yosek Yosek və Yoda
english: the son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Semein, the son of Joseph, the son of Judah,

jenjo: Yoda və Yowanan Yowanan və Resa Resa və Zerubabel Zerubabel və Sheyaltiyel Sheyaltiyel və Niri
english: the son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the son of Neri,

jenjo: Niri və Malki Malki və Adi Adi və Kosama Kosama və Elmadama Elmadama və Er
english: the son of Melchi, the son of Addi, the son of Cosam, the son of Elmodam, the son of Er,

jenjo: Er və Yoshuwa Yoshuwa və Eliyeza Eliyeza və Yorim Yorim və Matat Matat və Lawi
english: the son of Jose, the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi,

jenjo: Lawi və Simiyon Simiyon və Yahuda Yahuda və Yusufu Yusufu və Yonam Yonam və Eliyakim
english: the son of Simeon, the son of Judah, the son of Joseph, the son of Jonan, the son of Eliakim,

jenjo: Eliyakim və Meleya Meleya və Mena Mena və Matata Matata və Natan Natan və Dauda
english: the son of Melea, the son of Menan, the son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan, the son of David,

jenjo: Dauda və Yesse Yesse və Obed Obed və Bowaza Bowaza və Salmon Salmon və Nashon
english: the son of Jesse, the son of Obed, the son of Boaz, the son of Salmon, the son of Nahshon,

jenjo: Nashon və Aminadab Aminadab və Admin Admin və Arni Arni və Hezron Hezron və Perez Perez və Yahuda
english: the son of Amminadab, the son of Aram, the son of Hezron, the son of Perez, the son of Judah,

jenjo: Yahuda və Yakubu Yakubu və Ishaku Ishaku və Ibrahim Ibrahim və Tera Tera və Nahor
english: the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the son of Terah, the son of Nahor,

jenjo: Nahor və Serug Serug və Reyu Reyu və Peleg Peleg və Eber Eber və Shela
english: the son of Serug, the son of Reu, the son of Peleg, the son of Eber, the son of Shelah,

jenjo: Shela və Kenan Kenan və Arfakshad Arfakshad və Shem Shem və Nuhu Nuhu və Lamek
english: the son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,

jenjo: Lamek və Metusela Metusela və Enok Enok və Jared Jared və Mahalalel Mahalalel və Kenan
english: the son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalaleel, the son of Cainan,

jenjo: Kenan və Enosh Enosh və Set Set və Adamu Adamu a yɨ Fi.
english: the son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.

jenjo: Yeso mwə nya yə na hywa Urdun. O yɨlə be Kwang Fi, bɨ Kwang Fi de dɨ wə təkə nyi hu.
english: Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan, and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness

jenjo: Pu wə nwuyung pɨbi, Nɨnɨngvi sɨn hakəpu wə. O tangnɨng lo, hwə mwə wə mwələ.
english: for forty days, being tempted by the devil. He ate nothing in those days. Afterward, when they were completed, he was hungry.

jenjo: Nɨnɨngvi tsɨ wə tsa, “Aba mə dɨ Yɨ Fi kə a kəng yang, a myɛ te nɨ kə nɨngtang.”
english: The devil said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command this stone to become bread.”

jenjo: Yeso kwə nwa wə tsa, “Dəro və Fi tsa, ‘Be nɨngtang tsɨng kə ifafɨ jiku lo.’ ”
english: Jesus answered him, saying, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.’”

jenjo: Nɨnɨngvi ochi bɨ tə be wə ku pɨ a pĩlɨ, o ta wə na sɨ fangwa be kãlɨ wə hɛ̃ nabi.
english: The devil, leading him up on a high mountain, showed him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.

jenjo: Bɨ o tsa, “Min tə mə tsɨkunɨng ku fangwa be kãlɨ wə hɛ̃, bisɨ fangwa be e nɨng sɨ wə hɛ̃ le na mi. Ifɨ nɨ nyi mi dɨkə hɛ̃ dɨ wə min təlɨ.
english: The devil said to him, “I will give you all this authority, and their glory, for it has been delivered to me; and I give it to whomever I want.

jenjo: Aba a hyɔ̃ mi yang, fangwa hɛ̃ yin myɛkə a mə.”
english: If you therefore will worship before me, it will all be yours.”

jenjo: Yeso kwə nwa wə tsa, “E vĩ tang Dəro və Fi tsa, ‘A hyɔ̃ itwemə Fi, fə dɨ wə tsɨng man tswe shə o.’ ”
english: Jesus answered him, “Get behind me Satan! For it is written, ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.’”

jenjo: Nɨnɨngvi dɨ wə təkə Urushalima o tə be wə ləlɨ ku Kwə Fi, bɨ tsɨ wa, “Aba mə dɨ Yɨ Fi kə a kəng yang a hywə hywa pɨnɨ.
english: He led him to Jerusalem, and set him on the pinnacle of the temple, and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, cast yourself down from here,

jenjo: Bisɨ e vĩvĩ tang Dəro və Fi tsa, “ ‘On tũ e ikwətũ o dzwe wu en kang mə.
english: for it is written, ‘He will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you;’

jenjo: ‘En ke mə be na le, bi pu mə gbə sɨ te.’ ”
english: and, ‘On their hands they will bear you up, lest perhaps you dash your foot against a stone.’”

jenjo: Yeso kwə nwa wə tsa, “Fə Dəro və Fi tsa, ‘Bi man le be pɨ nyi Itwemə Fi yɛ.’ ”
english: Jesus answering, said to him, “It has been said, ‘You shall not tempt the Lord your God.’”

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ Nɨnɨngvi ha kəpu wə tɨngkə nɨ, bɨ o yə wə bang fə o chi na yang hĩ.
english: When the devil had completed every temptation, he departed from him until another time.

jenjo: Yeso fə wu Galili be sambe və Kwang Fi. Bi o wə lopɨ hɛ̃ hywa de.
english: Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee, and news about him spread through all the surrounding area.

jenjo: Son nyi le nasɨ nɨng pɨkwəsəku və e Yahuda, e ifafɨ hɛ̃ sɨn yənwa sɨ wə.
english: He taught in their synagogues, being glorified by all.

jenjo: Bɨ Yeso fə tə Nazarat pɨnɨ o kã kə lə nɨ. Ma tswelɨ və e ifɨ Yahuda, e tə pɨkwəsəku Vi Hũlɨ, bɨ o yi o tsɨpu bisɨ o sa Dəro və Fi.
english: He came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up. He entered, as was his custom, into the synagogue on the Sabbath day, and stood up to read.

jenjo: Bɨ e be pɨnɨ Ilinwa Iliya vĩkə nɨ bɨ e tə wə tə. O mwə o pĩ hywa bɨ o chi pɨnɨ e vĩkə tsa,
english: The book of the prophet Isaiah was handed to him. He opened the book, and found the place where it was written,

jenjo: “Kwang Itwemi Fi ku mi, bisɨ o gbə mi sɔ lə yang n wu be bi alalɨ wu n tə e ibe ifɨ. O tũ mi wu n wa be sɨ e ifɨ nɨ e tsə le kə nɨ n tə e igbanɨng bəlɨ a pɨ, wu n pĩ e ifɨ ibe n lena,
english: “The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent me to heal the broken hearted, to proclaim release to the captives, recovering of sight to the blind, to deliver those who are crushed,

jenjo: wun tenwa n tsa hywapɨ tswe yang nɨ Itwebɨ wun wa e ifɨ o lena nɨ.”
english: and to proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord.”

jenjo: Bɨ fə o mwə dəro de o kwɛlə, o tə mwambwi pɨ de bɨ tə o ku hywa. E ifafɨ hɛ̃ pɨkwəsəku de tsɨ nɨng sɨ wə.
english: He closed the book, gave it back to the attendant, and sat down. The eyes of all in the synagogue were fastened on him.

jenjo: Bɨ o pəsɔ be bi o tsɨ le, “Jɛnɨ nɨng nɨ e vĩkə tang dəro nɨ tswe yang kə akang, ba li yang be bwajang bə.”
english: He began to tell them, “Today, this Scripture has been fulfilled in your hearing.”

jenjo: Le hɛ̃ e nə bi a pikang ku wə, fə sɨ le la le be bi a hĩlɨ nɨ sɨn jikə nwa wə nɨ. Ku sen bipɨ, “Dɨ yɨ Yusufu nɨ lo?”
english: All testified about him, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth, and they said, “Isn’t this Joseph’s son?”

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ le tsa, “N yipɨ yang ban dɨ nwadũ nɨ tsɨka, ‘Itəhu, a tə ku mə njəmu! E nɨng nɨ bɨ li a tswekə Kaparnahum nɨ, a tswe və mə.’ ”
english: He said to them, “Doubtless you will tell me this parable, ‘Physician, heal yourself! Whatever we have heard done at Capernaum, do also here in your hometown.’”

jenjo: Bɨ fə Yeso tsɨ le tsa, “Kə akang sɨ min nə bə lə, en kwə ilinwa lo və wə.
english: He said, “Most certainly I tell you, no prophet is acceptable in his hometown.

jenjo: Ba li mi. Kə akang e hebwi lə ihyãnɨng Israila hywapɨ və Iliya Ilinwa. Sapɨnɨ mɨng la pɨ nəlɨ ha bwatə be hywĩhwyĩ hywĩtsɨng nɨ. Fə hwə dzu hywa de hɛ̃.
english: But truly I tell you, there were many widows in Israel in the days of Elijah, when the sky was shut up three years and six months, when a great famine came over all the land.

jenjo: Lehɛ̃ e tũ Iliya sɨ ifɨ akə lo, be le sɨ hebwi nɨ Zarefat hywa Sidon nɨ.
english: Elijah was sent to none of them, except to Zarephath, in the land of Sidon, to a woman who was a widow.

jenjo: Fə e ifɨ ihyãnɨng sɨn tswe ibe be dzwasɨ hywa Israila, hywapɨ və Elisha Ilinwa. Lehɛ̃ ifɨ nɨ chikə njamu nɨ ywang dɨ Naman ifɨ a Suriya tsɨng.”
english: There were many lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet, yet not one of them was cleansed, except Naaman, the Syrian.”

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ e ifɨ nɨ pɨkwəsəku likə mambɨ nɨ, le hɛ̃ e pwəchi e yɨlə dɨng dɨng.
english: They were all filled with wrath in the synagogue, as they heard these things.

jenjo: E yi e tsɨpu, e fɨ wə e jikə tangsə və, bɨ e tə be wə ləlɨ nwa te nɨ e mikə və le ku wə nɨ. Sen yidi pɨ to wə le hywa pɨ bi.
english: They rose up, threw him out of the city, and led him to the brow of the hill that their city was built on, that they might throw him off the cliff.

jenjo: Sen bəlɨ, bɨ o pa o ji tangsə le o tə tə lɨ o.
english: But he, passing through the middle of them, went his way.

jenjo: Tswa wə Yeso tə Kaparnahum və akə hywa Galili, o pəsɔ pɨ nyi e ifɨ na sɨ nɨng Vi Hũlɨ.
english: He came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee. He was teaching them on the Sabbath day,

jenjo: Le hɛ̃ sen li lalɨ be nihyã nyina sɨ nɨng o, bisɨ sambe lə sɨ bi a nəlɨ o.
english: and they were astonished at his teaching, for his word was with authority.

jenjo: Pɨkwəsəku və e Yahuda de, ifɨ akə lə nɨngvi ku wə. O ki nwakwəng be wi kɔ̃kɔ̃,
english: In the synagogue there was a man who had a spirit of an unclean demon, and he cried out with a loud voice,

jenjo: “E! Yeso mwe Nazarat, dɨ bə a yidi be bɨ kə? A wu pɨ bang bɨ kə? N yi dɨ mə kə wəde yang! Mə dɨ Ifɨ a Kĩlɨ və Fi!”
english: saying, “Ah! what have we to do with you, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know you who you are: the Holy One of God!”

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ nɨngvi de tsa, “A kwə nwa mə lə! A pa a ji sɨ wə!” Bɨ nɨngvi dɨ ifɨ de gbə hywa pɨpi le hɛ̃, bɨ o ji o yə wə nɨngdzwa ywang.
english: Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be silent, and come out of him!” When the demon had thrown him down in the middle of them, he came out of him, having done him no harm.

jenjo: Sɨbi tswe e ifɨ hɛ̃ sen nəsə bi bwa le sen tsa, “Dɨ na nyilɨ asɨnɨng və e bə nɨ? Be tsikunɨng be sambe, bɨ ibwi nɨ go e nɨngvi ku sen jilɨ!”
english: Amazement came on all, and they spoke together, one with another, saying, “What is this word? For with authority and power he commands the unclean spirits, and they come out!”

jenjo: Bɨ bi və Yeso wə lo hywa de hɛ̃.
english: News about him went out into every place of the surrounding region.

jenjo: Yeso yə pɨkwəsəku de bɨ o tə və Siman Bitulu. Tsa Siman lwe hywa be nɨngshi mpwe, bɨ e kũ Yeso bisɨ tə pələ wə.
english: He rose up from the synagogue, and entered into Simon’s house. Simon’s mother-in-law was afflicted with a great fever, and they begged him for her.

jenjo: Yeso tə tsɨ ku wə nɨ, o go mpwe bɨ mpwe de ji. Lelang iye de yi hywa pəsɔ pɨ mwə le dzwəwɛ.
english: He stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her. Immediately she rose up and served them.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ fi tə pɨ o bwa nɨ, e ifafɨ wu be e ifɨ nɨngshi tsɨngtsɨng sɨ Yeso. O pang sɨ le be na, o tɨng nɨngshi və le.
english: When the sun was setting, all those who had any sick with various diseases brought them to him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.

jenjo: Fə e nɨngvi ji sɨ e ifɨ ihyãnɨng be nwakwəng sen tsa, “Mə dɨ Yɨ Fi!” Yeso pwəchi sɨ le, o yə le e nəbi lo, bisɨ e yipɨ yang dɨ wə bɨ Fi Gbə wə sɔ lə.
english: Demons also came out of many, crying out, and saying, “You are the Christ, the Son of God!” Rebuking them, he didn’t allow them to speak, because they knew that he was the Christ.

jenjo: Pɨ kəkə nɨ, Yeso ji tə pɨnɨ ifɨ akə ywang nɨ. E ifɨ pəsɔ pɨ bapɨ wə. Sapɨnɨ tə e chi wə kə nɨ, e yidi o yə le lo.
english: When it was day, he departed and went into an uninhabited place, and the multitudes looked for him, and came to him, and held on to him, so that he wouldn’t go away from them.

jenjo: Bɨ o tsa, “Tɔle n nə bi alalɨ və Fi nyɔ e hywa akə, bisɨ dɨ nɨngnɨ e tũ mi kə bisɨ wə ho.”
english: But he said to them, “I must preach the good news of God’s Kingdom to the other cities also. For this reason I have been sent.”

jenjo: Bɨ son nə bi və Fi pɨkwəsəku hywa Yahudiya hɛ̃.
english: He was preaching in the synagogues of Galilee.

jenjo: Vi akə lə Yeso tsɨ nwa nvɔ mɨng a kã nɨ sen dzukə Jenisarat nɨ, bɨ e ifafɨ hyəngpɨ wu kwɛ wə le tangsə bisɨ e li bi və Fi.
english: Now while the multitude pressed on him and heard the word of God, he was standing by the lake of Gennesaret.

jenjo: Yeso bə fə bwayung nwa mɨng de. E ifɨ dzwi mɨng bwayung pĩ ngwa tang fə ku sen lo ka və le.
english: He saw two boats standing by the lake, but the fishermen had gone out of them, and were washing their nets.

jenjo: Yeso pĩ tang fə a tsɨng, a pɨnɨ kə a və Siman nɨ, bɨ o tsɨ wə tsa, “A to fə de a yə nwa ngwa tswənɨ.” Dɨbɨ o ku tang fə son nyi e ifɨ na sɨ nɨng.
english: He entered into one of the boats, which was Simon’s, and asked him to put out a little from the land. He sat down and taught the multitudes from the boat.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ o nə bi tɨngkə nɨ, bɨ o tsɨ Siman tsa, “A to fə de a le nɨng mɨng, yə a le e ka mə a mwə hyɨng.”
english: When he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, “Put out into the deep, and let down your nets for a catch.”

jenjo: Siman kwə nwa wə tsa, “Itwevə, bɨ tswe nwatũ nvi hɛ̃ bɨ mwə nɨng akə lo, lehɛ̃ bisɨ a nə bi yang bɨn le ka de le.”
english: Simon answered him, “Master, we worked all night, and took nothing; but at your word I will let down the net.”

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ e le ka tɨngkə nɨ, e mwə hyɨng ihyãnɨng. Ka və le pəsɔ pɨ hyənglɨ.
english: When they had done this, they caught a great multitude of fish, and their net was breaking.

jenjo: Bɨ e dzupɨ e sə tswe nwatũ və le tang fə a tsɨng bisɨ wu e pələ le. Wu e e hyɨng yɨ fə bwayung, bɨ fə pəsɔ pɨ tãlɨ.
english: They beckoned to their partners in the other boat, that they should come and help them. They came, and filled both boats, so that they began to sink.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ Siman Bitulu bə nɨng nɨ tswekəpɨ nɨ, bɨ o pə dzwang wə hywa pi Yeso o tsa, “Itwemi, a yə nɨhyã mi, mi dɨ ifɨ nɨng abe!”
english: But Simon Peter, when he saw it, fell down at Jesus’ knees, saying, “Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, Lord.”

jenjo: Bisɨ wə be nyɔ e ifɨ nɨ le tsung hɛ̃ nɨ, sɨbi tswe le yang sɨ hyɨng nɨ e mwəkə ihyãnɨng nɨ.
english: For he was amazed, and all who were with him, at the catch of fish which they had caught;

jenjo: Mambɨ sɨbi tswe e sə nwatũ və Siman, Yakubu be Yohana e yɨ Zabadi. Yeso tsɨ Siman tsa, “Bi man bibi yɛ. Chi nɨ man fɨ dɨ e ifafɨ man wukə sɨ mi.”
english: and so also were James and John, sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon. Jesus said to Simon, “Don’t be afraid. From now on you will be catching people alive.”

jenjo: Bɨ e fɨ fə və le e tsɨtə ngwa, e hywã nasɨ e nɨng və le hɛ̃, e mwə nyi wə.
english: When they had brought their boats to land, they left everything, and followed him.

jenjo: Hywa akə lə Yeso tə dzwəwɛ və akə, ibwi akə lə pɨbi kə idzwasɨ. Sapɨnɨ o bəkə Yeso nɨ bɨ o pə dzwəng wə hywa pi wə fə o kũ wə o tsa, “Itwemi, aba a kwələ yang, pa man tɨng dzwasɨ mi tɨng.”
english: While he was in one of the cities, behold, there was a man full of leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell on his face, and begged him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”

jenjo: Yeso chĩ na pang sɨ ibwi de bɨ tsa, “N kwələ yang. Dzwasɨ mə tɨng.” Lelang dzwasɨ pəchĩ yə sɨ wə.
english: He stretched out his hand, and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately the leprosy left him.

jenjo: Fə Yeso tsɨ wə tsa, “Bi man nə ifɨ akə lə yɛ. A tə sɨ ihyɔ̃nɨng tə bə mə. A fə ku mə ma lelɨ a nwa və Musa, ku loli və ifɨ. Bisɨ e ifɨ yipɨ dzwasɨ mə tɨng yang.”
english: He commanded him to tell no one, “But go your way, and show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing according to what Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”

jenjo: Bɨ bi və Yeso wə lopɨ hɛ̃, e ifɨ kə dzung dzung wu sɨn li bi və Fi nwa wə, wu son tɨng nɨngshi və le.
english: But the report concerning him spread much more, and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed by him of their infirmities.

jenjo: Lehɛ̃ e vi akə lə nɨ Yeso yi sɨn tə pɨ nɨ ifɨ akə ywang pɨbi nɨ, tə son pinwa.
english: But he withdrew himself into the desert, and prayed.

jenjo: Vi akə lə nɨ, Yeso ku sɨn nyi na sɨ hu, e Farisa be e inyi nasɨ lenwa və Musa nɨ ji Galili be Urushalima be nyɔ hywa de hɛ̃ lə pɨbi. Fə sambe və Itwenɨng Hɛ̃ lə ku Yeso hɛbələ o tɨng nɨngshi və e ifɨ.
english: On one of those days, he was teaching; and there were Pharisees and teachers of the law sitting by, who had come out of every village of Galilee, Judea, and Jerusalem. The power of the Lord was with him to heal them.

jenjo: E ifɨ akə dɨ ibwi akə kə ibwisɨ, e tsə wə be ki, sen yidi pɨ tə be wə tang və sɨ Yeso.
english: Behold, men brought a paralyzed man on a cot, and they sought to bring him in to lay before Jesus.

jenjo: E chi nɨhyã lo bisɨ dzung və e ifafɨ. Bɨ e pĩ e kə ku kwə, e le wə hywa be ki o, tangsə e ifafɨ pɨpi Yeso.
english: Not finding a way to bring him in because of the multitude, they went up to the housetop, and let him down through the tiles with his cot into the middle before Jesus.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ Yeso bə pəlɨ a nyi və le nɨ, o tsɨ ibwi de tsa, “Tswə mi, n e nyi hywa sɨ nɨng abe mə yang.”
english: Seeing their faith, he said to him, “Man, your sins are forgiven you.”

jenjo: E inyi nasɨ lenwa və Musa, be e Farisa pəsɔ pɨ nəsələ bwa le, sen tsa, “Dɨ wə sɨn nə bi byɔ pɨpi Fi ma nɨ? Dɨ Fi tsɨng bɨ sɨn e nyi hywa sɨ nɨng abe lo?”
english: The scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, “Who is this that speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?”

jenjo: Yeso yipɨ bi a nyilɨ və le yang, bɨ o tsɨ le tsa, “Dɨ bə tswe ku sɨ ban nyibi mambɨ nyi bə?
english: But Jesus, perceiving their thoughts, answered them, “Why are you reasoning so in your hearts?

jenjo: Dɨ ake shi nəlɨ, ‘N e nyi hywa sɨ nɨng abe mə yang,’ alo, ‘Yi a tsɨpu a tə’?
english: Which is easier to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven you;’ or to say, ‘Arise and walk?’

jenjo: Lehɛ̃ bisɨ ba yipɨ Yɨ Ifafɨ lə be tsɨkunɨng e nyi hywa sɨ nɨng abe və e ifɨ fangwa.” Bɨ o tsɨ ibwisɨ de tsa, “N tsɨ mə a yi, a kwa ki mə yə a tə və!”
english: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins” (he said to the paralyzed man), “I tell you, arise, and take up your cot, and go to your house.”

jenjo: Lelang, ibwi de yi tsɨpu pɨpi le hɛ̃, o kwa ki lwelɨ o bɨ o tə və son yənwa sɨ Fi.
english: Immediately he rose up before them, and took up that which he was laying on, and departed to his house, glorifying God.

jenjo: E ifɨ hɛ̃ kwəng le yi sɨ le, fə sɨbi tswe le, e yənwa sɨ Fi sen tsa, “Bɨ bə nɨng bisɨ yang jɛnɨ.”
english: Amazement took hold on all, and they glorified God. They were filled with fear, saying, “We have seen strange things today.”

jenjo: Tswa wə, Yeso ji bɨ o bə ifɨ bwi sede gbaku akə, dzung wə a Levi. o ku pɨ nwatũ o. Yeso tsɨ wə tsa, “A mwə nyi mi.”
english: After these things he went out, and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the tax office, and said to him, “Follow me!”

jenjo: Levi gbahywa yi tsɨpu, o hywã nasɨ nyɔ nɨng hɛ̃ bɨ o mwə nyi wə.
english: He left everything, and rose up and followed him.

jenjo: Bɨ Levi ywi nɨngtang ihyãnɨng tang və wə bisɨ Yeso. E ifɨ dɨ sede gbaku be e ifɨ kə dzung dzung wu pɨ nɨngtang de.
english: Levi made a great feast for him in his house. There was a great crowd of tax collectors and others who were reclining with them.

jenjo: E Farisi be e inyi nasɨ lenwa və Musa tangsə le wu nəbi nyitswi sɨ e mwambwi və Yeso tsa, “Dɨ bə tswe sɨ ban tangnɨng be e ifɨ bwi sede gbaku be e ifɨ nɨng abe lɨ?”
english: Their scribes and the Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, “Why do you eat and drink with the tax collectors and sinners?”

jenjo: Yeso kwə nwa le tsa, “E ifɨ njamu sɨn bapɨ itəhu lo, be dɨ e ifɨ nɨngshi.
english: Jesus answered them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.

jenjo: Oho! N wu pɨ dzupɨ e ifɨ a pikang mwə myɛ lo, be dɨ e ifɨ nɨng abe.”
english: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”

jenjo: Fə e tsɨ Yeso tsa, “E mwambwi və Yohana sen hywifi kəvivi sen pinwa, fə a və e Farisa mambɨ, be e mwambwi mə ku sen tang ku sen nwalɨ.”
english: They said to him, “Why do John’s disciples often fast and pray, likewise also the disciples of the Pharisees, but yours eat and drink?”

jenjo: Yeso kwə nwa le tsa, “E tswə bu iye a hu ban tsɨ le tsa e hywifi sapɨnɨ le lə tsung be wə bɨtsɨng nɨ?
english: He said to them, “Can you make the friends of the bridegroom fast, while the bridegroom is with them?

jenjo: Hywapɨ sɨn wulɨ nɨ en dɨkə bu iye a hu en yə tangsə le. Sapɨ de en hywifi hywi.”
english: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them. Then they will fast in those days.”

jenjo: Yeso nə le bi akə lə tsa, “Ifɨ hyəng nwa nɨngji a hu pekə zənɨngjiw. O tswe mambɨ yang, on hyəng nɨngji o a hu hyəng, fə pa jisə be zənɨngjiwu.
english: He also told a parable to them. “No one puts a piece from a new garment on an old garment, or else he will tear the new, and also the piece from the new will not match the old.

jenjo: Mambɨ ifɨ akə pa e mɨng inabi a hu tang ho mbla akywi nɨ wɔ tɨngkə nɨw. Aba o tswe mambɨ yang, mɨng inabi a hu de yin pwə fə yin gba ho mbla a kywi de, mɨng inabi de yin te hywa, ho mbla de yin bangkəbang.
english: No one puts new wine into old wine skins, or else the new wine will burst the skins, and it will be spilled, and the skins will be destroyed.

jenjo: Oho! Mɨng inabi a hu sen e le təng ho mbla a hu.
english: But new wine must be put into fresh wine skins, and both are preserved.

jenjo: Dɨbɨ ho mambɨ, Ifɨ nɨ yidi pɨ nwa mɨng inabi a hu tswa a kywi nɨ ywang, bisɨ on tsa akywi pe a hu yang.”
english: No man having drunk old wine immediately desires new, for he says, ‘The old is better.’”

jenjo: Vi akə Yeso be e mwambwi O ku sɨn ho nwa fanɨng Vi Hũlɨ, e mwambwi o hywɛ tswɨtswi mu, bɨ wi be na ku sen tanglɨ.
english: Now on the second Sabbath after the first, he was going through the grain fields. His disciples plucked the heads of grain and ate, rubbing them in their hands.

jenjo: E Farisa akə bi le tsa, “Dɨ bisɨ bə sɨ ban tswe nɨng nɨ lenwa və bɨ nəkə tsa bi en tswe Vi Hũlɨ yɛ?”
english: But some of the Pharisees said to them, “Why do you do that which is not lawful to do on the Sabbath day?”

jenjo: Yeso kwə nwa le tsa, “Ba sa pɨ nɨ Dəro və Fi nəkə nɨng nɨ Dauda be e ifɨ o tswekə sapɨnɨ hwə mwə le kə nɨ lo?
english: Jesus, answering them, said, “Haven’t you read what David did when he was hungry, he, and those who were with him;

jenjo: O tə tang Kwə və Fi, o dɨ nɨngtang a kyĩlɨ nɨ e tswekə bisɨ e ihyɔ̃nɨng nɨ, o tang fə o tə e ifɨ o tang bɨ. Lehɛ̃ təsəsɨ lo be lenwa və Musa.”
english: how he entered into God’s house, and took and ate the show bread, and gave also to those who were with him, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests alone?”

jenjo: Bɨ Yeso tsɨ le tsa, “Yɨ Ifafɨ dɨ Itwe Vi Hũlɨ.”
english: He said to them, “The Son of Man is lord of the Sabbath.”

jenjo: Vi Hũlɨ akə lə nɨ, Yeso tə pɨkwəsəku və e Yahuda tə nyi na sɨ nɨng. Ibwi akə lə pɨbi kəna wə a nali bwi yang.
english: It also happened on another Sabbath that he entered into the synagogue and taught. There was a man there, and his right hand was withered.

jenjo: E inyi nasɨ lenwa və Musa be e Farisa sɨn pang pɨ nɨhya nɨ en mwəkə Yeso be ayibe nɨ, bɨ e tsɨ nɨng sɨ wə a on tɨng nɨngshi və e ifɨ.
english: The scribes and the Pharisees watched him, to see whether he would heal on the Sabbath, that they might find an accusation against him.

jenjo: Bisɨ Yeso yi bi anyilɨ və le yang, o tsɨ ibwi de tsa, “A yi a tsɨpu a wu chi nɨ.” Bɨ o yi o tsɨpu pɨbi.
english: But he knew their thoughts; and he said to the man who had the withered hand, “Rise up, and stand in the middle.” He arose and stood.

jenjo: Bɨ Yeso tsɨ le tsa, “Min bi bə bi, dɨ ake lenwa kwələ e tswe Vi Hũlɨ, nɨng a pikang alo pyɨngnɨng? Walɨ a hũlɨ lelɨ alo yəlɨ a hũlɨ?”
english: Then Jesus said to them, “I will ask you something: Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good, or to do harm? To save a life, or to kill?”

jenjo: O myɛ nɨng wə o bə le hɛ̃, bɨ o tsɨ ibwi de tsa, “A chĩ kəna mə hywa.” Ibwi de tswe mambɨ nɨ, bɨ kəna o chĩ hywa fə losə.
english: He looked around at them all, and said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He did, and his hand was restored as sound as the other.

jenjo: Be e Farisa be e inyi nasɨ Lenwa be ywa fə e pəsɔ pɨ pangsələ bwale nɨng nɨ en tswekə Yeso nɨ.
english: But they were filled with rage, and talked with one another about what they might do to Jesus.

jenjo: Sapɨde, vi akə lə Yeso tə ku te pɨ pinwa. Pɨkə wə pɨbi son pinwa sɨ Fi.
english: In these days, he went out to the mountain to pray, and he continued all night in prayer to God.

jenjo: Pɨ wu kəkə nɨ, bɨ o dzupɨ e mwambwi o. O dɨ e ifɨ bwahywə ji yung tangsə le, nɨ o dzu le kə e mwambwipu o nɨ.
english: When it was day, he called his disciples, and from them he chose twelve, whom he also named apostles:

jenjo: Siman, nɨ sen dzukə Bitulu be hywĩ wə Andirawu, Yakubu be Yohana, be Filibu be Batilomi,
english: Simon, whom he also named Peter; Andrew, his brother; James; John; Philip; Bartholomew;

jenjo: Matiyu be Toma be Yakubu yɨ Halfa, be Siman nɨ sen dzukə yɨ hywa nɨ,
english: Matthew; Thomas; James, the son of Alphaeus; Simon, who was called the Zealot;

jenjo: Yahuda yɨ Yakubu, be Yahuda Iskariyoti, ifɨ nɨ təkə mwə o nɨ.
english: Judas the son of James; and Judas Iscariot, who also became a traitor.

jenjo: Yeso be e mwambwipu o pĩ hywa ku te, e wu hywa pɨ a pyənglɨ. Bɨ e chi e mwambwi o ihyãnɨng be e ifɨ kə dzungdzung pwɔsə pɨbi. Kə e ifɨ a Yahudiya be Urushalima, be hywa Taya be Sidon,
english: He came down with them, and stood on a level place, with a crowd of his disciples, and a great number of the people from all Judea and Jerusalem, and the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, who came to hear him and to be healed of their diseases;

jenjo: nɨ wu pɨ li bi o fə bisɨ tɨnglɨ a nɨngshi və le. E ifɨ nɨ nɨngvi kukə ku le nɨ, o tɨng nɨngshi və le hɛ̃.
english: as well as those who were troubled by unclean spirits, and they were being healed.

jenjo: Fə e ifɨ de hɛ̃ yidi pɨ pang sɨ wə, bisɨ sambe sɨn ji sɨ wə sɨn tɨng nɨngshi və le.
english: All the multitude sought to touch him, for power came out of him and healed them all.

jenjo: O tsɨ nɨng sɨ e mwambwi o bɨ o tsa, “Pərkə dɨ a və bə e ifɨ ibe, bisɨ ivə və Fi dɨ a və bə.
english: He lifted up his eyes to his disciples, and said, “Blessed are you who are poor, God’s Kingdom is yours.

jenjo: Pərkə dɨ a və bə, bə nɨ sɨ ban ta hwə sɨswenɨ, kə ywa bə yin tsətsə. Pərkə dɨ a və bə, bə nɨ ku ban tata sɨswenɨ, kə yi ban məmə.
english: Blessed are you who hunger now, for you will be filled. Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh.

jenjo: Pərkə dɨ a və bə sapɨnɨ e ifɨ la bə, e ta bə e tsɨ sen hywãjə bə, fə e dzu bə e ifɨ pyɨngnɨng, bisɨ Yɨ Ifafɨ.
english: Blessed are you when men shall hate you, and when they shall exclude and mock you, and throw out your name as evil, for the Son of Man’s sake.

jenjo: “Ba li lalɨ vi o le, ba hywə be bɛlɨ, bisɨ kə akang gyədə və bə dzwe kã o. Mambɨ e papa və le tswe be e ilinwa və Fi a na nwa chi nɨ.”
english: Rejoice in that day, and leap for joy, for behold, your reward is great in heaven, for their fathers did the same thing to the prophets.

jenjo: “Wewe ta bə yang, e ifɨ nɨngchinɨng a sɨswenɨ, bisɨ ba ochi ba li lalɨ və bə yang.
english: “But woe to you who are rich! For you have received your consolation.

jenjo: Wewe ta bə yang, e ifɨ ywatsə, hwə yin le bə le chi nɨ. Wewe ta bə yang e ifɨ məmə sɨswenɨ, chi nɨ yi ban pəshi be ta kə.
english: Woe to you, you who are full now, for you will be hungry. Woe to you who laugh now, for you will mourn and weep.

jenjo: Wewe ta bə yang, bə nɨ e ifɨ hɛ̃ sɨn nə bi a pikang ku bə nɨ. Mambɨ e papa və le nə bi a pikang ku e ilinwa a nwayung.”
english: Woe, when men speak well of you, for their fathers did the same thing to the false prophets.

jenjo: “Be sɨ min nə bə lə bə nɨ sɨ ban li mi kə nɨ, ba tswe bi və e mbwe və bə. E ifɨ nɨ la bə hɛ̃, ba tswe le nɨng a hĩlɨ lə.
english: “But I tell you who hear: love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,

jenjo: Ba tswe e ifɨ tɨngjə bə nɨng akəng lə, e ifɨ nɨ sɨn tə bə ibe nɨ, ba pinwa bisɨ le.
english: bless those who curse you, and pray for those who mistreat you.

jenjo: Aba ifɨ akə gbəjang mə gwa a tsɨng yang, a myɛ wə a tsɨng lə bɨ. A ifɨ akə kwə alkibale mə dɨ yang, bi man nyə wə pɨ dɨ nɨng yasɨ mə a tangsə yɛ.
english: To him who strikes you on the cheek, offer also the other; and from him who takes away your cloak, don’t withhold your coat also.

jenjo: Ifɨ nɨ ke kũ nɨng na mə hɛ̃, a tə wə. A ifɨ akə dɨ nɨng mə akə yang, bi fə man bipɨ yɛ.
english: Give to everyone who asks you, and don’t ask him who takes away your goods to give them back again.

jenjo: Nɨng nɨ sɨ ban yidi e ifɨ tswe bə lə nɨ, ba tswe le lə bɨ.
english: “As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.

jenjo: “A sɨ ban tswe dɨ bi və e ifɨ tswe bi və bə yang, dɨ gyədə bə ban chi pɨbi? Kə e ifɨ nɨng abe sɨn tswe bi və e ifɨ tswe bi və le bɨ.
english: If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners love those who love them.

jenjo: A dɨ e ifɨ nɨ sen tswe bə nɨng a pikang lə bɨ ban tswe le lə yang, dɨ gyədə bə ban chi pɨbi? Kə e ifɨ nɨng abe sen tswe mambɨ wɛ!
english: If you do good to those who do good to you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners do the same.

jenjo: A e ifɨ nɨ sɨ ban tə le yə nɨ dɨ e ifɨ nɨ ba tsɨnyi pa bang en fə bə fə yang, dɨ gyədə bə ban chi pɨbi? Kə e ifɨ nɨng abe sen təsə yə fə sen tsɨnyi en fəsə fə kushi ywang.
english: If you lend to those from whom you hope to receive, what credit is that to you? Even sinners lend to sinners, to receive back as much.

jenjo: Be bə a bə nɨ, ba tswe bi və e mbwe və bə, ba tswe le nɨng ahyĩlɨ lə. Ba tə le yə, bi ban tsɨnyi sɨ fəlɨ yɛ. Hɛbələ ba chi gyədə a kã, fə ba myɛkə e yɨ Fi Ipe nyɔ nɨng Hɛ̃, bisɨ son tswe e ifɨ shĩnɨng be e ifɨ kãnyi nɨng ahyĩlɨ lə.
english: But love your enemies, and do good, and lend, expecting nothing back; and your reward will be great, and you will be children of the Most High; for he is kind toward the unthankful and evil.

jenjo: Ba bəshi, bisɨ Ta və bə dɨ ibəshi.
english: “Therefore be merciful, even as your Father is also merciful.

jenjo: “Bi ban bə ayibe və ifɨ akə yɛ, Fi bə ayibe və bəw bɨ. Bi ban le e ifɨ yɛ, Fi le bəw bɨ. Ba e nyi bə hywa be e ifɨ, yi ban chi e nyi hywa sɨ Fi bɨ.
english: Don’t judge, and you won’t be judged. Don’t condemn, and you won’t be condemned. Set free, and you will be set free.

jenjo: Ba tə nɨng, en tə bə tə bɨ. Dɨ tasɔ nyinɨng a pikang yɨlə pyɔpyɔ, sãsã lɨ, fə e yo nalə akə sɨn telɨ bɨ Fi yin myɛ e bə nwa nɨngji. A yipɨ tasɔ nɨ a nyikə e ifɨ nɨng lə nɨ, dɨbɨ Fi yin nyi mə kə lə.”
english: “Give, and it will be given to you: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, will be given to you. For with the same measure you measure it will be measured back to you.”

jenjo: Bɨ Yeso fə nə le bi akə lə tsa, “Igbanɨng pa mwə igbanɨng kə mwə? Le be bwayung və le e te bwa wa?
english: He spoke a parable to them. “Can the blind guide the blind? Won’t they both fall into a pit?

jenjo: Imyɛnasɨnɨng pe inyinasɨnɨng lo, be a e ta wə nasɨ nɨng de pikang yang, yi on ku ma ifɨ nɨ nyi wə na lə nɨ.”
english: A disciple is not above his teacher, but everyone when he is fully trained will be like his teacher.

jenjo: “Dɨ bə tswe a tsɨ nɨng sɨ yɨ kũ nɨ nɨng hywi mə nɨ, be nwakə nɨ lwekə nɨng mə nɨ yilə mə lo?
english: Why do you see the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?

jenjo: Tswe nwu man tsɨ hywĩ mə, ‘Min te n dɨ mə kũ lə nɨng mə, be nwakə nɨ lwekə nɨng mə nɨ a bə a mə lo? Bə e ifɨ sɨfɨ̃! Ba ochi ba dɨ nwakə nɨ nɨng bə nɨ, kə ba bəpɨ pikang ba dɨkə kũ nɨng hywĩ bə.”
english: Or how can you tell your brother, ‘Brother, let me remove the speck of chaff that is in your eye,’ when you yourself don’t see the beam that is in your own eye? You hypocrite! First remove the beam from your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye.

jenjo: “Kə a pikang sɨn chi yɨ abe lo, mambɨ kə abe sɨn chi yɨ a pikang lo.
english: For there is no good tree that produces rotten fruit; nor again a rotten tree that produces good fruit.

jenjo: Sen bə kə a pikang le sɨ chilɨ wə. En bwi fe pu kəhwə lo, fə en chi inabi pu kwandɛ lo.
english: For each tree is known by its own fruit. For people don’t gather figs from thorns, nor do they gather grapes from a bramble bush.

jenjo: Le sɨ nɨng a pikang nɨ ifɨ a pikang lekə nyinyi wə nɨ bɨ son ji be nɨng a pikang. Fə ifɨ pyɨngnɨng sɨn ji be pyɨngnɨng lesɨ pyɨngnɨng nɨ lwekə nyinyi wə nɨ.” Dɨ ləkã nɨngnɨ lwekə nyinyi wə nɨ bɨ nwa wə sɨn nəlɨ.
english: The good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings out that which is good, and the evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart brings out that which is evil, for out of the abundance of the heart, his mouth speaks.

jenjo: “Dɨ bi sɨ bəde ku ban dzu mi, ‘Itwebɨ, Itwebɨ,’ be ban tswe nɨng nɨ n nəkə nɨ lo?
english: “Why do you call me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ and don’t do the things which I say?

jenjo: Ke ifɨ nɨ wukə sɨ mi ku sɨn kang chwi sɨ bi mi fə sɨn tswelɨ yang,
english: Everyone who comes to me, and hears my words, and does them, I will show you who he is like.

jenjo: o ku ma ifɨ mi və nɨ ha bwa dzwi lə, o le nɨng nyi kwə o ku te. Sapɨnɨ mɨng gba dɨpɨ fə ywa mɨng wə, lehɛ̃ kwə de de lo, bisɨ o mi wə ku te.
english: He is like a man building a house, who dug and went deep, and laid a foundation on the rock. When a flood arose, the stream broke against that house, and could not shake it, because it was founded on the rock.

jenjo: Ke ifɨ nɨ likə bi mi be tswekə nwatũ lo yang, o ku ma ifɨ nɨ mikə kwə ku hywa, o le nɨng nyi kwə lo. Sapɨnɨ mɨng gba wukə be ywa wu gbə kwə de nɨ, bɨ kwə de de jwa hywa hɛ̃.”
english: But he who hears, and doesn’t do, is like a man who built a house on the earth without a foundation, against which the stream broke, and immediately it fell, and the ruin of that house was great.”

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ Yeso nə e ifɨ bi lə tɨngkə hɛ̃ nɨ, bɨ o tə Kaparnahum.
english: After he had finished speaking in the hearing of the people, he entered into Capernaum.

jenjo: Ihyãfɨ tabwi və e Roma akə lə nɨ sɨn tswe bi və mwənshə o ihyãnɨng. Mwənshə de lwe nɨngshi hywɛ̃ na bwa.
english: A certain centurion’s servant, who was dear to him, was sick and at the point of death.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ o likə bi və Yeso nɨ, bɨ o tũ e ihyãfɨ və e Yahuda, tə e kũ Yeso wu tɨng nɨngshi və mwənshə o.
english: When he heard about Jesus, he sent to him elders of the Jews, asking him to come and save his servant.

jenjo: E ihyãfɨ de təkə sɨ Yeso nɨ, e e fo e tə wə e tsa, “Ibwi nɨ lo yang a pələ wə,
english: When they came to Jesus, they begged him earnestly, saying, “He is worthy for you to do this for him,

jenjo: bisɨ son tswe bi e ifɨ və bɨ, fə o mi bɨ pɨkwəsəku lə yang.”
english: for he loves our nation, and he built our synagogue for us.”

jenjo: Bɨ Yeso tə tsung be le. Sapɨnɨ o kyə̃ və ihyãfɨ tabwi və e Roma de nɨ, bɨ ibwi de tũ e tswə wə nə Yeso lə tsa, “Ihyãfɨ, bi man shi sɨ mə bisɨ mi yɛ! N lolə nɨ man wukə tang və mi nɨ lo.
english: Jesus went with them. When he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying to him, “Lord, don’t trouble yourself, for I am not worthy for you to come under my roof.

jenjo: Dɨbɨ tswe, n bə ku mi n lolə nɨ min təkə pɨpi mə nɨ lo. Be a nə bi yang, mwənshə mi yin yiyi hywa nɨngshi.
english: Therefore I didn’t even think myself worthy to come to you; but say the word, and my servant will be healed.

jenjo: Kə mi nɨ ihyãfɨ akə lə chi mi bɨ, nɨ lə be tsɨkunɨng ku mi. Fə e itabwi akə lə pu mi, a n tsɨ ifɨ a pɨnɨ, ‘A tə,’ son təlɨ, n tsɨ ifɨ akə, ‘A wu,’ son wulɨ. Nɨng nɨ n nə kə e mwənshə mi lə hɛ̃, son tswelɨ.”
english: For I also am a man placed under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go!’ and he goes; and to another, ‘Come!’ and he comes; and to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ Yeso li kə mambɨ nɨ, sɨbi mwə wə. Bɨ o myɛ o nə e ifɨ nɨ sɨn mwəkə tswa wə nɨ lə o tsa, “Min nə bə lə, təngsə Israila hɛ̃ n mɛdi pɨ chi ipənyi tsa ma və mwe Ywavə nɨ lo.”
english: When Jesus heard these things, he marveled at him, and turned and said to the multitude who followed him, “I tell you, I have not found such great faith, no, not in Israel.”

jenjo: E ifɨ nɨ ihyãfɨ tabwi və e Roma tũkə fə tə tangvə de nɨ, bɨ tə e chi nɨngshi və mwənshə de tɨng yang.
english: Those who were sent, returning to the house, found that the servant who had been sick was well.

jenjo: Tswilo, bɨ Yeso tə və akə nɨ sen dzukə Nayin, e mwambwi o be e ifɨ kə dzungdzung tə tsung be wə.
english: Soon afterwards, he went to a city called Nain. Many of his disciples, along with a great multitude, went with him.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ e kyə̃ nwa nɨhyã və de nɨ, bɨ e dɨ bwa imwə a ibwi akə, na o chi wə tsɨngdodo, sen ji kə fə iye de dɨ hebwi. E ifɨ və de kə dzungdzung mwə tswa iye de.
english: Now when he came near to the gate of the city, behold, one who was dead was carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow. Many people of the city were with her.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ Itwebɨ Yeso bə wə kə nɨ, bɨ o bəshi wə, o tsɨ wə, “Man tata yɛ!”
english: When the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said to her, “Don’t cry.”

jenjo: Bɨ tə, o ta kəna wə sɨ ki nɨ e tsəkə bwa nɨ, bɨ e ifɨ nɨ dɨkə bwa de nɨ tsɨ hywa. Yeso tsa, “Imwə a ibwi, n tsɨ ma a yi a ku nyi!”
english: He came near and touched the coffin, and the bearers stood still. He said, “Young man, I tell you, arise!”

jenjo: Bɨ ifɨ nɨ bwi kə nɨ yi ku nyi, o pəsɔ pɨ nə bi. Yeso mwə wə tə na o.
english: He who was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he gave him to his mother.

jenjo: Sɨbi mwə le hɛ̃, bɨ e yənwa Fi sen tsa, “Ilinwa və Fi a kã wu yang tangsə bɨ! Fi wuyang pɨ pələ e ifɨ o.”
english: Fear took hold of all, and they glorified God, saying, “A great prophet has arisen among us!” and, “God has visited his people!”

jenjo: Bi və nɨngnɨ Yeso tswekə nɨ, wə lo hywa Yahudiya be e nyɔ hywa nɨ kwɛ le nɨ hɛ̃.
english: This report went out concerning him in the whole of Judea, and in all the surrounding region.

jenjo: E mwambwi və Yohana itswe bɔtismɔ tə nə wə e nɨng nɨ tswekəpɨ nɨ hɛ̃. Bɨ Yohana dzupɨ bwayung tangsə le,
english: The disciples of John told him about all these things.

jenjo: o tũ le sɨ Itwebɨ Yeso tə e bipɨ, “Dɨ mə kə ifɨ nɨ Fi gbə wə sɔ lə nɨ yin wu kə nɨ, alo bɨ midzwi ifɨ akə be tsɨng wə?”
english: John, calling to himself two of his disciples, sent them to Jesus, saying, “Are you the one who is coming, or should we look for another?”

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ e təkə sɨ Yeso nɨ, e tsɨ wə tsa, “Yohana Itswe Bɔtismɔ tũ bɨ wu bɨ bi mə, ‘Dɨ mə kə ifɨ nɨ Fi gbə wə sɔ lə nɨ yin wu kə nɨ, alo bɨ midzwi ifɨ akə be tsɨng wə?’ ”
english: When the men had come to him, they said, “John the Baptizer has sent us to you, saying, ‘Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?’”

jenjo: Sapɨde, Yeso tɨng nɨngshi və e ifɨ nɨngshi, be ifɨ sɨshi, be e ifɨ nɨ nɨngvi ku kə ku le nɨ. Fə e igbanɨng chi bəlɨ a pɨ yang.
english: In that hour he cured many of diseases and plagues and evil spirits; and to many who were blind he gave sight.

jenjo: Bɨ Yeso nə e mwambwi nɨ Yohana tũkə nɨ, o tsa, “Tə ba nə Yohana lə, nɨngnɨ ba bə kə be a pɨnɨ ba li kə nɨ. E igbanɨng sɨn bəpɨ, e ibwipu sɨn holɨ, nɨngshi və e idzwasɨ sɨn tɨnglɨ, e igbajang sɨn li pɨ, e ifɨ nɨ bwi kə nɨ sɨn yilɨ, sen nə e ifɨ ibe, bi alalɨ və Fi lə.
english: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you have seen and heard: that the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.

jenjo: Pərkə dɨ a və ifɨ nɨ nyi wə gbəshə lo sɨ pənyi o ku mi.”
english: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.”

jenjo: E mwambwi və Yohana fə təkə nɨ, bɨ Yeso pəsɔ pɨ nə bi ku Yohana sɨ e ifɨ nɨ kwəsə kə dzungdzung nɨ o tsa, “Dɨ bə tə ban bəlɨ fahu? Ba tə pɨ bə ifɨ akə ma bwa faki nɨ ywa sɨn wəkə nɨ?
english: When John’s messengers had departed, he began to tell the multitudes about John, “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?

jenjo: Mambɨ lo yang, dɨbə ba ji tə ban bəlɨ? Ifɨ nɨngtsənɨng a pikang? Oho! E ifɨ nɨngtsənɨng a pikang be kulɨ a lalɨ nɨ, sen ku a le və ivə.
english: But what did you go out to see? A man clothed in soft clothing? Behold, those who are gorgeously dressed, and live delicately, are in kings’ courts.

jenjo: Be dɨbə ba ji tə ban bəlɨ? Ilinwa və Fi? O, min nə bə lə, o pe ilinwa və Fi yang.
english: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.

jenjo: Dɨ Yohana bɨ Dəro və Fi nə bi ku wə tsa, “ ‘A bə, min tũ itenwa mi wa mə, nɨ yin mə mə nɨhyã lə chi mə nɨ.’
english: This is he of whom it is written, ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’

jenjo: Sɨ min nə bə lə, tangsə e yɨ nɨ e iye chi kə nɨ, ifɨ nɨ pe Yohana be kãlɨ nɨ ywang. Lehɛ̃ ifɨ a hang tangsə ivə və Fi, pe wə yang.”
english: “For I tell you, among those who are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptizer, yet he who is least in God’s Kingdom is greater than he.”

jenjo: E ifɨ hɛ̃ be e ifɨ bwi sede gbaku likə bi və Yeso nɨ, bɨ e kwələ nɨhyã və Fi dɨ nɨhyã a hywiwə, bisɨ Yohana tswe le bɔtismɔ lə yang.
english: When all the people and the tax collectors heard this, they declared God to be just, having been baptized with John’s baptism.

jenjo: E Farisa be e inyi nasɨ lenwa və Musa la bɔtismɔ və Yohana yang, bisɨ mambɨ e la nɨngnɨ Fi tsɨkə nyinyi wə bisɨ le nɨ yang.
english: But the Pharisees and the lawyers rejected the counsel of God, not being baptized by him themselves.

jenjo: Yeso nə bi tsa, “Dɨ bə ho min nyi be e ifɨ a fangwa a sɨswenɨ? E ku ma bə de?
english: “To what then will I liken the people of this generation? What are they like?

jenjo: E ku ma e imwə yangshang nɨ kukə fa nɨngtsa, sen dzusə be nwakwang, “ ‘Bɨ ji bə twe twe lə, ba la pɨ bwə dang lɨ. Bɨ le bi be nwa a shi, ba la pɨ tata lɨ.’
english: They are like children who sit in the marketplace, and call to one another, saying, ‘We piped to you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned, and you didn’t weep.’

jenjo: Wulɨ və Yohana Itswe Bɔtismɔ, on tang nɨng lo son nwa mɨng inabi ma e ifɨ lo, ba tsa, ‘O lə be nɨngvi.’
english: For John the Baptizer came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, ‘He has a demon.’

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ Yɨ Ifafɨ wu kə nɨ, son tang lɨ son nwa mɨng inabi ma nyɔ e ifafɨ, fə ba tsa, ‘Ba bə gagũ nɨngtang be byɛ̃nɛ nɨ, tswə e ifɨ bwi sede gbaku be e ifɨ nɨng abe!’
english: The Son of Man has come eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Behold, a gluttonous man, and a drunkard; a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’

jenjo: Lehɛ̃ e ifɨ nɨ sɨn mwə tswa hywĩku və Fi nɨ sen ta nalə wə hywiwə.”
english: Wisdom is justified by all her children.”

jenjo: Vi akə lə, mwe Farisa akə dzupɨ Yeso pɨ tang nɨngtang və wə. Bɨ Yeso tə və mwe Farisa de, fə gã hywa nwaji nɨngtang de.
english: One of the Pharisees invited him to eat with him. He entered into the Pharisee’s house, and sat at the table.

jenjo: Iye akə lə və akã de, sɨn ho ywa. O likə Yeso sɨn tang nɨng və mwe Farisi de nɨ, bɨ o dɨ lelu alabasita a nywi yemumu,
english: Behold, a woman in the city who was a sinner, when she knew that he was reclining in the Pharisee’s house, brought an alabaster jar of ointment.

jenjo: o wu na tswa wə o pə dzwang wə hywa kəpu wə, son tata. Gə̃mi pəsɔ pɨ te susu nɨng wə tswa pu Yeso. Bɨ o mwə tsaku wə, o nu kə kəpu Yeso. Fə o yə pɨ pə ku wə hywa tswapu Yeso lo, o gba nwa lelu nywi de son e lə.
english: Standing behind at his feet weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears, and she wiped them with the hair of her head, kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ ibwi Farisa nɨ dzupɨ wə pɨ tang nɨng de bəkə nɨng nɨ iye de tswekə nɨ, bɨ o nyi bi o tsa, “A ibwi nɨ dɨ Ilinwa və Fi kə akang yang, on yipɨ iye nɨ sin dzwe na sɨ wə nɨ, dɨ ifɨ nɨng abe.”
english: Now when the Pharisee who had invited him saw it, he said to himself, “This man, if he were a prophet, would have perceived who and what kind of woman this is who touches him, that she is a sinner.”

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ wə, “Siman, n lə be bi nɨ min nə mə kə lə nɨ.” Bɨ Siman tsa, “Inyinasɨnɨng, a nə mi lə, sɨ min li lɨ.”
english: Jesus answered him, “Simon, I have something to tell you.” He said, “Teacher, say on.”

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ wə tsa, “Itəyə sede akə mwə e ifɨ bwayung yə sede. O mwə ifɨ a tsɨng nɨng sede denari nwuli ji nwuhywə, fə o mwə ifɨ a tsɨng de nɨng sede denari nwuyung ji hywə.
english: “A certain lender had two debtors. The one owed five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.

jenjo: Le be bwayung və le hɛ̃ e ywang be sede fə lɨ lo, bisɨ mambɨ bɨ o yafə le lə. Bəlɨ a mə, dɨ wə bɨngsə le yin tswe bi wə pe nwa?
english: When they couldn’t pay, he forgave them both. Which of them therefore will love him most?”

jenjo: Siman tsɨ wə tsa, “Bəlɨ a mi, dɨ ifɨ nɨ be nɨng sede ihyãnɨng nɨ.” Bɨ Yeso fə tsɨ wə tsa, “O, a nə tsɨ yang.”
english: Simon answered, “He, I suppose, to whom he forgave the most.” He said to him, “You have judged correctly.”

jenjo: Bɨ o myɛ chi wə o e sɨ iye de, o tsɨ Siman tsa, “A bə iye nɨ yang? N wu tang və mə a tə mi mɨng lo kəpu lo, be o lo kəpu mi be gə̃mi o, fə o nu be tsaku wə.
