english: Turning to the woman, he said to Simon, “Do you see this woman? I entered into your house, and you gave me no water for my feet, but she has wet my feet with her tears, and wiped them with the hair of her head.

jenjo: N wu tang və mə, a ka mi a tsɨ gyəng mə lo, be ta lɨ a pu mi və mə, iye nɨ kulə pu mi sɨn kalɨ.
english: You gave me no kiss, but she, since the time I came in, has not ceased to kiss my feet.

jenjo: A nu nywi ku mi lo, be iye nɨ nu kəpu mi be nywi yemumu yang.
english: You didn’t anoint my head with oil, but she has anointed my feet with ointment.

jenjo: Sɨ min nə mə lə, e e nyi hywa sɨ e nɨng abe o nɨ nywangkɔshi nɨ yang, bisɨ son tswebi ihyãnɨng. Be ifɨ nɨ e ekə nyi hywa tswəni bisɨ wə nɨ, son tswebi tswəni yinfa.”
english: Therefore I tell you, her sins, which are many, are forgiven, for she loved much. But to whom little is forgiven, the same loves little.”

jenjo: Bɨ Yeso tsɨ iye de tsa, “E e nyi hywa sɨ e nɨng abe mə yang.”
english: He said to her, “Your sins are forgiven.”

jenjo: E ifɨ nɨ ku kə nwa ji nɨngtang be wə nɨ, pəsɔ pɨ bisə bwa le sen tsa, “Dɨ wə a wə ho, be nɨng abe hɛ̃ son e nyi hywa sɨ wə?”
english: Those who sat at the table with him began to say to themselves, “Who is this who even forgives sins?”

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ iye de tsa, “Pəlɨ a nyi mə ku mi ji be mə ku yang, a tə be tã.”
english: He said to the woman, “Your faith has saved you. Go in peace.”

jenjo: Tswa wə, Yeso ho və a kã be və a bɨnghu, son tenwa bi alalɨ a ivə və Fi. E mwambwipu o bwahywə ji bwayung tsung be wə,
english: Soon afterwards, he went about through cities and villages, preaching and bringing the good news of God’s Kingdom. With him were the twelve,

jenjo: fə be e iye akə nɨ e ji be e nɨngvi be nɨngshi sɨ le nɨ. Maryamu nɨ sen dzukə iye Magadala nɨ e ji be e nɨngvi hywĩyung sɨ wə nɨ, lə tangsə e iye de.
english: and certain women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities: Mary who was called Magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone out;

jenjo: Be Yowana he Kuza, nɨ sin tsɨnɨng tangvə Hiridus nɨ, pɔsɨ Suzana be e iye kə dzung dzung nɨ sin pələ le be nɨngna le nɨ.
english: and Joanna, the wife of Chuzas, Herod’s steward; Susanna; and many others; who served them from their possessions.

jenjo: Tangsə e vi de, e ifɨ kə dzung dzung wu sɨn pwɔsə fə e ifɨ ihyãnɨng ji hywa tsɨng tsɨng sɨn wu sɨ Yeso lɨ, o nə le nwadũ nɨ lə o tsa,
english: When a great multitude came together, and people from every city were coming to him, he spoke by a parable.

jenjo: “Iləpɨ̃ tə pɨ gbə nɨngpyənɨng fanɨng. Wə ku gbəlɨ a nɨngpyənɨng de ho, bɨ e akə te ku nɨhyã, e ta be pu fə e hywĩ chi bwi tang.
english: “The farmer went out to sow his seed. As he sowed, some fell along the road, and it was trampled under foot, and the birds of the sky devoured it.

jenjo: E akə te hywa ku te, nɨ e ji kə dzwa nɨ, bɨ e chi kwɛ̃ bisɨ hywa de mwə mɨng lo.
english: Other seed fell on the rock, and as soon as it grew, it withered away, because it had no moisture.

jenjo: E nɨngpyənɨng akə o bwa kəhwə, e kã tsung, e hwə de kpə̃ le, e ji ku lo.
english: Other fell amid the thorns, and the thorns grew with it, and choked it.

jenjo: Fə e nɨngpyənɨng de akə o ku hywa a pikang, e kã fə e tsɨ nɨng nwuhmə nwuhmə.” Yeso nə nwadũ de tɨngkə nɨ, bɨ o tsa, “Ke ifɨ nɨ lə be chwi hɛ̃, o kang tswi o li.”
english: Other fell into the good ground, and grew, and produced one hundred times as much fruit.” As he said these things, he called out, “He who has ears to hear, let him hear!”

jenjo: Bɨ e mwambwi o bi wə dɨbə kə kəsɛ̃sɛ̃ nwadũ de nɨ.
english: Then his disciples asked him, “What does this parable mean?”

jenjo: Bɨ o tsa, “E kwə bə lə yang ba yi sũnyi ivə və Fi, be e nyɔ e ifɨ a nɨ sɨ min nə le nwadũ lə hɛbələ, “ ‘A e tsɨ nɨng le lə, pa e bəw, e kəjang lə hɛ̃, pa e liw.’
english: He said, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of God’s Kingdom, but to the rest in parables; that ‘seeing they may not see, and hearing they may not understand.’

jenjo: “Dɨ kəsɛ̃sɛ̃ bi de ho nɨ. Nɨngpyənɨng de, dɨ bi və Fi.
english: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.

jenjo: E a pɨnɨ tekə ku nɨhyã nɨ, e ku ma e ifɨ nɨ likə bi və Fi, bɨ nɨnɨngvi wu kwə bi de dɨ tangsə nyi le, hɛbələ bi en pənyi sɨ bi və Fi de e jiku.
english: Those along the road are those who hear, then the devil comes, and takes away the word from their heart, that they may not believe and be saved.

jenjo: E nɨngpyənɨng nɨ tekə hywa ku te nɨ, ku ma e ifɨ nɨ likə bi, e kwə bi de be bɛlɨ. E pənyi ku bi və Fi de vi tswəni, sapɨnɨ ibe chi le yang, e wa pənyi və le tə, bisɨ sũnyi le mwə hywa lo.
english: Those on the rock are they who, when they hear, receive the word with joy; but these have no root, who believe for a while, then fall away in time of temptation.

jenjo: E nɨngpyənɨng nɨ te bwa kəhwə nɨ, ku ma e ifɨ nɨ li kə bi, be sapɨnɨ sen təlɨ nɨhyã nɨ, bi a nyilɨ fangwa be bapɨ nɨngchinɨng be yidi lalɨ kpə̃ le, e tswe pwətɛ lo.
english: That which fell among the thorns, these are those who have heard, and as they go on their way they are choked with cares, riches, and pleasures of life, and bring no fruit to maturity.

jenjo: Be e nɨngpyənɨng nɨ tekə hywa a pikang nɨ, ku ma e ifɨ nɨ likə bi, e kwə bi de be nyitsɨng, e mwə na lə, e tsa nyi bɨ e tswe pwətɛ.
english: Those in the good ground, these are those who with an honest and good heart, having heard the word, hold it tightly, and produce fruit with perseverance.

jenjo: “Ifɨ akə ywang nɨ tsɨ dzwakəpɨ fə dɨ ywe tang bo, aloyang o ywe dzwa de bwa hywe. Oho tswe mambɨw! Nɨng a pikang dɨbɨ ifɨ de dɨ dzwa de tsɨ ku kə hɛbələ e ifɨ nɨ wu kə tangvə nɨ bə pɨkəpɨ.
english: “No one, when he has lit a lamp, covers it with a container, or puts it under a bed; but puts it on a stand, that those who enter in may see the light.

jenjo: Nɨng nɨ yweywelɨ hɛ̃ yin jiji, fə nɨng nɨ e pe ji lə hɛ̃ en mwə ji de en be tsɨ nɨngfa.
english: For nothing is hidden, that will not be revealed; nor anything secret, that will not be known and come to light.

jenjo: Bisɨ mambɨ ba tswe hakilo be nɨng nɨ sɨ ban likə nɨ, bisɨ ifɨ nɨ lə be nɨng yang en yi wə ku, ke ifɨ nɨ ywang be nɨng akə nɨ, busɨ nɨngnɨ son kyɛ̃ lɨ ləkə nɨ, en kwə en dɨdɨ na wə.
english: Be careful therefore how you hear. For whoever has, to him will be given; and whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken away even that which he thinks he has.”

jenjo: Vi akə lə, na və Yeso be e hywĩ wə wu sɨ wə, be e chi nɨhyã bəlɨ wə lo bisɨ dzung və e ifɨ.
english: His mother and brothers came to him, and they could not come near him for the crowd.

jenjo: Bɨ ifɨ akə nə wə lə tsa, “Na mə be e hywĩ mə tsɨ pɨfa, sen yidi bəlɨ mə.”
english: Some people told him, “Your mother and your brothers stand outside, desiring to see you.”

jenjo: Bɨ o tsɨ le, “Na mi be e hywĩ mi, dɨ le ho kə e ifɨ nɨ li kə bi və Fi fə sen tswekə nɨ.”
english: But he answered them, “My mother and my brothers are these who hear the word of God, and do it.”

jenjo: Vi akə nɨ Yeso tsɨ e mwambwi o tsa, “Bɨ hyã bɨ tə ngwa pɨ le.” E pĩ tang fə bɨ e pəsɔ pɨ təlɨ.
english: Now on one of those days, he entered into a boat, himself and his disciples, and he said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side of the lake.” So they launched out.

jenjo: Sen hyãkə nɨ, bɨ nɨnglwe dɨ wə. Pa en yalɨ, ywa mɨng a kã yi ku te wu o ku mɨng de. Le tangsə hũlɨ be bwa bisɨ ywa wə mɨng sɨn e tang fə.
english: But as they sailed, he fell asleep. A wind storm came down on the lake, and they were taking on dangerous amounts of water.

jenjo: E mwambwi o dzupɨ wə nɨnglwe e tsa, “Ihyãfɨ! Ihyãfɨ! A və bɨ tɨng yang, bɨn bwi bwi ho le.” O ya nɨnglwe bɨ o go ywa be mɨng nɨ sɨn tswekə nɨngdzwinɨng de nɨ, bɨ pɨ ka twəng twəng.
english: They came to him, and awoke him, saying, “Master, master, we are dying!” He awoke, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water, and they ceased, and it was calm.

jenjo: Yeso bi e mwambwi o tsa, “Yə pəlɨ a nyi və bə be?” E yabwi ihyãnɨng fə sɨbi tswele sen bisə, “Dɨ wə a wə ho nɨ, ywa be mɨng hɛ̃ sɨn li nwa wə?”
english: He said to them, “Where is your faith?” Being afraid they marveled, saying to one another, “Who is this then, that he commands even the winds and the water, and they obey him?”

jenjo: Yeso be e mwambwi o ho dzwawɛ tangsə fə, e hyã e yə hywa Galili bɨ e tə na hywa və e ifɨ a Garasina na nwa Teku Galili.
english: They arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is opposite Galilee.

jenjo: Yeso pĩ hywa tang fə, bɨ o kwəsə be ibwi a hywa de, nɨ nɨngvi kukə ku wə nɨ. Hywi ihyãnɨng nɨngvi de dɨ ibwi de sɨn gbə hywa, sen tsə wə be bi, le hɛ̃ son wa bi de ma be jə. Nɨngvi de tswe wə son ho na fa hu. Ha kə dzung dzung, ibwi de tsənɨng sɨ wə lo, on lwe və lo, son lwe na tũ. O bə kə Yeso nɨ, o tata be wi kɔ̃kɔ̃ bɨ o wa na o hywa pu Yeso. Yeso go e nɨngvi de tsa, “Ba ji ba yə sɨ ibwi nɨ.” Ibwi de ki nwakwəng tsa, “Dɨ bə sɨ man yidi be mi, Yeso Yɨ Fi Ipe nyɔ nɨng hɛ̃? Kã nyi mə hɛ̃ bi man tɔlə mi yɛ.”
english: When Jesus stepped ashore, a certain man out of the city who had demons for a long time met him. He wore no clothes, and didn’t live in a house, but in the tombs.

jenjo: Yeso bipɨ tsa, “Dzung mə a wə?” Bɨ ibwi de tsa, “Kə dzung dzung.” Bisɨ e nɨngvi yɨ sɨ wə dɨngdɨng.
english: Jesus asked him, “What is your name?” He said, “Legion,” for many demons had entered into him.

jenjo: E kũ Yeso hywi ihyãnɨng bi on to le on e bwa nɨ sen tsəkə nɨngvi pɨbi nɨ yɛ.
english: They begged him that he would not command them to go into the abyss.

jenjo: E yɔ kə dzungdzung lə pu te de sen tangnɨng pɨbi. Bɨ e nɨngvi de kũ Yeso o kwə le lə e tə tangsə e yɔ. Bɨ o kwə le lə.
english: Now there was there a herd of many pigs feeding on the mountain, and they begged him that he would allow them to enter into those. He allowed them.

jenjo: E nɨngvi de jikə sɨ ibwi nɨ, e tə tangsə e yɔ. E yɔ de hɛ̃ pĩ hywa pu te be putũ, tə e kywi mɨng, e bwi pɨbi.
english: The demons came out of the man, and entered into the pigs, and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake, and were drowned.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ e igbə yɔ de bə e nɨng nɨ tswekəpɨ nɨ, bɨ e hywi e tə tə sen nə e ifafɨ bi de lə sen myɛkə.
english: When those who fed them saw what had happened, they fled, and told it in the city and in the country.

jenjo: E ifɨ ji hebilə e bə nɨngnɨ tswekə pɨ nɨ. E wu kə sɨ Yeso nɨ, bɨ e chi ifɨ nɨ nɨngvi jikə sɨ wə nɨ, ku pɨpi Yeso, o tsə nɨng sɨ wə, fə tiku o wuyang sɨ wə. Bɨ bi abilɨ tswe le hɛ̃.
english: People went out to see what had happened. They came to Jesus, and found the man from whom the demons had gone out, sitting at Jesus’ feet, clothed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.

jenjo: E ifɨ nɨ tsɨ bəkə nɨng de nɨ, myɛ nɨngnɨ tswekə pɨ tiku və ibwi de fə wukə sɨ wə nɨ, sen nə e ifɨ de lə.
english: Those who saw it told them how he who had been possessed by demons was healed.

jenjo: Bɨ e ifɨ a hywa Garasina be nyɔ pɨ nɨ kwɛle le tangsə hɛ̃ nɨ, kũ Yeso yə nwa hywa və le, bisɨ bi abilɨ tswele yang ihyãnɨng. Sapɨnɨ Yeso yidi pɨ pĩ tang fə, bɨ ibwi nɨ nɨngvi ji yə kə sɨ wə nɨ, kũ Yeso, “A yə mi n mwə nyi mə.” Yeso kwə nwa wə tsa, “Fə a tə və tə a nə e nɨngnɨ Fi tswe mə kə lə nɨ.” Bɨ ibwi de tə mwə tangsə və son tenwa və e nɨng nɨ Yeso tswe wə kə lə nɨ. Bɨ Yeso pĩ təng fə bɨ e tə.
english: All the people of the surrounding country of the Gadarenes asked him to depart from them, for they were very much afraid. He entered into the boat, and returned.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ Yeso hyã fə wukə nɨ, e ifɨ kə dzungdzung myɛ kwə wə, bisɨ sen midzwi wə.
english: When Jesus returned, the multitude welcomed him, for they were all waiting for him.

jenjo: Bɨ ibwi akə kə ihyãfɨ pɨkwəsəku və e Yahuda, sen dzung wə a Yayirus. O wu o pe hywa chi Yeso son kũ wə o tə və lɨ,
english: Behold, there came a man named Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue. He fell down at Jesus’ feet, and begged him to come into his house,

jenjo: yɨ wə tsɨngdodo kə imwə a iye, ha wə bwahywə ji bwayung sɨn dəbwa. Sapɨnɨ Yeso o nɨhyã və Yayirus nɨ, e ifɨ sɨn kpə̃ wə.
english: for he had an only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she was dying. But as he went, the multitudes pressed against him.

jenjo: Tangsə le iye akə lə nɨ tswe ibe ha bwahywə ji bwayung, hywi sɨn te sɨ wə, fə ifɨ nɨ pa tɨngkə nɨngshi o nɨ ywang.
english: A woman who had a flow of blood for twelve years, who had spent all her living on physicians, and could not be healed by any,

jenjo: Bɨ o wu na tswa Yeso, o pəng na sɨ nwa nɨng yasɨ və Yeso. Lelang, hywi nɨ sɨn te kə sɨ wə nɨ tsɨ hywa mambɨ.
english: came behind him, and touched the fringe of his cloak, and immediately the flow of her blood stopped.

jenjo: Yeso bipɨ tsa, “Dɨ wə tə na sɨ mi?” E tsa nwa hɛ̃ nɨ, bɨ Bitulu tsa, “Itwevə, e ifɨ kə dzung dzung kwɛ mə le tangsə sen to mə.”
english: Jesus said, “Who touched me?” When all denied it, Peter and those with him said, “Master, the multitudes press and jostle you, and you say, ‘Who touched me?’”

jenjo: Yeso tsa, “Ifɨ akə tə na sɨ mi kə a nwanyɔ, bisɨ n li sambe ji yang sɨ mi.”
english: But Jesus said, “Someone did touch me, for I perceived that power has gone out of me.”

jenjo: Iye de bəkə Yeso yipɨ yang nɨ, bɨ o ji sɨ wə sɨn gba mimi bɨ o ywɛ hywa pɨpi Yeso. Onə nɨng e ifɨ hɛ̃, nɨngnɨ tswe wə o ta na sɨ nɨng yasɨ və Yeso nɨ, be nɨngshi nɨ tɨngkə nabi sɨ wə nɨ.
english: When the woman saw that she was not hidden, she came trembling, and falling down before him declared to him in the presence of all the people the reason why she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ wə tsa, “Iye, pəlɨ a nyi mə sɨ mi tɨng nɨngshi mə yang, a tə be a tã və Fi.”
english: He said to her, “Daughter, cheer up. Your faith has made you well. Go in peace.”

jenjo: Yeso nə bi tɨng nwa wə lo, bɨ ifɨ akə nɨ jikə tangvə Yayirus ihyãfɨ pɨkwəsəku de wu nə wə lə tsa, “Bi man tɔlə inyi nasɨ nɨng nɨ yɛ, yɨ mə bwi yang.”
english: While he still spoke, one from the ruler of the synagogue’s house came, saying to him, “Your daughter is dead. Don’t trouble the Teacher.”

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ Yeso likə nɨ bɨ o tsɨ Yayirus tsa, “Bi man bibi yɛ, a pənyi mə sɨ mi, hũlɨ wə fə yin wuwu.”
english: But Jesus hearing it, answered him, “Don’t be afraid. Only believe, and she will be healed.”

jenjo: Yeso təkə və Yayirus nɨ, o kwələ ifɨ akə tə tangkwə be wə lo, dɨ Bitulu be Yohana be Yakubu pwɔsɨ ta və imwə de be na və imwə de yinfa.
english: When he came to the house, he didn’t allow anyone to enter in, except Peter, John, James, the father of the child, and her mother.

jenjo: E ifɨ nɨ tang və de hɛ̃, sɨn go ta fə sen tsəki bisɨ imwə a iye de. Yeso tsɨ le tsa, “Bi ban tata yɛ, o bwi lo son lwe dɨ nɨnglwe.”
english: All were weeping and mourning her, but he said, “Don’t weep. She isn’t dead, but sleeping.”

jenjo: Bɨ e mə wə bisɨ e yipɨ imwə de bwi yang.
english: They were ridiculing him, knowing that she was dead.

jenjo: Yeso mwə kəna imwə a iye de, o dzupɨ be wi kɔ̃kɔ̃ o tsa, “Yɨ mi, a yi!”
english: But he put them all outside, and taking her by the hand, he called, saying, “Child, arise!”

jenjo: Hũlɨ wə fə wu sɨ wə, bɨ o yi o tsɨ pu. Yeso nə le lə tsa, “Ba tə wə nɨngtang.”
english: Her spirit returned, and she rose up immediately. He commanded that something be given to her to eat.

jenjo: Sɨbi mwə e ichilɨ və imwə iye de ihyãnɨng, fə Yeso fɨ tswi le bi en nə ifɨ akə lə yɛ.
english: Her parents were amazed, but he commanded them to tell no one what had been done.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ Yeso dzupɨ e mwambwipu wə bwahywə ji bwayung wukə pɨ a tsɨng nɨ, o tə le sambe be tsɨkunɨng tə e nyə e nɨngvi fə e tɨng nɨngshi.
english: He called the twelve together, and gave them power and authority over all demons, and to cure diseases.

jenjo: Bɨ o tũ le tə e tenwa bi a ivə və Fi, fə e tɨng nɨngshi və e ifɨ sɨshi.
english: He sent them out to preach God’s Kingdom and to heal the sick.

jenjo: O tsɨ le tsa, “Ankələni ba dɨ nɨng akə na bisɨ dzwəwɛ nɨ, bi ban dɨ kə pəna yɛ, alo ho mbla, alo nɨngtang, alo sede, fə bi ban dɨ nɨng tsanɨng akə na bə yɛ.
english: He said to them, “Take nothing for your journey—neither staffs, nor wallet, nor bread, nor money; neither have two coats each.

jenjo: Və ifɨ nɨ mwə bə dzwəwɛ hɛ̃, ba ku pɨbi təkə hywapɨnɨ dzwəwɛ və bə yikə nɨ.
english: Into whatever house you enter, stay there, and depart from there.

jenjo: Pɨnɨ e mwə bə dzwəwɛ lo hɛ̃, ba ku fo hywa və le tswapu bə sapɨnɨ ban jikə tangsə və de nɨ. Tsɨkə nɨngnɨ ta nalə tsa, ke nɨngnɨ chi le kə hɛ̃, dɨ le e tswe ku le lə.
english: As many as don’t receive you, when you depart from that city, shake off even the dust from your feet for a testimony against them.”

jenjo: Dɨbɨ e mwambwipu de o nɨhyã sen kwa hywa de, sen tenwa bi alalɨ və Fi sɨ e ifafɨ, fə pɨnɨ e təkə lə hɛ̃ sen tɨng nɨngshi və e ifɨ.
english: They departed, and went throughout the villages, preaching the Good News, and healing everywhere.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ Klɔ Hiridus Antipas li bi ku e nɨngnɨ Yeso sɨn tswekə nɨ hɛ̃, bɨ ku wə lwi bisɨ e ifɨ sɨn nəlɨ sen tsa dɨ Yohana itswe bɔtismɔ bɨ yi hywa bwa.
english: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him; and he was very perplexed, because it was said by some that John had risen from the dead,

jenjo: E ifɨ akə tsa dɨ Iliya ilinwa bɨ huji.” Fə e ifɨ akə tsa dɨ Ilinwa və Fi a nani akə bɨ dzwi.”
english: and by some that Elijah had appeared, and by others that one of the old prophets had risen again.

jenjo: Be Hiridus nyibi tsa, “N tũ ku Yohana yang, yə dɨ wə sɨ min li bi ku wə ho?” Dɨbɨ o bapɨ nɨhyã pɨ bə Yeso.
english: Herod said, “John I beheaded, but who is this, about whom I hear such things?” He sought to see him.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ e mwambwipu və Yeso fə dzwəwɛ de wukə nɨ, bɨ e nə Yeso e nɨng nɨ e tswekə nɨ hɛ̃. Bɨ O ho be mwambwipu o, e yə tangsə e ifafɨ, e tə na və a kã nɨ sen dzukə Batsaida nɨ.
english: The apostles, when they had returned, told him what things they had done. He took them, and withdrew apart to a desert region of a city called Bethsaida.

jenjo: Lehɛ̃ e ifafɨ li pɨ nɨ o təkə lə nɨ, dɨbɨ e nyəpɨ wə. O tsɨ le e ho sɨ le tsa lə nɨ, bɨ o nə le bi a ivə və Fi lə, fə o tɨng nɨngshi və e ifɨ sɨshi.
english: But the multitudes, perceiving it, followed him. He welcomed them, and spoke to them of God’s Kingdom, and he cured those who needed healing.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ fi kyə̃pɨ o bwa nɨ, e mwambwipu və Yeso bwahywə ji yung wu sɨ wə bɨ e tsa, “A le e ifɨ nɨ na, hɛbələ e bapɨ nɨng nɨ en tangkə nɨ be pɨ lwelɨ na e və a bɨnghu be e bɨngkə a pikang nɨ pəsəpi be pɨnɨ, kə bɨ le bɨnghu və hyə̃ nɨngtang be pɨ lwelɨ ywang.”
english: The day began to wear away; and the twelve came, and said to him, “Send the multitude away, that they may go into the surrounding villages and farms, and lodge, and get food, for we are here in a deserted place.”

jenjo: Yeso kwə nwa le tsa, “Ba bə ba tə le nɨngtang.” Bɨ e kwə wə lə e tsa, “Nyɔ la dɨ kumpa bwahmə yinfa be hyɨng bwayung. Sɨ man yidi tə bɨ jə nɨngtang bisɨ e ifafɨ nɨ hɛ̃?”
english: But he said to them, “You give them something to eat.” They said, “We have no more than five loaves and two fish, unless we should go and buy food for all these people.”

jenjo: E ifafɨ tə yang nwufe bwahmɨ pɨbi. Lehɛ̃ o nə e mwambwi o lə o tsa, “Ba nə le lə, e mwəsə nwuyung ji hywə nwuyung ji hywə, yə e ku hywa.”
english: For they were about five thousand men. He said to his disciples, “Make them sit down in groups of about fifty each.”

jenjo: Bɨ e mwambwi o tswe mambɨ, e ifafɨ hɛ̃ ku hywa yang.
english: They did so, and made them all sit down.

jenjo: Yeso bwi e kumpa bwahmə be e hyɨng bwayung de nɨ, bɨ o dɨ ku wə o yikə dzwe, o tə Fi kãlɨ bɨ o chwĩ le yangshang fə o tə e mwambwi o tə e tsə e ifɨ lə.
english: He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to the sky, he blessed them, and broke them, and gave them to the disciples to set before the multitude.

jenjo: E ifafɨ tang nɨng ywa le tsə. E mwambwi o pwɔ nyɔ nɨngtang yɨ kəlo bwahywə ji yung.
english: They ate, and were all filled. They gathered up twelve baskets of broken pieces that were left over.

jenjo: Vi akə lə Yeso sɨn pinwa be tsɨng wə, bɨ o wu na sɨ e mwambwi o, fə o bi le o tsa, “Be e ifafɨ sɨn tsa mi dɨ wəde?”
english: As he was praying alone, the disciples were with him, and he asked them, “Who do the multitudes say that I am?”

jenjo: E mwambwi o kwə nwa wə tsa, “E ifɨ akə tsa mə dɨ Yohana Itswe Bɔtismɔ, e ifɨ akə tsa mə dɨ Iliya, fə e ifɨ akə tsa mə dɨ tsɨng tangsə e ilinwa və Fi a nani bɨ dzwi.”
english: They answered, “‘John the Baptizer,’ but others say, ‘Elijah,’ and others, that one of the old prophets is risen again.”

jenjo: O bi le o tsa, “Yə ba bə, ba tsa mi dɨ wəde?” Bitulu kwə nwa wə tsa, “Dɨ mə kə Ifɨ nɨ Fi gbə wə sɔ tũ kə nɨ.”
english: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” Peter answered, “The Christ of God.”

jenjo: Yeso fɨ chwi le tsa, bi e nə ifɨ akə lə yɛ.
english: But he warned them, and commanded them to tell this to no one,

jenjo: Fə o tsa, “Dɨ tɔle Yɨ Ifafɨ tswe ibe tsɨng tsɨng, fə e ihyãfɨ və e Yahuda, be e ihyãfɨ hyɔ̃nɨng be e inyi nasɨ lenwa və Musa, yin la wə la. En yə wə yə, be nɨng bwatə a vi, on yi be hũli.”
english: saying, “The Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.”

jenjo: O nə e ifafɨ nɨ tsɨkə pɨbi nɨ lə o tsa, “Ke ifɨ nɨ hɛ̃ tangsə bə nɨ yidi pɨ mwə tswa mi yang, tɔle o la ku wə, fə o dɨ gãlɨkə ibe o vi hɛ̃, kə o mwə nyi mi.
english: He said to all, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.

jenjo: Ifɨ nɨ sɨn yidi pɨ kang hũlɨ wə yang, hũlɨ wə yin lala. Ke ifɨ nɨ tə hũlɨ wə hywakĩ bisɨ mi yang, on jiku ji.
english: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, but whoever will lose his life for my sake, the same will save it.

jenjo: Dɨ pwətɛ bə ifɨ yin chi pɨbi, a e tsa o chi fangwa nɨ hɛ̃ fə o la hũlɨ wə?
english: For what does it profit a man if he gains the whole world, and loses or forfeits his own self?

jenjo: Ke ifɨ nɨ tswe suku mi be bi mi hɛ̃, mi bɨmpo min tswe suku o mambɨ, hywapɨ nɨ fə min wu kə be kãlɨ mi, be kãlɨ və Fi ta mi, pwɔsɨ a və e ikwətũ a kĩlɨ və Fi dzwe.
english: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words, of him will the Son of Man be ashamed, when he comes in his glory, and the glory of the Father, and of the holy angels.

jenjo: Min nə bə bi anɨng lə, tangsə bə nɨ ba tsɨkə pɨnɨ nɨ, e ifɨ akə lə nɨ yin bə Ivə və Fi, kə bang bwa yi dɨ le.
english: But I tell you the truth: There are some of those who stand here, who will in no way taste of death, until they see God’s Kingdom.”

jenjo: Tswe ma pu hywĩtə nɨ, bɨ Yeso dɨ Bitulu be Yakubu be Yohana təkə ku te akə, hɛbələ tə o pinwa.
english: About eight days after these sayings, he took with him Peter, John, and James, and went up onto the mountain to pray.

jenjo: Wə ku pilɨ a nwa ho, bɨ pwəchi wə be e nɨng nɨ o yakə sɨ wə nɨ myɛ sɨn chwĩ yiyi.
english: As he was praying, the appearance of his face was altered, and his clothing became white and dazzling.

jenjo: E ifɨ bwayung, Musa be Iliya
english: Behold, two men were talking with him, who were Moses and Elijah,

jenjo: huji pɨbi be chwĩyiyi a kãlɨ. Sen nəsə bi be Yeso, ku nɨngnɨ Fi nəkə ku bwilɨ nɨ yi on bwikə Urushalima nɨ, yin tswe mambɨ.
english: who appeared in glory, and spoke of his departure, which he was about to accomplish at Jerusalem.

jenjo: Bitulu be e nyɔ le nɨ, nɨng le yɨlə be jĩjĩ nɨnglwe. Hywapɨ nɨ nɨng le kə kə nɨ, bɨ e bə Yeso tangsə kãlɨ o be e ifɨ bwayung nɨ tsɨkə gyɛ wə nɨ.
english: Now Peter and those who were with him were heavy with sleep, but when they were fully awake, they saw his glory, and the two men who stood with him.

jenjo: Musa be Iliya sɨn fəlɨ ho, bɨ Bitulu tsa, “Itwebɨ, hyĩkwã bɨ pɨnɨ nɨ. Bɨ e nɨng hywa bwatə, tsɨng dɨ a mə, tsɨng a və Musa, a nɨng bwatə tsɨkə a və Iliya.” O yi nɨng nɨ son nəkə nɨ lo bisɨ tiku o ywang sɨ wəw.
english: As they were parting from him, Peter said to Jesus, “Master, it is good for us to be here. Let’s make three tents: one for you, and one for Moses, and one for Elijah,” not knowing what he said.

jenjo: Wə ku bi a nəlɨ ho, bɨ chi dzwe wu dɨpɨ hɛ̃. Sapɨnɨ chi de wu ki le kə nɨ, bɨ e mwambwi de bibi hɛ̃.
english: While he said these things, a cloud came and overshadowed them, and they were afraid as they entered into the cloud.

jenjo: E li wi tangsə chi de tsa, “Dɨ Yɨ Mi nɨ n gbə wə sɔ lə ho, ba kang tswi sɨ bi o.”
english: A voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him!”

jenjo: Wi de nə bi tɨngkə nɨ, bɨ e bə Yeso tsɨ be tsɨng wə. E mwambwi de də nə ifɨ akə bi və nɨng de e bəkə nɨ lo.
english: When the voice came, Jesus was found alone. They were silent, and told no one in those days any of the things which they had seen.

jenjo: Pɨkə sɨ wə, e pĩ hywa ku te nɨ, bɨ e ifɨ kə dzungdzung kwəsə be Yeso.
english: On the next day, when they had come down from the mountain, a great multitude met him.

jenjo: Ibwi akə tangsə e ifafɨ de, dzupɨ be wi bɨ o tsa, “Inyinasɨnɨng, kã nyi mə hɛ̃, a bə shi və mwambwi mi, dɨ wə kə yɨ tsɨng dodo sɨ mi.
english: Behold, a man from the crowd called out, saying, “Teacher, I beg you to look at my son, for he is my only child.

jenjo: Nɨngvi akə sɨn tɔlə wə, tswe imwə de sɨn ki nwakwang. Akə yang sɨn tsə imwə de sɨn gbə hywa fə fo ta sɨn ji nwa wə. Nɨngvi de sɨn dɨ imwə de sɨn chi hywa, fə tswe wə son dɨ nɨngdzwa ihyãnɨng. Nɨngvi de sɨn tə imwə nɨ hũlɨ lo.
english: Behold, a spirit takes him, he suddenly cries out, and it convulses him so that he foams, and it hardly departs from him, bruising him severely.

jenjo: N kũ e mwambwi mə, hɛbələ e ji be nɨngvi nɨ yə sɨ imwə de, be ywang. Nɨngvi de la pɨ ji lɨ.
english: I begged your disciples to cast it out, and they couldn’t.”

jenjo: Yeso a nwa wə tsa, “Bə e ifɨ a hywapɨnɨ, ba pənyi lo sɨ mi. Fə kãlɨ a nyi yɨ ywa bə dɨngdɨng. Kə a donɨ min ku tsung be bə fə min tsanyi be bə kə? A wu be yɨ mə de pɨnɨ.”
english: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you and bear with you? Bring your son here.”

jenjo: Imwə de sɨn wu lɨ ho, bɨ nɨngvi de tsə wə gbə hywa, fə tswe sɨ imwə de sɨn bwə jɔjɔ. Lehɛ̃, Yeso go nɨngvi de jikə, fə tɨng nɨngshi və imwə de. Yeso mwə wə tə ta o.
english: While he was still coming, the demon threw him down and convulsed him violently. But Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the boy, and gave him back to his father.

jenjo: Sɨbi tswe e ifafɨ bisɨ kãlɨ sambe və Fi nɨ e bəkə nɨ. E ifafɨ lə ku sɨn tswe sɨbi bɨtsɨng ku e nɨngnɨ Yeso tswekə nɨ, bɨ o tsɨ e mwambwi o tsa,
english: They were all astonished at the majesty of God. But while all were marveling at all the things which Jesus did, he said to his disciples,

jenjo: “Ba kə jang bə, ba li bi nɨ min nəkə nɨ. En le mi, Yɨ Ifafɨ, en tə na e ifɨ akə.”
english: “Let these words sink into your ears, for the Son of Man will be delivered up into the hands of men.”

jenjo: Lehɛ̃ e yi chi ku bi nɨ o nəkə nɨ lo. E ywe bi de sɨ le, bisɨ bi e yipɨ yɛ, fə sen bibi pɨ bi wə bi de.
english: But they didn’t understand this saying. It was concealed from them, that they should not perceive it, and they were afraid to ask him about this saying.

jenjo: E mwambwi və Yeso pəsɔ pɨ tsasə nwa bwa le ku ifɨ nɨ yin myɛkə ihyãfɨ nɨ.
english: There arose an argument among them about which of them was the greatest.

jenjo: Yeso yi bi a nyilɨ və le hɛ̃, bɨ o mwə imwə fyɛ̃ni wu o tsɨ gyɛ wə.
english: Jesus, perceiving the reasoning of their hearts, took a little child, and set him by his side,

jenjo: Bɨ o tsɨ le tsa, “Ke ifɨ nɨ dɨ imwə fyɛ̃ni ma və ifɨ nɨ kə dzwəwɛ bisɨ mi yang, o mwə dɨ mi dzwəwɛ. Fə ifɨ nɨ mwə mi kə dzwəwɛ nɨ, dɨ Ta mi nɨ tũ mi kə nɨ, bɨ o mwə dzwəwɛ. Ifɨ a hang tangsə bə hɛ̃, dɨ wə kə ihyãfɨ.”
english: and said to them, “Whoever receives this little child in my name receives me. Whoever receives me receives him who sent me. For whoever is least among you all, this one will be great.”

jenjo: Yohana nə Yeso lə tsa, “Itwevə, bɨ bə ifɨ akə sɨn tswe pwatɛ be dzung mə, son go e nɨngvi son jikə. Bɨ nyə wə pɨ tswelɨ bisɨ wə le tangsə bɨ lo.”
english: John answered, “Master, we saw someone casting out demons in your name, and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow with us.”

jenjo: Bɨ Yeso tsɨ wə tsa, “Bi ban nyə wə yɛ! Bisɨ ifɨ nɨ wənyi bə lo hɛ̃, dɨ a və bə.”
english: Jesus said to him, “Don’t forbid him, for he who is not against us is for us.”

jenjo: Fə tə lɨ və Yeso dzwe kyə̃pɨ kə nɨ, bɨ Yeso tsanyi o nɨhyã Urushalima mambɨ.
english: It came to pass, when the days were near that he should be taken up, he intently set his face to go to Jerusalem,

jenjo: O tũ e itenwa akə o chi, tə nə e ifɨ və a bɨnghu Samariya lə, mə pɨ bisɨ wulɨ o.
english: and sent messengers before his face. They went, and entered into a village of the Samaritans, so as to prepare for him.

jenjo: E ifɨ a və a bɨnghu de kwələ Yeso wu dzwəwɛ və le lo, bisɨ dɨ Urushalima Yeso yidi pɨ təlɨ le bɨmpo e li lalɨ təlɨ o pɨ de lo.
english: They didn’t receive him, because he was traveling with his face set towards Jerusalem.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ e mwambwi o, Yakubu be Yohana bəkə mambɨ nɨ, bɨ e tsa, “Itwebɨ, a kwələ bɨ dzupɨ dzwa dzwe wu tswə̃ e ifɨ və a bɨnghu nɨ ma tswelɨ və Iliya!”
english: When his disciples, James and John, saw this, they said, “Lord, do you want us to command fire to come down from the sky, and destroy them, just as Elijah did?”

jenjo: Yeso kwə le lə lo, bɨ o myɛ, o go le o pe hywa.
english: But he turned and rebuked them, “You don’t know of what kind of spirit you are.

jenjo: Bɨ e o nɨhyã, e tə və a bɨnghu akə.
english: For the Son of Man didn’t come to destroy men’s lives, but to save them.” They went to another village.

jenjo: Le ku nɨhyã ho, bɨ ifɨ akə tsɨ Yeso tsa, “Min mwə nyi mə, pɨnɨ man təkə lə hɛ̃.”
english: As they went on the way, a certain man said to him, “I want to follow you wherever you go, Lord.”

jenjo: Yeso kwə nwa wə tsa, “E tabwa, lə be bwa nɨ sen lwekə lə nɨ, e hywĩ lə be və le, be Yɨ Ifafɨ ywang be pɨnɨ on tsɨkə ku wə lə nɨ lo.”
english: Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes, and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head.”

jenjo: Yeso nə ifɨ akə lə tsa, “Wu, a myɛkə mwambwi mi.” Ibwi de kwələ yang, fə o tsa, “Itwemi, fə min tə və, tə min chwi bwa və ta mi, kə fə n wu, n mwə nyi mə.”
english: He said to another, “Follow me!” But he said, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ wə tsa, “A yə e bwa chwi bwa və le. Be mə a mə, dɨ nwatũ mə ho kə a tə tə a tenwa bi a Ivə və Fi.”
english: But Jesus said to him, “Leave the dead to bury their own dead, but you go and announce God’s Kingdom.”

jenjo: Ifɨ akə tsa, “N kwələ yang, Itwemi, min mwə nyi mə, lehɛ̃ a yə mi tə min be e ifɨ mi nwa kə fə n wu.”
english: Another also said, “I want to follow you, Lord, but first allow me to say good-bye to those who are at my house.”

jenjo: Be Yeso tsɨ wə tsa, “Ke ifɨ nɨ pəsɔ nwatũ, fə o hywã na lə hɛ̃, o lo pɨ tswe nwatũ tangsə Ivə və Fi lo.”
english: But Jesus said to him, “No one, having put his hand to the plow, and looking back, is fit for God’s Kingdom.”

jenjo: Tswa wə nɨ, Itwebɨ Yeso dzupɨ e mwambwi o nwutə ji hywə nyəng tsɨ hywa ji bwayung, bɨ o tũ le bwayung bwayung e o chi wə e tə e və be e pɨnɨ hywakĩ son yidi pɨ təkə lə nɨ.
english: Now after these things, the Lord also appointed seventy others, and sent them two by two ahead of him into every city and place, where he was about to come.

jenjo: Bɨ o tsɨ le o tsa, “Nɨng pɨ̃ dzwang yang ihyãnɨng, be e itswe nwatũ sɨ wə tswəni. Ba kũ itwe fanɨng tũpɨ be e itswe nwatũ fanɨng de.
english: Then he said to them, “The harvest is indeed plentiful, but the laborers are few. Pray therefore to the Lord of the harvest, that he may send out laborers into his harvest.

jenjo: Ba tə! Sɨ min tũ bə ma nɨngpunga tangsə e tantswĩ.
english: Go your ways. Behold, I send you out as lambs among wolves.

jenjo: Bi ban dɨ ho nɨntsənɨng, be nɨngtang, aloyang hũ yɛ, fə bi ban tsɨ hywa bisɨ pɨ tsasə be ifɨ akə ku nɨhyã yɛ.
english: Carry no purse, nor wallet, nor sandals. Greet no one on the way.

jenjo: A ba tə tangvə yang ba o chi ba tsa, ‘Də, a tã və Fi wu tangvə nɨ.’
english: Into whatever house you enter, first say, ‘Peace be to this house.’

jenjo: Aba ifɨ a tã lə tangvə de yang, pɨtsapɨ a tãnyi və bə wu ku wə. Aba ifɨ a tã ywang lo yang, pɨtsapɨ a tã və bə fə wu ku bə.
english: If a son of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; but if not, it will return to you.

jenjo: Ba ku tangvə de, ba tang ba nwa nɨng nɨ e tə bəkə hɛ̃, bisɨ hyĩkwã e fə ifɨ tswe nwatũ pɨtswə̃ o. Bi ban yi və a pɨnɨ ban tə və a kə yɛ.
english: Remain in that same house, eating and drinking the things they give, for the laborer is worthy of his wages. Don’t go from house to house.

jenjo: “Pɨnɨ bə təkələ e mwə bə dzwəwɛ hɛ̃, ke nɨng nɨ e tsɨ bə chi bə hɛ̃, ba tang.
english: Into whatever city you enter, and they receive you, eat the things that are set before you.

jenjo: Ba tɨng sɨshi və e ifɨ a pɨ de, fə ba tsɨ le tsa, ‘Ivə və Fɨ kyə̃pɨ yang sɨ bə.’
english: Heal the sick who are therein, and tell them, ‘God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’

jenjo: Pɨnɨ ba təkə lə e mwə bə dzwəwɛ lo yang, ba tə ku nɨhyã və de ba tsa,
english: But into whatever city you enter, and they don’t receive you, go out into its streets and say,

jenjo: ‘A dɨ fo hywa və bə nɨ ta mwə pu bɨ nɨ, bɨ ku bɨ etə yang tsɨkə kitə ku bə. Lehɛ̃ bə yipɨ Ivə və Fi kyãpɨ yang.’
english: ‘Even the dust from your city that clings to us, we wipe off against you. Nevertheless know this, that God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’

jenjo: Ku min nə bə lə, vi kitə və Fi nɨ sɨn wukə nɨ, Tɔlə və e ifɨ və de yin pe a və e ifɨ a Sodom.
english: I tell you, it will be more tolerable in that day for Sodom than for that city.

jenjo: Wewe ta bə e ifɨ a Korasin be mə Betsaida! Nwatũ nɨng tswe sɨbi nɨ e tswe kə sɨ bə nɨ, a sako e tswe mambɨ tangsə e ifɨ a Taya be Sidon yang, lakə e ifɨ de myɛ nyi le e sɨ Fi e tsə zənɨng e e fo e tə wə yang.
english: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.

jenjo: Vi kitə de, Fi yin bəshi və e ifɨ a Taya be Sidon pe sɨ bə.
english: But it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon in the judgment than for you.

jenjo: Mə Kaparnahum, sɨ man bə ma kãlɨ mə e dɨ mə en təkə dzwe? Oho! En tə be mə bwa.
english: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, will be brought down to Hades.

jenjo: “Ke ifɨ nɨ li bə hɛ̃, o li dɨ mi. Ifɨ nɨ la mi yang, o la dɨ ifɨ nɨ tũ mi kə nɨ.”
english: Whoever listens to you listens to me, and whoever rejects you rejects me. Whoever rejects me rejects him who sent me.”

jenjo: E ifɨ nwutə ji hywə kyə bwayung fə wu sɨn bɛlɨ e tsa, “Itwebɨ, a bɨ dzu dzung mə yang, e nɨngvi kusɨn li nwa bɨ.”
english: The seventy returned with joy, saying, “Lord, even the demons are subject to us in your name!”

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ le tsa, “N bə Shetan wana o dzwe ma mɛmɛ.
english: He said to them, “I saw Satan having fallen like lightning from heaven.

jenjo: Ba li, n təbə tsɨkunɨng yang ban ta e tso be e hyəng, fə ban pe sambe və mbwe və bə Shetan, nɨng akə pa hwə̃ baw.
english: Behold, I give you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will in any way hurt you.

jenjo: Bi ban bɛ bisɨ e nɨngvi ku sɨn li bə yɛ, lehɛ̃ ba bɛ bisɨ e vĩ dzung bə yang dzwe.”
english: Nevertheless, don’t rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.”

jenjo: Sapɨde Kwang Fi tswe Yeso li lalɨ bɨ o tsa, “Ta mi, ku sɨ min yənwa sɨ mə, Itwe dzwe be fangwa hɛ̃, bisɨ a ywe bi anɨng sɨ e ifɨ a yulɨ be e ifɨ hywĩku, a ta e imwə yangshang na lə. Hĩkwã Ta, kə dɨ nɨngnɨ a yidi kə ho.
english: In that same hour Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit, and said, “I thank you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you have hidden these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.”

jenjo: Ta mi tə mi tsɨkunɨng yang ku e nɨng hɛ̃. Ifɨ akə yi dɨ wə kə yɨ de lo, be dɨ Ta tsɨng. Mambɨ ifɨ akə yi dɨ wə kə Ta de lo, be dɨ yɨ tsɨng be e ifɨ nɨ yɨ de yidi kə dzwa tsɨ le lə nɨ.”
english: Turning to the disciples, he said, “All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is, except the Father, and who the Father is, except the Son, and he to whomever the Son desires to reveal him.”

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ nyɔ dɨ le bwa le nɨ, bɨ o myɛ o tsɨ le tsa, “Bə dɨ e ifɨ pərkə, bə nɨ nɨng ba bəkə e nɨng nɨ.
english: Turning to the disciples, he said privately, “Blessed are the eyes which see the things that you see,

jenjo: Sɨ min nə bə lə, e Ilinwa be e ivə ihyãnɨng tsɨbi pɨ bəlɨ fə li nɨngnɨ ba bəkə fə ba likə nɨ, be e chi lo.”
english: for I tell you that many prophets and kings desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them, and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.”

jenjo: Vi akə inyi nasɨ lenwa və Musa akə tsɨpu o gbə ywa Yeso o tsa, “Inyi nasɨ nɨng, dɨbə min tswe min chikə hũlɨ kə a itsɨng?”
english: Behold, a certain lawyer stood up and tested him, saying, “Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ wə tsa, “Yə Lenwa və Musa tsa bəde? Sɨ man sa wə nwu?”
english: He said to him, “What is written in the law? How do you read it?”

jenjo: Ibwi de kwə tsa, “ ‘A tswe bi və Itwe mə Fi be nyi mə hɛ̃ be hũlɨ mə hɛ̃ be sambe mə hɛ̃ be tiku mə hɛ̃.’ Fə, ‘A tswe bi və ifɨ kwanki mə, ma tswelɨ sɨ man tswekə bi ku mə nɨ.’ ”
english: He answered, “You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your strength, and with all your mind; and your neighbor as yourself.”

jenjo: Yeso fə kwə tsa, “A nə tsɨ yang. A tswe mambɨ yang man chi hũlɨ kə a itsɨng.”
english: He said to him, “You have answered correctly. Do this, and you will live.”

jenjo: Ibwi de yidi pɨ ta e ifɨ na lə lɨ ywang be ayibew, bɨ o bi Yeso o tsa, “Yə dɨ wə kə ifɨ kwanki mi?”
english: But he, desiring to justify himself, asked Jesus, “Who is my neighbor?”

jenjo: Sa akə lə nɨ ibwi Yahudiya akə yi Urushalima on tə dzwəwɛ Jeriko, bɨ o kwəsə be e ifɨ nɨng yinɨng be nɨng bi. E gbə wə a bwi e nɨng hɛ̃ na wə, bɨ e yə wə na bwa.
english: Jesus answered, “A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and he fell among robbers, who both stripped him and beat him, and departed, leaving him half dead.

jenjo: Ihyɔ̃nɨng və Fi akə wu sɨn pelɨ. Sapɨnɨ o bəkə ifɨ de lwekə hywa nɨ, bɨ o gã o mwə ngwa tsɨng o pe.
english: By chance a certain priest was going down that way. When he saw him, he passed by on the other side.

jenjo: Mambɨ ihyãfɨ akə pɨnyi Levi wu chi wə lwe hywa, bɨ o mwə ngwa tsɨng o pe.
english: In the same way a Levite also, when he came to the place, and saw him, passed by on the other side.

jenjo: “Bɨ ibwi Samariya mwe Ywavə wu on pelɨ, o bəshi və ifɨ de.
english: But a certain Samaritan, as he traveled, came where he was. When he saw him, he was moved with compassion,

jenjo: O tə sɨ wə, o lo wə nwa nɨngdzwa lə, fə o gba hu lə o tsə be zənɨng. O dɨ wə o tsɨ ku wande, bɨ o tə be wə tangvə akə, o tsɨ nɨng sɨ wə.
english: came to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. He set him on his own animal, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.

jenjo: Pɨkə sɨ wə, o tə itwevə de sede pang bwayung. Bɨ o tsɨ wə tsa, ‘A tsɨ nɨng sɨ wə. Aba a yə sede ku wə pe mambɨ yang, fə n wu yang min fə ma fə.’ ”
english: On the next day, when he departed, he took out two denarii, and gave them to the host, and said to him, ‘Take care of him. Whatever you spend beyond that, I will repay you when I return.’

jenjo: Yeso bi Inyi nasɨ lenwa de tsa, “Tangsə e ifɨ bwatə nɨ, dɨ wə kə ifɨ kwanki və ifɨ nɨ e gbəkə nɨ?”
english: Now which of these three do you think seemed to be a neighbor to him who fell among the robbers?”

jenjo: Ibwi de tsa, “Ifɨ nɨ bəkə shi o nɨ.” Bɨ Yeso tsɨ wə tsa, “Tə a tswe mambɨ.”
english: He said, “He who showed mercy on him.” Then Jesus said to him, “Go and do likewise.”

jenjo: Yeso be e mwambwi o ku nɨhyã pɨ tə Urushalima. E wu və a bɨnghu akə nɨ iye akə lə pɨbi dzung wə a Marta. O mwə le dzwəwɛ tang və wə.
english: As they went on their way, he entered into a certain village, and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.

jenjo: Hywĩ wə Maryamu wu ku hywa pɨpi Yeso ku sɨn li bi o.
english: She had a sister called Mary, who also sat at Jesus’ feet, and heard his word.

jenjo: Be Marta tsɨ sɨn tswe ibe sɨ nwatũ nɨngtang a ywilɨ. O wu sɨ Yeso o tsɨ wə, “Itwemi, yɨlə mə lo ho hywĩ mi yə mi sɨ min tswe nwatũ be tsɨng mi? A tsɨ wə wu o pələ mi.”
english: But Martha was distracted with much serving, and she came up to him, and said, “Lord, don’t you care that my sister left me to serve alone? Ask her therefore to help me.”

jenjo: Bɨ Itwebɨ tsɨ wə, “Marta, Marta, a yilə ku mə fə sɨ man wanchə ku e nɨng ihyãnɨng.
english: Jesus answered her, “Martha, Martha, you are anxious and troubled about many things,

jenjo: Dɨ nɨng tsɨng bɨ ifɨ sɨn bapɨ. Maryamu chi nɨng de yang. Pa e kwə e dɨ na wəw.”
english: but one thing is needed. Mary has chosen the good part, which will not be taken away from her.”

jenjo: Vi akə lə nɨ Yeso sɨn pinwa pɨ akə. O pinwa tɨngkə nɨ, bɨ tsɨng tangsə e mwambwipu o tsɨ wə tsa, “Itwebɨ, a nyi bɨ na sɨ pilɨ a nwa, ma nyilɨ Yohana nyikə e mwambwi o na lə nɨ.”
english: When he finished praying in a certain place, one of his disciples said to him, “Lord, teach us to pray, just as John also taught his disciples.”

jenjo: O tsɨ le tsa, “A yi ban pinwa yang ba tsa, “ ‘Fi ta və bɨ dzwe, e tə dzung mə kãlɨ. Ivə mə wu.
english: He said to them, “When you pray, say, ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy. May your Kingdom come. May your will be done on earth, as it is in heaven.

jenjo: A tə bɨ nɨngtang kəvivi.
english: Give us day by day our daily bread.

jenjo: A e nyi mə hywa ku nɨng abe və bɨ, kə bɨ bɨmpo sɨ bɨn e a bɨ nyi bɨ hywa sɨ e ifɨ nɨ sɨn tswe bɨ ayibe lə nɨ. Bi man yə bɨ bɨn o sɨ pɨ hãpɨ yɛ, be a ji be bɨ na ipyɨngnɨng.’ ”
english: Forgive us our sins, for we ourselves also forgive everyone who is indebted to us. Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.’”

jenjo: Bɨ fə o tsɨ le tsa, “Aba a lə be tswə, bɨ a tə sɨ wə be nyinyi nvi a tsɨ wə tsa, ‘A mwə mi yə nwa chɛ̃ nfa bwatə,
english: He said to them, “Which of you, if you go to a friend at midnight, and tell him, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves of bread,

jenjo: tswə mi akə wu dzwawɛ sɨ mi, n ywang be nɨngtang nɨ min tə wə nɨ lo.’
english: for a friend of mine has come to me from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him,’

jenjo: “Bɨ o kwə tangkwə o tsa, ‘Bi man yilə mi yɛ. N chi nwakwə yang, n lwe hywa yang be e yɨ mi ku hywe. N pa yi n tə mə nɨng akəw.’
english: and he from within will answer and say, ‘Don’t bother me. The door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed. I can’t get up and give it to you’?

jenjo: Sɨ min nə bə lə, aba o yi bisɨ mə dɨ tswə wə lo yang, on yiyi bisɨ myɛlɨ a myɛ gwɛgwɛ a tsɨ wə hywa nɨ, on tə mə nɨngnɨ hɛ̃ a yidi nɨ.
english: I tell you, although he will not rise and give it to him because he is his friend, yet because of his persistence, he will get up and give him as many as he needs.

jenjo: “Bisɨ mambɨ sɨ min nə bə lə, ba kũ pɨ en tə bə tə. Ba bapɨ, ban chichi. Ba gbə na nwakwə, en be bə lə be.
english: “I tell you, keep asking, and it will be given you. Keep seeking, and you will find. Keep knocking, and it will be opened to you.

jenjo: Ke ifɨ nɨ bipɨ hɛ̃, en tə wə tə. Ifɨ nɨ bakə pɨ hɛ̃ on chichi, fə ifɨ nɨ gbə na nwakwə yang, en be nwakwə bisɨ wə.
english: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.

jenjo: “Dɨ wə tangsə bə e ichilɨ imwə, yɨ wə kũ kumpa na wə, on tə wə te? Alo o kũ hyɨng, on tə wə mɨmɨ?
english: “Which of you fathers, if your son asks for bread, will give him a stone? Or if he asks for a fish, he won’t give him a snake instead of a fish, will he?

jenjo: Mambɨlo yang, o kũ pɨng yang on tə wə hyəng?
english: Or if he asks for an egg, he won’t give him a scorpion, will he?

jenjo: Bə kə e ifɨ pyɨngnɨng ba yi nɨng a pikang nɨ ban təkə e yɨ bə yang, səko ta və bə dzwe, yi on tə e ifɨ nɨ bi wə Kwang Fi nɨ tə”
english: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him?”

jenjo: Yeso go nɨngvi sɨ ifɨ akə sɨn nə bi lo son jikə. Sapɨnɨ nɨngvi de jikə nɨ, bɨ ibwi nɨ sɨn nəkə bi de lo pəsɔ pɨ nə bi. Bɨ sɨbi tswe e ifafɨ pɨbi.
english: He was casting out a demon, and it was mute. When the demon had gone out, the mute man spoke; and the multitudes marveled.

jenjo: Be e ifɨ akə tsa, “Le sɨ Belzebuba, nɨnɨngvi bɨ o chi dzwanglɨ nɨ son nyəkə e nɨngvi nɨ.”
english: But some of them said, “He casts out demons by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”

jenjo: E ifɨ akə yidi pɨ nyi Yeso, e tsɨ wə tsa, “A tswe nɨngbisɨ nɨ bɨn yipɨ kə akang a chi tsɨkunɨng le sɨ Fi.”
english: Others, testing him, sought from him a sign from heaven.

jenjo: Yeso yipɨ bi a nyilɨ və le yang, bɨ o tsɨ le tsa, “Aba və nwa le tsɨ tsɨng tsɨng sen tasə bwi bwa le yang, və de tsɨw. Ke və nɨ ku le kwəsə lo hɛ̃, və de yin yasə ya.
english: But he, knowing their thoughts, said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation. A house divided against itself falls.

jenjo: Ba tsa n chi dzwanglɨ le sɨ Nɨnɨngvi bɨ sɨ min nyəkə e nɨngvi. Aba tangvə Shetan yi tsɨsə ku sen tabwi bwa le yang, tswe nwu və de yi tsɨkə lɨ?
english: If Satan also is divided against himself, how will his kingdom stand? For you say that I cast out demons by Beelzebul.

jenjo: Aba e tsa n chi dzwanglɨ le sɨ Nɨnɨngvi bɨ sɨ min nyəkə e nɨngvi yang, yə e mwambwi və bə chi a le dzwanglɨ le sɨ wəde bɨ sen jikə? E ifɨ və bə yin tə bə nwayung tə.
english: But if I cast out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore will they be your judges.

jenjo: Aba n nyə e nɨngvi sɨ min jikə be sambe və Fi yang, Ivə və Fi wu tangsə bə yang ho.
english: But if I by God’s finger cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come to you.

jenjo: “Hywapɨnɨ ifɨ sambe bwi nɨngbi o sɨn tsɨ nɨng sɨ və wə yang, nɨng akə la tangvə wəw.
english: “When the strong man, fully armed, guards his own dwelling, his goods are safe.

jenjo: Be hywapɨnɨ ifɨ nɨ tsa pe wəkə nɨ, wu lwe ku wə fə pe sambe o, on bwi e nɨngbi nɨ o tsɨkə nyi lə nɨ on təkə tə, fə e nɨngna nɨ o bwikə na itwevə de, ifɨ sambe de tə yin tsəsə be e tswə wə.
english: But when someone stronger attacks him and overcomes him, he takes from him his whole armor in which he trusted, and divides his plunder.

jenjo: “Ifɨ nɨ tsung be mi lo hɛ̃, son wənyi mi, fə ke ifɨ nɨ pələ mi si pwɔlɨ lo hɛ̃, ifɨ de bwi sɨn yatə.
english: “He that is not with me is against me. He who doesn’t gather with me scatters.

jenjo: “Aba nɨngvi ji sɨ ifi yang, ku son tə nyihu nɨ mɨng ywang pɨbi lo nɨ. A o chi pɨ kulɨ lo yang, on tsa, ‘Fə min tə pɨ kulɨ mi nɨ n yəkə lə nɨ.’
english: The unclean spirit, when he has gone out of the man, passes through dry places, seeking rest, and finding none, he says, ‘I will turn back to my house from which I came out.’

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ fə o wukə nɨ, on chi və de e kɔ kĩkĩlɨ fə e mə tsɨ pikang.
english: When he returns, he finds it swept and put in order.

jenjo: Bisɨ mambɨ nɨngvi de fə tə yin bapɨ e nɨngvi hywĩyung nɨ pe wə be kãlɨ anyi nɨ. Le hɛ̃ wu en tə ku wə en ku pɨbi, ibe və ifɨ de yin pe a na nwachi.”
english: Then he goes, and takes seven other spirits more evil than himself, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first.”

jenjo: Wə ku bi a nəlɨ ho, bɨ iye akə nə bi be wi tsa, “Na nɨ dɨ mə ywa fə a ũkə mɨngmi wə nɨ, dɨ ifɨ pərkə.”
english: It came to pass, as he said these things, a certain woman out of the multitude lifted up her voice, and said to him, “Blessed is the womb that bore you, and the breasts which nursed you!”

jenjo: Yeso kwə tsa, “Be pərkə dɨ a və e ifɨ nɨ likə bi və Fi fə sɨn tswekə nwatũ nɨ.”
english: But he said, “On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it.”

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ dzung və e ifɨ de sɨn yiku lɨ, bɨ Yeso nə bi tsa, “E ifafɨ a hywa pɨnɨ dɨ e ifɨ kãnyi, ku sen yidi n ta le na sɨ nɨngbisɨ kə e kwələ. Dɨ nɨngnɨ min ta le nalə ho kə nɨng nɨ tswe pɨ hywa və Yunana nɨ.
english: When the multitudes were gathering together to him, he began to say, “This is an evil generation. It seeks after a sign. No sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah, the prophet.

jenjo: Nɨngnɨ chikə Yunana nɨ tswe e ifɨ və a Niniva yipɨ dɨ Fi tũ wə nɨ. Mambɨ nɨngnɨ yin chikə Yɨ Ifafɨ nɨ yin myɛkə nɨng nɨ yi en yipɨ dɨ Fi tũ wə nɨ.
english: For even as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites, so will also the Son of Man be to this generation.

jenjo: “Vi kitə Iye Ivə a Sheba on tsa e ifɨ a hywa a pɨnɨ lə be ayibe. O yi pɨ a tswilɨ bisɨ o li bi a yulɨ və Sulemanu. Lehɛ̃ ifɨ nɨ pekə Sulemanu nɨ wu yang, be sɨ ban li wə lə?
english: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and will condemn them: for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, one greater than Solomon is here.

jenjo: E ifɨ a Niniva, yi en tsɨsə be e ifɨ a hywa a pɨnɨ vi kitə, bisɨ e li bi tenwa və Yunana e mwə myɛ e yə nɨng abe və le yang. Sɨswenɨ ifɨ nɨ pekə Yunana nɨ wuyang, be ba mwə ba myɛ lo.
english: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonah, and behold, one greater than Jonah is here.

jenjo: “Ifɨ nɨ tsɨkə dzwakəpɨ fə ywekə bwa hywe nɨ ywang, aloyang o pe shə ku wə. Be on tsɨ le ku hywe bisɨ kəpɨ sɨ e ifɨ nɨ wukə tangvə nɨ.
english: “No one, when he has lit a lamp, puts it in a cellar or under a basket, but on a stand, that those who come in may see the light.

jenjo: Dɨ nɨng mə bɨ tsɨkə dzwakəpɨ sɨ mə. Aba nɨng mə tsɨ pikang yang, sɨ mə kəkəlɨ. A nɨng mə tsɨ pikang lo yang, sɨ mə hɛ̃ dɨ tangkuchi.
english: The lamp of the body is the eye. Therefore when your eye is good, your whole body is also full of light; but when it is evil, your body also is full of darkness.

jenjo: Bisɨ mambɨ a kang ku mə, pɨ a kəlɨ nɨ a tsa a ləkə nɨ, kang bi dɨ tangkuchi.
english: Therefore see whether the light that is in you isn’t darkness.

jenjo: Aba sɨ mə hɛ̃ tsɨkə pɨ akəlɨ, ngwa akə tangkuchi ywang lo yang, nyɔ sɨ mə hɛ̃ yin tsɨkə pɨ akəlɨ ku ma dzwa nɨ e tsɨ kə sɨn kəkəpɨ sɨ mə nɨ.”
english: If therefore your whole body is full of light, having no part dark, it will be wholly full of light, as when the lamp with its bright shining gives you light.”

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ Yeso nə bi tɨng kə nɨ, ibwi Farisa akə dzupɨ wə pɨ nɨngtang. Bɨ tə o ku hywa nwaji nɨngtang de.
english: Now as he spoke, a certain Pharisee asked him to dine with him. He went in, and sat at the table.

jenjo: Ibwi Farisa de bə Yeso pəsɔ pɨ tangnɨng o lo na wə lo nɨ, bɨ nɨng de tə wə sɨbi.
english: When the Pharisee saw it, he marveled that he had not first washed himself before dinner.

jenjo: Bɨ Itwebɨ tsɨ wə tsa, “Bə e Farisa, dɨ tswa ji be ilang sɨ ban lolɨ, be tangsə nyinyi bə yilə be kunɛnɛ be nyi akãlɨ.
english: The Lord said to him, “Now you Pharisees cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter, but your inward part is full of extortion and wickedness.

jenjo: E ifɨ a yalɨ! Dɨ Fi bɨ mə tangsə be tswa lo?
english: You foolish ones, didn’t he who made the outside make the inside also?

jenjo: Bisɨ mambɨ ba lo tangsə kĩlə, ba tə e ifɨ ibe nɨng tənɨng, nyɔ sɨ bə hɛ̃ yin kĩkĩ.
english: But give for gifts to the needy those things which are within, and behold, all things will be clean to you.

jenjo: “Wewe ta bə yang, e Farisa! Sɨ ban tə Fi kəka nɨngpɨ̃ və bə hɛ̃, be nyinyi bə chĩ sɨ bi anɨng be tswelɨ abi və Fi. Ba tə kəka, be bi ban yə tswelɨ a e nɨng a pikang yɛ.
english: But woe to you Pharisees! For you tithe mint and rue and every herb, but you bypass justice and God’s love. You ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.

jenjo: “Wewe ta bə yang, e Farisa! Sɨ ban yidi pɨkulɨ və e ihyãfɨ pɨkwəsəku be pɨ tsapɨ və e ifɨ lomwe.
english: Woe to you Pharisees! For you love the best seats in the synagogues, and the greetings in the marketplaces.

jenjo: “Wewe ta bə yang, bisɨ ba ku ma kutũ nɨ yəhywa e ifɨ sɨn ho ku wə be e yipɨ lo nɨ.”
english: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like hidden graves, and the men who walk over them don’t know it.”

jenjo: Ifɨ akə tangsə e inyi nasɨ lenwa və Musa tsɨ Yeso tsa, “Inyi nasɨ nɨng, nɨng nɨ a nəkə nɨ, a tɨng dɨ jə bɨ!”
english: One of the lawyers answered him, “Teacher, in saying this you insult us also.”

jenjo: Yeso tsa, “Wewe ta bə yang, e inyi nasɨ lenwa və Musa! Bisɨ ba dɨ nɨng a mwilɨ ba tsɨ e ifafɨ ku, be ba ta le kyɛ̃ be nɨnghywə na bisɨ ba pələ le lo.
english: He said, “Woe to you lawyers also! For you load men with burdens that are difficult to carry, and you yourselves won’t even lift one finger to help carry those burdens.

jenjo: “Wewe ta bə yang, bisɨ ba mi kutũ və e ilinwa və Fi nɨ e papa və bə yəkə nɨ.
english: Woe to you! For you build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.

jenjo: Nɨng nɨ ta na lə ba kwələ yang be e nɨng nɨ e papa və bə de tswekə nɨ yang. E yə e ilinwa və Fi, bə bɨmpo ba mi kutũ le.
english: So you testify and consent to the works of your fathers. For they killed them, and you build their tombs.

jenjo: Dɨ nɨng nɨ Fi be yipɨ o nəkə ho nɨ, ‘Min tũ e ilinwa be e mwambwipu sɨ le, en yə e ifɨ akə en la bi və e ifɨ akə.’
english: Therefore also the wisdom of God said, ‘I will send to them prophets and apostles; and some of them they will kill and persecute,

jenjo: Bisɨ mambɨ e ifɨ a hywapɨnɨ yi en dɨ ayibe bisɨ hywi və e ilinwa nɨ e yəkə dɨlə pəsɔ fangwa nɨ.
english: that the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;

jenjo: Pəsɔ sɨ yəlɨ və Habila wukə sɨ yəlɨ və Zakariya, nɨ e yəkə tangsə pɨ hyɔ̃nɨng be Kwə və Fi nɨ. Min nə bə lə, e ifɨ a sɨswenɨ yin tswe ibe bisɨ le.
english: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zachariah, who perished between the altar and the sanctuary.’ Yes, I tell you, it will be required of this generation.

jenjo: “Wewe ta bə yang, e inyi nasɨ lenwa və Musa! Ba dɨ nɨng be nwakwə a yulɨ ba mwə na bə, bə be ku bə ba tə tangsə lo, fə ba nyə e ifɨ pɨ təlɨ!”
english: Woe to you lawyers! For you took away the key of knowledge. You didn’t enter in yourselves, and those who were entering in, you hindered.”

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ Yeso yəkə pɨ de nɨ, e inyi nasɨ lenwa və Musa, be e Farisa pəsɔ pɨ tswe nɨngdzwinɨng be pɨbipɨ bi ihyãnɨng.
english: As he said these things to them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to be terribly angry, and to draw many things out of him;

jenjo: Sen hã wə hɛbələ e chi o nə bi akə nɨ en mwə wə kə nɨ.
english: lying in wait for him, and seeking to catch him in something he might say, that they might accuse him.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ e ifafɨ pɔsə tswe dzung penwa sen tasə ku nɨ, bɨ Yeso myɛ chi e sɨ e mwambwi o tsa, “Ba tswe hakilo be fɨlɨ a nwa və e Farisa. Bisɨ sen mwə nyi Fi na nwa be ywang nyinyi lew.
english: Meanwhile, when a multitude of many thousands had gathered together, so much so that they trampled on each other, he began to tell his disciples first of all, “Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.

jenjo: Vi lə sɨn wulɨ, nɨng nɨ ke e pe ji lə hɛ̃ en be en tsɨ nɨng fa, nɨng nɨ ke e ywekə hɛ̃ nɨng nyi wə yin jiji.
english: But there is nothing covered up, that will not be revealed, nor hidden, that will not be known.

jenjo: Mambɨ, bi nɨ ba nəkə bɨng tangkuchi hɛ̃, en lili bɨng pwəsə fi. Fə nɨng nɨ ba nəkə tangkwə kɨngkɨng hɛ̃ en tenwa sɨ wə ku ndzwifo bisɨ e ifafɨ hɛ̃ li.
english: Therefore whatever you have said in the darkness will be heard in the light. What you have spoken in the ear in the inner rooms will be proclaimed on the housetops.

jenjo: “E tswə mi, bi ban bibi və e ifɨ nɨ sɨn yəkə tswəsɨ yinfa be nɨng nɨ en tswekə tswa wə nɨ ywang.
english: “I tell you, my friends, don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.

jenjo: Min ta bə nasɨ ifɨ nɨ ban bibi o nɨ. Ba bibi və Fi. Dɨ wə bɨ o yə ifɨ yang, tswa wə o lə be sambe nɨ on dɨ wə on gbəkə dzwa nɨ. Dɨ wə bɨ ban hywilɨ.
english: But I will warn you whom you should fear. Fear him, who after he has killed, has power to cast into Gehenna. Yes, I tell you, fear him.

jenjo: “Ku sen jə yəbyɔ bwahmə kobo bwayung lo? Lehɛ̃ nyinyi Fi chĩ sɨ yəbyɔ tsɨng lo.
english: “Aren’t five sparrows sold for two assaria coins? Not one of them is forgotten by God.

jenjo: Busɨ tsaku nɨ ku bə nɨ, e sa le yang hɛ̃. Bisɨ mambɨ, bi ban bibi yɛ. Ba pe e yəbyɔ ihyãnɨng yang.
english: But the very hairs of your head are all counted. Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.

jenjo: “Min nə bə lə, ke ifɨ nɨ nəkə nɨng e ifɨ tsa lɨ dɨ a mi hɛ̃, mi Yɨ Ifafɨ min nə mambɨ nɨng e ikwətũ və Fi dzwe.
english: “I tell you, everyone who confesses me before men, him will the Son of Man also confess before the angels of God;

jenjo: Ke ifɨ nɨ la mi kə nɨng e ifɨ hɛ̃, mambɨ mi Yɨ Ifafɨ min la o nɨng e ikwətũ və Fi dzwe.
english: but he who denies me in the presence of men will be denied in the presence of the angels of God.

jenjo: Ke ifɨ nɨ nəkə bi ku Yɨ Ifafɨ hɛ̃, e mwə mwane ku wə lo, be ifɨ nɨ nə bɨ anfa ku Kwang Fi hɛ̃, en e nyi hywa və mwəne de lo.
english: Everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but those who blaspheme against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.

jenjo: “Aba e dɨ bə e təkə pɨkwəsəku və e Yahuda chi e ihyãfɨ, aloyang e itsɨkunɨng, bi nyi bə gbəshə bisɨ nɨhyã ji be ku bə be e nɨngnɨ ban nəkə nɨ yɛ.
english: When they bring you before the synagogues, the rulers, and the authorities, don’t be anxious how or what you will answer, or what you will say;

jenjo: Sa a wə, Kwang Fi yin nyi bə na sɨ bi pɨbi.”
english: for the Holy Spirit will teach you in that same hour what you must say.”

jenjo: Ifɨ akə tangsə e ifɨ nɨ tsɨkə pɨbi nɨ tsa, “Inyinasɨnɨng, a nə hywĩ mi lə bɨ tsəsə nɨng nɨ ta və bɨ bwikə yə bɨ lə nɨ.”
english: One of the multitude said to him, “Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me.”

jenjo: Yeso kwə nwa wə tsa, “Tswə mi, dɨ wə tsɨ mi kə inəza tənsə bə bɨ min tswe mambɨ lɨ?”
english: But he said to him, “Man, who made me a judge or an arbitrator over you?”

jenjo: Bɨ o tsɨ le o tsa, “Ba kang ku bə, be e kunɛnɛ hywakĩ, bisɨ hũlɨ bə tsɨ le ku e nɨngchinɨng nɨ ba ləkə nɨ lo.”
english: He said to them, “Beware! Keep yourselves from covetousness, for a man’s life doesn’t consist of the abundance of the things which he possesses.”

jenjo: O nə le bi akə lə o tsa, “Ifɨ nɨngchinɨng akə lə. Ibwi de ləpɨ̃ hywa a pikang, bɨ o chi nɨngpɨ̃ tswe sɨbi.
english: He spoke a parable to them, saying, “The ground of a certain rich man produced abundantly.

jenjo: O nyibi nyinyi wə o tsa, ‘Dɨbə min tswe lɨ? Pa akã nɨ min ekə nɨng pɨ̃ a pɨnɨ nɨ ywang.’
english: He reasoned within himself, saying, ‘What will I do, because I don’t have room to store my crops?’

jenjo: “Bɨ o tsa, ‘Dɨ nɨng nɨ min tswekə ho nɨ. Min de e pa nɨ min mi a kã, min chi pɨnɨ min ekə nɨngpɨ̃ mi be nyɔ nɨng hɛ̃.
english: He said, ‘This is what I will do. I will pull down my barns, and build bigger ones, and there I will store all my grain and my goods.

jenjo: Min tsɨ ku mi, “Sɨswenɨ n lə be nɨngtang nɨ min tangkə ha ihyãnɨng nɨ. Min hũ ku mi lə! Min tang, min nwa, min li lalɨ!’ ”
english: I will tell my soul, “Soul, you have many goods laid up for many years. Take your ease, eat, drink, be merry.”’

jenjo: “Fi tsɨ wə tsa, ‘Mə Danhywɛ! Man bwibwi be nvi nɨ, yə nɨng nɨ a pwɔkə nɨ man yə dɨ wə de lə?’
english: “But God said to him, ‘You foolish one, tonight your soul is required of you. The things which you have prepared—whose will they be?’

jenjo: “Kə akang, dɨ yalɨ ifi pwɔ nɨngchinɨng fangwa nɨ, be sɨ Fi o ywang be nɨng chinɨng pɨbi.”
english: So is he who lays up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.”

jenjo: Bɨ fə o myɛ chi sɨ e mwambwi o tsa, “Dɨbɨ tswe n tsɨ ba bi ban yɨlə ku bə be bi və nɨngtang aloyang bi və nɨngtsənɨng yɛ.
english: He said to his disciples, “Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life, what you will eat, nor yet for your body, what you will wear.

jenjo: Hũlɨ pe nɨngtang yang, tswəsɨ pe nɨngtsənɨng yang.
english: Life is more than food, and the body is more than clothing.

jenjo: Ba bə e kɨnka. En pyənɨng lo, en ji be nɨngpɨ̃ lo, e ywang be pɨ tsɨnɨng sako e mi pa. Dɨ Fi sɨn tang be le. Ba pe hywĩ be pwatɛ yang sɨ wɛ!
english: Consider the ravens: they don’t sow, they don’t reap, they have no warehouse or barn, and God feeds them. How much more valuable are you than birds!

jenjo: Pəshi pa yiku vi və bəw.
english: Which of you by being anxious can add a cubit to his height?

jenjo: Aba pəshi pa tswe hu lo yang ya dɨbə kə pwatɛ yɨlə ku sɨ nɨng a kənkã?
english: If then you aren’t able to do even the least things, why are you anxious about the rest?

jenjo: “Ba bə hĩlɨ a fɨnglɨ və twi. Ma sen tswe nwatũ, en mə nɨngyasɨ lo. Le hɛ̃ Sulemanu be kãlɨ o hɛ̃ o tsə nɨng a tswĩlɨ o pe le lo.
english: Consider the lilies, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin; yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

jenjo: Aba Fi sɨn tsə e hu nɨng tsə nɨng a hĩlɨ lə nɨ jɛnɨ o lə bang pɨ kĩ dzwa yin tswə̃ wə tswə̃ yang, on tsə bə nɨng tsə nɨng lə tsə. Bə e ifɨ pənyi fandi.
english: But if this is how God clothes the grass in the field, which today exists, and tomorrow is cast into the oven, how much more will he clothe you, O you of little faith?

jenjo: “Bi ban nyi bi ku e nɨngnɨ ban tangkə fə ban nwa kə nɨ yɛ. Bi ban pəshi sɨ wə yɛ.
english: Don’t seek what you will eat or what you will drink; neither be anxious.

jenjo: Dɨ e ifɨ fangwa sen nyi bi ku le. Ta və bə yipɨ nɨngnɨ hã bə kə nɨ yang, on tə bə tə
english: For the nations of the world seek after all of these things, but your Father knows that you need these things.

jenjo: Ba pəsɔ bapɨ Ivə və Fi na nwachi. On yi bə ku e nyɔ nɨng hɛ̃.
english: But seek God’s Kingdom, and all these things will be added to you.

jenjo: “Bi sɨbi tswe bə yɛ, e ifɨ a mi a kang. Ta və bə son li lalɨ, son yidi pɨ tə bə lalɨ tangsə Ivə o.
english: Don’t be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the Kingdom.

jenjo: “Ba bwi nɨng və bə ba jə ba tə e ifɨ nɨ ywang be nɨng akə nɨ. Dɨ bɨ tsɨkə ho və bə nɨ n fe kə lo nɨ! Pazhĩ və Fi sɨn gba lo. On kang bə pɨ tsɨnɨng və bə lə pikang, ifɨ yinɨng tə pɨ dew, sanshĩ pəw.
english: Sell that which you have, and give gifts to the needy. Make for yourselves purses which don’t grow old, a treasure in the heavens that doesn’t fail, where no thief approaches, neither moth destroys.

jenjo: Pɨnɨ jɔdi mə tsɨkə lə nɨ, dɨ pɨde nyi mə tsɨ pɨ bi.
english: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

jenjo: “Ba tsə ji bə bisɨ nwatũ, dzwa və bə kəpɨ.
english: “Let your waist be dressed and your lamps burning.

jenjo: Ba ku kulɨ və ifɨ nɨ kusɨn midzwi itwe wə vɨ nɨnglang tsəlɨ a iye nɨ. E ku be nɨngtsɨ sapɨnɨ o wukə hɛ̃ o gbə nwakwə yang lelang e be wə lə.
english: Be like men watching for their lord, when he returns from the marriage feast; that, when he comes and knocks, they may immediately open to him.

jenjo: Kɛ shə nɨ ku be nɨngtsɨ midzwi fəlɨ və itwevə o hɛ̃, on tə le gyadə və le. Min nə bə bi anɨng lə, on fə nɨng yasɨ a kã, on tsɨ le tsa, e ku hywa, on tsə le nɨng tang!
english: Blessed are those servants, whom the lord will find watching when he comes. Most certainly I tell you, that he will dress himself, and make them recline, and will come and serve them.

jenjo: Lakə on wu be nyinyi nvi aloyang be nandzwi, a donɨ o wu hywakĩ on tə e shə nɨ ku be nɨngtsɨ nɨ gyada və le be lalɨ.
english: They will be blessed if he comes in the second or third watch, and finds them so.

jenjo: “Ba yipɨ a itwevə yipɨ sapɨnɨ ifɨ nɨng yinɨng yin wukə nɨ yang, o kwələ e wə nwakwə e wu tanvə wəw.
english: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what hour the thief was coming, he would have watched, and not allowed his house to be broken into.

jenjo: Ba ku be yulɨ kə vi hɛ̃, bisɨ Yɨ Ifafɨ yin wu hywapɨnɨ ba yipɨ lo nɨ.”
english: Therefore be ready also, for the Son of Man is coming in an hour that you don’t expect him.”

jenjo: Bitulu bipɨ tsa, “Itwebɨ, sɨ man nə dɨ bɨ yinfa bi nɨ lə, aloyang be nyɔ e ifafɨ hɛ̃?”
english: Peter said to him, “Lord, are you telling this parable to us, or to everybody?”

jenjo: Itwebɨ kwə nwa wə tsa, “Ke shə a pikang nɨ tswe nɨng hywiwe be yulɨ yang, dɨ wə bɨ itwevə o yin tsɨ wə ku nyɔ e shə o hɛ̃. O mwə le na, on tə le nɨng tang aba hywa wə tswe yang.
english: The Lord said, “Who then is the faithful and wise steward, whom his lord will set over his household, to give them their portion of food at the right times?

jenjo: Aba itwevə fə wu chi shə de tswe nwatũ a hĩlɨ yang on tə wə gyadə o.
english: Blessed is that servant whom his lord will find doing so when he comes.

jenjo: Min nə bə bi anɨng lə, itwevə mwə wə on tsɨ ku nyɔ nɨng o hɛ̃.
english: Truly I tell you, that he will set him over all that he has.

jenjo: A nɨ shə de kyɛ̃ tsa, ‘Itwevə mi fə pəpi lo dzwawɛ,’ bɨ o pəsɔ pɨ gbə e shə a ibwi be e a iye, o tang, o nwa mi yə wə.
english: But if that servant says in his heart, ‘My lord delays his coming,’ and begins to beat the menservants and the maidservants, and to eat and drink, and to be drunken,

jenjo: Itwevə və shə de yin fə dzwəwɛ be pɨ yipɨ o lo. Wu on gbə wə lə sɨ wə, on to na intswaku wə on letə pɨnɨ e tsəkə ifɨ nɨ pənyi sɨ Fi lo nɨ.
english: then the lord of that servant will come in a day when he isn’t expecting him, and in an hour that he doesn’t know, and will cut him in two, and place his portion with the unfaithful.

jenjo: “Be shə nɨ yipɨ e nɨngnɨ Itwevə o yɛdi nɨ, o mə tsɨlɨ o lo, fə o tswe e nɨng de itwevə o yidi nɨ lo yang, en gbəwə lələ ihyãnɨng.
english: That servant, who knew his lord’s will, and didn’t prepare, nor do what he wanted, will be beaten with many stripes,

jenjo: Be ifɨ nɨ yipɨ e nɨng de lo nɨ yang o tswe nɨngnɨ hĩkəlo yang ibe o tswani. Ke ifɨ nɨ e tə nɨng ihyãnɨng na wɛ hɛ̃, nɨng ihyãnɨng bɨ en bipɨ na wɛ. Ifɨ nɨ e kwələ e tə wə nɨng ihyãnɨng na wə nɨ, en bipɨ e nɨng kə dzungdzung na we lɛ.
english: but he who didn’t know, and did things worthy of stripes, will be beaten with few stripes. To whomever much is given, of him will much be required; and to whom much was entrusted, of him more will be asked.

jenjo: “N wu pɨ pə dzwa fangwa, yidi a mi manɨ sako ke dzwa de mwə yang!
english: “I came to throw fire on the earth. I wish it were already kindled.

jenjo: Bɔtismɔ lə sɨn midzwi mi chi, fə tɔle n tswe ibe jələdɨ tɛmə nɨng de wu tswe pe yang hĩ.
english: But I have a baptism to be baptized with, and how distressed I am until it is accomplished!

jenjo: Sɨ ban kyɛ̃ ma dɨ a tãlɨ bɨ n wukə Fangwa? Mambɨ lo, n wu pɨ bwi ku bə tsɨ tsɨng tsɨng.
english: Do you think that I have come to give peace in the earth? I tell you, no, but rather division.

jenjo: Dɨlə sɨswenɨ təkə chi və tsɨng yin tsəsə bwayung, e ifɨ bwatə yin sɨngsə be e ifɨ bwayung, e ifɨ bwayung yin sɨngsə be e ifɨ bwatə.
english: For from now on, there will be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.

jenjo: “Ta be yɨ nwa le yin tsɨ tsɨngtsɨng yɨ be ta yi en tsɨsə. Na yin tsɨsə be yɨ a iye. Yɨ a iye yin tsɨsə be na. Na və ibwi yin tsɨsə be tsa wə. He yɨ a ibwi ntsɨsə be tsa wə.”
english: They will be divided, father against son, and son against father; mother against daughter, and daughter against her mother; mother-in-law against her daughter-in-law, and daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.”

jenjo: Yeso myɛ chi sɨ e ifafɨ tsa, “Aba ba bə chi nahywa yang ban tsa, ‘Da lə sɨn wulɨ,’ bɨmpo dɨ bi anɨng.
english: He said to the multitudes also, “When you see a cloud rising from the west, immediately you say, ‘A shower is coming,’ and so it happens.

jenjo: Aba ba li ywa te igɔ̃ wəyang ba tsa, ‘Dɨ ywadzwi,’ do ho mambɨ.
english: When a south wind blows, you say, ‘There will be a scorching heat,’ and it happens.

jenjo: E ifɨ sɨfɨ̃! Ba yi pɨ myɛlɨ və chi be ywa dzwe be hywapɨ yang, be ba pa ba yipɨ nɨng nɨ sɨn tswekə nɨng hywapɨ nɨ lo.
english: You hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and the sky, but how is it that you don’t interpret this time?

jenjo: “Dɨ bə tswe ba na ku bə bi anɨng və nɨngnɨ pikang ban tswekə nɨ lo?
english: Why don’t you judge for yourselves what is right?

jenjo: A ifɨ akə ki nwakwang mə fadə yang, a tswe nɨngnɨ te man tswekə hɛ̃ ba lisə nwa nihyã pako ba ta fadə. Mambɨ loyang on tə be mə chi inəza o mwə mə on tə e ifɨ nɨngji a bi en tsə mə tsə.
english: For when you are going with your adversary before the magistrate, try diligently on the way to be released from him, lest perhaps he drag you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and the officer throw you into prison.

jenjo: A ba a tswe mambɨ yang, man ku pɨbi a jiw tɛmə a fə nɨng nɨ e tũ məkə lə hɛ̃ yang hĩ.”
english: I tell you, you will by no means get out of there, until you have paid the very last penny.”

jenjo: Sapɨ de e ifɨ nɨ pɨbi nɨ nə Yeso bi və e ifɨ a Galili nɨ Bilatus yə le sapɨnɨ sen hyɔ nɨng en təkə Fi nɨ.
english: Now there were some present at the same time who told him about the Galileans, whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.

jenjo: Yeso tsa, “Sɨ ban bə mə e ifɨ a Galili nɨ pe nyɔ e ifɨ a Galili yang hɛ̃ be nɨng abe bɨsɨ nɨng nɨ chile kə na?
english: Jesus answered them, “Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans, because they suffered such things?

jenjo: Min nə bə la, mambɨ lo! Tɛmə ba efo bə myɛ bə yə nɨng abe və bə, dɨbɨ alo yang, bə ma ban bwibwi mambɨ.
english: I tell you, no, but unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.

jenjo: Yə e ifɨ bwahywə ji hywĩtə nɨ bwi kə bisɨ kwə nɨ de ku le Suluwam nɨ? Sɨ ban bə e pe nyɔ̃ e ifɨ nɨ kukə Urushalima nɨ yang be nɨng abe?
english: Or those eighteen, on whom the tower in Siloam fell, and killed them; do you think that they were worse offenders than all the men who dwell in Jerusalem?

jenjo: Mambɨ lo, min nə bə lə a bə efo bə myɛ bə yə nɨng a be lo yang, bə ma ban bwibwi mambɨ.”
english: I tell you, no, but, unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.”

jenjo: Bɨ Yeso nə le bi akə lə o tsa, “Ifɨ akə nɨ gɛ̃ kəfe ywakaba o. O wu pɨ bapɨ chilɨ fe de be o chi nɨng a kə lo.
english: He spoke this parable. “A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard, and he came seeking fruit on it, and found none.

jenjo: Bɨ o tsɨ ifɨ nɨ sin tsikə nɨng sɨ fanɨng de o tsa, ‘Ha bwatə sɨ min wu pu kə nɨ bisɨ fe, be n chi nɨng akə lo! A le wə a gbə hywa! Dɨ bisɨ bə o tang pɨ son chi lɨ?’
english: He said to the vine dresser, ‘Behold, these three years I have come looking for fruit on this fig tree, and found none. Cut it down. Why does it waste the soil?’

jenjo: “Bɨ ifɨ nɨ sɨn tsɨkə nɨng sɨ fanɨng de tsɨ wə tsa, ‘Itwevə, a yə wə. Min ha bwa myɛ kwa pu wə, fə min wu be bɨng nɨng wu min e pu wə tangsə ha nɨ.
english: He answered, ‘Lord, leave it alone this year also, until I dig around it, and fertilize it.

jenjo: A o chi ha nɨ sɨ wukə nɨ yang, hĩ kwã, be a o chi lo yang, a le kə de gbə hywa.’ ”
english: If it bears fruit, fine; but if not, after that, you can cut it down.’”

jenjo: Vi Hũlɨ akə lə nɨ Yeso sɨn nyinasɨ nɨng pɨkwəsəku və e Yahuda.
english: He was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbath day.

jenjo: O bə iye akə nɨ nɨngvi tsɨ wə nɨngshi bimbya si wə nɨ, ha bwahywə ji hwĩtə son pe kwang kwang, o pa o yi o tsɨ chĩ hywaw.
english: Behold, there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and she was bent over, and could in no way straighten herself up.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ Yeso bə wə kə nɨ, o dzupɨ iye de yi wu chi bɨ o tsa, “Iye, sɨshi ma tɨng yang!”
english: When Jesus saw her, he called her, and said to her, “Woman, you are freed from your infirmity.”

jenjo: O ta na wə sɨ wə, lelang o yi o chĩ hywa son yənwa sɨ Fi.
english: He laid his hands on her, and immediately she stood up straight, and glorified God.

jenjo: Bɨ ifɨ nɨ mwə kə pɨkwəsəku na nɨ pwəchi bɨsɨ Yeso tɨng nɨngshi sɨ wə Vi Hũlɨ. Bɨ o tsɨ e ifɨ o tsa, “vi lə hywĩtsɨng tangsə hywivi bɨ sen tswe nwatũ nɨ. Bə wu e tɨng nɨngshi sɨ bə, bi ban wu Vi Hũlɨ yɛ.”
english: The ruler of the synagogue, being indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath, said to the multitude, “There are six days in which men ought to work. Therefore come on those days and be healed, and not on the Sabbath day!”

jenjo: Itwebɨ tsa, “E ifɨ sɨfɨ̃! Ban tswe nwatũ Vi Hũlɨ lo ɔ? Bisɨ bə sɨ ban pĩ wande aloyang bə pyĩ hyɔ̃ sɨ ban bə təkə pɨ tə mɨng Vi Hũlɨ?
english: Therefore the Lord answered him, “You hypocrites! Doesn’t each one of you free his ox or his donkey from the stall on the Sabbath, and lead him away to water?

jenjo: Iye nɨ dɨ pɨnyi Ibrahim, bɨ Shetan mwə wə tsə pepelɨ ha bwahywə ji hywĩtə. Aba e pĩ wə e le na Vi Hũlɨ yang tsɨ lo?
english: Ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan had bound eighteen long years, be freed from this bondage on the Sabbath day?”

jenjo: O nə male nɨ bɨ sɨku tswe e mbwe o, be e ifafɨ li lalɨ nɨng akəng nɨ hɛ̃ son tswe kə nɨ.”
english: As he said these things, all his adversaries were disappointed, and all the multitude rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.

jenjo: Bɨ Yeso bi pɨ tsa, “Ivə və Fi nɨ kuma bə de, dɨ bə mi nyi kə lɨ a?
english: He said, “What is God’s Kingdom like? To what shall I compare it?

jenjo: O kuma nɨngnɨng byangni nɨ ifɨ dɨ pyə kə ywakaba nɨ. O kã o myɛkə kə nɨ e hwyĩ wu sɨ məkə və kə na wə nɨ.”
english: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and put in his own garden. It grew, and became a large tree, and the birds of the sky live in its branches.”

jenjo: Fə o bi pɨ tsa, “Dɨ bə min nyi kə Ivə və Fi?
english: Again he said, “To what shall I compare God’s Kingdom?

jenjo: O kuma yisti nɨ en kwɛ kə sɔ ihyãnɨng yang yin hɛ ho lo lə hɛ̃.”
english: It is like yeast, which a woman took and hid in three measures of flour, until it was all leavened.”

jenjo: Yeso nyi nə sɨ nɨng tangsə e və a kã be e və a hang. Sapɨnɨ wə ku nɨhyã son təkə Urushalima nɨ.
english: He went on his way through cities and villages, teaching, and traveling on to Jerusalem.

jenjo: Bɨ ifɨ akə bi wə tsa, “Itwebɨ, e ifɨ tswəni bɨn jiku lɨ a?” O tsɨ le,
english: One said to him, “Lord, are they few who are saved?” He said to them,

jenjo: “Ba tswe nɨng nɨ ke ban tswekə hɛ̃ bə mwə nwakwə a təlɨ ba tə tangsə Ivə və Fi, bisɨ min nə bə lə, e ifɨ ihyãnɨ tswe nɨhyã nɨ en təkə pɨbɨ nɨ, e paw.
english: “Strive to enter in by the narrow door, for many, I tell you, will seek to enter in, and will not be able.

jenjo: A itwevə yi chi nwakwə yang, ban tsɨ pɨfa sɨ ban kũ pɨ ba tsa, ‘Itwebɨ, a be bɨ nwakwə lə!’ Le hɛ̃ on tsɨ ba tsa, ‘N yi bə lo, n yi pɨnɨ bə jikə lə nɨ lo.’
english: When once the master of the house has risen up, and has shut the door, and you begin to stand outside, and to knock at the door, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us!’ then he will answer and tell you, ‘I don’t know you or where you come from.’

jenjo: “Be yi ban tsa, ‘Kə bɨ tang nɨng yang tsung fə bɨ nwa yang tsung be mə, fə a nyi na sɨ nɨng yang ku nɨhyã və bɨ.’
english: Then you will begin to say, ‘We ate and drank in your presence, and you taught in our streets.’

jenjo: “Be on tsɨ bə on tsa, ‘N yi bə lo, n yi pɨnɨ bə jikə pɨbɨ nɨ lo, ho bə yə mi pɨ, bə hɛ̃ e ifɨ pyɨngnɨng.’
english: He will say, ‘I tell you, I don’t know where you come from. Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity.’

jenjo: “Pɨ de Talɨ a ta be tanglɨ a ji lə bisɨ yi ban bə Ibrahim, Ishaku be Yakubu be nyɔ e Ilinwa o hɛ̃ tangsə Ivə və Fi, be ba bə nɨ e nyə bə en e pɨfa.
english: There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth, when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets, in God’s Kingdom, and yourselves being thrown outside.

jenjo: E ifɨ yin ji nyi be na hywa, te igo be nə te igɔ̃, wu en ku hywa pɨ tangnɨng tangsə Ivə və Fi.
english: They will come from the east, west, north, and south, and will sit down in God’s Kingdom.

jenjo: Kə bi anɨng e ifɨ nwachi jɛnɨ nɨ, yin myɛkə e ichi tswa. E ichi tswa jɛnɨ nɨ, yin myɛkə e ifɨ a nwachi.”
english: Behold, there are some who are last who will be first, and there are some who are first who will be last.”

jenjo: Hywa a wə e Farisa akə lə wu sɨ Yeso wu tsɨ wə tsa, “A yə pɨnɨ a fə a tə pɨ akə, Hiridus sɨn bapɨ nɨhyã pɨ yəlɨ ma.
english: On that same day, some Pharisees came, saying to him, “Get out of here, and go away, for Herod wants to kill you.”

jenjo: O tsɨ le, “Fə tə ba nə ifɨ kãnyi nɨ lə ba tsa, sɨ min nyə e nɨngvi sɨ e ifɨ, sɨ min tɨng nɨngshi sɨ le jɛnɨ, be ban pɨ kĩ, be nɨng bwətə a vi, min e nyitɨngku nwatũ mi!’
english: He said to them, “Go and tell that fox, ‘Behold, I cast out demons and perform cures today and tomorrow, and the third day I complete my mission.

jenjo: A dɨ bə yin tswe nɨng hɛ̃, tɔle mi nɨhyã jɛnɨ be bangpɨkĩ be kyɛ̃ pile. E Ilinwa və Fi sɨn bwi pɨ akə lo tɛma le Urushalima!
english: Nevertheless I must go on my way today and tomorrow and the next day, for it can’t be that a prophet would perish outside of Jerusalem.’

jenjo: “Dɨ bə Urushalima, Urushalima, bə nɨ sɨ ban yə kə e Ilinwa nɨ e tũ kə sɨ bə nɨ. N pwəsɨ mi tsa bisɨ n bwi ku e yɨ bə wun kwɛsə ma nɨng tswe nɨng və yɛ nɨ bwikə e yi wə son ki be nwakanchɛ̃ wə nɨ, le hɛ̃ ba kwələ lo!
english: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, that kills the prophets, and stones those who are sent to her! How often I wanted to gather your children together, like a hen gathers her own brood under her wings, and you refused!

jenjo: E yə və bə kə dzɨng və. Sɨ min nəbə lə, fə ba chi bəlɨ a miw, tɛma vi nɨ ban tsa, ‘Ifɨ nɨ wukə be dzung Itwebɨ nɨ dɨ ifɨ parkə.’ ”
english: Behold, your house is left to you desolate. I tell you, you will not see me, until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’”

jenjo: Vi hũlɨ akə lə, Yeso tə və ihyãfɨ ve Farisa akə pɨ tang nɨng. E ifɨ ihyãnɨng tsɨ nɨng sɨ wə.
english: When he went into the house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees on a Sabbath to eat bread, they were watching him.

jenjo: Bɨ ibwi akə wu tsɨ pɨpi wə, sɨ wə hɛ̃ hywi yɨlə.
english: Behold, a certain man who had dropsy was in front of him.

jenjo: Yeso bi e Farisa be e inyi na sɨ lenwa və Musa nɨ tsɨkə pɨbi nɨ tsa, “Tsɨ yang e tɨng nɨngshi sɨ ifɨ Vi Hũlɨ?”
english: Jesus, answering, spoke to the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?”

jenjo: E kye be nwa le. Bɨ Yeso mwə kəna ifɨ de, o tɨng kə nɨngshi o nɨ, bɨ o tsɨ wə tsa, “A hywi a tə.”
english: But they were silent. He took him, and healed him, and let him go.

jenjo: Bɨ o tsɨ le o tsa, “Aba nɨngtsa və bə, aloyang yɨ bə wana o bwabu Vi Hũlɨ yang, ba fɨ wə bə ji kə vi a ina wa?”
english: He answered them, “Which of you, if your son or an ox fell into a well, wouldn’t immediately pull him out on a Sabbath day?”

jenjo: E kye be nwa le, bisɨ bi nɨ en nəkə nɨ ywang.
english: They couldn’t answer him regarding these things.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ o bə kə e idzwəwɛ sɨn bəpɨ pɨkulɨ a pikang pɨ nɨngtang nɨ, bɨ o nə le bi lə o tsa,
english: He spoke a parable to those who were invited, when he noticed how they chose the best seats, and said to them,
