jenjo: “Aba e dzupɨ mə sɨ nɨnglang yang, bi tə man ku hywa pɨ kulɨ və e ihyãfɨ yɛ. Lakə o tũpɨ yang sɨ ifɨ nɨ pe mə kə be kãlɨ nɨ yang.
english: “When you are invited by anyone to a marriage feast, don’t sit in the best seat, since perhaps someone more honorable than you might be invited by him,

jenjo: A mambɨ yang, itwevə nɨ tũkə pɨ sɨ bə nɨ, yi on wu sɨ mə wu on tsa, ‘A yi a tə ifɨ nɨ pɨ kulɨ a mə.’ Man yi be suku nɨng mɛ, man tə pɨ kulɨ və e imwə a hang.
english: and he who invited both of you would come and tell you, ‘Make room for this person.’ Then you would begin, with shame, to take the lowest place.

jenjo: Aba e tũpɨ sɨ mə kə dzwəwɛ yang, a tə a ku pɨ kulɨ və e imwə hang, hɛbilə ifɨ nɨ tũpɨ sɨ mɛ nɨ wu yang on tsɨ ma, ‘Tswəmi, a yi a ku wu pɨ kulɨ və e ihyãfɨ nɨ.’ Dɨ sapɨnɨ man chi kə kãlɨ nɨng nyɔ e idzwəwɛ hɛ̃ ho.
english: But when you are invited, go and sit in the lowest place, so that when he who invited you comes, he may tell you, ‘Friend, move up higher.’ Then you will be honored in the presence of all who sit at the table with you.

jenjo: Ke ifɨ nɨ sɨn dɨ ku wə kə nɨng akə hɛ̃, en fə be wə en wukə hywa. Fə ifɨ nɨ yəku wə hywa hɛ̃, en dɨ wə en yikə dzwe.”
english: For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.”

jenjo: Bɨ Yeso tsɨ itwevə nɨ tũpɨ sɨ we nɨ tsa, bɨ o tsa, “Aba a lə be nɨnglang mə nɨ yang, bɨ man tũpɨ sɨ e tswə mə, be e hywĩ mə, be lənyɔ mə, be e ifɨ nɨngchinɨng nɨ kwang ki mə nɨ yɛ. Aba a tũpɨ sɨ le yang, yi en tũpɨ sɨ mə. Mambɨ, e fə mə yang ho.
english: He also said to the one who had invited him, “When you make a dinner or a supper, don’t call your friends, nor your brothers, nor your kinsmen, nor rich neighbors, or perhaps they might also return the favor, and pay you back.

jenjo: Aba a lə be nɨnglang yang, a tũpɨ sɨ e ibe ifɨ, be e ibwipu, be e ifɨ bwisɨ sɨ, be e igbanɨng,
english: But when you make a feast, ask the poor, the maimed, the lame, or the blind;

jenjo: man chi parkə chi. Pa e fə mə sɨswenɨ nɨwu, be Fi yin fə mə fə sapɨ yilɨ və e ifɨ a nɨng tũ.”
english: and you will be blessed, because they don’t have the resources to repay you. For you will be repaid in the resurrection of the righteous.”

jenjo: Tsɨng tangsə e ifɨ nɨ kukə sɨn tangnɨng likə bi nɨ, bɨ o tsɨ Yeso tsa, “Ke ifɨ nɨ chi tang kə nɨngtang sɨ nɨnglang ivə və Fi hɛ̃, wə dɨ ifɨ parkə!”
english: When one of those who sat at the table with him heard these things, he said to him, “Blessed is he who will feast in God’s Kingdom!”

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ wə tsa, “Ifɨ akə lə nɨ tswe nɨnglang a kã, bɨ o tũpɨ sɨ e dzwəwɛ ihyãnɨng.
english: But he said to him, “A certain man made a great supper, and he invited many people.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ hywa nɨnglang dɨ pɨ tsɨkə nɨ, o tũ mwanshə o tə nə e ifɨ nɨ e tũkə pɨ sɨ le nɨ lə tsa, ‘Ba wu, nɨng hɛ̃ mə tsɨ yang.’
english: He sent out his servant at supper time to tell those who were invited, ‘Come, for everything is ready now.’

jenjo: “Be e ifɨ de hɛ̃ pəsɔ pɨ nə bi be nyichwi. Ifɨ a na nwachi tsa, ‘N jə fanɨng sɨswenɨ, mɨn tə pɨ bə lɨ. N chi na lo.’
english: They all as one began to make excuses. “The first said to him, ‘I have bought a field, and I must go and see it. Please have me excused.’

jenjo: “Ifɨ akə tsa, ‘N jə e hyɔ̃ ləpɨ̃ bwa bwahmɨ, tə min pang na lə, n chi na lo.’
english: “Another said, ‘I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I must go try them out. Please have me excused.’

jenjo: “Fə ifɨ akə tsa, ‘N tsə iye a hu chwi lo nɨ, n pa n wuw.’
english: “Another said, ‘I have married a wife, and therefore I can’t come.’

jenjo: “Mwanshə de fə wu nə itwevə wə lə nɨ, bɨ ywa itwevə de be, fə o tsɨ wə tsa, ‘A holə pəpi, a tə ku nɨhyã a kã be a hang tangsə və nɨ hɛ̃, tə a wu be e ibe ifɨ, be e ibwipu, be e igbanɨng pwɔsɨ e ifɨ kəpu tsɨng.’
english: “That servant came, and told his lord these things. Then the master of the house, being angry, said to his servant, ‘Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in the poor, maimed, blind, and lame.’

jenjo: “Sapɨnɨ mwanshə de fəkə nɨ wu tsa, ‘Itwevə, n tswe nɨng nɨ a nəkə nɨ yang, fə nyɔ pɨ tsɨ yinfa.’
english: “The servant said, ‘Lord, it is done as you commanded, and there is still room.’

jenjo: “Bɨ itwevə de tsɨ mwanshə de tsa, ‘A tə ku nɨhyã be nɨhyã və a bɨnghu nɨ hɛ̃, a lanwa a tə le e wu bisɨ və mi yɨlə.
english: “The lord said to the servant, ‘Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.

jenjo: Sɨ min nə bə lə, bɨngsə e ifɨ nɨ n tũpɨ sɨ le na nwachi nɨ e pang nɨngtang miw.’ ”
english: For I tell you that none of those men who were invited will taste of my supper.’”

jenjo: Vi akə lə nɨ, e ifɨ kə dzungdzung lasəpu be Yeso sen tə dzwəwɛ, bɨ o myɛ chi sɨ le o tsa,
english: Now great multitudes were going with him. He turned and said to them,

jenjo: “Ifɨ nɨ ke wukə sɨ mi hɛ̃, aba o la ta o, be na o, pwɔsɨ he wə be e yɨ wə, be e hywĩ wə, be hũlɨ wə lo yang, pa o myɛkə mwambwi miw.
english: “If anyone comes to me, and doesn’t disregard his own father, mother, wife, children, brothers, and sisters, yes, and his own life also, he can’t be my disciple.

jenjo: Fə ifɨ nɨ ke kwələ, mwə nyi mi tswe ibe, ma e ifɨ nɨ sen dɨkə gãlɨkə və le təkə pɨ yəlɨ le nɨ lo, pa o myɛ kə mwambwi miw.
english: Whoever doesn’t bear his own cross, and come after me, can’t be my disciple.

jenjo: Aba ifɨ tsɨng bɨngsə bə sɨn yidi pɨ mi kwə yang, be o ku hywa o kyɛ̃ nɨng nɨ on yə kə sɨ kwə de nɨ lo. Yə a nɨ o pəsɔ nwatũ fə sede o lo nɨ on mikə kwə de tɨng kə nɨ lo yang?
english: For which of you, desiring to build a tower, doesn’t first sit down and count the cost, to see if he has enough to complete it?

jenjo: A o le gĩkwə de, be o mi tə nyitɨngku wə lo yang, e ifɨ nɨ bəkə hɛ̃ yin mə wə mə,
english: Or perhaps, when he has laid a foundation, and is not able to finish, everyone who sees begins to mock him,

jenjo: en tsa, ‘Ifɨ nɨ pəsɔ pɨ mi nɨng, be o e nyitɨngku wə lo.’
english: saying, ‘This man began to build, and wasn’t able to finish.’

jenjo: “Aloyang, e tsa ivə akə lə be e itabwi nwufe bwahywə sɨn yidi pɨ ji bwi be ivə akə nɨ ləkə be e itabwi nwufe nwutsɨng. On ku hywa on kyɛ̃ bi nyinyi wə on tsa, “Mi be e itabwi mi, pa bɨn ta bwi nɨ ta be Ivə le nɨ?”
english: Or what king, as he goes to encounter another king in war, will not sit down first and consider whether he is able with ten thousand to meet him who comes against him with twenty thousand?

jenjo: Aba o bə lɨ pa lo yang, on wapɨ lə on tũpɨ sɨ ivə a pɨ le sapɨnɨ ivə de lə pɨ a chwilɨ bɨtsɨng, on bapɨ nɨhyã kũlɨ a tãlɨ.
english: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sends an envoy, and asks for conditions of peace.

jenjo: Do mambɨ, ifɨ nɨ ke tatswa sɨ e nɨng nɨ o ləkə nɨ lo yang, pa o myɛkə mwambwi miw.
english: So therefore whoever of you who doesn’t renounce all that he has, he can’t be my disciple.

jenjo: “Chikwɛ̃ dɨ nɨng a pikang. Aba pwəlɨ o tɨng yang, en tswe nwu en chikə pwəlɨ wə a?
english: Salt is good, but if the salt becomes flat and tasteless, with what do you season it?

jenjo: O ywang be Pwətɛ ve, fə pwətɛ sɨ wə ywang fanɨng. En dɨ en tsutə yinfa. “Ifɨ nɨ lə be chwi hɛ̃, kang chwi li!”
english: It is fit neither for the soil nor for the manure pile. It is thrown out. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”

jenjo: Vi akə e ifɨ pwɔ sede gbəku be e ifɨ nɨng abe wu sen pwɔsə pɨpi Yeso, sen kang chwi sɨ bi o.
english: Now all the tax collectors and sinners were coming close to him to hear him.

jenjo: Bɨ e Farisa be e inyi nasɨ lenwa və Musa pəsɔ pɨ nə bi be nyichwi sen tsa, “Ibwi nɨ dɨ tswə e ifɨ nɨng abe. Fə son tangnɨng be le.”
english: The Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying, “This man welcomes sinners, and eats with them.”

jenjo: Bɨ Yeso nə le nwabi nɨ lə o tsa,
english: He told them this parable.

jenjo: “A e tsa tsɨng və bə lə be nɨngpunga nwuhmɨ, bɨ tsɨng və le la yang, dɨbə on tswe lɨ? Pa o ho o yə nyɔ, nwunyə ji li nyəng tsɨhywa ji nyə, fə tə bapɨ a tsɨng nɨ ləkə nɨ, tɛma o chi wə yang hĩ wa?
english: “Which of you men, if you had one hundred sheep, and lost one of them, wouldn’t leave the ninety-nine in the wilderness, and go after the one that was lost, until he found it?

jenjo: A o chi wə yang, bisɨ lalɨ on dɨ wə on gbə tənchwi wə,
english: When he has found it, he carries it on his shoulders, rejoicing.

jenjo: on wukə və, fə on dzupɨ e tswə wə be e ifɨ kwanki o on tsɨ le tsa, ‘Wu bə pələ mi be bɛlɨ, bisɨ nɨngpunga mi nɨ ləkə nɨ, n chi wə yang.’ ”
english: When he comes home, he calls together his friends and his neighbors, saying to them, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found my sheep which was lost!’

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ le tsa, “Do mambɨ, dzwe hɛ̃ sɨn li lalɨ, bisɨ ifɨ nɨng abe nɨ efo mwə myɛkə nɨ, pe nyɔ la le e ifɨ a pikang nɨ nwunyə ji li, nyəng tsɨhywa ji nyə nɨ bi və elɨ afo mwə myɛlɨ ywang bisɨ le nɨ yang nɨng Fi!”
english: I tell you that even so there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents, than over ninety-nine righteous people who need no repentance.

jenjo: Fə Yeso nə e ifɨ de bi akə lə tsa, “A iye lə be kwabo bwahywə bɨ a tsɨng la yang, dɨbə on tswelɨ a? On kə dzwa on kɔ tang və de, tɛmə o chi yang hĩ.
english: Or what woman, if she had ten drachma coins, if she lost one drachma coin, wouldn’t light a lamp, sweep the house, and seek diligently until she found it?

jenjo: Aba o chi yang, on dzupɨ e tswə wə be e ifɨ kwənki o, on tsa, ‘Wu ba pələ mi be bɛlɨ, bisɨ n chi nɨng sede mi nɨ lakə nɨ yang.’
english: When she has found it, she calls together her friends and neighbors, saying, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found the drachma which I had lost.’

jenjo: Mambɨ e Ikwətũ və Fi sɨn li lalɨ bisɨ ifɨ nɨ tsɨng efo mwə myɛ wukə sɨ wə nɨ.”
english: Even so, I tell you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner repenting.”

jenjo: Yeso fə nə le bi akə lə tsa, “Ibwi akə lə be e yɨ a ibwi bwayung.
english: He said, “A certain man had two sons.

jenjo: Yɨ wə a hang tsɨ ta o tsa, ‘Ta, a tə mi gyədə a mi tangsə nɨng mə.’ Bɨ ta və le tsə le nɨngchinɨng nɨ o ləkə nɨ.
english: The younger of them said to his father, ‘Father, give me my share of your property.’ He divided his livelihood between them.

jenjo: “Chwi lo, bɨ yɨ wə a hang bwi nɨng o hɛ̃, yi tə dzwəwɛ hywa a tswilɨ. Tə o lakə nɨngchinɨng o sɨ ywa a tswelɨ pɨbi.
english: Not many days after, the younger son gathered all of this together and traveled into a far country. There he wasted his property with riotous living.

jenjo: O la nɨng na wə hɛ̃ wu tɨngkə nɨ, bɨ hwə hakyəng dzu hywa de. Fə o pəsɔ pɨ tswe ibe.
english: When he had spent all of it, there arose a severe famine in that country, and he began to be in need.

jenjo: O tə pɨ bapɨ nwatũ sɨ ibwi akə hywa de. Ibwi de tə wə nwatũ təlɨ və e yɔ nɨngtang.
english: He went and joined himself to one of the citizens of that country, and he sent him into his fields to feed pigs.

jenjo: O yidi pɨ chi nɨngtang və e yɔ de tanglɨ, be o chi ifɨ nɨ tə wə kə nɨ lo.
english: He wanted to fill his belly with the husks that the pigs ate, but no one gave him any.

jenjo: “Hakilo o fə wu sɨ wə nɨ, bɨ o tsa, ‘E shə və ta mi lə be nɨngtang ihyãnɨng, be mami hwə yin le mi le!
english: But when he came to himself he said, ‘How many hired servants of my father’s have bread enough to spare, and I’m dying with hunger!

jenjo: Fə min tə sɨ ta mi, tə min tsɨ wə min tsa, “Ta mi, n tswe ayibe yang sɨ Fi dzwe be pɨpi mə.
english: I will get up and go to my father, and will tell him, “Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in your sight.

jenjo: N lola nɨ en dzu mikə yi mə nɨ lo. A myɛ mi ma tsɨng bɨngsə e ifɨ nɨ sɨn tswe mə nwatũ shə lə nɨ.’ ”
english: I am no more worthy to be called your son. Make me as one of your hired servants.”’

jenjo: Bɨ o yi fə o wu və sɨ ta o. “Wə pɨ a tswilɨ bɨ ta o bə wə. Bisɨ yidi be bəshi, ta o yi be putũ tə o mwə wə o ka wə o tsɨ gyang wə.
english: “He arose, and came to his father. But while he was still far off, his father saw him, and was moved with compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.

jenjo: “Yɨ wə tsa, ‘Ta mi, n tswe ayibe yang sɨ Fi dzwe be pɨpi mə. N lola nɨ en dzu mi ɛ yɨ mə nɨ lo.’
english: The son said to him, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in your sight. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.’

jenjo: “Bɨ ta o tsɨ e mwanshə o tsa, ‘Ba wu be nɨng yasɨ a pikang, wu ba ya wə lə. Ba e wə nɨngfi nɨnghywə na wə, ba ta wə hũ kəpu wə.
english: “But the father said to his servants, ‘Bring out the best robe, and put it on him. Put a ring on his hand, and shoes on his feet.

jenjo: Ba wu be hyɔ̃ nɨ sɨ wə tsɨ bubu nɨ, ba yə bɨ tswe nɨnglang bɨ bɛ.
english: Bring the fattened calf, kill it, and let us eat, and celebrate;

jenjo: Kə yi mi nɨ bwi yang bɨ fə wu nɨ. O la bɨ fə e chi wə nɨ.’ Bɨ e pəsɔ pɨ tsanɨntsa.
english: for this, my son, was dead, and is alive again. He was lost, and is found.’ They began to celebrate.

jenjo: “Sapɨde Yi wə a kã la fanɨng son tswe nwatũ. O fə wu on kyã pɨ və le lɨ, bɨ o li sen le bi be dang a bwəlɨ.
english: “Now his elder son was in the field. As he came near to the house, he heard music and dancing.

jenjo: Bɨ o dzupɨ tsɨng tangsə e shə və ta o, o bi wə a dɨbə sɨn tswenɨng.
english: He called one of the servants to him, and asked what was going on.

jenjo: Shə de tsa, ‘Hywĩ mə fə wu yang, bɨ ta mə tsa bɨ yə wə hyɔ̃ a kã nɨ tsɨbubu nɨ lə, bisi fə o wu tsa be jəmu8.’
english: He said to him, ‘Your brother has come, and your father has killed the fattened calf, because he has received him back safe and healthy.’

jenjo: “Hywĩ wə a yɨ a kywi pwəchi, la pɨ tə tangvə. Ta o ji wu kũ wə o tə tangvə.
english: But he was angry, and would not go in. Therefore his father came out, and begged him.

jenjo: Imwə de kwə nwa ta o tsa, “Dɨ bisɨ bəde! E ha nɨ hɛ̃ n ku sɨ min tswe mə shə lə, n mɛdi pɨ la ma tũ lo. Le hɛ̃ a mɛdi pɨ mwə yɨ nɨngpu a tə mi bisɨ n li lalɨ be e tswə mi lo.
english: But he answered his father, ‘Behold, these many years I have served you, and I never disobeyed a commandment of yours, but you never gave me a goat, that I might celebrate with my friends.

jenjo: Be yɨ ma nɨ bwi nɨngchinɨng ma tə bangkə ku e iye gbəkə fə wukə nɨ, a mwə hyɔ̃ nɨ sɨ wə tsɨ bubu nɨ a yə wə lə!’
english: But when this your son came, who has devoured your living with prostitutes, you killed the fattened calf for him.’

jenjo: “Ta o tsa, ‘Yɨ mi, vi hɛ̃ ma tsung be mi, e nɨng mi hɛ̃ dɨ a ma.
english: “He said to him, ‘Son, you are always with me, and all that is mine is yours.

jenjo: Hĩkwã bɨ bɛ bɨ li lalɨ, bisɨ hywĩ ma bwi yang bɨ fə wu be hũlɨ, o la yang bɨ fə e chi wə.’ ”
english: But it was appropriate to celebrate and be glad, for this, your brother, was dead, and is alive again. He was lost, and is found.’”

jenjo: Yeso nə e mwambwi o bi lə tsa, “Ifɨ nɨngchinɨng akə lə e tsɨ wə e tsa, shə o nɨ o tsɨkə nwa nɨng o nɨ sɨn bang wə sede o.
english: He also said to his disciples, “There was a certain rich man who had a manager. An accusation was made to him that this man was wasting his possessions.

jenjo: Bɨ o dzupɨ wə tang ve o bi wə, ‘Dɨbə sɨ min li ku mə nɨ a? A vĩ mi e nɨng nɨ sɨ man tswe kə be sede mi be e nɨng mi nɨ lə, bisɨ dɨ mə fə yi man tsɨ nɨng sɨ nɨng mi lo.’
english: He called him, and said to him, ‘What is this that I hear about you? Give an accounting of your management, for you can no longer be manager.’

jenjo: “Bɨ shə de nyibi o tsa, ‘Dɨ ba min tswe sɨswenɨ? Itwevə mi yin kwə nwatũ na mi yin dɨ dɨ. N ywang be sambe ləlɨ a pɨ̃, fə suku nɨngkũnɨng sɨn tswe mi.
english: “The manager said within himself, ‘What will I do, seeing that my lord is taking away the management position from me? I don’t have strength to dig. I am ashamed to beg.

jenjo: N yipɨ nɨng nɨ min tswekə nɨ yang. Aba e pəku sɨ mi e nyə pɨ nwatũ mi nɨ yang, e ifɨ yin dɨ mi dɨ və le.’
english: I know what I will do, so that when I am removed from management, they may receive me into their houses.’

jenjo: “Bi o dzupɨ e ifɨ nɨ son bi le yə nɨ. O bi ifɨ a na nwachi, ‘Yə və itwevə mi bwanɛ ku mə?’
english: Calling each one of his lord’s debtors to him, he said to the first, ‘How much do you owe to my lord?’

jenjo: “Ifɨ de kwə nwa wə tsa, ‘La nywi nwunfe.’ “Bɨ ihyãfɨ shə de tsɨ wə tsa, ‘A ku hywa papi a dɨ dəro mə a vĩ nwuli ji nwunhywə.’
english: He said, ‘A hundred batos of oil.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and sit down quickly and write fifty.’

jenjo: “O dzupɨ ifɨ a nɨng bwəng o bi wə tsa, ‘Bwane sen bi mə?’ “O tsɨ wə tsa, ‘Tasɔ nɨngmwi nwunfe.’ Bɨ ihyãfɨ shə de tsɨ wə tsa, ‘A dɨ dəro mə a vĩ nwunhywə hywi bwanyə.’
english: Then he said to another, ‘How much do you owe?’ He said, ‘A hundred cors of wheat.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and write eighty.’

jenjo: “Ifɨ nɨng chinɨng yənwa sɨ yulɨ və shə sɨ tswelɨ a nɨhyã və nɨng fangwa. Ka akəng e ifɨ fangwa nɨ pə nyi sɨ Fi lo nɨ, e lə be yulɨ nɨ en mwəkə tswə be e ifɨ və le nɨ, pe sɨ e ifɨ nɨ pə nyi sɨ Fi nɨ yang.
english: “His lord commended the dishonest manager because he had done wisely, for the children of this world are, in their own generation, wiser than the children of the light.

jenjo: Sɨ min nə bə lə ba tswe pwəte be nɨngchinɨng a fangwa ba mwəkə tswə, bisɨ sapɨnɨ nɨng de tɨng yəbə na yang, en dzupɨ bə tə ba ku dzwe kə a itsɨng.
english: I tell you, make for yourselves friends by means of unrighteous mammon, so that when you fail, they may receive you into the eternal tents.

jenjo: “Ke ifɨ nɨ tsɨ nɨng sɨ nɨngchinɨng a tswə pikang hɛ̃, pa on tsɨnɨng tsɨ pɨkang sɨ a kã. Ifɨ nɨ benwa ku nɨng chinɨng a tswə yang, fə yin benwa ku a ihyãnɨng.
english: He who is faithful in a very little is faithful also in much. He who is dishonest in a very little is also dishonest in much.

jenjo: A ba tsɨ nɨng pikang sɨ nɨngchinɨng a fangwa nɨ lo yang, yə dɨ wə yin kwə bi və ba be nɨngchinɨng a və a dzwe?
english: If therefore you have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?

jenjo: A ba tsɨ nɨng sɨ nɨng və e ifɨ pikang lo yang, yə dɨ wə yin tə bə nɨng akə nɨ yin myɛkə a və bə nɨ a?
english: If you have not been faithful in that which is another’s, who will give you that which is your own?

jenjo: “Ifɨ sɨn tswe shə və e ifɨ yung lo. On la bi və ifɨ a tsɨng, on kwə bi a tsɨng. A pa a tswe shə və Fi be jɔdiw.”
english: No servant can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to one, and despise the other. You aren’t able to serve God and Mammon.”

jenjo: E Farisa nɨ sen yidi jɔdi nɨ mə Yeso.
english: The Pharisees, who were lovers of money, also heard all these things, and they scoffed at him.

jenjo: Bɨ o tsɨ le o tsa, “Ba dɨ ku bə kə e ifɨ a nɨng nɨng e ifafɨ, be Fi yipɨ nyi a kãlɨ və bə yang. Nɨng nɨ e ifafɨ fangwa sɨn tə le kə kãlɨ nɨ, dɨ byɔ sɨ Fi.
english: He said to them, “You are those who justify yourselves in the sight of men, but God knows your hearts. For that which is exalted among men is an abomination in the sight of God.

jenjo: “Dəro Lenwa və Musa be bi və e Ilinwa bɨ tsɨkə nɨhyã pəko wulɨ və Yohana itswe Bɔtismɔ, be sɨswenɨ dɨ bi alalɨ a Ivə və Fi bɨ sen tenwa sɨ wə, a dɨ wə hywakĩ sɨn pwəsɨtsa yidi pɨ ji tə tangsə be sambe.
english: The law and the prophets were until John. From that time the Good News of God’s Kingdom is preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it.

jenjo: Dɨ nɨng a shilɨ lo e tsa, dzwe be hywa yin la ma təbudzɨng, be shi pe yang e tsa, nɨng tsɨng ji yə tangsə Dəro Lenwa və Fi nɨ təkə Musa nɨ.
english: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away, than for one tiny stroke of a pen in the law to fall.

jenjo: Si min nə bə lə, “Ke ifɨ nɨ le he wə na, fə dɨ iye akə tsə yang, son gbə dɨ kə. Fə ifɨ nɨ tsə iye nɨ ji kə və bu we hɛ̃, wə ma son gbə dɨ kə be iye de bɨ.”
english: Everyone who divorces his wife, and marries another, commits adultery. He who marries one who is divorced from a husband commits adultery.

jenjo: Yeso tsa, “Ibwi akə dɨ ifɨ nɨngchinɨng, e gbə bya sɨ nɨng tsənɨng o, vi hɛ̃ son li lalɨ.
english: “Now there was a certain rich man, and he was clothed in purple and fine linen, living in luxury every day.

jenjo: Ibe ifɨ akə lə sɨn ku nwa nihyã və wə, dzung wə a Lazarus, sɨ wə hɛ̃ kəkə nɨngdzwa.
english: A certain beggar, named Lazarus, was taken to his gate, full of sores,

jenjo: Lazarus lwe pɨbi son midzwi mumu nɨngtang nɨ sɨn o kə hywa ku hywe ji nɨngtang və ifɨ nɨngchinɨng nɨ. Be idzwa hɛ̃ wu sen lɨng nwa nɨngdzwa o.
english: and desiring to be fed with the crumbs that fell from the rich man’s table. Yes, even the dogs came and licked his sores.

jenjo: “Bwa wu dɨ ibe ifɨ de, bɨ e ikwətũ dzwe dɨ wə təkə sɨ Ibrahim. Tswa wə, ifɨ nɨngchinɨng de bwi, bɨ e ifɨ a o chwi wə.
english: The beggar died, and he was carried away by the angels to Abraham’s bosom. The rich man also died, and was buried.

jenjo: Bɨ kwəng wə tə və a hywa. Ku son tswe ibe dzwa. O dɨ ku o bə Lazarus tsɨ gyɛ Ibrahim pɨ a tswili.
english: In Hades, he lifted up his eyes, being in torment, and saw Abraham far off, and Lazarus at his bosom.

jenjo: Ifɨ nɨngchinɨng ki nwakwang tsa, ‘Ta mi Ibrahim, a bəshi mi, a tũ Lazarus so nɨng hywəna wə mɨng bwukə chwi mi, sɨ min tɔla dzwa nɨ.’
english: He cried and said, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water, and cool my tongue! For I am in anguish in this flame.’

jenjo: “Ibrahim tsɨ wə tsa, ‘Yɨ mi, a kyɛ̃ sapɨnɨ mə fangwa nɨ, a chi e nɨng yang hɛ̃ nɨ a yɛdi nɨ, be Lazarus ywang be nɨng akə dɨ pwənɛ yinfa. Sɨswenɨ o chi hũlɨ yang, be sɨ mə tswe ibe.
english: “But Abraham said, ‘Son, remember that you, in your lifetime, received your good things, and Lazarus, in the same way, bad things. But here he is now comforted, and you are in anguish.

jenjo: Dɨ bi a wə lo, tangsə bɨ be mə bwa lə kə a kã. Ke ifɨ nɨ yikə sɨbi yin hywə on təkə sɨ bə nɨ ywang, do mambɨ ifɨ yin hywə sɨ bə on wukə sɨ bɨ nɨ ywang.’
english: Besides all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed, that those who want to pass from here to you are not able, and that no one may cross over from there to us.’

jenjo: “Bɨ ifɨ nɨngchinɨng tsa, ‘Ta mi Ibrahim, a tũ Lazarus tangvə ta mi.
english: “He said, ‘I ask you therefore, father, that you would send him to my father’s house;

jenjo: E hywĩ mi lə bwahmɨ. Tə o fɨ chwi le, hebilə aba e bwi yang bi en wu pɨ tɔlə nɨ yɛ.’
english: for I have five brothers, that he may testify to them, so they won’t also come into this place of torment.’

jenjo: “Ibrahim tsɨ wə tsa, ‘Musa be e Ilinwa fɨ chwɨchwi le yang. E hywĩ mə sen sa e dəro nɨ e vĩ kə nɨ sapɨnɨ e yɛdi hɛ̃.’
english: “But Abraham said to him, ‘They have Moses and the prophets. Let them listen to them.’

jenjo: “Ifɨ nɨngchinɨng tsa, ‘O ho! Ta mi Ibrahim, pa e li lewu! Aba ifɨ akə yi hywabwa tə sɨ le yang, en mwə en myɛ en yə nɨng abe və le.’
english: “He said, ‘No, father Abraham, but if one goes to them from the dead, they will repent.’

jenjo: “Ibrahim tsa, ‘A e li nwa Musa be e Ilinwa lo yang, a dɨ ifɨ a kə yi hywabwa hɛ̃, e li nwa wəw.’ ”
english: “He said to him, ‘If they don’t listen to Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded if one rises from the dead.’”

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ e mwambwi o tsa, “E nɨng ha kəpu ifɨ o sɨ nɨng abe lalə sɨn wulɨ. Be wewe lə bisɨ ifɨ nɨ yin ha kəpu ifɨ akə o sɨ nɨng abe nɨ.
english: He said to the disciples, “It is impossible that no occasions of stumbling should come, but woe to him through whom they come!

jenjo: Pelə yang e tsə nyi nənɨng kə akã tswi ifɨ de, fə e dɨ wə e gbə mɨng, nɨ on tswe tsɨng tangsə e imwə a hang nɨ o sɨ nɨng abe.
english: It would be better for him if a millstone were hung around his neck, and he were thrown into the sea, rather than that he should cause one of these little ones to stumble.

jenjo: Bisɨ mambɨ, ba tswe hakilo. “Aba hywĩ mə tswe ayibe sɨ mə yang, a go wə. Aba fə wu o kũ mə yang, a e nyi mə hywa.
english: Be careful. If your brother sins against you, rebuke him. If he repents, forgive him.

jenjo: A e tsa, vi a tsɨng son tswe ayibe sɨ mə hywi hywĩyung, fə son wu sɨ mə hywi hywĩyung pɨ kũ mə yang, a e nyi mə hywa sɨ ayibe o.”
english: If he sins against you seven times in the day, and seven times returns, saying, ‘I repent,’ you shall forgive him.”

jenjo: E mwambwipu tsɨ Itwebɨ tsa, “Sɨ bɨn yidi a yi bɨ ku pəlɨ a nyi və bɨ sɨ mə.”
english: The apostles said to the Lord, “Increase our faith.”

jenjo: Yeso kwə nwa le tsa, “Aba pəlɨ a nyi və bə sɨ mi tə ma nɨng manchɛ̃ yang, ban tsɨ kə nɨ be kãlɨ o, ‘Dzu tə a kywi mɨng,’ on li nwa bə li!
english: The Lord said, “If you had faith like a grain of mustard seed, you would tell this sycamore tree, ‘Be uprooted, and be planted in the sea,’ and it would obey you.

jenjo: “A e tsa ifɨ akə tangsə bə lə be mwənshə nɨ təkə nwa pɨ̃, aloyang tə pɨ gbə nɨng tsa. Sapɨnɨ shə de fə wukə nɨ, itwevə de pa tsɨ shə de tsa, ‘Wu a ku hywa a tangnɨng tsung be mi’? O ho!
english: But who is there among you, having a servant plowing or keeping sheep, that will say, when he comes in from the field, ‘Come immediately and sit down at the table,’

jenjo: Tɛmə itwevə de yin nə mwənshə de lə tsa, ‘A ywi mi nɨngtang lə, fə tə a mə sɨmə pikang. Wu a tə mi nɨngtang mi, tswa wɛ yə tə a tang nɨng.’
english: and will not rather tell him, ‘Prepare my supper, clothe yourself properly, and serve me, while I eat and drink. Afterward you shall eat and drink’?

jenjo: Le hɛ̃, en tswe shə de sakko lə lo, bisɨ son tswe dɨ nwatũ nɨ sen fə wə bisɨ wə nɨ.
english: Does he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded? I think not.

jenjo: Do tsɨng be bə, sapɨnɨ ba tswe e nɨng nɨ n nə bə kə lə nɨ yang, ba tsa, ‘Bɨ dɨ e shə yinfa, bɨ tswe dɨ nwatũ və bɨ.’ ”
english: Even so you also, when you have done all the things that are commanded you, say, ‘We are unworthy servants. We have done our duty.’”

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ Yeso be e mwambwi o mwə nɨhyã sen tə Urushalima nɨ, o mwə na nwa hywa Samariya be Galili.
english: As he was on his way to Jerusalem, he was passing along the borders of Samaria and Galilee.

jenjo: Təlɨ wə və akə ho, bɨ o kwəsə be e idzwasɨ bwahywə. E tsɨ tswilə,
english: As he entered into a certain village, ten men who were lepers met him, who stood at a distance.

jenjo: bɨ e dzupɨ be wi kɔ̃kɔ̃ e tsa, “Yeso! Itwevə! A bəshi bɨ!”
english: They lifted up their voices, saying, “Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!”

jenjo: Yeso myɛ nɨng e sɨ le, bɨ o tsɨ le, “Ba tə sɨ e ihyɔ̃nɨng tə te bə sɨ bə.” Sen təlɨ ho ku nɨhyã bɨ sɨ le pyɛlə hɛ̃.
english: When he saw them, he said to them, “Go and show yourselves to the priests.” As they went, they were cleansed.

jenjo: Tsɨng tangsə le bə o chi kə njəmu nɨ, o fə na tswa o wu sɨ Yeso, son yənwa sɨ dzung Fi be wi kɔ̃kɔ̃.
english: One of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, glorifying God with a loud voice.

jenjo: O pe hywa chi Yeso, son kã wə. Ibwi de dɨ ifɨ a Samariya.
english: He fell on his face at Jesus’ feet, giving him thanks; and he was a Samaritan.

jenjo: Yeso bipɨ tsa, “N tsa mi ake dɨ e ifɨ bwahywə bɨ chi njamu lo? Yə nyɔ e ifɨ a hywĩnyə de be?
english: Jesus answered, “Weren’t the ten cleansed? But where are the nine?

jenjo: Tswe nwu dɨ mwɛ Ywavə nɨ yinfa bɨ fə na tswa bisɨ o tə Fi kãlɨ a?”
english: Were there none found who returned to give glory to God, except this stranger?”

jenjo: Dɨbɨ Yeso tsɨ wə, “A yi a tə. Pəlɨ a nyi mə sɨ mi tə mə njamu yang.”
english: Then he said to him, “Get up, and go your way. Your faith has healed you.”

jenjo: Vi akə lə, e Farisa bi Yeso tsa, “Donɨ bɨ Ivə və Fi yin wulɨ a?” Bɨ Yeso kwə nwale tsa, “Wulɨ a Ivə və Fi sen bə be nɨng lo.
english: Being asked by the Pharisees when God’s Kingdom would come, he answered them, “God’s Kingdom doesn’t come with observation;

jenjo: Ifɨ ywang nɨ lə be tsɨkunɨng nɨ yin tsa, ‘Ba bə, dɨ Ivə və Fi ho nɨ,’ aloyang tsa, ‘Dɨ Ivə və Fi ho le,’ bɨsɨ Ivə və Fi le tangsə bə.”
english: neither will they say, ‘Look, here!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ for behold, God’s Kingdom is within you.”

jenjo: Bɨ Yeso nə e mwambwi o bi lə tsa, “Hywapɨ lə sɨn wulɨ, nɨ ban yidi pɨ bə vi tsɨng və Yɨ Ifafɨ tangsə e vi nɨ on fəkə nɨ, be ba chi bəlɨw.
english: He said to the disciples, “The days will come, when you will desire to see one of the days of the Son of Man, and you will not see it.

jenjo: E ifafɨ yin fɨ̃nwa bə tsa, ‘Dɨ wə ho le!’ aloyang, ‘Dɨ wə ho nɨ!’ Bi ban ji ba mwə tswa le yɛ.
english: They will tell you, ‘Look, here!’ or ‘Look, there!’ Don’t go away, nor follow after them,

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ Yɨ Ifafɨ fən wukə nɨ, ban bə wə ma mɛmɛ nɨ sɨn hyə̃kə dzwe e ifɨ hɛ̃ sɨn bakə nɨ.
english: for as the lightning, when it flashes out of the one part under the sky, shines to the other part under the sky; so will the Son of Man be in his day.

jenjo: Be Yɨ Ifafɨ yin o chi tswe ibe, fə e ifɨ a hywapɨnɨ yin la wə la.
english: But first, he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.

jenjo: “Ma nɨng nɨ tswepɨ fangwa və e Nuhu nani nɨ, Yɨ Ifafɨ fə wu on chi fangwa mambɨ vi fəlɨ o.
english: As it was in the days of Noah, even so will it be also in the days of the Son of Man.

jenjo: Vi a wə, pa hywa mɨng gba wulɨ, e ifafɨ sen tanglɨ, sen nwalɨ, sen tsəsə bwa le, dɨ təkə vi nɨ Nuhu pĩkə tangfə nɨ. Bɨ mɨng gba wu dɨ le hɛ̃.
english: They ate, they drank, they married, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noah entered into the ship, and the flood came, and destroyed them all.

jenjo: “Do ho tsɨng be hywa və Lot. E ifafɨ sen tang nɨng, sen nwalɨ, sen jə nɨng, fə e mə sen jəlɨ, sen pyənɨng fə sen mi və.
english: Likewise, even as it was in the days of Lot: they ate, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they built;

jenjo: Vi nɨ Lot ji yəkə Sodom nɨ, bɨ dzwa be te tɔfa o dzwe wu tswə̃ le hɛ̃.
english: but in the day that Lot went out from Sodom, it rained fire and sulfur from the sky, and destroyed them all.

jenjo: “Do ho mambɨ be nɨng nɨ yin tswekə pɨ sɨ vi wulɨ və Yɨ Ifafɨ nɨ.
english: It will be the same way in the day that the Son of Man is revealed.

jenjo: Vi a wə, ifɨ nɨ tsɨkə pɨfa yang bi fə on tə tangvə pɨ dɨ nɨng akə yɛ. Mambɨ be ifɨ nɨ tsɨkə fanɨng nɨ, bi fə on tə və yɛ.
english: In that day, he who will be on the housetop, and his goods in the house, let him not go down to take them away. Let him who is in the field likewise not turn back.

jenjo: Ba nyibi və he Lot!
english: Remember Lot’s wife!

jenjo: Ke ifɨ nɨ yidi pɨ kang hũlɨ wə fangwa nɨ hɛ̃, hũlɨ wə yin lɨla. Ifɨ nɨ tə hũlɨ wə fangwa nɨ hɛ̃ bisɨ bi mi yang, on chi hũlɨ a kə a itsɨng.
english: Whoever seeks to save his life loses it, but whoever loses his life preserves it.

jenjo: Sɨ min nə bə lə, vi a wə, e ifɨ bwayung lwe ku hywe sen lwenɨnglwe be nvi, en dɨ tsɨng en yə a tsɨng pɨbi.
english: I tell you, in that night there will be two people in one bed. The one will be taken, and the other will be left.

jenjo: E iye bwayung sen nənɨng tsung nwa nyi, en dɨ tsɨng en yə a tsɨng.”
english: There will be two grinding grain together. One will be taken, and the other will be left.”

jenjo: Yeso kwə nwa le tsa, “E nɨng nɨng nɨ yin tswe le pɨ ake?” Yeso kwa nwa le tsa, “Pɨnɨ bwilɨnɨng lwekə lə, dɨ pɨ de bɨ man chi e za pwɔsə pɨbi.”
english: They, answering, asked him, “Where, Lord?” He said to them, “Where the body is, there will the vultures also be gathered together.”

jenjo: Vi akə Yeso nə e mwambwi o nwabi nɨ lə, bisɨ e wadakə pɨ pinwa be Fi kəvivi, bi sa le tɨng yɛ.
english: He also spoke a parable to them that they must always pray, and not give up,

jenjo: O tsɨ le tsa, “Itswe kitə lə və ake, son bibi və Fi lo, on bəshi və e ifafɨ lo.
english: saying, “There was a judge in a certain city who didn’t fear God, and didn’t respect man.

jenjo: Hebwi akə lə və de nɨ sɨn wu sɨ ikitə de hũlɨ ywang bisɨ o chi ku wə, son tsɨ wə a, ‘A pələ mi sɨ kitə nɨ tangsə mi be tswə kitə mi nɨ.’
english: A widow was in that city, and she often came to him, saying, ‘Defend me from my adversary!’

jenjo: Sɨ pəsɔ nɨ, ikitə de gbajang sɨ bi və hebwi de. Tswawɛ bɨ o kyɛ̃ nyi wə tsa, ‘Min bibi və Fi lo, min bəshi və e ifɨ lo,
english: He wouldn’t for a while, but afterward he said to himself, ‘Though I neither fear God, nor respect man,

jenjo: le hɛ̃ hebwi nɨ nyədi shi o tsɨ mi hywa, bisɨ mambɨ min tswe kitə nɨ be nyi tsɨng min tə wə nɨng ku wə, aba mambɨ lo yang n chi hũlɨ na wəw.’ ”
english: yet because this widow bothers me, I will defend her, or else she will wear me out by her continual coming.’”

jenjo: Itwebɨ tsa, “Ba li bi və Itswe kitə nɨ sɨn bibi və Fi lo nəkə nɨ.
english: The Lord said, “Listen to what the unrighteous judge says.

jenjo: A ifɨ ma le, kwələ tsa lɨn pələ yang, sɨ ban bə Fi tswe e ifɨ o kitə a pikang lə wa? A e ifɨ o sen tata sɨ we nvi be fi yang, on zɨngpu zɨng be ta və le?
english: Won’t God avenge his chosen ones, who are crying out to him day and night, and yet he exercises patience with them?

jenjo: Sɨ min nə bə lə, on tswe kitə a pikang ku e ifɨ o lepu yinfa. Be wulɨ və Yɨ Ifafɨ, pa on chi e ifɨ nɨ pəkə nyi sɨ wə fangwa nɨ chi?”
english: I tell you that he will avenge them quickly. Nevertheless, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?”

jenjo: Bɨ Yeso nə nwabi ku e ifɨ nɨ sen dɨ ku le ma e pe nyɔ e ifɨ hɛ̃ be nwatũ a kang yang nɨ. O tsa,
english: He spoke also this parable to certain people who were convinced of their own righteousness, and who despised all others.

jenjo: “E ifɨ bwayung tə Kwə Fi pɨ pinwa. Ifɨ a tsɨng dɨ mwɛ Farisa, ifɨ a tsɨng dɨ ifɨ bwi sede gbaku.
english: “Two men went up into the temple to pray; one was a Pharisee, and the other was a tax collector.

jenjo: Mwɛ Farisa tsɨ be tsɨng wə bɨ tsa, ‘Fi, n kã mə yang, bisɨ mi dɨ ifɨ nɨng abe mə nyɔ e ifɨ lo. Bisɨ min hwə̃ pɨ lo, min yi nɨng lo, fə min gbəkə lo. N kuma və ifɨ bwi sede gbaku nɨ lo!
english: The Pharisee stood and prayed to himself like this: ‘God, I thank you, that I am not like the rest of men, extortionists, unrighteous, adulterers, or even like this tax collector.

jenjo: Sɨ min hywi sɨ mi pu bwayung hywi nvi hɛ̃, fə sɨ min tə kəka və e nɨng nɨ n chikə nɨ hɛ̃.’
english: I fast twice a week. I give tithes of all that I get.’

jenjo: “Be ifɨ bwi sede gbaku nɨ tsɨkə be tsɨng wə nɨ, dɨ ku wə yi dzwe sang wə sapɨnɨ son pi kə nwa nɨ. O tsə na ku wə son pəshi, o tsa, ‘Fi, a bəshi mi, bisɨ mi dɨ ifɨ nɨng abe.’
english: But the tax collector, standing far away, wouldn’t even lift up his eyes to heaven, but beat his breast, saying, ‘God, be merciful to me, a sinner!’

jenjo: “Sɨ min nə bə lə, ifɨ nɨng abe nɨ, dɨ mwɛ Farisa nɨ lo, fə tə və tangsə wə be Fi mə tsɨ yang. Ke ifɨ nɨ dɨ ku wə kə nɨng akə hɛ̃, Fi yin fə be wə wukə hywa. Ke ifɨ nɨ yə ku hywa hɛ̃, Fi yin dɨ wə yikə dzwe.”
english: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but he who humbles himself will be exalted.”

jenjo: Vi akə lə nɨ, E ichilɨ və e imwə, wu be le bisɨ Yeso wu pang sɨ le tə le parkə. Sapɨnɨ e mwambwi o bəkə nɨ, e go le.
english: They were also bringing their babies to him, that he might touch them. But when the disciples saw it, they rebuked them.

jenjo: Bɨ Yeso dzupɨ e imwə yangshang tsɨ e mwambwi o tsa, “Ba yə e imwə yangshang wu sɨ mi. Bi ban nyə le yɛ! Bisɨ Ivə və Fi dɨ a və e ifɨ nɨ ma və le nɨ.
english: Jesus summoned them, saying, “Allow the little children to come to me, and don’t hinder them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.

jenjo: Sɨ min nə bə bi anɨng lə, ifɨ nɨ dɨkə Ivə və Fi ma və e imwə yangshang lo hɛ̃, o pa o tə ləw.”
english: Most certainly, I tell you, whoever doesn’t receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”

jenjo: Ihyãfɨ və e Yahuda akə bi Yeso tsa, “Inyi nasɨ nɨng akəng, dɨbə min tswe kə n chi kə hũlɨ a kə a itsɨng?”
english: A certain ruler asked him, saying, “Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”

jenjo: Yeso bi wə tsa, “Dɨbə tswe nɨng bɨ a dzu mi ifɨ a kəng? Dɨ Fi tsɨng kə ifɨ a kəng.
english: Jesus asked him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good, except one—God.

jenjo: A yipɨ hywibi lenwa yang hɛ̃, ‘Bi man gbəkə yɛ, bi man yə ifɨ yɛ, bi man yi nɨng yɛ, bi man lənwa bi ku ifɨ akə be nwayung yɛ, a tə ta mə be na mə kãlɨ.’ ”
english: You know the commandments: ‘Don’t commit adultery,’ ‘Don’t murder,’ ‘Don’t steal,’ ‘Don’t give false testimony,’ ‘Honor your father and your mother.’”

jenjo: O tsa, “E nɨng le hɛ̃, mi kə imwə a hang sɨ min tswelɨ dɨlə wukə jɛnɨ.”
english: He said, “I have observed all these things from my youth up.”

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ Yeso likə bi o nɨ, o tsa, “Nyɔ la dɨ nɨng tsɨng bɨ man tswelɨ. A jə be e nɨngchinɨng mə hɛ̃, a tə e ibe ifɨ sede sɨ wə, mən chi akə chi dzwe. Yə a wu a mwə nyi mi.”
english: When Jesus heard these things, he said to him, “You still lack one thing. Sell all that you have, and distribute it to the poor. You will have treasure in heaven. Come, follow me.”

jenjo: Ibwi de likə bi o nɨ, bɨ sɨ wə bwitsɨng, bisɨ o lə be nɨngchinɨng tswe sɨbi.
english: But when he heard these things, he became very sad, for he was very rich.

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ nɨng sɨ wə bəbə bɨ tsa, “Təlɨ a Ivə və Fi yin shishi sɨ e ifɨ nɨngchinɨng!
english: Jesus, seeing that he became very sad, said, “How hard it is for those who have riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!

jenjo: Dɨ nɨng a shilɨ lo ɔ, e tsa kiloba pa bwa njəmɨng? Be, təlɨ və ifɨ nɨngchinɨng tangsə Ivə və Fi shi pe mambɨ yang.”
english: For it is easier for a camel to enter in through a needle’s eye, than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”

jenjo: E ifɨ nɨ likə nɨ tsa, “Yə dɨ wə yin ji ku lɨ fangwa nɨ a?”
english: Those who heard it said, “Then who can be saved?”

jenjo: Yeso kwə nwa le tsa, “Nɨng a shilɨ sɨ e ifafɨ, dɨ nɨng a shilɨ lo sɨ Fi.”
english: But he said, “The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.”

jenjo: Bitulu tsa, “Bɨ yə e nɨng nɨ bɨ ləkə nɨ yang hɛ̃, bisɨ bɨ mwə nyi mə!”
english: Peter said, “Look, we have left everything, and followed you.”

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ le tsa, “Ka a kəng, sɨ min nə bə lə, ke ifɨ nɨ yəkə və, aloyang iye, aloyang e hywĩ, aloyang e ichilɨ wə, aloyang e yɨ bisɨ Ivə və Fi yang,
english: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or wife, or brothers, or parents, or children, for God’s Kingdom’s sake,

jenjo: on chi gyədə ihyãnɨng fangwa a sɨswenɨ, be hũlɨ a kə a itsɨng fangwa a pɨnɨ sɨn wu kə nɨ.”
english: who will not receive many times more in this time, and in the world to come, eternal life.”

jenjo: Yeso yi be e mwambwipu bwahywə ji bwayung o təkə gwatsɨng bɨ o tsɨ le tsa, “Ba li! Bɨn tə Urushalima. Nɨng nɨ e Ilinwa vĩ kə ku Yɨ Ifafɨ hɛ̃, yin tswɨtswe pɨbi.
english: He took the twelve aside, and said to them, “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and all the things that are written through the prophets concerning the Son of Man will be completed.

jenjo: E mwə mi en tə e Ywavə, en mə mi, en tɨngjə mi, en tu chichi sɨ mi.
english: For he will be delivered up to the Gentiles, will be mocked, treated shamefully, and spit on.

jenjo: En gbə mi be tswe, fə en yə mi. Tswa vi a nɨng bwatə, min yi be hũlɨ.”
english: They will scourge and kill him. On the third day, he will rise again.”

jenjo: Be e mwambwipu o yipɨ e nɨng de lo, bwebwe bi de yweywe sɨ le. E yipɨ nɨng nɨ Yeso sɨn nəkə bi ku wə nɨ lo.
english: They understood none of these things. This saying was hidden from them, and they didn’t understand the things that were said.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ Yeso wu kyə̃ Jeriko nɨ, igbanɨng akə lə ku nwa nihyã, son kũ nɨng.
english: As he came near Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the road, begging.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ ibwi de li kə e ifɨ wu sɨn pe kə nɨ, bɨ o bi pɨ o tsa, “Dɨ bə sɨn tswe nɨng lɨ a?”
english: Hearing a multitude going by, he asked what this meant.

jenjo: E tsɨ wə e tsa, “Dɨ Yeso mwɛ Nazarat wu sɨn pe lɨ.”
english: They told him that Jesus of Nazareth was passing by.

jenjo: O dzupɨ be wi, “Yeso! Yɨ Dauda! A bəshi mi!”
english: He cried out, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”

jenjo: E ifɨ nɨ tsɨkə chi nɨ go wə pe hywa, e tsɨ wə tsa, ‘A kwə nwa mə lə.’ Fə o ki nwakwəng be wi kɔ̃kɔ̃, “Yɨ Dauda! A bə shi mi!”
english: Those who led the way rebuked him, that he should be quiet; but he cried out all the more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ hywa o tsa, “Ba wu be igbanɨng de sɨ mi.” Wu on kyə̃ pɨ lɨ, bɨ Yeso bi wə tsa.
english: Standing still, Jesus commanded him to be brought to him. When he had come near, he asked him,

jenjo: “Dɨ bə sɨ man yidi n tswe mə lə?” Igbanɨng de tsa, “Itwemi, sɨ min yidi pɨ bə pɨ.”
english: “What do you want me to do?” He said, “Lord, that I may see again.”

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ wa, “Mambɨ yang, a chi bəlɨ a pɨ! Pəlɨ a nyi mə, tɨng nɨngshi mə yang.”
english: Jesus said to him, “Receive your sight. Your faith has healed you.”

jenjo: Nabi o pəsɔ pɨ bə pɨ, bɨ o mwənyi Yeso, son yənwa sɨ kãlɨ və Fi. Sapɨnɨ e ifafɨ bə kə nɨ, le hɛ̃ sen yənwa sɨ Fi.
english: Immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God. All the people, when they saw it, praised God.

jenjo: Yeso mwə təngsa Jeriko son pe lɨ,
english: He entered and was passing through Jericho.

jenjo: bɨ ihyãfɨ bwi sede gbaku akə lə dzung wə a Zaka, dɨ ifɨ nɨngchinɨng.
english: There was a man named Zacchaeus. He was a chief tax collector, and he was rich.

jenjo: Son tswe nihyã nɨ on bəkə ifɨ nɨ sen dzukə a Yeso nɨ, be wə dɨ ifɨ a sũlɨ o chi nɨhyã nɨ on bə wə kə nɨ lo bisɨ dzung və e ifafɨ.
english: He was trying to see who Jesus was, and couldn’t because of the crowd, because he was short.

jenjo: Bɨ o hywi tũ o ochi e ifɨ tə o pĩ kəchɛ̃, bisɨ o bə Yeso nɨ wu on pe kə na nihyã de nɨ.
english: He ran on ahead, and climbed up into a sycamore tree to see him, for he was going to pass that way.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ Yeso wukə pu kə nɨ wə pɨbi nɨ, Yeso dɨ ku wə yi kə dzwe bɨ o dzu wə be dzung wə o tsa, “Zaka a pĩ hywa pəpi. Min myɛ kə idzwəwɛ və mə jɛnɨ.”
english: When Jesus came to the place, he looked up and saw him, and said to him, “Zacchaeus, hurry and come down, for today I must stay at your house.”

jenjo: Bɨ Zaka pĩ hywa pəpi, bɨ mwə wə dzwəwɛ və we be lalɨ kə ihyãnɨng.
english: He hurried, came down, and received him joyfully.

jenjo: E ifafɨ hɛ̃ li lalɨ və nɨng de lo, sen dɨ bi be nyitswi sen tsa, “Ibwi nɨ wə dɨ dzwəwɛ və ifɨ nɨng abe.”
english: When they saw it, they all murmured, saying, “He has gone in to lodge with a man who is a sinner.”

jenjo: Lehɛ̃, Zaka yɨ tsɨpu chi Yeso tsa, “Itwemi a bə, min kə nɨngchinɨng mi bwayung, a tsɨng min tə e ibe ifɨ, aba n benwa ifɨ akə yang, min fə wə hywi bwanyə.”
english: Zacchaeus stood and said to the Lord, “Behold, Lord, half of my goods I give to the poor. If I have wrongfully exacted anything of anyone, I restore four times as much.”

jenjo: Dɨ bɨ Yeso tsɨ Zaka tsa, “Jiku wu yang tangvə nɨ jɛnɨ, ibwi nɨ tɨtɛ dɨ pɨnyi və Ibrahim.
english: Jesus said to him, “Today, salvation has come to this house, because he also is a son of Abraham.

jenjo: Mi Yɨ Ifafɨ, n wu bisɨ n bapɨ nɨng nɨ la kə nɨ n ji be le ku.”
english: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save that which was lost.”

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ e ifɨ kang chwi sɨ nɨng nɨ son nə kə nɨ, Yeso tsi hywa lo. O nə le bi lə be nwabi, bisɨ e kyə̃ pɨ tə Urushalima yang. Be o yi bi anyilɨ və le yang, sen tsa le, Ivə və Fi yin pəsɔ sɨswenɨ.
english: As they heard these things, he went on and told a parable, because he was near Jerusalem, and they supposed that God’s Kingdom would be revealed immediately.

jenjo: Bɨ o tsa, “Ihyãfɨ akə lə nɨ tə dzwəwɛ hywa a pɨ a tswilɨ, tə en ya wə ivə, kə fə o wu.
english: He said therefore, “A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.

jenjo: Pa on yi dzwəwɛ lɨ, bɨ o dzupɨ e shə o bwahywə, o e nɨng sede yɨ ho bwatə bwatə bɨ o tsə le, fə o tsɨ le o tsa, ‘Ba tswe filu be sede nɨ pəko fə n wu.’
english: He called ten servants of his, and gave them ten mina coins, and told them, ‘Conduct business until I come.’

jenjo: “Be e ifɨ o wənyi wə, bɨ e tũ e inə nwa tswa we sen tsa, ‘Bɨ yidi ibwi nɨ myɛ kə ivə və bɨ lo.’
english: But his citizens hated him, and sent an envoy after him, saying, ‘We don’t want this man to reign over us.’

jenjo: “Lehɛ̃, e ya wə ivə de yang. Fə o wukə nɨ, bɨ o dzupɨ e shə nɨ o tə le kə sede nɨ. Son yidi pɨ yipɨ nɨngnɨ e tswekə be sede de, pwɔsɨ mɨng ku wə nɨ e chi kə nɨ.
english: “When he had come back again, having received the kingdom, he commanded these servants, to whom he had given the money, to be called to him, that he might know what they had gained by conducting business.

jenjo: “Ifɨ a na nwachi tsa, ‘Itwevə, n tswe filu be sede tsɨng nɨ a tə mikə nɨ fə n chi mɨng ku wə bwahywə.’
english: The first came before him, saying, ‘Lord, your mina has made ten more minas.’

jenjo: “Bɨ ivə de tsa, ‘Sakko mə, mə dɨ shə a pikang. A tsɨ nɨng mə sɨ nɨng a tswə nɨ n tə mə kə nɨ yang. Bisɨ mambɨ, min tə mə və bwahywə a ku kə klɔ ku le kə gyəda a mə.’
english: “He said to him, ‘Well done, you good servant! Because you were found faithful with very little, you shall have authority over ten cities.’

jenjo: “Nɨng bwayung ve shə de tsa, ‘Itwevə, n tswe filu be sede nɨ tsɨng a tə mi kə nɨ, n chi mɨn ku wə bwahmɨ.’
english: “The second came, saying, ‘Your mina, Lord, has made five minas.’

jenjo: “Ivə de tsa, ‘Sakko mə. Man ku kə klo ku e və bwahmɨ.”
english: “So he said to him, ‘And you are to be over five cities.’

jenjo: “Bɨ nɨng bwatə ve shə de fə be nɨng sede yin fa bɨ o tsa, ‘Itwevə, a mwə ni. N hwə nɨng sede ma be zənɨng bɨ tə n ywe tə pikang.
english: Another came, saying, ‘Lord, behold, your mina, which I kept laid away in a handkerchief,

jenjo: Sɨ min bibi, bisɨ bi mə shi o. Sɨ man dɨ nɨng nɨ dɨ mə a lekə lo nɨ. Fə sɨ man ji nɨngpɨ̃ pɨnɨ a pyə kə lo nɨ.’
english: for I feared you, because you are an exacting man. You take up that which you didn’t lay down, and reap that which you didn’t sow.’

jenjo: “Ivə de pwəchi bɨ tsa, ‘Mə shə abe! Dɨ bi nɨ a nəkə kənwa mə nɨ, bɨ min tswe məkə kitə lə. A yipɨ yang sɨ min dɨ nɨng nɨ kə a mi lo nɨ, mambɨ lo? Fə sɨ min ji nɨngpɨ̃, pɨ nɨ n pyəkə nɨng pɨbi nɨ lo?
english: “He said to him, ‘Out of your own mouth will I judge you, you wicked servant! You knew that I am an exacting man, taking up that which I didn’t lay down, and reaping that which I didn’t sow.

jenjo: Dɨbə tswe a tə e ifɨ akə sede de tswe filu lo? Lakə fəlɨ mi nɨ, min chi sede mi be mɨng ku wə chi na le.’
english: Then why didn’t you deposit my money in the bank, and at my coming, I might have earned interest on it?’

jenjo: “Bɨ ivə de myɛ chi sɨ nyɔ e ifɨ nɨ tsɨ kə gyɛ we nɨ tsa, ‘Ba dɨ sede de nə wɛ, ba tə ifɨ nɨ be ho sede nwuntsɨng ji hywə nɨ.’
english: He said to those who stood by, ‘Take the mina away from him, and give it to him who has the ten minas.’

jenjo: “Bɨ e tsa, ‘Itwevə, o lə be sede bwahywə na we lɛ!’
english: “They said to him, ‘Lord, he has ten minas!’

jenjo: “Ivə tsa, ‘Ke e ifɨ nɨ tswe nɨng a pikang be nɨng nɨ e tə le kə nɨ hɛ̃, dɨ le bɨ en yi le ku nɨng lɨ. Be e ifɨ nɨ tswe kə nɨng anfa be a və le yang, a pɨ nɨ be le nɨ en kwə en dɨdɨ na le.
english: ‘For I tell you that to everyone who has, will more be given; but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.

jenjo: Be bi və e mbwe mi nɨ yidi mi n lwe ivə ku le lo nɨ, ba bwi le wu bə yə pɨpi mi nɨ.’ ”
english: But bring those enemies of mine who didn’t want me to reign over them here, and kill them before me.’”

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ Yeso nəbi tɨng kə nɨ, bɨ o ochi e mwambwi o son tə na Urushalima.
english: Having said these things, he went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ o kyə̃ e və nɨ sen dzuka Betapaji be Betani nɨ tsɨkə pəsəpi Te Kə Zetun nɨ, o tũ e mwambwi bwayung o chi.
english: When he came near to Bethsphage and Bethany, at the mountain that is called Olivet, he sent two of his disciples,

jenjo: O tsɨ le tsa, “Ba tə və a bɨnghu le, tə ban chi yɨ wande nɨ e mɛdi pɨ pĩ wə lo nɨ, tsə nwa nɨhyã. Ba pĩ ba wukə.
english: saying, “Go your way into the village on the other side, in which, as you enter, you will find a colt tied, which no man had ever sat upon. Untie it, and bring it.

jenjo: Aba ifɨ akə bi ba tsa, ‘Dɨ wə tũ ba wu sɨ ban pĩ lɨ a?’ Ba tsɨ wa, ‘Dɨ Itwebɨ sɨn yidi.’ ”
english: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you untying it?’ say to him: ‘The Lord needs it.’”

jenjo: Tə e chi yɨ wande de, ma nəlɨ və Yeso.
english: Those who were sent went away, and found things just as he had told them.

jenjo: Sen pĩ wande de ho, bɨ e itwe wande bi le tsa, “Tswe nwu ku sɨ ban pĩ wande de?”
english: As they were untying the colt, its owners said to them, “Why are you untying the colt?”

jenjo: E mwambwi kwə nwa le tsa, “Dɨ Itwebɨ sɨn yidi.”
english: They said, “The Lord needs it.”

jenjo: E wu be yɨ wande e tə Yeso, bɨ e fə nɨng ya sɨ və le e pyang ku wande, bɨ o pĩ.
english: They brought it to Jesus. They threw their cloaks on the colt, and set Jesus on them.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ wande sɨn wu kə nɨ, bɨ e ifafɨ bwi nɨng ki dzwi və le pyang ku nɨhyã chi wə.
english: As he went, they spread their cloaks on the road.

jenjo: O kyə̃ pɨ wukə zɨzɛ̃ nɨhyã nɨ yikə ku Te Zetun nɨ, bɨ e mwambwi o pəsɔ pɨ yənwa sɨ Fi be wi kɔ̃kɔ̃, sen yənwa sɨ Fi bisɨ nɨng nɨ e bəkə nɨ.
english: As he was now getting near, at the descent of the Mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works which they had seen,

jenjo: Bɨ e ki nwakwəng sen tsa, “Parkə dɨ a və ivə nɨ wukə bisɨ dzung Itwebɨ!” “Atã lə sɨ Fi, kãlɨ dɨ a və Fi dzwe!”
english: saying, “Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord! Peace in heaven, and glory in the highest!”

jenjo: E Farisa nɨ tangsə e ifafi de tsa, “Inyi nasɨ nɨng, a pwəchi si e mwambwi mə e kwə nwa le lə!”
english: Some of the Pharisees from the multitude said to him, “Teacher, rebuke your disciples!”

jenjo: Yeso kwə tsa, “Ka a kəng sɨ min nə bə lə, aba e kwə nwa le sə yang, e te nɨ tsɨkə nwa nɨhyã nɨ, yin en yənwa sɨ Fi.”
english: He answered them, “I tell you that if these were silent, the stones would cry out.”

jenjo: Wu on kyə̃ Urushalima lɨ, o dɨ nɨng wə o bəkə və de nɨ, bɨ gə̃mi pəsɔ pɨ se nɨng wə son pəshi bisɨ və de.
english: When he came near, he saw the city and wept over it,

jenjo: O tsa, “A e tsa ba yipɨ nɨng nɨ sɨ ban yidi sɨswenɨ nɨ yang dɨ atã! Be sɨswenɨ pe nwa bə yang, e ywe sɨ bə lɛ!
english: saying, “If you, even you, had known today the things which belong to your peace! But now, they are hidden from your eyes.

jenjo: Vi lə sɨn wulɨ, e nbwe və bə yin mi nɨng en kwɛ bə kə, en tabwi be bə, e itabwi və le yin kwɛ ba pɨ jilɨ ywang.
english: For the days will come on you, when your enemies will throw up a barricade against you, surround you, hem you in on every side,

jenjo: En yə bə be e yɨ bə be nyɔ e ifafɨ nɨ və bə nɨ hɛ̃. Ngang nɨ ba mi be te ba kwɛ kə və bə nɨ, en de hywa hɛ̃, bisɨ ba gbə tswi sɨ wuli və Fi nɨ wu pɨ ji be bə ku nɨ.”
english: and will dash you and your children within you to the ground. They will not leave in you one stone on another, because you didn’t know the time of your visitation.”

jenjo: Bɨ Yeso tə Kwə Fi, o pəsɔ pɨ nyə e ifɨ nɨ sɨn tswekə filu pɨbi nɨ.
english: He entered into the temple, and began to drive out those who bought and sold in it,

jenjo: O tsɨ le o tsa, “E vĩvĩ tang Dəro və Fi tsa, ‘Təngvə mi dɨ pɨ pinwa,’ Bɨ ban myɛ kə pɨ ywelɨ və e ifɨ nɨng yi nɨng yɛ!”
english: saying to them, “It is written, ‘My house is a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a ‘den of robbers’!”

jenjo: Tswa we, son nyi nasɨ nɨng vi hɛ̃ Kwə Fi, be e ihyãfɨ hyɔ̃nɨng be e inyi na sɨ lenwa və Musa, be nyɔ e ihyãfɨ pəsɔ pɨ tswe nihyã bisɨ e yə Yeso.
english: He was teaching daily in the temple, but the chief priests and the scribes and the leading men among the people sought to destroy him.

jenjo: Lehɛ̃ e chi nɨhyã lo, bisɨ e ifɨ hɛ̃ kəng tswi sɨ bi o nɨ son nəkə nɨ.
english: They couldn’t find what they might do, for all the people hung on to every word that he said.

jenjo: Vi akə lə nɨ, Yeso sɨn nyi e ifɨ nə sɨ nɨng, son tenwa və bi alalɨ Kwə Fi, bɨ Ivə hyɔ̃nɨng be e inyi nasɨ Lenwa və Musa, wu sɨ wə be nyɔ e ihyãfɨ.
english: On one of those days, as he was teaching the people in the temple and preaching the Good News, the priests and scribes came to him with the elders.

jenjo: E tsɨ wə e tsa, “Be tsɨkunɨng və wə, sɨ man tswekə e nɨngnɨ? A chi tsɨkunɨng de le bəde?”
english: They asked him, “Tell us: by what authority do you do these things? Or who is giving you this authority?”

jenjo: Yeso kwə nwa le tsa, “Mi ma sɨ min bi bə bi. Ba o chi ba nə mi lə.
english: He answered them, “I also will ask you one question. Tell me:

jenjo: Dɨ wə tə Yohana tsɨkunɨng nɨ son tswekə Bɔtismɔ nɨ? Dɨ Fi dzwe tə wə? A mambɨ loyang, Dɨ e ifafɨ tə wə?”
english: the baptism of John, was it from heaven, or from men?”

jenjo: E pəsɔ pɨ nəsələ bwa le sen tsa, “Yə dɨbə bɨn nəlɨ a? A bɨ tsa, ‘Dɨ Fi yang,’ on tsa, ‘Dɨbə tswe ba kwələ be Yohana lo?’
english: They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will say, ‘Why didn’t you believe him?’

jenjo: A fə bɨ tsa, ‘Dɨ e ifafɨ yang,’ e ifɨ nɨ pwɔsə pinɨ hɛ̃ yin gbə bɨ be te, bisɨ e tsɨnyi lə yang tsa Yohana dɨ Ilinwa.”
english: But if we say, ‘From men,’ all the people will stone us, for they are persuaded that John was a prophet.”

jenjo: Bisɨ mambɨ e tsa, “Bɨ yi dɨ wə tũ Yohana lo.”
english: They answered that they didn’t know where it was from.

jenjo: Bɨ Yeso tsɨ le tsa, “Mi ma te n nə bə ifɨ nɨ lə tə mi tsɨkunɨng nɨsɨ min tswekə e nɨng nɨ lo.”
english: Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”

jenjo: Dɨbɨ Yeso ledũ sɨ e ifɨ tsa, “Ifɨ akə gɛ̃ kə a tanglɨ ihyãnɨng fa nɨng o, o tə e ifɨ tsɨ nɨng lə, bɨ o tə hywa akə tə o ku pɨbi ha kə dzungdzung.
english: He began to tell the people this parable. “A man planted a vineyard, and rented it out to some farmers, and went into another country for a long time.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ chilɨkə de dzwang kə nɨ, o tũ shə o tsɨng tə sɨ e itsɨnɨng sɨ fanɨng de bisɨ e tə wə chilɨkə de o wukə. Bɨ e iləpɨ̃ de təsə sɨ shə de e gbə e nyə wə be na yinfa.
english: At the proper season, he sent a servant to the farmers to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard. But the farmers beat him, and sent him away empty.

jenjo: Fə itwe fənɨng tũ shə o akə ben tsɨng, bɨ e tɨng jə wə, e gbə wə, fə e to wə be nə yinfa e le tə.
english: He sent yet another servant, and they also beat him, and treated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.

jenjo: O tũ nɨng bwatə və e shə fə wu, bɨ e tə wə nɨngdzwa, e fɨ wə e jikə fanɨng de.
english: He sent yet a third, and they also wounded him, and threw him out.

jenjo: “Itwe fənɨng be ku wə bɨ tsa, ‘Dɨ bə min tswelɨ a?’ N yi pɨ nɨng nɨ min tswekə nɨ yang! Min tũ yɨ mi nɨ sɨ min yidi nɨ. Lakə en bə kãlɨ o bə.’
english: The lord of the vineyard said, ‘What shall I do? I will send my beloved son. It may be that seeing him, they will respect him.’

jenjo: “Be sapɨnɨ e itsɨnɨng sɨ fənɨng bəkə yɨ wə nɨ, bɨ e nəsələ bwəle sen tsa, ‘Dɨ ifɨ nɨ en yə wə kə fənɨng ho sɨn wi nɨ. Bɨ yə wə, bɨ kwə fanɨng de bɨ dɨ myɛkə a və bɨ!’
english: “But when the farmers saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.’

jenjo: E fɨ wə hywa e jikə fənɨng de, bɨ e mwə wə e yə.” Yeso bipɨ tsa, “Dɨbə itwe fənɨng de yin tswekə e itsɨnɨng sɨ fənɨng de sɨ bəlɨ a və bə a?”
english: They threw him out of the vineyard, and killed him. What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do to them?

jenjo: Min nə bə lə, wu on yə e iləpĩ de, fə o dɨ fənɨng de on tə e ifɨ akə.” Sapɨnɨ e ifafɨ likə mambɨ nɨ, e tsa, “O ho, bi nɨng de tswe mambɨ yɛ!”
english: He will come and destroy these farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.” When they heard it, they said, “May it never be!”

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ nɨng sɨ le bə bɨ tsa, “Yə dɨbə Dəro və Fi sɨn nəlɨ nɨ tsɨka, “ ‘Te nɨ e ifɨ minɨng lakə nɨ myɛ kə jə te kwə yang.’
english: But he looked at them, and said, “Then what is this that is written, ‘The stone which the builders rejected, the same was made the chief cornerstone?’

jenjo: Ifɨ nɨ ke o sɨ te de hɛ̃, on wə yangshang. Be ifɨ nɨ te de o ku wə hɛ̃, yin nə wə kə nyəmwi.”
english: Everyone who falls on that stone will be broken to pieces, but it will crush whomever it falls on to dust.”

jenjo: E inyinasɨ lenwa və Musa, be e ihyãfɨ hyɔ̃nɨng sen yidi pɨ mwə Yeso nabi bisɨ e yipɨ yang son nə bi de ku le, dɨ le kə e iləpɨ̃ pyɨngnɨng de. Be sen bibi və e ifafɨ.
english: The chief priests and the scribes sought to lay hands on him that very hour, but they feared the people—for they knew he had spoken this parable against them.

jenjo: Sen tsɨnɨng pɨkəng sɨ wə, bɨ e fə e ifɨ akə sede tə dɨ ku le ma le dɨ e ifɨ a pikang, bisɨ wu e pang nwa Yeso. Aba o nəbi ayibe yang e chi nɨhyã mwəlɨ wə e tə itsɨkunɨng be gwamnati və e Roma.
english: They watched him, and sent out spies, who pretended to be righteous, that they might trap him in something he said, so as to deliver him up to the power and authority of the governor.

jenjo: E ifɨ nɨ e tũkə nɨ wu tsɨ Yeso tsa, “Inyinasɨ nɨng, bɨ yipɨ yang sɨ man nə bi anɨng fə sɨ mə nyi nasɨ nɨng pikang, sɨ man tswe bi və ifɨ akə lo. Sɨ man nyinasɨ nihyã və Fi be bi anɨng.
english: They asked him, “Teacher, we know that you say and teach what is right, and aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God.

jenjo: Sɨswenɨ a nə bɨ lə, hĩkwã bɨ fə sede gbəku sɨ Kaisa Ivə Roma? Aloyang, hĩ lo?”
english: Is it lawful for us to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?”

jenjo: O bə pɨ hã pɨ və le de, bɨ o tsa,
english: But he perceived their craftiness, and said to them, “Why do you test me?

jenjo: “Ba ta mi na sɨ nɨng sede və e Roma de n bə. Dɨ kwəng wə be dzung wə de e gbə ku sede de?” Bɨ e tsa, “Dɨ a və Kaisar.” Bɨ o tsa,
english: Show me a denarius. Whose image and inscription are on it?” They answered, “Caesar’s.”

jenjo: “Hĩkwã ba tə Kaisar nɨngnɨ tsɨkə a və Kaisar nɨ, fə ba tə Fi nɨngnɨ tsɨkə a və Fi nɨ.”
english: He said to them, “Then give to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”

jenjo: Bisɨ mambɨ pa e mwə wə nɨng e ifɨ lo, be nɨng nɨ o nə le lə nɨ. Sɨbi tswe le, e tsɨ pɨ le ka twangtwang.
english: They weren’t able to trap him in his words before the people. They marveled at his answer, and were silent.

jenjo: E ihyãfɨ və e Saduki nɨ tsɨka, aba ifafɨ bwi yang yilɨ hywabwa ywang nɨ, wu bi Yeso bi e tsa,
english: Some of the Sadducees came to him, those who deny that there is a resurrection.

jenjo: “Inyi nasɨ nɨng, Musa lenwa tsa a ba ifɨ tsə iye chi yɨ be wə lo bɨ o bwi yang, hywĩ wə akə dɨ hebwi de chi yɨ be wə bisɨ dzung hywĩ wə.
english: They asked him, “Teacher, Moses wrote to us that if a man’s brother dies having a wife, and he is childless, his brother should take the wife, and raise up children for his brother.

jenjo: A e tsa, e hywĩsə lə hywĩyung. Ihyãfɨ və le tsə iye bɨ bwi, e chi yɨ lo.
english: There were therefore seven brothers. The first took a wife, and died childless.

jenjo: Bɨ ifɨ nɨ yɔ wə kə nɨ dɨ hebwi de, fə o bwi.
english: The second took her as wife, and he died childless.

jenjo: Fə hywĩ wə a nɨng bwəta dɨ iye de mambɨ. Nɨng nɨ tswe le mambɨ be hywĩyung və le hɛ̃, e bwi e chi yɨ lo.
english: The third took her, and likewise the seven all left no children, and died.

jenjo: Sɨ nyitɨng ku wə iye de wu bwi.
english: Afterward the woman also died.

jenjo: Yə a nə bɨ lə, dɨ wə de kə bu iye nɨ vi yilɨ hywabwa? Bisɨ le hywĩyung hɛ̃ e tsə wə yang.”
english: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them will she be? For the seven had her as a wife.”

jenjo: Yeso kwə nwa le tsa, “Iye a tsəlɨ dɨ a və e ifɨ fangwa a sɨswenɨ.
english: Jesus said to them, “The children of this age marry, and are given in marriage.

jenjo: Sɨ Fangwa a pɨ nɨ sɨn wu kə nɨ, tsəlɨ a iye aloyang ibwi ywang, sɨ e ifɨ nɨ Fi yin yi be le hywabwa nɨ.
english: But those who are considered worthy to attain to that age and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in marriage.

jenjo: Fə bwilɨ ywang kə a itsɨng. Mambɨ en ku ma a və e Ikwətũ və Fi dzwe lɛ. Le nɨ e yi kə hywabwa nɨ le dɨ e yɨ Fi,.
english: For they can’t die any more, for they are like the angels, and are children of God, being children of the resurrection.

jenjo: “Musa be ku wə vĩ yang tsa bi və e ifɨ nɨ bwi kə nɨ, en yiyi hywabwa. Hywapɨnɨ o bə dzwa nɨ sɨn tswə̃ kə ku kə hwə, nɨ o dzukə pɨ Itwebɨ o tsa, ‘Fi və Ibrahim, Fi və Ishaku, be Fi və Yakub.’
english: But that the dead are raised, even Moses showed at the bush, when he called the Lord ‘The God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’

jenjo: Wə dɨ Fi və e ifɨ a hũlɨ, dɨ Fi və e ifɨ a bwa lo, bisɨ sɨ wə e ifɨ hɛ̃ lə be hũlɨ.”
english: Now he is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for all are alive to him.”

jenjo: E inyi nasɨ lenwa və Musa akə kwə nwa wə tsa, “Inyi nasɨ nɨng, a nə hywiwe!”
english: Some of the scribes answered, “Teacher, you speak well.”

jenjo: Ifɨ akə fə nyisɨ bi wə bi lo.
english: They didn’t dare to ask him any more questions.

jenjo: Bɨ Yeso bi le tsa, “Dɨ bə tswe e tsa Kristi nɨ Fi gbə wə sɔ lə nɨ dɨ Yɨ Dauda?
english: He said to them, “Why do they say that the Christ is David’s son?

jenjo: Bisɨ Dauda be ku wə vĩ tang Dəro və Zabura tsa, “ ‘Itwebɨ tsɨ Itwemi tsa, “A ku be kãlɨ na mi a nali
english: David himself says in the book of Psalms, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand,

jenjo: tɛmə n fə be e mbwe mə hywa, n myɛ le kə pɨ ta pu mə yang hĩ.” ’
english: until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’

jenjo: Aba Dauda dzu wə a Itwemi yang, tswe nwu on myɛ kə yɨ wə lɨ a?”
english: “David therefore calls him Lord, so how is he his son?”

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ e ifɨ kəng tswi sen likə bi o nɨ, bɨ o tsɨ e mwambwi o tsa,
english: In the hearing of all the people, he said to his disciples,

jenjo: “Ba tswe hakilo be e inyi nasɨ lenwa və Musa! E yidi pɨ holɨ be nɨng yasɨ a kã, e ifɨ ywɛhywa tsa le lomwe. Fə sen yidi pɨkulɨ və e ihyãfɨ pɨkwəsəku be pɨ nɨnglang.
english: “Beware of those scribes who like to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the marketplaces, the best seats in the synagogues, and the best places at feasts;

jenjo: Dɨ le sen benwa e hebwi sɨ nɨng və le sɨku ywang. sen pinwa a fĩlɨ tangsə e ifafɨ bɨsɨ e ywe nɨngnyi le. Bisɨ mambɨ, e ifɨ ma le, yi en tɔlə tswe sɨbi.”
english: who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers: these will receive greater condemnation.”

jenjo: Yeso dɨ ku wə, bɨ o bə e ifɨ nɨngchinɨng wu sen le ushila və le tang ji dɨ nɨng Kwə Fi.
english: He looked up, and saw the rich people who were putting their gifts into the treasury.

jenjo: Bɨ o bə hebwi akə kə ibe ifɨ, wu tə kwəbo bwayung.
english: He saw a certain poor widow casting in two small brass coins.

jenjo: O tsa, “Sɨ min nə bə lə, hebwi nɨ tə nɨngnɨ pe nyɔ e ifafɨ yang hɛ̃.
english: He said, “Truly I tell you, this poor widow put in more than all of them,

jenjo: E ifafɨ nɨ hɛ̃, dzwɛ tswəni tangsə nɨngnɨ e ləkə nɨ bɨ e tə, be wə a wə, nasɨ nɨngnɨ be wə kə ho bɨ o tə.”
english: for all these put in gifts for God from their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, put in all that she had to live on.”

jenjo: E mwambwi o akə pəsɔ pɨ yənwa sɨ sə̃lɨ e sə̃kə Kwə Fi, be te a pikang pwɔsɨ e nɨngtənɨng nɨ e tə e hyɔ̃ Fi nɨ. Yeso tsa,
english: As some were talking about the temple and how it was decorated with beautiful stones and gifts, he said,

jenjo: “Vi lə sɨ wulɨ, Kwə Fi nɨ sɨ ban bə tsɨkə nɨ, en de wə en yə hywa, pa e yə te akə ku akəw.”
english: “As for these things which you see, the days will come, in which there will not be left here one stone on another that will not be thrown down.”

jenjo: E bipɨ e tsa, “Inyi nasɨ nɨng, be donɨ bɨ e nɨng de yin tswelɨ a? Dɨ bə kə nɨngbəlɨ nɨ bɨn yikə pɨ vi de wuyang?”
english: They asked him, “Teacher, so when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are about to happen?”

jenjo: Yeso tsa, “Ba ku be yulɨ. Kə e ifɨ akə yin wu be dzung mi, en tsa dɨ le kə mi. En tsɨ bə en tsa vi de tswe yang, bi ban kwələ yɛ.
english: He said, “Watch out that you don’t get led astray, for many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he,’ and, ‘The time is at hand.’ Therefore don’t follow them.

jenjo: Aba ba li bi və bwi a talɨ, be nyənglɨ a na bwi yang, bi ban bibi yɛ. Dɨ nyitɨngku fangwa ho lo.”
english: When you hear of wars and disturbances, don’t be terrified, for these things must happen first, but the end won’t come immediately.”

jenjo: O yiku o tsa, “E hywa yi en tasə bwi bwa le, e ivə yin jibwi bwa le.
english: Then he said to them, “Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.

jenjo: Yi ban li b i və hywa myɛ sɨ pelɨ, hwə sɨn dzulɨ, fə nɨngshi yin ho lopɨ hɛ̃. Ban bə e nɨng tswe sɨbi be e nɨng a bəlɨ dzwe.
english: There will be great earthquakes, famines, and plagues in various places. There will be terrors and great signs from heaven.

jenjo: Pa e nɨng nɨ wun tswelɨ hɛ̃, en mwə bə, en tsɨ bə chi. En tə be ba kwə pɨkwəsəku və le, en tsə bə kwəsɨnang. En wu be bə pɨpi e ivə be e itwe hywa bisɨ mi.
english: But before all these things, they will lay their hands on you and will persecute you, delivering you up to synagogues and prisons, bringing you before kings and governors for my name’s sake.

jenjo: E nɨng nɨ yin chi ba bisɨ sɨ ban tenwa və bi alalɨ mi.
english: It will turn out as a testimony for you.

jenjo: Bi ban yɨlə ku bə bi və e nɨng nɨ ban nəkə ban jikə ku nɨ yɛ.
english: Settle it therefore in your hearts not to meditate beforehand how to answer,

jenjo: Min tə bə yulɨ be yinagang bi nɨ e iwənyi bə pa le bə be biw nɨ.
english: for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to withstand or to contradict.

jenjo: E ichilɨ bə mwə ba yin tɨtə, e hywĩ ba, e lənyɔ, be e tswə bə, en yə e ifɨ akə, e ifɨ hɛ̃ yin la bi və bə.
english: You will be handed over even by parents, brothers, relatives, and friends. They will cause some of you to be put to death.

jenjo: E ifɨ hɛ̃ en la bə bisɨ mi.
english: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake.

jenjo: Lehɛ̃ a dɨ tsa ku bə tsɨng ke lalo.
english: And not a hair of your head will perish.

jenjo: Ba tsɨ tsa ban jiku ji.”
english: “By your endurance you will win your lives.

jenjo: “A ba bə e itəbwi kwɛ Urushalima le tangsə yang ba yipɨ hywapɨ delɨ sɨ wə wu yang.
english: “But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then know that its desolation is at hand.

jenjo: E ifɨ nɨ Yahudiya nɨ e hywi e tə ku te. E ifɨ nɨ tangsə Urushalima nɨ hywi, e ifɨ nɨ ywang hywa de nɨ bi fə en tə və yɛ.
english: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains. Let those who are in the middle of her depart. Let those who are in the country not enter therein.

jenjo: Vi a wə dɨ vi tɔla. Bisɨ bi və e Ilinwa və Fi nɨ tang dəro tsɨkə bi a nɨng.
english: For these are days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.

jenjo: Nɨng a shi lɨ lə bisɨ e iye ywa be e ifɨ nɨ be e imwə tswamwi nɨ, hywa pɨ de ibe akã lə ihyãnɨng, e chi a pwəlɨ və Fi yin wu ku e ifɨ a hywapɨnɨ.
english: Woe to those who are pregnant and to those who nurse infants in those days! For there will be great distress in the land, and wrath to this people.

jenjo: E ifɨ akə en yə le be kafare, e ifɨ akə en bwi le en təkə hywa a nɨngfa tə en myɛkə e mwanshə. E Ywavə wu mwə Urushalima na en tə le ibe tɛmə vi nɨ Fi təkə e Ywavə lwekə ivə ku le nɨ tɨng yang hĩ.
english: They will fall by the edge of the sword, and will be led captive into all the nations. Jerusalem will be trampled down by the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.

jenjo: “Ban bə nɨng tswe sɨbi nɨ mɛdi pɨ tswelɨ lo sɨ fi be hywĩhywĩ be ndzɨng dzwe. Ku e ifɨ fangwa hɛ̃ yin lwilwi bisɨ wi chi nwə a kã be ywa ku mɨng nɨ sɨn wə ma npɔ̃ nɨ.
english: There will be signs in the sun, moon, and stars; and on the earth anxiety of nations, in perplexity for the roaring of the sea and the waves;

jenjo: E ifafɨ yin sũbwi bisɨ bilɨ a bi be e nɨng nɨ sen bə yin wukə fangwa lə nɨ, e nɨng sambe dzwe hɛ̃ Fi yin yo le yo.
english: men fainting for fear, and for expectation of the things which are coming on the world: for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.

jenjo: Habi e bə Yɨ Ifafɨ yi hu jikə, tangsə chi be sambe be kãlɨ o ho.
english: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ e nɨng nɨ hɛ̃ pəsɔ pɨ tswe nɨng yang, ba yi ba tsɨ pu, ba dɨ ku bə ba yi kə dzwe bisɨ sapɨ jili a ku və bə kyə̃pɨ yang.”
english: But when these things begin to happen, look up, and lift up your heads, because your redemption is near.”

jenjo: Bɨ Yeso nə le nwabi nɨ lə tsa, “Ba bə kəfe be nyɔ e kə hɛ̃,
english: He told them a parable. “See the fig tree, and all the trees.

jenjo: Aba yang le pəsɔ pɨ pəlɨ yang, ba yipɨ ywadzwi kyə̃pɨ yang.
english: When they are already budding, you see it and know by your own selves that the summer is already near.

jenjo: Do mambɨ, sapɨnɨ ba bə e nɨng sɨn tswe nɨng ma nɨ yang, ba yipɨ Ivə və Fi kyə̃pɨ yang.
english: Even so you also, when you see these things happening, know that God’s Kingdom is near.

jenjo: “Ka a kəng, e nɨng nɨ yin tswe nɨng hɛ̃, e ifɨ a hywapɨ nɨ ku lə, e bwi lo.
english: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all things are accomplished.

jenjo: dzwe be fangwa nɨ yin pɨpe, be e bi mi sɨn pe lo.
english: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will by no means pass away.

jenjo: “Ba tswe hakilo, bi ban yə tanglɨ a nɨng, be nwalɨ a nɨng, be yidi nɨng fangwa nɨ dɨ hakilo və bə yɛ. Mambɨlo yang, vi nɨ wun chi bə ma mɨng gba be nyinyi nvi.
english: “So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day will come on you suddenly.

jenjo: Bisɨ vi nɨ yin wu e ifɨ fangwa nɨ lə hywakĩ.
english: For it will come like a snare on all those who dwell on the surface of all the earth.

jenjo: Ba tsɨ tsa, ba wədəkə pɨ pinwa kəvivi, bisɨ ba chi sambe pɨ jiku sɨ e nɨng nɨ yin tswekə nɨ, hebilə ba chi na ba tsɨ pɨpi Yɨ Ifafɨ.”
english: Therefore be watchful all the time, praying that you may be counted worthy to escape all these things that will happen, and to stand before the Son of Man.”

jenjo: Yeso sɨn nyi na sɨ nɨng kəvivi Kwə Fi, aba nandzwi pə yang, o mwə nyə fə tə son lwe ku Te Zetun.
english: Every day Jesus was teaching in the temple, and every night he would go out and spend the night on the mountain that is called Olivet.

jenjo: Be nyinvi a bubu, e ifafɨ wu sen pwɔsə sɨ wə Kwə Fi sen li bi o.
english: All the people came early in the morning to him in the temple to hear him.

jenjo: Nɨnglang nɨ sen tswekə be kunpə nɨ yisti ywang sen dzuka Nɨngtsa Hyãlɨ nɨ kyə̃pɨ yang,
english: Now the feast of unleavened bread, which is called the Passover, was approaching.

jenjo: ivə hyɔ̃nɨng be e inyi nasɨ Lenwa və Musa sɨn pangpɨ nihyã nɨ en yəkə Yeso nɨ. Bisɨ sen bibi və nyɔ e ifafɨ.
english: The chief priests and the scribes sought how they might put him to death, for they feared the people.

jenjo: Bɨ Shetan tə nyi Yahuda Iskariyoti, tsɨng tangsə e mwambwipu və Yeso bwahywə ji yung.
english: Satan entered into Judas, who was also called Iscariot, who was counted with the twelve.

jenjo: Dɨbɨ Yahuda yi tə sɨ e ivə hyɔ̃nɨng be e ihyãfɨ tsɨnɨng Kwə Fi, bɨ o nəsələ be le, nihyã nɨ o le Yeso on tə le en mwə wə kə nɨ.
english: He went away, and talked with the chief priests and captains about how he might deliver him to them.

jenjo: Sɨ le la le tswe sɨbi, bɨ e kwələ e tsa en fə wə fə.
english: They were glad, and agreed to give him money.

jenjo: Yahuda kwə le lə lɨn pələ le, bɨ o pangpɨ nihyã nɨ on tə lekə Yeso kɨngkɨng sapɨnɨ e ifafɨ ywang nɨ.
english: He consented, and sought an opportunity to deliver him to them in the absence of the multitude.

jenjo: Bɨ vi nɨnglang kumpə nɨ yisti ywang pibi nɨ sen fikə nɨngpunga hyɔ̃nɨng a Hyãlɨ pəsɔ nɨ.
english: The day of unleavened bread came, on which the Passover must be sacrificed.

jenjo: Yeso tũ Bitulu be Yohana, o tsɨ le o tsa, “Ba o chi tə ba mə Nɨngtang Hyãlɨ ba tsɨ, bisɨ bɨ tang tsung.”
english: Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, “Go and prepare the Passover for us, that we may eat.”

jenjo: E bi wə bi e tsa, “Dɨ pɨ ake sɨ man yidi bɨ mə nɨngtang de pɨbi?”
english: They said to him, “Where do you want us to prepare?”

jenjo: O kwə nwa le o tsa, “Sapɨnɨ ba təkə tangsə Urushalima nɨ, ban kwə ibwi akə dɨ mɨng tang bo. Ba mwə tswa wə ba tə və nɨ o təkə lə hɛ̃.
english: He said to them, “Behold, when you have entered into the city, a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him into the house which he enters.

jenjo: Ba tsɨ itwevə de ba tsa, ‘Inyi nasɨ nɨng sɨn bipɨ tsa, “Dɨ kwə dzwəwɛ ake bɨ min tang Nɨnglang Hyãlɨ be e mwambwi mi pɨbi lɨ a?” ’
english: Tell the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says to you, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?”’

jenjo: On dɨ bə on təkə tangkwə a kã və a dzwe nɨ e mə tsɨtsɨlɨ nɨ. Dɨ pɨ de ho. Tə ba tswe nɨngtang de pɨbi.”
english: He will show you a large, furnished upper room. Make preparations there.”

jenjo: E tə tangsə və de, ta e chi ma nɨngnɨ Yeso nə le lə nɨ, bɨ e tswe Nɨngtang Hyãlɨ de pɨbi.
english: They went, found things as Jesus had told them, and they prepared the Passover.

jenjo: Hywapɨ tswekə nɨ, bɨ Yeso be e mwambwipu o bwəhywa ji yung ku hywa ku hywe nɨngtang.
english: When the hour had come, he sat down with the twelve apostles.

jenjo: Yeso tsa, “N tsɨ nɨng mi sɨ hywapɨ nɨ be mwəne nyi nyi mi, bisɨ bɨ tang nɨngtang nɨ tsung habi ibe a mi pəsɔ ho.
english: He said to them, “I have earnestly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer,

jenjo: Sɨ min nə bə lə sɨswenɨ te fə n tswe nɨnglang akə fangwa nɨw, tɔnə dɨ nyitɨng ku wə tangsə Ivə və Fi yang hĩ.”
english: for I tell you, I will no longer by any means eat of it until it is fulfilled in God’s Kingdom.”

jenjo: Bɨ Yeso dɨ kofi, sapɨ nɨ o kã kə Fi ku we nɨ, bɨ o tsa, “Ba mwə ba tsəsə bwa bə.
english: He received a cup, and when he had given thanks, he said, “Take this, and share it among yourselves,

jenjo: Bisɨ te fə n nwa mɨng chilɨ kə Zaitun pɨnɨ lo tɔnə Ivə və Fi wu yang hi.”
english: for I tell you, I will not drink at all again from the fruit of the vine, until God’s Kingdom comes.”

jenjo: Bɨ o dɨ kumpə, sapɨnɨ o kã Fi kuwe nɨ, o chwĩ nyangshang bɨ o ta e mwambwi o, son tsa, “Dɨ sɨ mi nɨ, e ta bisɨ bə. Ba tswe mambɨ bisɨ ba wədəkə pɨ nyibi be mi.”
english: He took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke, and gave it to them, saying, “This is my body which is given for you. Do this in memory of me.”

jenjo: Mambɨ fə o tə le kofi akə tswa nɨngtang o tsa, “Kofi nɨ dɨ ndɛ̃ və Fi a hu nɨ o tsəkə be hywi mi nɨ te hywa bisɨ bə nɨ.
english: Likewise, he took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood, which is poured out for you.

jenjo: Be ifɨ nɨ yi on tə kə mwə mi nɨ ku lə nwa hywe nɨ tsung be mi,.
english: But behold, the hand of him who betrays me is with me on the table.

jenjo: Yɨ Ifafɨ yin bwibwi ma nɨng nɨ e vĩkə nɨ, be wewe ta ifɨ nɨ yin le wə on təkə nɨ!”
english: The Son of Man indeed goes, as it has been determined, but woe to that man through whom he is betrayed!”

jenjo: E mwambwi o pəsɔ pɨ bipɨ bwəle sen tsa, yə dɨ wə bɨ yin tswe nɨngnɨ lɨ tangsə bi nɨ.
english: They began to question among themselves, which of them it was who would do this thing.

jenjo: Bɨ e pəsɔ pɨ tswasə nwa bwəle sen tsa, yə dɨ wə yin ku kə ihyãfɨ tangsə le lɨ.
english: There arose also a contention among them, which of them was considered to be greatest.

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ le tsa, “Fangwa nɨ, e ivə be e ihyãfɨ hywa e tsɨku e ifɨ və le, lehɛ̃ e dɨ ku le kə e ipələ e ifɨ.
english: He said to them, “The kings of the nations lord it over them, and those who have authority over them are called ‘benefactors.’

jenjo: Be mambɨ lo tangsə bə a bə. Be ihyãfɨ və bə myɛ ku wə kə imwə, fə itsɨkunɨng və bə o ku kə itswe shə və e nyɔ.
english: But not so with you. But one who is the greater among you, let him become as the younger, and one who is governing, as one who serves.

jenjo: Tangsə itwevə be mwənshə o, dɨ wə kə ifɨ dɨ nɨngtang tɛ pɨfa? Tɨtɛ nɨ dɨ mwənshə. Məmbɨ lo pɨ nɨ, bisɨ n ku kə mwənshə tangsə bə.
english: For who is greater, one who sits at the table, or one who serves? Isn’t it he who sits at the table? But I am among you as one who serves.

jenjo: Dɨ bə bɨ ba tsɨtsa tsung be mi hywapɨ tswe ibe mi.
english: But you are those who have continued with me in my trials.

jenjo: Min ya bə ivə, ma yalɨ Ta mi ya mi ivə nɨ,
english: I confer on you a kingdom, even as my Father conferred on me,

jenjo: hebilə ba tang ba nwa sɨ ivə a mi. Fə ban ku, ku e kəzɛ̃ ban tswe e nwakəvə və e Israila bwahywə ji yung kitə lə.
english: that you may eat and drink at my table in my Kingdom. You will sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.”

jenjo: “Siman, Siman, Shetan sɨn yidi pɨ kwə bə dɨ tə ye ma a və wəng tangsə nɨngnɨng.
english: The Lord said, “Simon, Simon, behold, Satan asked to have all of you, that he might sift you as wheat,

jenjo: Be n pinwa yang bisɨ bi ba o sɨ pəlɨ a nyi və bə. Sapɨnɨ a mwə a myɛ fə a wu sɨ mi yang, a pwə e hywĩ mə pwəsɨ le tsa lə.”
english: but I prayed for you, that your faith wouldn’t fail. You, when once you have turned again, establish your brothers.”

jenjo: Bitulu tsa, “Itwebɨ, n kwələ yang min tə kwəsɨnang tsung be mə kə, a dɨ bwilɨ yang bɨ bwi tsung.”
english: He said to him, “Lord, I am ready to go with you both to prison and to death!”

jenjo: Bɨ Yeso tsɨ wə tsa, “Bitulu, min nə mə lə, pa yɛ tata be hywapɨkĩ jɛnɨ lɨ, man la mi hywi bwatə.”
english: He said, “I tell you, Peter, the rooster will by no means crow today until you deny that you know me three times.”

jenjo: Bɨ Yeso bi le tsa, “Sapɨnɨ N tũ bə tə bə tenwa bi və Fi bə dɨ sede na lo, alo ho mwənə aloyang nɨng yasɨ lo nɨ, nɨng a kə lə bə yang?” Bɨ e tsa, “Oho nɨng akə la bɨ lo.”
english: He said to them, “When I sent you out without purse, and wallet, and shoes, did you lack anything?” They said, “Nothing.”

jenjo: O tsa, “Sɨswenɨ, bə dɨ sede be ho mwənə və bə. Ifɨ nɨ ywang be kafale yang o dɨ nɨng yasɨ o jə, o jəkə kafale tsɨng!
english: Then he said to them, “But now, whoever has a purse, let him take it, and likewise a wallet. Whoever has none, let him sell his cloak, and buy a sword.

jenjo: E vĩvĩ tsa, ‘E sa wə tangsə e ifɨ nɨng abe.’ ” O! kə akəng nɨng nɨ e Ilinwa nəkə nɨ tɔle e nyitɨng ku wə ku mi.”
english: For I tell you that this which is written must still be fulfilled in me: ‘He was counted with transgressors.’ For that which concerns me has an end.”

jenjo: Bɨ e mwambwi o tsa, “Itwebɨ, bɨ lə be kafare bwayung nə bi.” O tsa, “Lolə yang.”
english: They said, “Lord, behold, here are two swords.” He said to them, “That is enough.”

jenjo: Bɨ Yeso ji tə ku te zetun ma nɨng nɨ son tswekə tɨtɛ nɨ, e mwambwi o tə tsung be wə kə.
english: He came out, and went, as his custom was, to the Mount of Olives. His disciples also followed him.

jenjo: O tə kə pɨ de nɨ, bɨ o tsɨ le o tsa, “Ba kũ Fi, hɛbələ bi ban o sɨ pɨnyipɨ və Shetan yɛ.”
english: When he was at the place, he said to them, “Pray that you don’t enter into temptation.”

jenjo: O ho o tə chi ma tswilɨ və te nɨ ifɨ gbəkə be kəna nɨ, bɨ o pə dzwang wə hywa o pinwa,
english: He was withdrawn from them about a stone’s throw, and he knelt down and prayed,

jenjo: o tsa, “Ta mi, aba a kwələ yang, a dɨ mi iləng pwəne nɨ lə ku mi. Lehɛ̃, dɨ yidi a mi lo, dɨ nɨng nɨ a yidi nɨ kə tswe.”
