english: saying, “Father, if you are willing, remove this cup from me. Nevertheless, not my will, but yours, be done.”

jenjo: Bɨ ikwətũ dzwe akə hu ji sɨ Yeso, bisɨ yi wə ku nyi a tsalɨ.
english: An angel from heaven appeared to him, strengthening him.

jenjo: Bisɨ mwənɛ nɨ wə tangsə wə nɨ, o pwəsɨ wə tsa o pinwa, pɨtswə̃ sɨn bu sɨ we ma hywi sɨn te hywa.
english: Being in agony he prayed more earnestly. His sweat became like great drops of blood falling down on the ground.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ o yikə pɨ pinwa nɨ, bɨ fə tə o chi e mwambwi o sɨn lwe nɨnglwe hake sɨ a tɨnglɨ be pəlɨ ashi.
english: When he rose up from his prayer, he came to the disciples, and found them sleeping because of grief,

jenjo: Bɨ o tsɨ le o tsa, “tswe nwu sɨ ban lwe nɨng lwe? Ba yi ba pinwa, hɛbələ bi ban o sɨ pɨnyipɨ və Shetan yɛ.”
english: and said to them, “Why do you sleep? Rise and pray that you may not enter into temptation.”

jenjo: Wə ku bi a nəlɨ ho, pa en nyalɨ e ifafɨ kə dzung dzung wu tsung be Yahuda tsɨng tangsə e mwambwipu bwahywə ji yung nɨ, dɨ wə kə ifɨ nɨ o chi nɨ. Bɨ o ho o tə a sɨ Yeso pɨ ka wə tsɨ ngyəng wə,
english: While he was still speaking, behold, a multitude, and he who was called Judas, one of the twelve, was leading them. He came near to Jesus to kiss him.

jenjo: bɨ Yeso tsɨ wə tsa, “Yahuda, man yidi pɨ le Yɨ Ifafɨ təlɨ ho bɨ man tsɨ nwa mə tswa kəna mi ma pɨ tsapɨ və ifɨ a pikang nɨ a?”
english: But Jesus said to him, “Judas, do you betray the Son of Man with a kiss?”

jenjo: E mwəmbwi o bəkə nɨng nɨ yin tswekə pɨnɨ, bɨ e tsa, “Itwebɨ, bɨ tsɛ sɨ le be e kafare və bɨ?”
english: When those who were around him saw what was about to happen, they said to him, “Lord, shall we strike with the sword?”

jenjo: Mwəmbwi və Yeso akə tũ chwi a na li və tsɨng tangsə e mwənshə və e ihyãfɨ hyɔ̃nɨng de be kafale.
english: A certain one of them struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.

jenjo: Bɨ Yeso tsa, “Loləyang mambɨ!” Bɨ Yeso pang na sɨ chwi shə de, dɨ fə ta pɨmbe wə.
english: But Jesus answered, “Let me at least do this”—and he touched his ear, and healed him.

jenjo: Bɨ Yeso nə e ifɨ nɨ ji pɨ wu mwə wə kə nɨ, e ivə hyɔ̃nɨng be e ihyãfɨ tsɨ nɨng sɨ Kwə Fi, be e nyɔ ihyãfɨ de o tsa, “Ba ji be kafare be e kə nɨ, mi dɨ ifɨ nɨng yinɨng be nɨng bi na?
english: Jesus said to the chief priests, captains of the temple, and elders, who had come against him, “Have you come out as against a robber, with swords and clubs?

jenjo: Bɨ ku tsung kəvivi mi be bəkə tangsə Kwə Fi, tswe nwu ba mwə mi pɨbi lo? Be dɨ hywapɨ və bə be e tsɨkunɨng tangkuchi ho nɨ.”
english: When I was with you in the temple daily, you didn’t stretch out your hands against me. But this is your hour, and the power of darkness.”

jenjo: E mwə wə kə nɨ, bɨ e to wə e le chi, e tə be wə və ivə hyɔ̃nɨng. Bitulu leywa lə pɨ a tswili bɨ son mwə tswa le.
english: They seized him, and led him away, and brought him into the high priest’s house. But Peter followed from a distance.

jenjo: E itsə ywa de mə dzwa tangsə və de, bɨ Bitulu wu ku tangsə le son bwi dzwa tsung be le kə.
english: When they had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard, and had sat down together, Peter sat among them.

jenjo: Imwə a iye akə lə kə shə tang və de, o bə Bitulu ku sɨn bwi dzwa nɨ, dɨbɨ o tsɨ nɨng pikang sɨ wə, imwə a iye de tsa, “Ibwi nɨ lə tangsə e ifɨ mwə nyi Yeso.
english: A certain servant girl saw him as he sat in the light, and looking intently at him, said, “This man also was with him.”

jenjo: Be Bitulu tsa nwa tsa, “Iye, n mɛdi pɨ yi wə lo!”
english: He denied Jesus, saying, “Woman, I don’t know him.”

jenjo: Nalə tswanɨ ifɨ akə bə Bitulu bɨ o tsa, “Mə ma mə dɨ tsɨng və le.” Bitulu kwə nwa wə tsa, “Mə ibwi nɨ, mi dɨ tsɨng və le lo!”
english: After a little while someone else saw him, and said, “You also are one of them!” But Peter answered, “Man, I am not!”

jenjo: Sa tsɨng wu pe kə nɨ, bɨ ifɨ akə ben tsɨng wə wu tsa, “Ibwi nɨ dɨ ifɨ a Galili, kə a kang wə tsung be Yeso kə.”
english: After about one hour passed, another confidently affirmed, saying, “Truly this man also was with him, for he is a Galilean!”

jenjo: Be Bitulu tsa, “Mə ibwi nɨ, n yi chi bi nɨ sɨ man nəkə nɨ lo.” Wə ku bi a nəli ho bɨ yɛ tata.
english: But Peter said, “Man, I don’t know what you are talking about!” Immediately, while he was still speaking, a rooster crowed.

jenjo: Itwebɨ myɛ chi e sɨ Bitulu, bɨ nyi Bitulu o sɨ bi nɨ Itwebɨ nə wə kə lə sako tsa, “Pa yɛ tata be hywapɨkĩ lɨ, man tsa nwa hywi bwatə, man tsa a yi mi lo.”
english: The Lord turned, and looked at Peter. Then Peter remembered the Lord’s word, how he said to him, “Before the rooster crows you will deny me three times.”

jenjo: Bɨ Bitulu pa ji, o tata be nwashi.
english: He went out, and wept bitterly.

jenjo: E ifɨ tsə ywa nɨ sen tsɨ nɨng sɨ Yeso nɨ, mə wə be pɨyɔpɨ fə e gbə wə.
english: The men who held Jesus mocked him and beat him.

jenjo: E tsə nɨng wə be zənɨng fə sen bi wə bi be pɨyɔpɨ sen tsa, “A nə bɨ lə, dɨ wə de gbə mə?”
english: Having blindfolded him, they struck him on the face and asked him, “Prophesy! Who is the one who struck you?”

jenjo: Fə e hywã jə wə, kə bi pɨyɔpɨ.
english: They spoke many other things against him, insulting him.

jenjo: Pɨ kəkə nɨ, bɨ e ihyãfɨ Yahuda be e ivə hyɔ̃nɨng və le, be e inyi nasɨ lenwa və Musa wu pwɔsə pɨ a tsɨng bɨ e ifɨ tsə ywa wu be Yeso pɨpi e ihyãfɨ de.
english: As soon as it was day, the assembly of the elders of the people were gathered together, both chief priests and scribes, and they led him away into their council, saying,

jenjo: Bɨ e ihyãfɨ de tsɨ wə tsa, “A nə bɨ lə, dɨ mə kə ifɨ nɨ Fi gbə wə sɔ lə nɨ?” Bɨ o tsɨ le o tsa, “A n tsa dɨ mi kə ifɨ de yang, ba pa ba kwələw.
english: “If you are the Christ, tell us.” But he said to them, “If I tell you, you won’t believe,

jenjo: Fə n bi bə bisɨ bəde ba kwələ be mi lo yang, ba pa ba kwə mi ləw.
english: and if I ask, you will in no way answer me or let me go.

jenjo: Vi lə sɨn wulɨ chi tswəni nɨ mi Yɨ Ifafɨ yi min chi pɨ kulɨ na li və Fi Ipekãlɨ.”
english: From now on, the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God.”

jenjo: Le hɛ̃ e bi Yeso bi e tsa, “Dɨ mə kə Yɨ Fi ho?” Bɨ o tsɨ le o tsa, “Ba nə yang hywiwə, dɨ mi.”
english: They all said, “Are you then the Son of God?” He said to them, “You say it, because I am.”

jenjo: Dɨbɨ e ihyãfɨ de tsa, “Nyɔ bi akə lə? Bɨ be ku bɨ bɨ li yang nwa wə!”
english: They said, “Why do we need any more witness? For we ourselves have heard from his own mouth!”

jenjo: Bɨ e ihyãfɨ de hɛ̃, le Yeso chi e təkə sɨ Bilatus.
english: The whole company of them rose up and brought him before Pilate.

jenjo: Nana bɨ e pəsɔ pɨ wə bi ku Yeso, e tsɨ wə e tsa, “Bɨ mwə ibwi nɨ, son lwi ku e ifɨ və bɨ. O nə le bi lə o tsa bi en fə Kaisar sede gbaku yɛ, fə son dɨ ku wə kə Ifɨ nɨ Fi gbəwə sɔ nɨ.”
english: They began to accuse him, saying, “We found this man perverting the nation, forbidding paying taxes to Caesar, and saying that he himself is Christ, a king.”

jenjo: Bɨ Bilatus bi Yeso tsa, “Dɨ mə kə Ivə ve Yahuda?” Yeso kwə nwa wə tsa, “Mambɨ, ma nəlɨ a mə.”
english: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered him, “So you say.”

jenjo: Bɨ Bilatus myɛ chi wə, e sɨ e ivə hyɔ̃nɨng be nyɔ e ifafɨ hɛ̃, o tsa, “N chi ibwi nɨ be ayibe akə lo!”
english: Pilate said to the chief priests and the multitudes, “I find no basis for a charge against this man.”

jenjo: Le hɛ̃ e gba chwi lə fə sen nəbi sen tsa, “Pɨnɨ o təkə hɛ̃ hywa Yahudiya, son lwi ku e ifɨ be e nɨng nɨ son nyi e ifafɨ nalə nɨ. O pəsɔ Galili bɨ dɨlə o wu kə Urushalima nɨ.”
english: But they insisted, saying, “He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee even to this place.”

jenjo: Bilatus likə nɨ, o bi pɨ o tsa, “Wə dɨ ifɨ a Galili?”
english: But when Pilate heard Galilee mentioned, he asked if the man was a Galilean.

jenjo: E kwə nwa wə e tsa wə dɨ ifɨ a Galili nɨ, bɨ Bilatus to wə tə Hiridus, bisɨ Galili le tangsə hywa və Hiridus. Sapɨ de nɨ, Hiridus lə Urushalima.
english: When he found out that he was in Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem during those days.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ Hiridus bəkə Yeso nɨ, o li lalɨ ihyãnɨng bisɨ be tswilɨ kuson yidi pɨ bə Yeso. O li bi ihyãnɨng ku Yeso, bɨ o tsɨ nyi son yidi pɨ bə Yeso tswe nɨng tswesɨbi akə nɨng wɛ.
english: Now when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceedingly glad, for he had wanted to see him for a long time, because he had heard many things about him. He hoped to see some miracle done by him.

jenjo: O bi Yeso bi ihyãnɨng, be Yeso la pɨ kwə nwa wə lɨ.
english: He questioned him with many words, but he gave no answers.

jenjo: E ihyãfɨ hyɔ̃nɨng be e inyi nasɨ lenwa və Musa, tsɨ pɨbi sɨn nə bi a be ku Yeso be nwakwəng.
english: The chief priests and the scribes stood, vehemently accusing him.

jenjo: Bɨ Hiridus be e ifɨ tabwi o, yɔ Yeso, fə sen mə wə. Bɨ e ya wə nɨng yasɨ a pikang lə, e to wə fə e tə təsɨ Bilatus.
english: Herod with his soldiers humiliated him and mocked him. Dressing him in luxurious clothing, they sent him back to Pilate.

jenjo: vi a ina bɨ Bilatus be Hiridus myɛkə e tswəsa. Tɨtɛ nɨ le dɨ e mbwesə.
english: Herod and Pilate became friends with each other that very day, for before that they were enemies with each other.

jenjo: Bilatus pwɔ e ivə hyɔ̃nɨng, be e inyi nasɨ lenwa və Musa, be nyɔ e ifɨ hɛ̃ pɨ a tsɨng,
english: Pilate called together the chief priests, the rulers, and the people,

jenjo: bɨ o tsɨ le o tsa, “Ba mwə ibwi nɨ ba tə mi ba tsa, son pwə e ifafɨ tə nyəng nabwi, n bi wə bi nɨng bə nɨ hɛ̃ n chi wə be ayibe akə lo ku bi nɨ ba ki nwakwəng o sɨ mi bisɨ wə nɨ.
english: and said to them, “You brought this man to me as one that perverts the people, and behold, having examined him before you, I found no basis for a charge against this man concerning those things of which you accuse him.

jenjo: Mambɨ, Hiridus chi wə be ayibe akə lo, dɨbɨ to wə fə o tə bɨ. Ibwi nɨ tswe ayibe nɨ en yə wə kə nɨ lo.
english: Neither has Herod, for I sent you to him, and see, nothing worthy of death has been done by him.

jenjo: Bisɨ mambɨ, mɨn tswe hu sɨ wə be nɨngbənɨng yə n le wə na.”
english: I will therefore chastise him and release him.”

jenjo: Bɨ e ki nwakwəng be wi tsɨng e tsa, “A to ibwi nɨ, tə te yə wə! Be a le Barabas na tə!”
english: But they all cried out together, saying, “Away with this man! Release to us Barabbas!”—

jenjo: Barabas de, dɨ ibwi akə nɨ e tsəkə kwəsɨnang bisɨ o yi be hakilo ve e ifɨ a və le, be yəlɨ və ifɨ.
english: one who was thrown into prison for a certain revolt in the city, and for murder.

jenjo: Bilatus la nwa le bisɨ son yidi pɨ le Yeso na tə.
english: Then Pilate spoke to them again, wanting to release Jesus,

jenjo: Be e ku lə be nwakwəng sen tsa, “Pi wə ku kə ɛ! Pi wə ku kə ɛ!”
english: but they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify him!”

jenjo: Bilatus bi le hywi bwatə tsa, “Bisɨ bəde? Be dɨ ayibe ake bɨ o tswe? N chi wə be ayibe akə lo nɨ min yə wə kə, bisɨ mambɨ min nə hu sɨ wə be tswe yə n le wə na.”
english: He said to them the third time, “Why? What evil has this man done? I have found no capital crime in him. I will therefore chastise him and release him.”

jenjo: Lehɛ̃, e tsɨlə be wi kɔ̃kɔ̃ sen yidi e pi Yeso ku kə ɛ, fə nwakwəng le pe sambe o.
english: But they were urgent with loud voices, asking that he might be crucified. Their voices and the voices of the chief priests prevailed.

jenjo: Bɨ Bilatus tswe le nɨng nɨ e yidi nɨ lə.
english: Pilate decreed that what they asked for should be done.

jenjo: Ma yidi və le, Bilatus le Barabas na, ifɨ nɨ e tsəkə kwəsɨnang bisɨ yilɨ a hakilo e ifɨ a və le, be yəlɨ a ifɨ nɨ. Bɨ o mwə Yeso o tə le tə, bisɨ e tswe nɨng nɨ nyi le yidi be wə kə nɨ.
english: He released him who had been thrown into prison for insurrection and murder, for whom they asked, but he delivered Jesus up to their will.

jenjo: Hywapɨnɨ e ifɨ tabwi to Yeso le chi sen təkə ho, bɨ a kwəsə be ifɨ a Sayirin akə nɨ sen dzukə Siman nɨ, o fə fanɨng son tə və wə Urushalima ho. E mwə ibwi de, bɨ e tsɨ wə o dɨ gãlɨkə nɨ en pi Yeso ku wɛ nɨ, o mwə tswa Yeso.
english: When they led him away, they grabbed one Simon of Cyrene, coming from the country, and laid on him the cross, to carry it after Jesus.

jenjo: E ifɨ kə dzungdzung mwə tswa le, tangsə le e iye akə lə sɨn go ta bisɨ Yeso.
english: A great multitude of the people followed him, including women who also mourned and lamented him.

jenjo: Be Yeso kwəng bɨ o tsɨ le o tsa, “Bə e yɨ a iye Urushalima, bi ban tata bisɨ mi yɛ, ba tata bisɨ ku bə, be e yɨ bə.
english: But Jesus, turning to them, said, “Daughters of Jerusalem, don’t weep for me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.

jenjo: Vi lə sɨn wulɨ nɨ ban tsa, ‘Jang kang e iye hona yang, nɨ mɛdi pɨ chi yɨ lo nɨ, be mi nɨ yɨ a hyɛ̃ mɛdi pɨ ũ kə lo nɨ.’
english: For behold, the days are coming in which they will say, ‘Blessed are the barren, the wombs that never bore, and the breasts that never nursed.’

jenjo: Hywapɨ de, en kũ e te en tsa, ‘Ba o ku bɨ!’ fə en nə e nwa gyang lə en tsa, ‘Ba tswi bɨ!’
english: Then they will begin to tell the mountains, ‘Fall on us!’ and tell the hills, ‘Cover us.’

jenjo: A en tswe e nɨngnɨ hywapɨnɨ kə sɨn nywi toto sɨswenɨ yang, dɨbə en tswekə e kə de aba o chiyang ho ɔ?”
english: For if they do these things in the green tree, what will be done in the dry?”

jenjo: E ifɨ gbapɨ bwayung akə lə nɨ, e to le e chi be Yeso bisɨ tə e yə le tsung.
english: There were also others, two criminals, led with him to be put to death.

jenjo: E tə pɨ akə nɨ sen dzukə a Kwang Ji Ku nɨ, Pɨbi bɨ e pi Yeso ku gãlɨkə tsung be e ifɨ gbapɨ bwayung nɨ. E pi Yeso ku gãlɨkə a tangsə, fə e ifɨ gbapɨ bwayung nɨ, e pi tsɨng ku gãlɨkə a na li, ifɨ a tsɨng ku gãlɨkə a na mi.
english: When they came to the place that is called The Skull, they crucified him there with the criminals, one on the right and the other on the left.

jenjo: Bɨ Yeso a nwa wə tsa, “Ta mi, a e nyi mə hywa sɨ e ifɨ nɨ, bisɨ e yi nɨngnɨ sen tswekə nɨ lo.” E ifɨ tabwi de, gbə nɨngbimbɨng, ke e ifɨ nɨ tang kə hɛ̃, en bwi nɨngtsənɨng o, en tsəsə bwa le.
english: Jesus said, “Father, forgive them, for they don’t know what they are doing.” Dividing his garments among them, they cast lots.

jenjo: E ifafɨ tsɨ pɨbi sen bəlɨ, bɨ e ihyãfɨ de mə Yeso sen tsa, “O gba e ifɨ akə o le na yang. Kə a kəng a dɨ wə kə Ivə nɨ Fi gba wə sɔ lə nɨ yang, o gba ku wə o le na.”
english: The people stood watching. The rulers with them also scoffed at him, saying, “He saved others. Let him save himself, if this is the Christ of God, his chosen one!”

jenjo: Be e ifɨ tabwi hɛ̃, sɨn mə Yeso be pɨ yɔpɨ, dɨbɨ e tə wə dzwe mi.
english: The soldiers also mocked him, coming to him and offering him vinegar,

jenjo: Sen mə wə sen tsa, “Kə a kəng a dɨ mə kə Ivə ve Yahuda yang, a gba ku mə a le na!”
english: and saying, “If you are the King of the Jews, save yourself!”

jenjo: E vĩ ku kə a pyənglɨ akə e tsa, “DƗ IVƏ VƏ E YAHUDA HO NƗ.” Bɨ e pi ku gãlɨkə nɨ e pikə Yeso pɨbi nɨ.
english: An inscription was also written over him in letters of Greek, Latin, and Hebrew: “THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

jenjo: Tsɨng tangsə e ifɨ gbapɨ bwayung nɨ, yɔ Yeso, o tsa, “N tsa mi ake dɨ mə kə ifɨ nɨ Fi gbə wə sɔ nɨ? Mambɨ yang, a gba ku mə a le na, yə a gba bɨ a le na!”
english: One of the criminals who was hanged insulted him, saying, “If you are the Christ, save yourself and us!”

jenjo: Ifɨ a tsɨng go hywĩ wə o tsa, “Man bibi və Fi lo? Mə nɨ, e tũ mə za a tsɨng be wə hɛ̃!
english: But the other answered, and rebuking him said, “Don’t you even fear God, seeing you are under the same condemnation?

jenjo: E pibɨ ku kə hywiwe, bisɨ e ayibe nɨ bɨ tswekə e ifɨ lə nɨ, be ibwi nɨ tswe ayibe akə lo.”
english: And we indeed justly, for we receive the due reward for our deeds, but this man has done nothing wrong.”

jenjo: Bɨ o nə Yeso lə o tsa, “Yeso, sapɨnɨ a təkə Ivə mə yang, bi nyi mə chĩ sɨ mi yɛ.”
english: He said to Jesus, “Lord, remember me when you come into your Kingdom.”

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ wə tsa, “Kə a kəng, min nə mə lə, jɛnɨ man ku tsung be mi PU KƏ CHƐ̃ və Fi.”
english: Jesus said to him, “Assuredly I tell you, today you will be with me in Paradise.”

jenjo: Be fi ho wu yang nyiku, bɨ tangkuchi dɨ hywa de hɛ̃, tə kə bi bwatə a nandzwi.
english: It was now about the sixth hour, and darkness came over the whole land until the ninth hour.

jenjo: Dɨ bɨ fi nɨ lwe dzwe sɨn kəpɨ nɨ, yə pɨ kəpɨ. Nɨngji nɨ sen ɔ kə tang Kwə Fi nɨ, o hyəng bwəng.
english: The sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn in two.

jenjo: Bɨ Yeso dzupɨ be wi kɔ̃kɔ̃ tsa, “Ta mi, min tə kwəng mi le kənə mə!” O nəkə mambɨ nɨ, bɨ o hũ hũlɨ a nyitɨngku, o bwi.
english: Jesus, crying with a loud voice, said, “Father, into your hands I commit my spirit!” Having said this, he breathed his last.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ ihyãfɨ və e tabwi Roma nɨ pi Yeso ku kə, bə e nɨngnɨ tswekəpɨ nɨ, bɨ o yənwa sɨ Fi o tsa, “Kə a kəng, ibwi nɨ dɨ ifɨ a nɨng sɨ Fi!”
english: When the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, “Certainly this was a righteous man.”

jenjo: E ifafɨ nɨ pwɔsə pɨbi bisɨ e bə be nɨng le nɨ, bə e nɨng nɨ tswekəpɨ hɛ̃, bɨ fə e tə və, e bwi na le e tsa gyang le.
english: All the multitudes that came together to see this, when they saw the things that were done, returned home beating their breasts.

jenjo: E ifɨ nɨ yi Yeso hɛ̃, be e iye nɨ mwəkə tswa wə Galili nɨ, e tsɨ pɨ a chwilɨ bɨ sen bəlɨ.
english: All his acquaintances, and the women who followed with him from Galilee, stood at a distance, watching these things.

jenjo: Ifɨ akə lə pɨbi nɨ sen dzuka Yusufu, wə dɨ ifɨ a kəng son tswe nɨng a pikang. Wə dɨ tsɨng tangsə e ihyãfɨ Yahuda.
english: Behold, a man named Joseph, who was a member of the council, a good and righteous man

jenjo: Dɨ ifɨ a Arimatiya tangsə hywa Yahudiya. O ku lə son midzwi wulɨ a ivə və Fi. Be o kwələ be nɨngnɨ nyɔ e ihyãfɨ de tswekə Yeso nɨ lo.
english: (he had not consented to their counsel and deed), from Arimathaea, a city of the Jews, who was also waiting for God’s Kingdom:

jenjo: Bɨ o tə sɨ Bilatus, bisɨ o kũ, e tə wə hywə Yeso.
english: this man went to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body.

jenjo: O dɨ hywə Yeso, o pĩ kə hywaku gə̃lɨ kə nɨ e pi wə pɨbi nɨ. O dɨ nɨngji a fɨ, bɨ o bɨng kə hywə Yeso, fə o le wə tangsə tũ nɨ sen hakə sɨ te nɨ. E mɛdi pɨ le ifɨ akə tangsə tũ de lo.
english: He took it down, and wrapped it in a linen cloth, and laid him in a tomb that was cut in stone, where no one had ever been laid.

jenjo: E nɨng nɨ hɛ̃ tswe nɨng habi Vi Hũlɨ və e Yahuda le nyi pɨ wulɨ ho.
english: It was the day of the Preparation, and the Sabbath was drawing near.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ e dɨ hywə Yeso sen təkə nɨ, bɨ e iye nɨ mwəkə nyi Yeso Galili nɨ mwə tswa le, bisɨ tə e bə tũ nɨ en le Yeso pɨbi nɨ, be lelɨ nɨ en le wə kə nɨ.
english: The women, who had come with him out of Galilee, followed after, and saw the tomb, and how his body was laid.

jenjo: E fə e tə və, bisɨ e chi ywĩ ye mumu be ywĩ nɨ en mə wə kə sɨ wə lə pikang ho. Pa en yalɨ Vi Hũlɨ wuyang, bɨ e hũ sɨ le ma nɨng nɨ lenwa nəkə nɨ.
english: They returned, and prepared spices and ointments. On the Sabbath they rested according to the commandment.

jenjo: Dzwe Vi Hũlɨ be nyinvi a bubu bɨ e iye wapɨlə dɨ nywi nɨ kũ wə ye mumu nɨ e ywĩkə be na le nɨ e tə ku tũ de.
english: But on the first day of the week, at early dawn, they and some others came to the tomb, bringing the spices which they had prepared.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ e təkə pɨbɨ nɨ, e bə nwa tũ lwe yinfa, bisɨ ifɨ akə ke te de e chikə nwa tũ de yə pɨ yang.
english: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb.

jenjo: E tə tangsə tũ, be e chi hywə Itwebɨ Yeso lo.
english: They entered in, and didn’t find the Lord Jesus’ body.

jenjo: Bi de yɨlə le. Bɨ e bə e ifɨ akə bwayung nɨng yasɨ vəle sɨn chwĩ yiyi. E ifɨ de tsɨ pəsəpi be le.
english: While they were greatly perplexed about this, behold, two men stood by them in dazzling clothing.

jenjo: Sɨbi tswe e iye de e pə ku le hywa. E ifɨ de tsɨ le tsa, “Tswe wũ sɨ ba bapɨ ifɨ be hũlɨ tũ lɨ?
english: Becoming terrified, they bowed their faces down to the earth. They said to them, “Why do you seek the living among the dead?

jenjo: Ba kyɛ̃ nɨng nɨ o nəbə kə lə nɨ, o yi yang ma nəlɨ o nə ba kələ Galili nɨ.
english: He isn’t here, but is risen. Remember what he told you when he was still in Galilee,

jenjo: O tsa en le Yɨ Ifafɨ en tə e ifɨ nɨng abe, en pi wə ku kə ɛ, be nɨng bwatə a vi on yi tũ.”
english: saying that the Son of Man must be delivered up into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again?”

jenjo: Habi bi de o nə le la nɨ o nyi le ho.
english: They remembered his words,

jenjo: Bɨ e fələ tə e nə nyɔ e mwambwi o, be e ifafɨ lə, nɨng nɨ sɨn təkə nɨ hɛ̃.
english: returned from the tomb, and told all these things to the eleven, and to all the rest.

jenjo: E iye de wu nəkə bi nɨ dɨ Maryamu Iye Magadala, be Joana, be Maryamu na və Yakubu, be e iye akə dɨ le bɨ wu e nə e mwambwipu o bi de lə.
english: Now they were Mary Magdalene, Joanna, and Mary the mother of James. The other women with them told these things to the apostles.

jenjo: Lehɛ̃ e mwambwipu de kwələ lo, sen tsɨ a le a dɨ bi anfa.
english: These words seemed to them to be nonsense, and they didn’t believe them.

jenjo: Bitulu hywi putũ tə ku tũ. O gbə tsɔ wə hywa nwa bwa o bə ifɨ a kə lo, dɨ nɨng nɨ e kwakə bwa nɨ yinfa bɨ o chi. Bɨ fə o tə və kuson nyi bi və nɨng de tswekə pɨ nɨ.
english: But Peter got up and ran to the tomb. Stooping and looking in, he saw the strips of linen lying by themselves, and he departed to his home, wondering what had happened.

jenjo: Nabi Vi de, e ifɨ bwayung tangsə e mwambwipu o, sen tə və nɨ sen dzwukə a Imawus nɨ, yilɨ Urushalima chwilɨ sɨ wə tswe yang kilomita bwahywə.
english: Behold, two of them were going that very day to a village named Emmaus, which was sixty stadia from Jerusalem.

jenjo: Le nɨhyã, kusen yɔbi və nɨng de tswe kə pɨ nɨ hɛ̃.
english: They talked with each other about all of these things which had happened.

jenjo: Le ku bi a nəlɨ bwa le, bɨ Yeso wu ləsə pu be le.
english: While they talked and questioned together, Jesus himself came near, and went with them.

jenjo: Le hɛ̃, e yipɨ dɨ Yeso ləsə pu be le lo, bisɨ Fi ki nɨng le, e yi wə lo.
english: But their eyes were kept from recognizing him.

jenjo: O bi le o tsa, “Dɨ bi bə sɨ ban yɔ sələ ku nɨhyã?” Ywa le be bɨ e tsɨ hywa pɨ a itsɨng e pə chi hywa.
english: He said to them, “What are you talking about as you walk, and are sad?”

jenjo: Bɨ tsɨng tangsə le nɨ sen dzuka Kilyobas nɨ, kwə nwa wə tsa, “Dɨ mə tsɨng kə dzwəwɛ Urushalima nɨ yipɨ e nɨng nɨ tswe kə pɨ pəle nɨ lo!”
english: One of them, named Cleopas, answered him, “Are you the only stranger in Jerusalem who doesn’t know the things which have happened there in these days?”

jenjo: Yeso bi wə tsa, “Be dɨbə tswe nɨng de?” Bɨ e tsa, “Bi və nɨng nɨ e tswekə Yeso ifɨ a Nazarat nɨ! Wə dɨ Ilinwa və Fi. Bi a nəlɨ o be tsɨkunɨng, fə o tswe nɨng bisɨ pɨpi Fi be e ifafɨ hɛ̃.
english: He said to them, “What things?” They said to him, “The things concerning Jesus, the Nazarene, who was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people;

jenjo: Le hɛ̃, e ihyãfɨ hyɔ̃nɨng be e ifɨ ivə və bɨ, mwə wə tə bisɨ tə e tũ wə za bwa lə fə e pi wə ku kə ɛ.
english: and how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him up to be condemned to death, and crucified him.

jenjo: Be bɨ pənyi bɨ ku wə tsa, ‘Dɨ wə kə Ifɨ nɨ yin wukə bisɨ o gba Israila le na.’ Dɨ nɨng bwatə a vi ho be tswelɨ və e nɨng nɨ.
english: But we were hoping that it was he who would redeem Israel. Yes, and besides all this, it is now the third day since these things happened.

jenjo: Bɨ e iye akə tangsə bɨ nɨ sɨ bɨn mwəkə nyi wə nɨ, tə ku tũ be nyivi a bubu, fə e wu be bi wa nyi,
english: Also, certain women of our company amazed us, having arrived early at the tomb;

jenjo: e tsa, ‘E chi hywə wə lo tũ.’ Fə e bə e Ikwətũ dzwe tsɨ le tsa, ‘Yeso lə be hũlɨ!’
english: and when they didn’t find his body, they came saying that they had also seen a vision of angels, who said that he was alive.

jenjo: E ibwi akə tangsə bɨ hywi putũ tə tũ, kə a kəng ma nəlɨ və e iye de, e chi hywə wə lo.”
english: Some of us went to the tomb, and found it just like the women had said, but they didn’t see him.”

jenjo: Bɨ Yeso tsɨ le tsa, “Dɨ hywɛlɨ ve bə ho sɨ bə nɨ? Ba shi pɨ pənyi sɨ bi və Fi nɨ e Ilinwa O vĩ kə tangsə dəro nɨ!
english: He said to them, “Foolish men, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!

jenjo: N tsa mi ake e Ilinwa və Fi ochi nə bi e tsa, Ifɨ Nɨ Fi Gbə Wə Sɔ nɨ, yin tswe ibe ku e nɨng nɨ hɛ̃, habi o chikə kãlɨ o ho lo ɔ?”
english: Didn’t the Christ have to suffer these things and to enter into his glory?”

jenjo: Bɨ Yeso nə le e nɨng nɨ lə e vĩ kə ku wə tangsə dəro, pəsɔ sɨ e dəro və Musa be e nyɔ a pɨnɨ e Ilinwa vĩ kə nɨ.
english: Beginning from Moses and from all the prophets, he explained to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning himself.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ e kyə̃ və a bɨnghu nɨ sen yidi pɨ tə dzwəwɛ pɨbi nɨ, bɨ Yeso tswe ma o pe on tə a chi.
english: They came near to the village, where they were going, and he acted like he would go further.

jenjo: Bɨ e kũ Yeso bisɨ o lwe tsung be le, pɨ kə yang bi o pelɨ, bisɨ nandzwi tswe yang. Fə pɨ kyə̃ pɨ fɨlɨ yang. Bɨ o kwələ.
english: They urged him, saying, “Stay with us, for it is almost evening, and the day is almost over.” He went in to stay with them.

jenjo: Hywa pɨ nɨ e ku hywa nwa hywe nɨngtang nɨ, bɨ Yeso dɨ kumpə kã Fi, bɨ o wə son tsə le.
english: When he had sat down at the table with them, he took the bread and gave thanks. Breaking it, he gave it to them.

jenjo: Bɨ nɨng le kə, fə e yipɨ dɨ Yeso be le. Nana bɨ o pəchĩ!
english: Their eyes were opened, and they recognized him, and he vanished out of their sight.

jenjo: E bisə bi bwa le e tsa, “Sapɨnɨ bɨ be wə nɨhyã son nə bɨ bi və e nɨng nɨ e vĩ kə tangsə Dəro və Fi lə nɨ, nyi bɨ li lalɨ lo ɔ?”
english: They said to one another, “Weren’t our hearts burning within us, while he spoke to us along the way, and while he opened the Scriptures to us?”

jenjo: E yi e tsɨ pu nana bɨ fə e tə Urushalima, tə e chi bwahywə ji tsɨng nɨ be nyɔ e ifɨ e ku pɨ a itsɨng. Wulɨ və le ho bɨ e wa le e tsa,
english: They rose up that very hour, returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and those who were with them,

jenjo: “Kə a kəng Itwebɨ yi yang! O huji yang sɨ Bitulu.”
english: saying, “The Lord is risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon!”

jenjo: Bɨ e ifɨ nɨ fə kə Imawus nɨ sen nə bi və Yeso nɨ huji kə sɨ le ku nɨhyã, be nɨng le nɨ be kə sapɨnɨ o wə kə kumpa o tsə le kə nɨ.
english: They related the things that happened along the way, and how he was recognized by them in the breaking of the bread.

jenjo: Le ku bi a nəli bɨ Yeso ji sɨ le, o tsɨ le tsa, “A tãlɨ ku tsung be bə kə.”
english: As they said these things, Jesus himself stood among them, and said to them, “Peace be to you.”

jenjo: Le hɛ̃ sɨbi tswe le e tsɨ a le a lakə dɨ jang bɨ e bə!
english: But they were terrified and filled with fear, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.

jenjo: “Dɨ bə tə bə sɨbi? Tswe nwu sɨ ba hĩ be mi dɨ wə nyi nyi bə?
english: He said to them, “Why are you troubled? Why do doubts arise in your hearts?

jenjo: Ba bə nyi na mi, be tswapu mi. Ba yipɨ dɨ mi, dɨ jang lo. Ba pang mi be na ba bə. Jang ywang be tswəsɨ ma miw!”
english: See my hands and my feet, that it is truly me. Touch me and see, for a spirit doesn’t have flesh and bones, as you see that I have.”

jenjo: Yeso nəkə mambɨ nɨ, ta le na sɨ nyina be tswapu wə.
english: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.

jenjo: Le hɛ̃, e tsɨ pɨbi nyi le kĩ lo bɨtsɨng, bisɨ sɨ a lalɨ be sɨbi. Bɨ o bi le o tsa, “Nɨng a tanglɨ ake lə be bəkə pi nɨ a?”
english: While they still didn’t believe for joy, and wondered, he said to them, “Do you have anything here to eat?”

jenjo: E tə wə yɨ hyɨng a walɨ,
english: They gave him a piece of a broiled fish and some honeycomb.

jenjo: bɨ o tang nɨng le.
english: He took them, and ate in front of them.

jenjo: O nə bi be le o tsa, “Dɨ e bi nɨ n nə bə lə, hywapɨ nɨ mi tsung be bə, nɨ n tsa, ‘E nɨng nɨ e vĩ kə ku mi tang Dəro və Musa be nyɔ e Ilinwa və Fi nɨ be tangsə Dəro Zabura hɛ̃, wu yin myɛkə bi anɨng.”
english: He said to them, “This is what I told you, while I was still with you, that all things which are written in the law of Moses, the prophets, and the psalms, concerning me must be fulfilled.”

jenjo: Bɨ o tə le nyi nyi, bisɨ e chi pɨ yipɨ ku e nɨng nɨ e vĩ kə tangsə Dəro və Fi nɨ.
english: Then he opened their minds, that they might understand the Scriptures.

jenjo: Bɨ o tsa, “Mambɨ, nani nɨ e vĩ tangsə Dəro, e tsa, ‘Tɔle Ifɨ Nɨ Fi Gbə Wə Sɔ nɨ tswe ibe, o bwi, fə o yi tũ vi a nɨng bwatə.’
english: He said to them, “Thus it is written, and thus it was necessary for the Christ to suffer and to rise from the dead the third day,

jenjo: Be dzung wə, en nə e ifɨ fangwa hywakĩ bi alalɨ nɨ tswe e ifafɨ yin yə tswelɨ və ayibe, en pəsɔ le Urushalima en tsa, ‘Ke ifɨ nɨ myɛ chi wə e sɨ mi hɛ̃, e nyihywa lə bisɨ e nɨng abe o.’
english: and that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name to all the nations, beginning at Jerusalem.

jenjo: Dɨ bə ba tsɨkə e ifɨ nɨ likə, fə bəkə e nɨng nɨ hɛ̃.
english: You are witnesses of these things.

jenjo: Ba midzwi hywa Urushalima pəko ba chi sambe nɨ Kwang Fi yin wukə dzwe, bisɨ min o chi min tũ nɨngtənɨng nɨ Ta mi tsa on tə bə kə nɨ.
english: Behold, I send out the promise of my Father on you. But wait in the city of Jerusalem until you are clothed with power from on high.”

jenjo: Yeso o chi le, e tə Betani, bɨ o bwi kəna wə, o tə le parkə.
english: He led them out as far as Bethany, and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ son tə le parkə nɨ, o yə le, bɨ Fi dɨ wə tə kə dzwe.
english: While he blessed them, he withdrew from them, and was carried up into heaven.

jenjo: Sen kã wə, be wi kɔ̃kɔ̃ bɨ fə e tə Urushalima, e yɨlə be bɛlɨ a kã.
english: They worshiped him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy,

jenjo: Sen ku pɨ a itsɨng Kwə Fi, sen yənwa sɨ Fi kəvivi.
english: and were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.

jenjo: Sɨ pəsɔ Bi lə, Bi de tsung be Fi kə, fə wə Bi de dɨ Fi.
english: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

jenjo: Wə tsung be Fi sɨ pəsɔ.
english: The same was in the beginning with God.

jenjo: Fi mə e nɨng hɛ̃ na sɨ wə. E mə nɨng akə lo tɛmə tsung be wə, nɨng nɨ e məkə nɨ hɛ̃ bi delə.
english: All things were made through him. Without him was not anything made that has been made.

jenjo: Sɨ wə hũlɨ lə, fə hũlɨ de tsɨkə pɨ akəlɨ sɨ e ifafɨ.
english: In him was life, and the life was the light of men.

jenjo: Pɨ a kəlɨ de kəpɨ bɨng tangkuchi, be tangkuchi ki wə lo.
english: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn’t overcome it.

jenjo: Fi tũ Ibwi akə wu, dzung wə a Yohana.
english: There came a man, sent from God, whose name was John.

jenjo: Wu o tenwa və pɨ akəlɨ de sɨ ifafɨ, hɛbələ nasɨ wə, e ifafɨ hɛ̃ li bi və pɨ akəlɨ de fə pənyi lə.
english: The same came as a witness, that he might testify about the light, that all might believe through him.

jenjo: Wə be ku wə, wə dɨ pɨ akəlɨ de lo. Be o wu pɨ tenwa bi və pɨ akəlɨ de.
english: He was not the light, but was sent that he might testify about the light.

jenjo: Pɨ akəlɨ a bi anɨng nɨ sɨn təkə e ifafɨ hɛ̃ pɨ a kəlɨ nɨ, sɨn wulɨ Fangwa.
english: The true light that enlightens everyone was coming into the world.

jenjo: Wə Fangwa, bɨmpo e mə Fangwa nasɨ wə, be Fangwa de fə yi wə lo.
english: He was in the world, and the world was made through him, and the world didn’t recognize him.

jenjo: O wu sɨ e ifɨ a o, be e ifɨ a o la wə.
english: He came to his own, and those who were his own didn’t receive him.

jenjo: Ke e ifɨ nɨ kwə bi o fə tsɨnyi sɨ dzung wə yang, o tə le tsɨkunɨng e myɛkə e yɨ Fi.
english: But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God’s children, to those who believe in his name:

jenjo: Dɨ e yɨ nɨ e chikə ma a və nyɔ e ifafɨ nɨ lo, alo yidi və ifafɨ lo, alo ma və nyɔ̃ chilɨ və e ifafɨ tangsə ibwi be iye lo, be dɨ pɨchipɨ və Fi.
english: who were born not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.

jenjo: Bi de myɛkə ifafɨ, fə o ku yang bɨng bɨ. Bɨ bə kãlɨ o yang, kãlɨ və Yɨ Tsɨng Dodo nɨ wukə sɨ Fi Ta nɨ. Fə wə dɨ ifɨ hĩkang be bi anɨng.
english: The Word became flesh, and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the one and only Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.

jenjo: Yohana tenwa ku wə be wi sɨ e ifafɨ o tsa, “Dɨ ifɨ nɨ n nə bə bi o lə n tsɨkə a, ‘Ifɨ nɨ yin wukə tswa mi nɨ, pe mi yang be kãlɨ, bisɨ o lə be tswilɨ kə pəko e chi mi.’ ”
english: John testified about him. He cried out, saying, “This was he of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me, for he was before me.’”

jenjo: Bisɨ hĩkang o, bɨ hɛ̃ bɨ chi parkə yang tsɨng tsɨng nyitɨngku wə ywang.
english: From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.

jenjo: Fi tə lenwa de nasɨ Musa, be hĩkang be bi anɨng wu nasɨ Yeso.
english: For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.

jenjo: Ifɨ akə mɛdi pɨ bə Fi lo, be Yɨ tsɨng dodo nɨ sɨn mwəsə nɨngji nwa mbɛ be Fi Ta nɨ, wu kədzwa tsɨ sɨ wə yang.
english: No one has seen God at any time. The one and only Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, he has declared him.

jenjo: Dɨ nɨng nɨ Yohana nəkə sapɨnɨ e Yahuda Urushalima tũkə e Ihyɔ̃nɨng be e Levi tə e bi Yohana tsa, “Dɨ mə kə Iwalena de?”
english: This is John’s testimony, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, “Who are you?”

jenjo: Yohana nə nwa wə o tsa, “Dɨ mi kə Iwalena de lo.”
english: He declared, and didn’t deny, but he declared, “I am not the Christ.”

jenjo: E bi wə e tsa, “Yə mə dɨ wəde? Mə dɨ Iliya?” O tsa, “Mi dɨ wə lo.” E mə fə e bi wə e tsa, “Dɨ ma kə Ilinwa?” O tsa, “Oho.”
english: They asked him, “What then? Are you Elijah?” He said, “I am not.” “Are you the prophet?” He answered, “No.”

jenjo: Fə e tsɨ wə e tsa, “Yə mə dɨ wəde? A nə bɨ nɨng nɨ tə bɨn nəkə ku mə sɨ e ifɨ nɨ tũ bɨ kə nɨ.”
english: They said therefore to him, “Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”

jenjo: Yohana kwə nwa le be bi və Ishaya Ilinwa o tsa, “Dɨ mi kə Wi nɨ sɨn dzukə pɨ fahu, ‘Ba mə nɨhyã və Itwebɨ chĩhywa.’ ”
english: He said, “I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way of the Lord,’ as Isaiah the prophet said.”

jenjo: Bɨ e ifɨ de e Farisa tũkə nɨ
english: The ones who had been sent were from the Pharisees.

jenjo: bi wə tsa, “A tsa mə dɨ Iwalena lo, mə dɨ Iliya lo, fə mə dɨ ilinwa lo, tswe nwu sɨ man tswe bɔtismɔ lɨ?”
english: They asked him, “Why then do you baptize, if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?”

jenjo: Yohana kwə nwa le tsa, “Sɨ mi tswe bɔtismɔ be mɨng, be ifɨ akə lə bɨng bə, be ba yi wə lo.
english: John answered them, “I baptize in water, but among you stands one whom you don’t know.

jenjo: Dɨ wə bɨ o wu tswa mi, a dɨ be hũ pu wə n lo pĩlɨ lo, bisɨ kãlɨ mi tə lo.”
english: He is the one who comes after me, who is preferred before me, whose sandal strap I’m not worthy to loosen.”

jenjo: E nɨng nɨ hɛ̃ tswepɨ le Betani, nwa mɨng Urdun pɨnɨ Yohanna tswekə e ifafɨ Bɔtismɔ lə nɨ.
english: These things were done in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.

jenjo: Pɨkə sɨ wə bɨ Yohana bə Yeso sɨn wu sɨ wə, bɨ o tsa, “Ba bə nɨngpungga və Fi nɨ yin dɨkə nɨng abe və e ifafɨ Fangwa hywakĩ nɨ.
english: The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!

jenjo: Dɨ ifɨ nɨ n tsɨkə, ‘Ifɨ lə sɨn wulɨ tswa mi, be o pe mi yang be kãlɨ, bisɨ pəko en chi mi lɨ, o lə.’
english: This is he of whom I said, ‘After me comes a man who is preferred before me, for he was before me.’

jenjo: Vado nɨ, n yipɨ wə ma a nɨ lo. Dɨ bisɨ n kədzwa n tsɨ e ifɨ a Israila sɨ wə, bɨ sɨ min tswe bɔtismɔ be mɨng.
english: I didn’t know him, but for this reason I came baptizing in water: that he would be revealed to Israel.”

jenjo: Bɨ Yohana nə bi tsa, “N bə Kwang Fi wu dzwe ma ko wu ku ku wə.
english: John testified, saying, “I have seen the Spirit descending like a dove out of heaven, and it remained on him.

jenjo: Ke n yipɨ wə ma a nɨ de lo. Be dɨ ifɨ nɨ tũ mi sɨ min tswekə bɔtismɔ nɨ bɨ tsɨ mi tsa, ‘Ifɨ nɨ a bə Kwang wu ku ku wə nɨ, dɨ ifɨ nɨ yin tswekə bɔtismɔ be Kwang Fi ho.
english: I didn’t recognize him, but he who sent me to baptize in water, he said to me, ‘On whomever you will see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he who baptizes in the Holy Spirit.’

jenjo: N bə yang, fə n tenwa sɨ min tsa, dɨ Yɨ Fi ho nɨ.
english: I have seen, and have testified that this is the Son of God.”

jenjo: Pɨkə sɨ wə, Yohana bɨmpo lə pɨbi be e mwambwi o bwayung.
english: Again, the next day, John was standing with two of his disciples,

jenjo: O bə Yeso sɨn pelɨ nɨ bɨ o tsɨ le o tsa, “Ba bə, dɨ Yɨ Nɨngpunga və Fi ho le!”
english: and he looked at Jesus as he walked, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God!”

jenjo: E mwambwi bwayung de li o nəkə mambɨ nɨ, bɨ e nyəpɨ Yeso.
english: The two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.

jenjo: Yeso kwang bə le nɨ, bɨ bi le tsa, “Dɨ bə sɨ ban bapɨ?” Bɨ e tsɨ wə e tsa, “Rabbi”, nwa ta sɨ wə ho kə inyinasɨnɨng, “a ku nake?”
english: Jesus turned, and saw them following, and said to them, “What are you looking for?” They said to him, “Rabbi” (which is to say, being interpreted, Teacher), “where are you staying?”

jenjo: Bɨ o tsɨ le tsa, “Ba wu tə ba bə.” Bɨ e mwə nyi wə e təkə pɨ kulɨ o. Ma bi bwanyə a nanjwi ho, bɨ e ku sɨ wə vi de hɛ̃.
english: He said to them, “Come, and see.” They came and saw where he was staying, and they stayed with him that day. It was about the tenth hour.

jenjo: Andirawus hywĩ Siman Bitulu lə tsɨng tangsə e ifɨ yung nɨ li bi nɨ Yohana nəkə, fə nyəkəpɨ Yeso nɨ.
english: One of the two who heard John, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.

jenjo: Andirawus ochi hywĩ wə Siman bɨ tsɨ wə tsa, “Bɨ chi Iwalena de yang!” Kristi ho be nwa e Helena.
english: He first found his own brother, Simon, and said to him, “We have found the Messiah!” (which is, being interpreted, Christ).

jenjo: Bɨ o wu be wə sɨ Yeso. Yeso bə wə bɨ tsa, “Dɨ məkə Siman yɨ Yohana. En dzumə a Kefa.” Bitulu ho be nwa e Helena.
english: He brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him, and said, “You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas” (which is by interpretation, Peter).

jenjo: Pɨkə sɨ wə, Yeso mə dzwəwɛ sɨn tə Galili. O chi Filibu bɨ o tsɨ wə o tsa, “Yi a mwə nyi mi”
english: On the next day, he was determined to go out into Galilee, and he found Philip. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.”

jenjo: Filibu be Andirawu be Bitulu dɨ e ifɨ a Basheda hɛ̃.
english: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, of the city of Andrew and Peter.

jenjo: Filibu tə chi Nataniye bɨ o tsɨ wə o tsa, “Bɨ chi ifɨ nɨ Musa nəkə bi o tang Dəro Lenwa, fə e Ilinwa vĩkə nɨng ku wə nɨ yang. Dɨ Yeso mwɛ Nazarat, a yɨ Yusu.”
english: Philip found Nathanael, and said to him, “We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, wrote: Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”

jenjo: Nataniye bipɨ tsa, “Nɨng a pikang akə lə yin ji Nazarat lɨ a?” Filibu tsɨ wə tsa, ‘A wu a bə.’
english: Nathanael said to him, “Can any good thing come out of Nazareth?” Philip said to him, “Come and see.”

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ Yeso bə Nataniye sɨn wukə nɨ, bɨ o tsɨ wə o tsa, “Dɨ mwɛ Israila nɨ kə akang, nwayung ywang kənwa wəw.”
english: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, “Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!”

jenjo: Nataniye bi wə tsa, “A tswe nwu bɨ a yi mi kə?” Bɨ Yeso kwə nwa wə tsa, “Pəko Filibu dzupɨ məlɨ pu kə fe le nɨ, n bə mə yang.”
english: Nathanael said to him, “How do you know me?” Jesus answered him, “Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.”

jenjo: Bɨ Nataniye tsa, “Inyinasɨnɨng, mə dɨ Yɨ Fi. Dɨ mə kə Ivə və Israila.”
english: Nathanael answered him, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God! You are King of Israel!”

jenjo: Yeso tsa, “Nataniye, kə dɨ bisɨ n tsɨ mə n bə ma yang hywapɨnɨ a kukə pu kə fe nɨ, bɨ a pənyi shi nɨ? Yi man bə e nɨng tswe sɨbi nɨ pekə a pɨnɨ nɨ.”
english: Jesus answered him, “Because I told you, ‘I saw you underneath the fig tree,’ do you believe? You will see greater things than these!”

jenjo: Fə o tsɨ le o tsa, “Kə akang sɨ min nə bə lə, yi ban bə nwa dzwe bebelɨ, fə e Ikwətũ və Fi pĩ sɨn wu hywa fə pĩ sɨn tə dzwe ku Yɨ ifafi.”
english: He said to him, “Most certainly, I tell you all, hereafter you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”

jenjo: Vi a nɨng bwatə chinɨ nɨnglang iye a tsəlɨ lə Kana a Galili na və Yeso lə pɨbi.
english: The third day, there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there.

jenjo: E tənwa sɨ Yeso be e mwambwi o pɨ nɨnglang de.
english: Jesus also was invited, with his disciples, to the marriage.

jenjo: Mɨng inabi tɨng bɨ na və Yeso tsɨ wə tsa, “Mɨng a nwalɨ və le tɨng yang.”
english: When the wine ran out, Jesus’ mother said to him, “They have no wine.”

jenjo: Yeso kwə nwa wə tsa, “Iye, tswe nwu sɨ man nə mi lə, kə hywami tswelo bɨtsɨng.”
english: Jesus said to her, “Woman, what does that have to do with you and me? My hour has not yet come.”

jenjo: Na o tsɨ e mwambwi nɨ pɨbi nɨ tsa, “Ke nɨng nɨ o nə bə lə hɛ̃ ba tswe.”
english: His mother said to the servants, “Whatever he says to you, do it.”

jenjo: E bantang lə pɨbi hywĩtsɨng e mə be te. Sen tsɨkə mɨng Nwanɨhywinɨng və e Yahuda bisɨ lolɨ a sɨ. E bantang de sin dɨ mɨng ləmɨng nwuntsɨng akə nwuntsɨng ji hywa.
english: Now there were six water pots of stone set there after the Jews’ way of purifying, containing two or three metretes apiece.

jenjo: Yeso nəbi be e mwəmbwi de tsa, “Ba e mɨng tangsə e bantang de hɛ̃. Hywapɨnɨ mɨng yikə nwa bantang nɨ bɨ o tsa,
english: Jesus said to them, “Fill the water pots with water.” They filled them up to the brim.

jenjo: “Ba tswe tə ba tə ihyãfɨ nɨnglang de.” Bɨ e tswe ma nəlɨ o.
english: He said to them, “Now draw some out, and take it to the ruler of the feast.” So they took it.

jenjo: Ihyãfɨ nɨnglang pənkə mɨng nɨ o myɛkə mɨng inabi de nɨ, o yipɨ pɨnɨ jikə lə nɨ lo. Be e mwəmbwi o nɨ təkə mɨng de nɨ yipɨ yang. Bɨ o dzupɨ itwe nɨnglang o tsa,
english: When the ruler of the feast tasted the water now become wine, and didn’t know where it came from (but the servants who had drawn the water knew), the ruler of the feast called the bridegroom,

jenjo: “Tɨtɛ dɨ mɨng inabi a lalɨ bɨ e pəsɔ pɨ təlɨ, aba sa e ifafɨ tɨng yang, kə e ji be nyɔ̃ tswa. Be mə a mə a ywe a lalɨ habi man jikə ho!”
english: and said to him, “Everyone serves the good wine first, and when the guests have drunk freely, then that which is worse. You have kept the good wine until now!”

jenjo: Dɨ pəsɔ nwatũ nɨng bisɨ o nɨ o tswekə ho le Ka-ana hywa Galili O ta na sɨ kalɨ o lə ho, fə o bi e mwambwi o pə nyi sɨ we.
english: This beginning of his signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee, and revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.

jenjo: Tswa nɨnglang de Yeso be na o be e hywĩ wə be e mwambwi o, e tə Kaparnahum e tswe vi pɨbi.
english: After this, he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, his brothers, and his disciples; and they stayed there a few days.

jenjo: Hywa nɨnglang hyãlɨ və e Yahuda tswe bɨ Yeso tə Urushalima.
english: The Passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

jenjo: Nɨng pɨfa Kwə Fi de bɨ o bə e ifɨ tswe filu sen ja be e hyɔ̃ be e nɨngpungga be e ko hyɔ̃nɨng be e ifɨ pyə sede ku hywe.
english: He found in the temple those who sold oxen, sheep, and doves, and the changers of money sitting.

jenjo: Yeso wi tswe nyəle kə tangsə Kwə Fi be e nɨngtsa de hɛ̃. O to hywe və e ifɨ pyə sede o wi hywa ywakwɛ,
english: He made a whip of cords, and threw all out of the temple, both the sheep and the oxen; and he poured out the changers’ money, and overthrew their tables.

jenjo: Bɨ fə o wu sɨ e ifɨ jə be e ko o tsa, “Ba ji be e nɨng nɨ bi ban myɛ Tanvə ta mi kə pɨ tswe lomwɛ yɛ!”
english: To those who sold the doves, he said, “Take these things out of here! Don’t make my Father’s house a marketplace!”

jenjo: Bɨ nɨng nɨ e vĩkə tangsə Dəlo nɨ, o nyi e mwambwi o, nɨ tsɨkə a, “Yidi nɨ n yɛdi tanvə ma sɨn tswə̃ mi ma dzwa.”
english: His disciples remembered that it was written, “Zeal for your house will eat me up.”

jenjo: E ihyãfɨ və e Yahuda bi wə tsa, “A chi tsɨkunɨng be sɨ man tswekə nɨng nɨ a? Aba dɨ Fi tə ma tsɨkunɨng nɨ yang yə dɨ nwatũ sɨbi bə man tabɨ nalə lɨ?”
english: The Jews therefore answered him, “What sign do you show us, seeing that you do these things?”

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ le tsa, “Ba de Kwə nɨ min mimi pu bwatə.”
english: Jesus answered them, “Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.”

jenjo: E tsa, “E dɨ ha nwuyung ji hywĩtsɨng bɨ e mikə kwə nɨ a tsa a pa man mimi pu bwatə?”
english: The Jews therefore said, “It took forty-six years to build this temple! Will you raise it up in three days?”

jenjo: Be kwənɨ Yeso sin tsɨ dɨ tswə sɨ wə.
english: But he spoke of the temple of his body.

jenjo: Tswa yilɨ o tũ e kyɛ̃ bi o bɨ kwə bi və Dəro, fə e pənyi sɨ bi və Yeso.
english: When therefore he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered that he said this, and they believed the Scripture, and the word which Jesus had said.

jenjo: Nɨng tswe sɨbi nɨ o tswekə hywa nɨnglang hyãlɨ Urushalima nɨ, tswe e ifafɨ dzung dzung tsɨnyi yang wə dɨ Iwalena.
english: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the Passover, during the feast, many believed in his name, observing his signs which he did.

jenjo: Lehɛ̃ Yeso kwələ tsɨku wə sɨ e ifafɨ lo, bisɨ o yi ifafɨ yang.
english: But Jesus didn’t entrust himself to them, because he knew everyone,

jenjo: Ifɨ nɨ yin ta wə nasɨ bi və ifafɨ nɨ ywang. Bisɨ o yi bi a nyilɨ və ifafɨ yang.
english: and because he didn’t need for anyone to testify concerning man; for he himself knew what was in man.

jenjo: Ifɨ a kə lə dzung wa Nikodimu wa dɨ tsɨng tangsə e Farisa dɨ ifɨ ivə və e yahuda.
english: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.

jenjo: O wu sɨ Yeso be nvi o tsa, “Inyinasɨnɨng bɨ yipɨ yang ma dɨ inyinasi nɨng nɨ wukə sɨ Fi nɨ. E nɨng tswe sɨbi nɨ sɨ man tswekə nɨ ifɨ nɨ pa yin tswekə be ku wə nɨ ywang dɨ ifɨ nɨ Fi tsung be wə nɨ kə tswe.”
english: The same came to him by night, and said to him, “Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher come from God, for no one can do these signs that you do, unless God is with him.”

jenjo: Yeso kwə nwa wə tsa, “Kə akang sɨ min nə ma lə aba e mə ifɨ e chi lo yang, o pa o pang Ivə və Fiw.”
english: Jesus answered him, “Most certainly, I tell you, unless one is born anew, he can’t see God’s Kingdom.”

jenjo: Nikodimu bi wə tsa, “Ifɨ kã yang o pə fə on tə ywa na o tə kə fə mə wə chi ɛ?”
english: Nicodemus said to him, “How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter a second time into his mother’s womb, and be born?”

jenjo: Yeso kwə nwa wə tsa, “Kə akang sɨ min nə mə lə aba e mə ifɨ e chi be mɨng be Kwang Fi lo yang, o tə tangsə Ivə və Fiw.
english: Jesus answered, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and spirit, he can’t enter into God’s Kingdom.

jenjo: Ifafɨ sɨn chi dɨ ifafɨ, be Kwang Fi sɨn tə ifɨ hũlɨ nɨ sɨn jikə sɨ Fi nɨ.
english: That which is born of the flesh is flesh. That which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

jenjo: Bi sɨbi n tswe mə bisɨ n tsɨ mə, ‘Tɔle e mə bə e chi yang hyĩ yɛ.’
english: Don’t marvel that I said to you, ‘You must be born anew.’

jenjo: Ywa wə sɨn tə pɨnɨ o yikədi nɨ. Sɨ man lilɨ be a yi pɨnɨ o yikə lə nɨ lo, a yi pɨ nɨ son təkə lə nɨ lo. Doho mambɨ a pa a yipɨ chilɨ KwangFi sɨn chikə ifɨ nɨw.”
english: The wind blows where it wants to, and you hear its sound, but don’t know where it comes from and where it is going. So is everyone who is born of the Spirit.”

jenjo: Nikodumu bi Yeso tsa, “Tswe wũ tswe kəlɨ?”
english: Nicodemus answered him, “How can these things be?”

jenjo: Yeso tsa, “Məkə inyinasɨhu və e Yahuda a yipɨ e nɨng nɨ lo?
english: Jesus answered him, “Are you the teacher of Israel, and don’t understand these things?

jenjo: Kə akang sɨ min nə mə lə, bɨ a bɨ dɨ nɨngnɨ nɨng bɨ bəkə fə bɨ yipɨ nɨ bɨ sɨ bɨn nə bə lə lehɛ̃ ba kwə bi və bɨ lo.
english: Most certainly I tell you, we speak that which we know, and testify of that which we have seen, and you don’t receive our witness.

jenjo: N nə bə bi fangwa lə, ba kwələ lo. Yə a nɨ n nə bə bi a dzwe lə yang kə ba kwələ a?
english: If I told you earthly things and you don’t believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?

jenjo: Ifɨ akə mɛdi pɨ tə dzwe lo, tɛmə dɨ Yɨ Ifafɨ nɨ wukə dzwe nɨ.
english: No one has ascended into heaven, but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.

jenjo: Tɔle en ta Yɨ Ifafɨ en kipu, ma talɨ Musa ta tso ku kə kipu bɨnghu nɨ.
english: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,

jenjo: Həbələ ke ifɨ nɨ pənyi sɨ we hɛ̃ on chi hũlɨ a kə a itsɨng.
english: that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

jenjo: Bisɨ Fi tswebi və Fangwa kə achɛ̃ bɨ o tə Yɨ wə tsɨng dodo, ke ifɨ nɨ pənyi sɨ wə hɛ̃ bi ku wə tə la yɛ, be o chi hũlɨ kə a itsɨng.
english: For God so loved the world, that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

jenjo: Fi tũ Yɨ wə wu Fangwa bisɨ wu tswe Fangwa kitə lo, be bisɨ Fangwa jiku nasɨ wə.
english: For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.

jenjo: Ke ifɨ nɨ pənyi sɨ we hɛ̃ kitə ywang ku wəw. Be ifɨ nɨ pənyi sɨ we lo yang kitə lə ku wə, bisɨ o pənyi sɨ dzung Yɨ Fi tsɨng dodo lo.
english: He who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn’t believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in the name of the one and only Son of God.

jenjo: Dɨ kɨtə nɨ en tswe le kələ ho nɨ, Pɨ akəlɨ wu Fangwa, be e ifafɨ Fangwa yidi tangkuchi bisɨ nwatũ və le dɨ nɨng pyɨnɨng.
english: This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light; for their works were evil.

jenjo: Ifɨ tswe pyɨnɨng yidi pɨ akəlɨ lo, o kwələ o wu sɨ pɨ akəlɨw bisɨ bi e ifɨ yipɨ nwatũ pyɨnɨng o.
english: For everyone who does evil hates the light, and doesn’t come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.

jenjo: Ke ifɨ nɨ lə be bi anɨng hɛ̃ son nyəpɨ pɨ akəlɨ, bisɨ e ifafɨ yipɨ sɨ lɨn tswe nɨng nɨ Fi yikədi nɨ.”
english: But he who does the truth comes to the light, that his works may be revealed, that they have been done in God.”

jenjo: Tswa wə Yeso be e mwambwi o tə nwa hywa Yahuda, e tswe vi pɨbi son tswe e ifafɨ bɔtismɔ.
english: After these things, Jesus came with his disciples into the land of Judea. He stayed there with them, and baptized.

jenjo: Yohana sɨn tswe e ifafɨ bɔtismɔ Ainon pəsəpi be Salim bisɨ mɨng kə akã lə pɨbi.
english: John also was baptizing in Enon near Salim, because there was much water there. They came, and were baptized.

jenjo: E nɨng nɨ tswepɨ yang kə tsəlɨ və Yohana kwəsɨnang.
english: For John was not yet thrown into prison.

jenjo: E mwambwi və Yohana tsasə nwa be mwɛ Yahuda bi və nwa nɨng hywinɨng lolɨ a nɨng və e Yahuda.
english: There arose therefore a questioning on the part of John’s disciples with some Jews about purification.

jenjo: E mwambwi və Yohana Itswe bɔtismɔ wu sɨ wə, bɨ e tsɨ wə e tsa, “Inyinasɨnɨng, ibwi le a tsɨkə tsung be wə nwa mɨng Urdun a tekənwa ku wə nɨ, sɨn tswe e ifafɨ bɔtismɔ, fə e ifɨ hɛ̃ fə sɨn tə sɨ wə.
english: They came to John, and said to him, “Rabbi, he who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, behold, the same baptizes, and everyone is coming to him.”

jenjo: Yohana Itswe Bɔtismɔ kwə nwa le tsa, “Ifɨ pa chi nɨng akəw, aba e tə wə tə dzwe lo yang.
english: John answered, “A man can receive nothing, unless it has been given him from heaven.

jenjo: Bə be ku bə ba yipɨ yang, n nə bə lə n tsa mi dɨ Iwalena de lo, be n wu pɨ mə nɨhyã pəko wulɨ a o.
english: You yourselves testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ,’ but, ‘I have been sent before him.’

jenjo: Iye a hu dɨ bisɨ ibwi ahu, be aba e tswə wə li wi wə yang sen bɛlɨ. Mi dɨ tswə ibwi a hu, n li lalɨ yang.
english: He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice. This, my joy, therefore is made full.

jenjo: Tɔle o chi kãli be mi a mi n fənahywa.
english: He must increase, but I must decrease.

jenjo: “Ifɨ nɨ wukə dzwe nɨ, o pe nyɔ e ifafɨ yang hywakĩ. Ifɨ fangwa wə dɨ a və fangwa, son nə bi ma e ifɨ a Fangwa. Be ifɨ nɨ wukə dzwe nɨ pe e ifɨ yang hɛ̃.
english: He who comes from above is above all. He who is from the earth belongs to the earth, and speaks of the earth. He who comes from heaven is above all.

jenjo: Son nə bi ku e nɨng nɨ o bəkə nɨ, lehɛ̃, e ifɨ nɨ kwəkə bi o nɨ ywang.
english: What he has seen and heard, of that he testifies; and no one receives his witness.

jenjo: E ifɨ nɨ kwəkə bi o nɨ kwələ yang, dɨ Fi kə bi anɨng.
english: He who has received his witness has set his seal to this, that God is true.

jenjo: Ifɨ nɨ Fi tũkə nɨ, dɨ bi və Fi ku son nəlɨ, bisɨ Fi sɨn tə Kwang wə nɨbɨwə.
english: For he whom God has sent speaks the words of God; for God gives the Spirit without measure.

jenjo: Ta tswebi və Yɨ wə, fə o tə nyɔ e nɨng hɛ̃ na wə.
english: The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.

jenjo: Ke ifɨ nɨ pənyi sɨ Yɨ wə yang, on chi hũlɨ a ka itsɨng. Be ifɨ nɨ lakə bi və Yɨ wə nɨ, wə a wə o chi hũlɨw, Chi a pwəlɨ və Fi lə ku wə.
english: One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys the Son won’t see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.”

jenjo: E Farisi li e tsa, E ifafɨ sɨn mwənyi Yeso sen tswe le bɔtismɔ pesɨ a və Yohana,
english: Therefore when the Lord knew that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus was making and baptizing more disciples than John

jenjo: Yeso be ku wə tswe e ifɨ bɔtismɔ lo be dɨ e mwambwi o.
english: (although Jesus himself didn’t baptize, but his disciples),

jenjo: Hywapɨnɨ Yeso likə nɨ bɨ o yə Yahuda fə o tə Galili.
english: he left Judea, and departed into Galilee.

jenjo: O mwə nɨhyã Samariya.
english: He needed to pass through Samaria.

jenjo: Bɨ o wu və akə tangsə Samariya sen dzu və de a Saikar pəsəpi be pɨnɨ Yakubu təkə yɨ wə Yusufu pɨ pɨbi nɨ.
english: So he came to a city of Samaria, called Sychar, near the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son, Joseph.

jenjo: Bwabu nɨ Yakubu hakə nɨ lə pɨbi, Yeso wu ku hywa ngwa bwabu bisɨ e yi pɨ a tswilɨ sa wə tɨng yang be holɨ.
english: Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being tired from his journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.

jenjo: Iye akə wu pɨ tə mɨng nwa bwabu de, Yeso tsɨ wə tsa, “A tə mi mɨng lə n nwa”
english: A woman of Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, “Give me a drink.”

jenjo: (E mwambwi o tə pɨ jə nɨngtang tangsə ve.)
english: For his disciples had gone away into the city to buy food.

jenjo: Iye Samariya kwə nwa wə tsa, “Mə dɨ mwɛ Yahuda mi dɨ iye Samariya. tswe wũ man bi mi bi və mɨng a nwalɨ?” (Bisɨ e Yahuda sɨn nwa mɨng na le lo)
english: The Samaritan woman therefore said to him, “How is it that you, being a Jew, ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?” (For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.)

jenjo: Yeso kwə nwa wə tsa, “Aba a yipɨ nɨng tənɨng və Fi yang fə a yi ifɨ nɨ bi mə bi və mɨng yang, kɛ a bi wə o tə mə mɨng hũlɨ a ka itsɨng yang.”
english: Jesus answered her, “If you knew the gift of God, and who it is who says to you, ‘Give me a drink,’ you would have asked him, and he would have given you living water.”

jenjo: Iye de tsa, “Ihyãfɨ a ywang be nɨng tə mɨng bɨmpo bwabu nɨ dzwi o. Yə man chi mɨng hũlɨ a ka itsɨng de bede?”
english: The woman said to him, “Sir, you have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep. So where do you get that living water?

jenjo: A pe ta və bɨ Yakubu nɨ hakə bwabu nɨ yə bɨ lə, wə be kuwə o nwa pɨbi be e yɨ wə be e nɨngtsa o nɨ yang?”
english: Are you greater than our father, Jacob, who gave us the well, and drank of it himself, as did his children, and his livestock?”

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ wə tsa, “Ifɨ nɨ nwa mɨng bwabu nɨ lɨng fə yin yə wə yə.
english: Jesus answered her, “Everyone who drinks of this water will thirst again,

jenjo: be ifɨ nɨ nwa mɨng nɨ min təkə nɨ yang lɨng fə yə wəw, yin myɛkə nyigũ nɨ yin təkə mɨng hũlɨ a ka itsɨng nɨ.”
english: but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.”

jenjo: Iye de tsa, “Ihyãfɨ a tə mi mɨng de lə bi lɨng le mi fə yin tswe ibe n wu bwabu nɨ pɨ tə mɨng yɛ.”
english: The woman said to him, “Sir, give me this water, so that I don’t get thirsty, neither come all the way here to draw.”

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ wə tsa, “Tə a dzupɨ bu mə ba wu tsung.”
english: Jesus said to her, “Go, call your husband, and come here.”

jenjo: O kwə ngwa Yeso o tsa, “Bu mi ywang,” Yeso tsɨ wə tsa, “A nə bi anɨng yang nɨ a tsɨkə a ywang be ibwi nɨ.
english: The woman answered, “I have no husband.” Jesus said to her, “You said well, ‘I have no husband,’

jenjo: Kakang, a tsə e ibwi bwahmɨ, ifɨ nɨ a kukə be wə sɨswenɨ dɨ bu mə lo. Bi mə dɨ bi anɨng.”
english: for you have had five husbands; and he whom you now have is not your husband. This you have said truly.”

jenjo: Iye de tsa, “Ihyãfɨ n bəkə nɨ mə dɨ ilingwa.
english: The woman said to him, “Sir, I perceive that you are a prophet.

jenjo: E ta və bɨ hyɔ̃ Fi ku te nɨ be bə a bə e Yahuda ba tsa dɨ Urushalima kə pɨ hyɔ̃ Fi.”
english: Our fathers worshiped in this mountain, and you Jews say that in Jerusalem is the place where people ought to worship.”

jenjo: Yeso tsa, “Iye a kangtswi a li mi pikəng hywapɨ lə sɨn wulɨ nɨ yi ban hyɔ̃ kə Fi Ta le ku te nɨ alo fə Urushalima lo.
english: Jesus said to her, “Woman, believe me, the hour comes, when neither in this mountain, nor in Jerusalem, will you worship the Father.

jenjo: Bə e ifɨ a Samariya sɨ ban hyɔ̃ nɨng nɨ ba yipɨ lo nɨ; Bɨ a bɨ sɨ bɨn hyɔ̃ nɨng nɨ bɨ yipɨ nɨ, bisɨ jilɨ a ku wu nasɨ e Yahuda,
english: You worship that which you don’t know. We worship that which we know; for salvation is from the Jews.

jenjo: Lehɛ̃ hywapɨ lə sɨ wulɨ, wuyang ho sɨswenɨ e ifɨ nɨ sɨn hyɔ̃kə Fi kə akəng nɨ en hyɔ̃ wə be KwangFi be bi anɨng, Kə dɨ e ifɨ hyɔ̃Fi male bɨ Fi sɨn yidi.
english: But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father seeks such to be his worshipers.

jenjo: Fi dɨ Kwang ke ifɨ nɨ yin hyɔ̃ wə hɛ̃ on hyɔ̃ wə be Kwang be bi anɨng.”
english: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”

jenjo: Iye de tsa, ‘N yipɨ yang iwalena sɨn wulɨ, aba o wu yang on nyi bɨ na sɨ nyɔ nɨng hɛ̃.”
english: The woman said to him, “I know that Messiah comes, he who is called Christ. When he has come, he will declare to us all things.”

jenjo: Yeso tsa, “Mi nɨ sɨ min nəkə bi be mə nɨ, dɨ mi kə wə.”
english: Jesus said to her, “I am he, the one who speaks to you.”

jenjo: E mwambwi o fə wu chi wə son nə bi be iye de sɨbi tswe le, be ifɨ nɨ bi kə iye de yin tsɨkə a, “Dɨ bə sɨ man yidi”? alo yin bikə Yeso tsa, “Tswe wũ sɨ man nəbi be iye nɨ a nɨ” ywang.
english: At this, his disciples came. They marveled that he was speaking with a woman; yet no one said, “What are you looking for?” or, “Why do you speak with her?”

jenjo: Iye de yə dzɔ̃ o nwa bwabu fə o tə tangsə və tə o nə e ifafɨ bi lə son tsa,
english: So the woman left her water pot, and went away into the city, and said to the people,

jenjo: “Ba wu ba bə ifɨ nɨ nə mi e nɨng nɨ lə hɛ̃ n mɛdi pɨ tswe kə nɨ. Di wə kə ifɨ nɨ Fi gbə wə sɔ nɨ a?”
english: “Come, see a man who told me everything that I did. Can this be the Christ?”

jenjo: E ifafɨ ji tangsə və wu sɨ Yeso.
english: They went out of the city, and were coming to him.

jenjo: Pəko en wulɨ e mwambwi o tsɨ wə tsa, “Ihyãfɨ a hashitə.”
english: In the meanwhile, the disciples urged him, saying, “Rabbi, eat.”

jenjo: Bɨ o tsɨ le o tsa, “N lə be nɨngtang nɨ ba yipɨ lo nɨ.”
english: But he said to them, “I have food to eat that you don’t know about.”

jenjo: E mwambwi o sɨn bisə bi bwa le sen tsa, ‘Ifɨ akə wu be nɨngtang wu tə wə yang?”
english: The disciples therefore said to one another, “Has anyone brought him something to eat?”

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ le tsa, “Dɨ nɨngtang mi ho n tswe nwatũ və ifɨ nɨ tũ mi nɨ n enyi wə.”
english: Jesus said to them, “My food is to do the will of him who sent me, and to accomplish his work.

jenjo: Dɨ bə nɨ sɨ ban tsa, “nyɔ hywĩhywĩ bwanyə bɨ en wu be nɨngpɨ̃ vəlɨ lo? Sɨ min nə bə lə ba kwang ba bə fanɨng! E nɨngpɨ̃ lo balɨ yang.
english: Don’t you say, ‘There are yet four months until the harvest?’ Behold, I tell you, lift up your eyes, and look at the fields, that they are white for harvest already.

jenjo: Sɨswenɨ iba nɨngpɨ sɨn tswe nwatũ sen fə wə gyədə o, o pəsɔpɨ pwɔ nɨng yang və hũlɨ a kə a itsɨng, hebilə ifɨ nɨ pyəkə nɨng nɨng be ifɨ nɨ ba nɨng nɨng nɨ e bɛ tsung.
english: He who reaps receives wages, and gathers fruit to eternal life; that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together.

jenjo: Bi nɨ e tsɨkə a ‘ifɨ akə pyənɨng ifɨ akə jinɨng de nɨ’ dɨ bi anɨng.
english: For in this the saying is true, ‘One sows, and another reaps.’

jenjo: N tũ bə tə ba ba nɨng nɨ sɨ bə shikə ləlo nɨ. E ifɨ akə tswe ibe lə, be ba ji nɨng ngwatũ ibe və le.”
english: I sent you to reap that for which you haven’t labored. Others have labored, and you have entered into their labor.”

jenjo: E Samariya tangsə və de ihyãnɨng pənyi sɨ wə bisɨ bi və iye nɨ tsɨkə a, “O nə mi e nɨng nɨ lə hɛ̃ n mɛdi pɨ tswekə nɨ.”
english: From that city many of the Samaritans believed in him because of the word of the woman, who testified, “He told me everything that I did.”

jenjo: Bɨ e Samariya wukə sɨ Yeso nɨ, e kũ wə bisɨ o ku tsung be le, o tswe vi bwayung be le.
english: So when the Samaritans came to him, they begged him to stay with them. He stayed there two days.

jenjo: E ifɨ kə dzungdzung pənyi sɨ Yeso bisɨ bi o.
english: Many more believed because of his word.

jenjo: E ifɨ a Samariya tsɨ iye de tsa, “Bɨ kwələ yang dɨ bisɨ bi mə yinfa lo, be bɨ li yang be bwajang bɨ, fə bɨ yipɨ yang kə akəng dɨ ifɨ nɨ n təkə Fangwa hɛ̃ jilɨ a ku nɨ.”
english: They said to the woman, “Now we believe, not because of your speaking; for we have heard for ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Savior of the world.”

jenjo: Tswa pu bwəng bɨ Yeso yi tə Galili
english: After the two days he went out from there and went into Galilee.

jenjo: Yeso be ku wə nəbi tsa, sen tə Ilinwa kãlɨ tangsə e ifɨ o lo.
english: For Jesus himself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own country.

jenjo: Yeso wukə Galili nɨ e ifɨ a Galili mwə wə dzəwɛ pikang. E bə e nɨngnɨ o tswekə yang sɨ hywa nɨnglang Urushalima.
english: So when he came into Galilee, the Galileans received him, having seen all the things that he did in Jerusalem at the feast, for they also went to the feast.

jenjo: Bɨ Yeso fə wu Ka-ana hywa Galili pɨnɨ o myɛ mɨng kə mɨng inabi lə nɨ. Ifɨ ivə akə lə pɨbi yɨ wə li lalɨ lo lwe Kafanahum.
english: Jesus came therefore again to Cana of Galilee, where he made the water into wine. There was a certain nobleman whose son was sick at Capernaum.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ o likə bi və Yeso yi Yahuda wuyang Galili nɨ, bɨ o nyəpɨ Yeso tə o kũ wə bisɨ wu o tɨng nɨngshi və yɨ wə nɨ sɨn dəbwa nɨ.
english: When he heard that Jesus had come out of Judea into Galilee, he went to him, and begged him that he would come down and heal his son, for he was at the point of death.

jenjo: Yeso kwə nwa wə tsa, Aba n tswe nɨng bisɨ yang habi ba pənyi sɨ mi ho.
english: Jesus therefore said to him, “Unless you see signs and wonders, you will in no way believe.”

jenjo: Ifɨ ivə de tsa, “Ihyãfɨ a wu mi lə pəpi bi yɨ mi bwi.”
english: The nobleman said to him, “Sir, come down before my child dies.”

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ wə tsa, “A ho a tə yɨ mə yin jiku ji!” Ibwi de kwə bi və Yeso bɨ ho tə.
english: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your son lives.” The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him, and he went his way.

jenjo: O fə son tə və bɨ e mwambwi o akə kwə wə nɨhyã tsɨ wə tsa, “Yɨ mə chi njəmu yang.
english: As he was now going down, his servants met him and reported, saying “Your child lives!”

jenjo: O bi e mwambwi de hywapɨnɨ imwə de chikə njəmu nɨ bɨ e tsa, “Do, be nandzwi.”
english: So he inquired of them the hour when he began to get better. They said therefore to him, “Yesterday at the seventh hour, the fever left him.”

jenjo: Ta və imwə de yipɨ dɨ hywapɨde bɨ Yeso tsɨ wə tsa, “Ho a tə, yɨ mə yin jiku ji.” Bɨ wə be e ifɨ və wə hywakĩ e kwə bi de.
english: So the father knew that it was at that hour in which Jesus said to him, “Your son lives.” He believed, as did his whole house.

jenjo: Dɨ nɨng bwəng və nɨngtswe sɨbi nɨ Yeso tswekə fəlɨ o Yahuda o wukə Galili nɨ.
english: This is again the second sign that Jesus did, having come out of Judea into Galilee.

jenjo: Tswa wə, Yeso tə Urushalima pɨ nɨnglang və e Yahuda.
english: After these things, there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

jenjo: Urushalima de vɔ mɨng akə lə e le lwang bwahmɨ myɛ kwakə nwa vɔ mɨng de. Sen dzu pɨ de a Betsaida. Vɔ mɨng de tsɨ pəsəpi be nwanɨhyã nɨ sen dzukə Nwanɨhyã Nɨngpungga nɨ.
english: Now in Jerusalem by the sheep gate, there is a pool, which is called in Hebrew, “Bethesda”, having five porches.

jenjo: E ifɨ nɨngshi kə dzungdzung lwe nwa vɔ mɨng de. E igbanɨng, be e ibwipu pɔsɨ e ibwisɨ.
english: In these lay a great multitude of those who were sick, blind, lame, or paralyzed, waiting for the moving of the water;

jenjo: Ifɨ akə lə pɨbi be nɨngshi, ha nwutsɨng ji bwali yantsɨ hywa bwatə.
english: A certain man was there, who had been sick for thirty-eight years.

jenjo: Hywapɨnɨ Yeso bə wə nɨ yipɨ o tswi yang hywa nɨngshi. Bɨ o bi wə o tsa, “Sɨ man yidi e tɨng nɨngshi mə?”
english: When Jesus saw him lying there, and knew that he had been sick for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to be made well?”

jenjo: Ifɨ nɨngshi kwə nwa wə tsa, “Ihyãfɨ, ifɨ nɨ yin pələ dɨ mi təkə sɨ mɨng hywa pɨnɨ Ikwətũ dzwe lwikə mɨng nɨ ywang. Aba n mwəbe pa min təlɨ yang ifɨ akə ochi mi tə yang lə.”
english: The sick man answered him, “Sir, I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up, but while I’m coming, another steps down before me.”

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ wə tsa, “Yi a tsɨpu a kwa ki mə a ho a tə.”
english: Jesus said to him, “Arise, take up your mat, and walk.”

jenjo: Nabi bɨ ifɨ de yi hywa nɨngshi, o kwa ki o bɨ o ho o tə təlɨ o. Nɨng de tswenɨng vi hũli.
english: Immediately, the man was made well, and took up his mat and walked. Now it was the Sabbath on that day.

jenjo: Bɨ e ihyãfɨ və e Yahuda tsɨ ifɨ nɨngshi tsa, “Jɛnɨ dɨ vi hũlɨ, lenwa və bɨ kwə mə lə a dɨ ki vi hũlɨ lo.’ ”
english: So the Jews said to him who was cured, “It is the Sabbath. It is not lawful for you to carry the mat.”

jenjo: O kwə nwa le o tsa, “Dɨ ifɨ nɨ tɨng nɨngshi nɨ bɨ tsɨ mi tsa, ‘A dɨ ki mə a ho a tə.’ ”
english: He answered them, “He who made me well, the same said to me, ‘Take up your mat, and walk.’”

jenjo: Bɨ e bi wə e tsa, “Dɨ wə kə ifɨ de tsɨ mə a kwa ki ma a təkə nɨ?”
english: Then they asked him, “Who is the man who said to you, ‘Take up your mat, and walk’?”

jenjo: Ifɨ nɨ e tɨng nɨngshi o nɨ yi Yeso lo, fə Yeso bɨmpo la bɨngsə dzungdzung e ifafɨ.
english: But he who was healed didn’t know who it was, for Jesus had withdrawn, a crowd being in the place.

jenjo: Tswa we bɨ Yeso tə kwəsə be wə Kwə Fi tsɨ wə tsa, “A bə, a chi njəmu yang, bi fə man tswe nɨng abe yɛ. A mambɨ a lo, nɨng nɨ pekə a pɨnɨ yin chi mə chi.
english: Afterward Jesus found him in the temple, and said to him, “Behold, you are made well. Sin no more, so that nothing worse happens to you.”

jenjo: Ifɨ de ho tə nə e Yahuda lə tsa, dɨ Yeso bɨ tɨng nɨngshi və lɨ.
english: The man went away, and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.

jenjo: Vi a wə lɛ, e pəsɔ pɨ tsɨ Yeso chi bisɨ o tswe e nɨng de vi hũli.
english: For this cause the Jews persecuted Jesus, and sought to kill him, because he did these things on the Sabbath.

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ le tsa, “Vi hɛ̃ Ta mi sɨn tswe nwatũ, dɨ lə wukə jɛnɨ. Fə mi ma, sɨ min tswe nwatũ.”
english: But Jesus answered them, “My Father is still working, so I am working, too.”

jenjo: Bisɨ mambɨ e iYahuda hywakĩ nyadi e yidi pɨ yə wə. Dɨ bisɨ tswelɨ a nwatũ vi hũlɨ tsɨng lo, pwɔsɨ son tsa Fi dɨ Ta və lɨ. Ma a le, o dɨ ku wə losə be Fi yang ho.
english: For this cause therefore the Jews sought all the more to kill him, because he not only broke the Sabbath, but also called God his own Father, making himself equal with God.

jenjo: Yeso kwə nwa le tsa, “Kə akang sɨ min nə bə lə, yɨ pa tswe nɨng akə be ku wəw. Be dɨ nɨng nɨ o bə Ta o sɨn tswekə nɨ bɨ son tswelɨ. Bisɨ dɨ nɨng nɨ Ta sɨn tswekə nɨ, bɨ Yɨ sɨn tswelɨ.
english: Jesus therefore answered them, “Most certainly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing of himself, but what he sees the Father doing. For whatever things he does, these the Son also does likewise.

jenjo: Bisɨ Ta sɨn tswebi və Yɨ de, bɨ o ta wə na sɨ nwatũ nɨ son tswekə nɨ bisɨ o tswe mambɨ. Fə on tə wə nwatũ nɨ pekə a pɨnɨ, habi sɨbi sɨwə tswe bə ho.
english: For the Father has affection for the Son, and shows him all things that he himself does. He will show him greater works than these, that you may marvel.

jenjo: Ma yilɨ Ta sɨn yi be e ifɨ bwa fə son tə le hũlɨ nɨ, doho mambɨ ke ifɨ nɨ nyinyi Yɨ ifafɨ yidi hɛ̃ on tə wə hũlɨ.
english: For as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, even so the Son also gives life to whom he desires.

jenjo: Lehɛ̃ Ta nə za ku ifɨ akəw, be o yə za de le na Yɨ ifafi.
english: For the Father judges no one, but he has given all judgment to the Son,

jenjo: Bisɨ e ifafɨ hywakĩ tə Yɨ wə kãlɨ ma kãlɨ nɨ sen təkə Ta nɨ. Ke ifɨ nɨ tə Yɨ kãlɨ lo hɛ̃, o tə dɨ Ta nɨ tũkə Yɨ nɨ kãlɨ lo.
english: that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He who doesn’t honor the Son doesn’t honor the Father who sent him.

jenjo: “Kə akang min nə bə lə ke ifɨ nɨ likə bi mi fə pənyi wə sɨ ifɨ nɨ tũ mi kə nɨ yang, on chi hũlɨ a kə a itsɨng, za a nəlɨ ywang ku wəw. Bwa hyã ku wa wə o chi hũli yang.
english: “Most certainly I tell you, he who hears my word, and believes him who sent me, has eternal life, and doesn’t come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.

jenjo: Sɨ min nə bə bi anɨng lə, hywapɨ lə sɨn wulɨ fə wu yang sɨswenɨ. E ifɨ a bwa yin li wi Yɨ Fi. Fə e ifɨ nɨ likə nɨ, en yiyi tũ be hũlɨ.
english: Most certainly, I tell you, the hour comes, and now is, when the dead will hear the Son of God’s voice; and those who hear will live.

jenjo: Ma hũlɨ nɨ Ta ləkə nɨ, bɨ o kwələ o tə Yɨ de lə be hũlɨ bɨ.
english: For as the Father has life in himself, even so he gave to the Son also to have life in himself.

jenjo: Fə o tə wə tsɨkunɨng nə za, bisɨ dɨ wə kə Yɨ Ifafɨ.
english: He also gave him authority to execute judgment, because he is a son of man.

jenjo: “Bɨ sɨbi və e nɨng nɨ tswe bə yɛ. Vi lə sɨn wulɨ nɨ e ifɨ a hyabwa yin likə wi wə nɨ.
english: Don’t marvel at this, for the hour comes, in which all that are in the tombs will hear his voice,

jenjo: Fə yi en ji tũ, e ifɨ nɨ tswe nɨng a kang nɨ e yi en tə pɨ hũlɨ. E ifɨ nɨ tswe kə nɨng abe nɨ yi en tswe ibe
english: and will come out; those who have done good, to the resurrection of life; and those who have done evil, to the resurrection of judgment.

jenjo: Mi be ku mi pa n tswe nɨng a kəw. Mɨn nə za ma nɨng nɨ o tə mikə nɨ. Za anəlɨ mi dɨ a bi anɨng. Dɨ nɨng ku mi sɨ min tswelɨ lo be dɨ nɨngnɨ ifɨ nɨ tũ mikə yidi nɨ.
english: I can of myself do nothing. As I hear, I judge, and my judgment is righteous; because I don’t seek my own will, but the will of my Father who sent me.

jenjo: “A bi nɨ sɨ min nə bə kə lə nɨ dɨ bi ku mi yang, ifɨ nɨ yin kwəkə lə nɨ ywang.
english: “If I testify about myself, my witness is not valid.

jenjo: Be dɨ Fi bɨ sɨn nə bi ku mi. Fə n yipɨ yang, dɨ bi anɨng bɨ o nə ku mi.
english: It is another who testifies about me. I know that the testimony which he testifies about me is true.

jenjo: Kə akywi ba tũ e ifɨ sɨ Yohana, fə kə akang dɨ bi anɨng bɨ o nə le lə.
english: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.

jenjo: Na dɨ bisɨ sɨ min tə sambe sɨ bi kənwa ifafɨ, be sɨ min nə bə e bi de lə, hebila ba jiku.
english: But the testimony which I receive is not from man. However, I say these things that you may be saved.

jenjo: Yohana kuma dzwa nɨ sɨn kəkəpɨ nɨ. Bɨmpo bə be ku bə sɨ ban yidi pɨ li lalɨ a pɨkəpɨ o.
english: He was the burning and shining lamp, and you were willing to rejoice for a while in his light.

jenjo: Be n lə be nɨng nɨ pekə nɨng nɨ Yohana nə bə kə lə nɨ. E nɨng nɨ Fi Ta tə mi tsa wu n tswekə n e nyiwə, fə dɨbɨ sɨ min tswelɨ nɨ. E ta bə na lə yang tsa, kə akəng dɨ Ta bi tũ mi.
english: But the testimony which I have is greater than that of John, for the works which the Father gave me to accomplish, the very works that I do, testify about me, that the Father has sent me.

jenjo: Fə Ta de ta na lə yang dɨlɨ lɨ tũ mi. Ba mɛdi pɨ li wi wə lo, fə ba mɛdi pɨ bə guji o lo.
english: The Father himself, who sent me, has testified about me. You have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.

jenjo: Səko bi o ku nyinyi bə, bisɨ ba la pɨ pənyi sɨ ifɨ nɨ o tũkə nɨ yang.
english: You don’t have his word living in you; because you don’t believe him whom he sent.

jenjo: Sɨ ban sa Dəlo və Fi vi hɛ̃, bisɨ sɨ ban tsɨnyi ban chi hũlɨ a kə a itsɨng pɨbi. Dəlo de bɨmpo sɨn nə bi ku mi!
english: “You search the Scriptures, because you think that in them you have eternal life; and these are they which testify about me.

jenjo: Lehɛ̃ ba la pɨ wu sɨ mi ba chi hũlɨ a kə a itsɨng.
english: Yet you will not come to me, that you may have life.

jenjo: “Sɨ mi yidi dɨ yəlɨ a nwa və e ifafɨ lo.
english: I don’t receive glory from men.

jenjo: Be mi a mi n yi bə yang. Sɨ ban tswebi və Fi nyinyi bə lo.
english: But I know you, that you don’t have God’s love in yourselves.

jenjo: Dɨ tsɨkunɨng və Ta mi bɨ n wukə, be ba kwə bi mi lo. Be aba ifɨ nɨ wu be dzung ku wə yang ban kwəbi o kwə.
english: I have come in my Father’s name, and you don’t receive me. If another comes in his own name, you will receive him.

jenjo: Tswe nwu ban kwə bi mi lɨ? Aba ba yɨnagang pɨ shi sɨ bə pɨ bapɨ yənwa bwabɛ, be ba pa ba shi sɨ bə pɨ bapɨ yənwa sɨ Fi nɨ nasɨ wə ho kə Fi tsɨng dodo nɨ lo.
english: How can you believe, who receive glory from one another, and you don’t seek the glory that comes from the only God?

jenjo: “Be bi ban tsɨnyi bə ban tsa lakə min kinwakwang və bə sɨ Ta bisɨ ayibe və bə yɛ. Ifɨ nɨ yin kinwakwang və bə nɨ dɨ Musa. Wə nɨ ba tsɨ nyinyi bə on lə nwa bə nɨ.
english: “Don’t think that I will accuse you to the Father. There is one who accuses you, even Moses, on whom you have set your hope.

jenjo: Musa vĩ nɨng ku mi, aba ba kwə bi o yang, ban kwə bi mi kwə bɨmpo.
english: For if you believed Moses, you would believe me; for he wrote about me.

jenjo: A ba kwələ be e nɨng nɨ Musa vĩkə nɨ lo yang, tswe nwu ban kwələ be e nɨng nɨ sɨ min nəkə nɨ?”
english: But if you don’t believe his writings, how will you believe my words?”

jenjo: Tswa wə, bɨ Yeso hyã tə nwa mɨng akã Galili, fə dzung mɨng de akə ho kə Tibariya.
english: After these things, Jesus went away to the other side of the sea of Galilee, which is also called the Sea of Tiberias.

jenjo: Bɨ e ifɨ kə dzungdzung mwə nyi wə, bisɨ e nɨng bisɨ nɨ e bə o tswekə sɨ e ifɨ nɨngshi nɨ.
english: A great multitude followed him, because they saw his signs which he did on those who were sick.

jenjo: Bɨ Yeso tə pĩ ku te o ku pɨbi be e mwambwi o.
english: Jesus went up into the mountain, and he sat there with his disciples.

jenjo: Nɨnglang hyãlɨ və e Yahuda kyə̃pɨ yang.
english: Now the Passover, the feast of the Jews, was at hand.

jenjo: Hywapɨnɨ Yeso bə e ifafɨ kə dzungdzung pə nɨng nyi wə nɨ, bɨ o bi Filibu o tsa, “Yə bɨn chi nɨngtang le bəde nɨ bɨ jə bɨn tə e ifɨ nɨ tanglɨ?”
english: Jesus therefore lifting up his eyes, and seeing that a great multitude was coming to him, said to Philip, “Where are we to buy bread, that these may eat?”

jenjo: O bi Filibu bisɨ son yidi pɨ nyi wə, nyinyi wə o bə nɨng nɨ on tswe kə nɨ yang.
english: This he said to test him, for he himself knew what he would do.

jenjo: Filibu kwə nwa wə tsa, “Ke e fə ifɨ gyədə nwatũ a hywĩhywĩ hywĩtə hɛ̃ pa jə nɨngtang lo ku e ifɨ nɨw.”
english: Philip answered him, “Two hundred denarii worth of bread is not sufficient for them, that everyone of them may receive a little.”

jenjo: Mwambwi o akə nɨ en dzuka Andirawus a hywĩ Bitulu nəbi tsa,
english: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to him,

jenjo: “Imwə akə lə pɨnɨ be kumpa bwahmɨ be hyɨng bwayung, yə dɨ bə yin tswelɨ sɨ dzungdzung və e ifɨ nɨ?”
english: “There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish, but what are these among so many?”

jenjo: Yeso tsa, “Ba tsɨ e ifafɨ de ku hywa.” Hu lə pɨbi ihyãnɨng bɨ e ifafɨ de fə ku hywa pɨbi. E ifɨ de nwufe bwahmɨ.
english: Jesus said, “Have the people sit down.” Now there was much grass in that place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.

jenjo: Yeso dɨ kumpa de tə Fi kãlɨ bɨ tsə e ifafɨ nɨ kukə hywa ni. Fə o tsə hyɨng de mambɨ lo ywatsə və le.
english: Jesus took the loaves; and having given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to those who were sitting down; likewise also of the fish as much as they desired.

jenjo: Hywapɨnɨ e tang nɨng lo lelə nɨ, bɨ o tsɨ e mwambwi o tsa, “Ba pwɔ nyɔ nɨng nɨ e yəkə lə nɨ. Bi en yə nɨng akə bangkə yɛ.”
english: When they were filled, he said to his disciples, “Gather up the broken pieces which are left over, that nothing be lost.”

jenjo: Bɨ e mwambwi o pwɔ nyɔ mumu de yɨ kəlo bwahywə ji yung. Nyɔ mumu kumpa nyəmwi bale bwahmɨ nɨ e ifafɨ tang yəkə lə nɨ.
english: So they gathered them up, and filled twelve baskets with broken pieces from the five barley loaves, which were left over by those who had eaten.

jenjo: E ifafɨ bəkə nɨng bisɨ nɨ Yeso tswekə nɨ bɨ e tsa, “Kə akang dɨ Ilinwa de nɨ e tsa yin wukə Fangwa ho.”
english: When therefore the people saw the sign which Jesus did, they said, “This is truly the prophet who comes into the world.”

jenjo: Yeso yipɨ e ifɨ de yidi pɨ mwə wə be tsa en ya wə Ivə ku le nɨ, bɨ o pa o ji tangsə le o tə ku te.
english: Jesus therefore, perceiving that they were about to come and take him by force, to make him king, withdrew again to the mountain by himself.

jenjo: Nandzwi tswekə nɨ, bɨ e mwmbwi o ho tə nwamɨng.
english: When evening came, his disciples went down to the sea,

jenjo: Bɨ e pĩ tang fə en hyã mɨng Kaparnahum. Pɨ fɨ yang Yeso ywang sɨ le tang fə de.
english: and they entered into the boat, and were going over the sea to Capernaum. It was now dark, and Jesus had not come to them.

jenjo: Bɨ ywa akã o ku mɨng, sɨn pə nggəng.
english: The sea was tossed by a great wind blowing.
