jenjo: E ngə fə tswe yang kilomita bwahmɨ alo hywĩtsɨng. Bɨ e bə Yeso ho ku mɨng sɨn wulɨ. Wu on kyã sɨ fə lɨ, bɨ le hɛ̃ e bibi.
english: When therefore they had rowed about twenty-five or thirty stadia, they saw Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing near to the boat; and they were afraid.

jenjo: Bɨ o tsɨ le o tsa, “Bi ban bibi yɛ dɨ mi.”
english: But he said to them, “It is I. Don’t be afraid.”

jenjo: Bɨ e bɛ pɨ dɨ wə tang fə, lelang fə de wu yang nwa ngwa pɨnɨ en wukə lə nɨ.
english: They were willing therefore to receive him into the boat. Immediately the boat was at the land where they were going.

jenjo: Pɨkə sɨ wə, e ifɨ nɨ tsung be le nɨ yipɨ yang dɨ fə tsɨng bɨ e mwambwi o pĩ, o pĩ tsung be le lo. Hywapɨnɨ le a le sen təkə və nɨ o ywang tangsə le. Nɨhyã o be tsɨng wə.
english: On the next day, the multitude that stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was no other boat there, except the one in which his disciples had embarked, and that Jesus hadn’t entered with his disciples into the boat, but his disciples had gone away alone.

jenjo: Be e fə akə lə yi Tibariya wu tsɨ pəsəpi be pɨnɨ e ifafɨ tangkə nɨngtang nɨ Yeso kã Fi tsə le kə nɨ.
english: However boats from Tiberias came near to the place where they ate the bread after the Lord had given thanks.

jenjo: Hywapɨnɨ e ifafɨ bəkə Yeso be e mwambwi o ywang nɨ, bɨ e pĩ tangsə e fə de e tə Kaparnahum pɨ bapɨ Yeso.
english: When the multitude therefore saw that Jesus wasn’t there, nor his disciples, they themselves got into the boats, and came to Capernaum, seeking Jesus.

jenjo: Hywapɨnɨ tə e chi wə ngwa pɨle nɨ e bi wə e tsa, “Itwevə, a hyã donɨ bɨ a wu pɨnɨ?”
english: When they found him on the other side of the sea, they asked him, “Rabbi, when did you come here?”

jenjo: Yeso kwə ngwa le tsa, “Kə akang sɨ min nə bə lə, sɨ ban bapɨ mi dɨ bi sɨ nɨng bisɨ nɨ sɨ ban bəkə nɨ lo. Be dɨ bisɨ nɨngtang nɨ sɨ ban chikə nɨ.
english: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, you seek me, not because you saw signs, but because you ate of the loaves, and were filled.

jenjo: Bi ban tswe nwatũ bisɨ nɨngtang nɨ yin bangkə bang nɨ yɛ, be ba tswe nwatũ nɨ yin tə bə hũlɨ a kə a itsɨng, nɨ Yɨ Ifafɨ yin tə bə kə nɨ. Dɨ wə bɨ Fi Ta kwələ ta wə do.”
english: Don’t work for the food which perishes, but for the food which remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give to you. For God the Father has sealed him.”

jenjo: Bɨ e bi wə e tsa, “Tswe nwu bɨn tswekə nwatũ nɨ Fi yɛdi nɨ a?”
english: They said therefore to him, “What must we do, that we may work the works of God?”

jenjo: Yeso kwə nwa le tsa, “Dɨ nwatũ de ho ba pənyi sɨ ifɨ nɨ o tũkə nɨ.”
english: Jesus answered them, “This is the work of God, that you believe in him whom he has sent.”

jenjo: E kwə nwa wə e tsa, “Yə dɨ nɨng bisɨ bə man tswelɨ nɨ bɨn pənyi sɨ mə nɨ? Dɨ bə man tswelɨ?
english: They said therefore to him, “What then do you do for a sign, that we may see, and believe you? What work do you do?

jenjo: E papa və bɨ nani bə ale nɨngbisɨ e tang Mana yang bɨnghu, ma vĩlɨ e vĩkə tang dəlo tsa, ‘O tə le kumpa a dzwe, e tang.’ ”
english: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness. As it is written, ‘He gave them bread out of heaven to eat.’”

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ le tsa, “Bi anɨng sɨ min nə bə lə, dɨ Musa tə bə nɨngtang a dzwe lo, be dɨ Ta mi tə bə Kumpa a nɨng nɨ wukə dzwe nɨ.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, it wasn’t Moses who gave you the bread out of heaven, but my Father gives you the true bread out of heaven.

jenjo: Dɨ kumpa və Fi ho kə ifɨ nɨ pĩkə hywa dzwe wu tə Fangwa hũlɨ nɨ.”
english: For the bread of God is that which comes down out of heaven, and gives life to the world.”

jenjo: E tsa, “Ihyãfɨ, dɨlə sɨswenɨ a tə bɨ kumpa de kəvivi.”
english: They said therefore to him, “Lord, always give us this bread.”

jenjo: Yeso nəbi tsa, “Dɨ mi kə kumpa tə hũlɨ. Ke ifɨ nɨ wu sɨ mi yang, hwə fə yə wəw. Fə ifɨ nɨ tsɨnyi wə sɨ mi hɛ̃, lɨng fə le wəw.
english: Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life. He who comes to me will not be hungry, and he who believes in me will never be thirsty.

jenjo: Be ma bi nɨ n nəbə kə lə nɨ, ba bə mi yang be bɨtsɨng ba kwə bi mi lo.
english: But I told you that you have seen me, and yet you don’t believe.

jenjo: Ke ifɨ nɨ Ta tə mi kə hɛ̃ yin wu sɨ mi wu. Mi bɨmpo n pəku sɨ le n nyəw.
english: All those whom the Father gives me will come to me. He who comes to me I will in no way throw out.

jenjo: N pĩhywa dzwe pɨ wu tswe nɨng ku mi lo, be dɨ nɨng və ifɨ nɨ tũ mi kə nɨ.
english: For I have come down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him who sent me.

jenjo: Fə ifɨ nɨ tũ mi nɨ, dɨ nɨng nɨ o yidi ho, e ifɨ nɨ o tə mi kə nɨ bi tsɨng və le la yɛ. Be n yi be le sɨ nyitɨngku vi.”
english: This is the will of my Father who sent me, that of all he has given to me I should lose nothing, but should raise him up at the last day.

jenjo: Ta mi yidi, ke ifɨ nɨ bəkə Yɨ fə tsɨnyi sɨ we yang, o chi hũlɨ a kə a itsɨng. Fə min yi be wə nyitɨngku vi.
english: This is the will of the one who sent me, that everyone who sees the Son, and believes in him, should have eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.”

jenjo: Yeso nəbi tɨngkə nɨ, bɨ e iYahuda pəsɔ pɨ nəbi be tswi bisɨ bi nɨ o nəkə o tsa, “Dɨ mi kə kumpa nɨ wukə dzwe nɨ.”
english: The Jews therefore murmured concerning him, because he said, “I am the bread which came down out of heaven.”

jenjo: E tsa, “Dɨ Yeso nɨ lo? Dɨ yɨ Yusufu nɨ bɨ yikə ta o be na o nɨ lo? Yə tswe nwu sɨswenɨ wu son tsa lɨ pĩ le dzwe?”
english: They said, “Isn’t this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How then does he say, ‘I have come down out of heaven?’”

jenjo: Yeso kwə nwa le tsa, “Bi ban nəbi be nyitswi bwa bə yɛ”
english: Therefore Jesus answered them, “Don’t murmur among yourselves.

jenjo: Ifɨ nɨ yin wukə sɨ mi be ku wə nɨ ywang, temə dɨ Ta nɨ tũ mi kə nɨ, bɨ fɨ wə wukə lɨ. Fə mi, min yi be ifɨ de sɨ nyitɨngku vi.
english: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him, and I will raise him up in the last day.

jenjo: E vĩvĩ tangsə dəlo və e Ilinwa tsa, ‘Le hɛ̃ Fi yin nyi le na sɨ nɨng.’ Ke ifɨ nɨ kangtswi sɨ Ta fə o myɛ nɨng akə yang, on wu sɨ mi wu.
english: It is written in the prophets, ‘They will all be taught by God.’ Therefore everyone who hears from the Father, and has learned, comes to me.

jenjo: Ifɨ nɨ yikə Ta nɨ ywang, be dɨ ifɨ nɨ wukə sɨ Fi nɨ. Dɨ wə tsɨng, bɨ o bə Ta de.
english: Not that anyone has seen the Father, except he who is from God. He has seen the Father.

jenjo: Kə akang sɨ min nə bə lə ifɨ nɨ tsɨnyi yang, on chi hũlɨ a kə itsɨng yang.
english: Most certainly, I tell you, he who believes in me has eternal life.

jenjo: Dɨ mi kə kumpa tə hũlɨ.
english: I am the bread of life.

jenjo: E papa və bə tang Mana bɨnghu lɛ, lehɛ̃ e bwi yang.
english: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, and they died.

jenjo: Be dɨ kumpa nɨ wukə dzwe ho nɨ, ke ifɨ nɨ tang kə hɛ̃ bwa ywang ku wə.
english: This is the bread which comes down out of heaven, that anyone may eat of it and not die.

jenjo: Dɨ mi kə kumpa tə hũlɨ nɨ wukə dzwe nɨ. Ifɨ nɨ tangkə kumpa nɨ hɛ̃ o bwiw, on ku be hũlɨ kə a itsɨng. Dɨ hyə̃hyə̃ mi bɨ yi min təlɨ kə kumpa nɨ min təkə hebilə fangwa chi hũlɨ.
english: I am the living bread which came down out of heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. Yes, the bread which I will give for the life of the world is my flesh.”

jenjo: Bɨ e Yahuda pəsɔ pɨ tsasə nwa bwa le sen tsa, “Tswe nwu ibwi nɨ tsa lɨn tə bɨ hyə̃hyə̃ lɨ bɨ tang?”
english: The Jews therefore contended with one another, saying, “How can this man give us his flesh to eat?”

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ le tsa, “Kə a kəng sɨ min nə bə lə, aba ifɨ nɨ tang hyə̃hyə̃ Yɨ ifafɨ fə nwa hywi wə lo yang, hũlɨ ywang be wə.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you don’t have life in yourselves.

jenjo: E ifɨ nɨ tangkə hyə̃hyə̃ mi fə nwakə hywi mi nɨ, e lə be hũlɨ a kə a itsɨng. Fə min yi be le sɨ nyitɨngku vi.
english: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.

jenjo: Bisɨ hyə̃hyə̃ mi dɨ nɨng tang a nɨng; hywi mi dɨ nɨng a nwalɨ a nɨng.
english: For my flesh is food indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.

jenjo: E ifɨ nɨ tangkə hyə̃hyə̃ mi fə nwa hywi mi yang, en ku tsung be mi fə min ku sɨ le.
english: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood lives in me, and I in him.

jenjo: Ma tũlɨ Ta Ikəhũlɨ tũ mi bɨ n ku be hũlɨkə nɨ, mambɨ ke ifɨ nɨ tang hyə̃hyə̃ mi hɛ̃, yi on ku be hũlɨ bisɨ mi.
english: As the living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father; so he who feeds on me, he will also live because of me.

jenjo: Dɨ mi kə kumpa a bi anɨng nɨ wukə dzwe nɨ. Ku ma kumpa nɨ e papa və bə tangkə bɨnghu fə tswa e bwikə nɨ lo. Ke ifɨ nɨ tangkə kumpa nɨ, on hũ kə hũlɨ a kə itsɨng.”
english: This is the bread which came down out of heaven—not as our fathers ate the manna, and died. He who eats this bread will live forever.”

jenjo: Yeso nə bi nɨ sapɨnɨ son nyina sɨ nɨng pɨ kwəsəku və e iYahuda Kaparnahum nɨ.
english: He said these things in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.

jenjo: E mwambwi o likə mambɨ nɨ ləkã le tsa, “Nyinasɨ hu nɨ shi o. Dɨ wə yin kwələ lɨ a?”
english: Therefore many of his disciples, when they heard this, said, “This is a hard saying! Who can listen to it?”

jenjo: Yeso yipɨ bi de yɨlə e mwambwi o yang nɨ, bɨ Yeso tsɨ le tsa, “Nɨng de be ywa bə yang?
english: But Jesus knowing in himself that his disciples murmured at this, said to them, “Does this cause you to stumble?

jenjo: Yə a nɨ ba bə Yɨ Ifafɨ fə sɨn tə dzwe pɨnɨ o jikə lə nɨ yang wa?
english: Then what if you would see the Son of Man ascending to where he was before?

jenjo: Dɨ Kwang sɨn tə hũlɨ be tswəsɨ sɨn tə hũlɨ lo. E bi nɨ n nə bə kə lə nɨ, ji le sɨ Kwang, bisɨ mambɨ hũlɨ lə sɨ e bi de.
english: It is the spirit who gives life. The flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and are life.

jenjo: Be e ifɨ akə tangsə bə tsɨnyi lo.” Yeso nə mambɨ bisɨ o ochi yipɨ e ifɨ nɨ pəkənyi lo nɨ yang, be ifɨ yin təkə mwə o nɨ.
english: But there are some of you who don’t believe.” For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were who didn’t believe, and who it was who would betray him.

jenjo: Fə Yeso nə le bi lə o tsa, “Dɨbɨ tswe n tsɨ bə a ifɨ nɨ yin wukə sɨ mi nɨ ywang tɛmə dɨ Ta kwə wə lə.”
english: He said, “For this cause I have said to you that no one can come to me, unless it is given to him by my Father.”

jenjo: Dɨlə pɨbi ləkã e mwambwi o yə pɨ mwə tswa wə.
english: At this, many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.

jenjo: Yeso bi e mwambwi o bwahywə ji yung tsa, “Be bə hɛ̃ ban yə pɨ mwə tswa mi?”
english: Jesus said therefore to the twelve, “You don’t also want to go away, do you?”

jenjo: Sima Bitulu kwə nwa wə tsa, “Itwebɨ, yə bɨn tə dɨ sɨ wə de? Kə dɨ e bi mə tsɨng bɨ sɨn tə hũlɨ kə a itsɨng.
english: Simon Peter answered him, “Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life.

jenjo: Bɨ kwələ yang, fə bɨ yipɨ yang dɨ mə kə ifɨ a kĩlɨ və Fi.”
english: We have come to believe and know that you are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”

jenjo: Yeso kwə tsa, “Dɨ mi bɨn bwi bə bwahywə ji yung lo? Be tsɨng və bə dɨ ikãnyi!”
english: Jesus answered them, “Didn’t I choose you, the twelve, and one of you is a devil?”

jenjo: (Son tsɨ dɨ Yahuda yɨ Sima Iskaliyoti. Wə dɨ tsɨng tangsə le bwahywə ji yung, be tswa wu o le wə tə.)
english: Now he spoke of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, for it was he who would betray him, being one of the twelve.

jenjo: Tswa e nɨng nɨ, Yeso ho sɨn myɛ hywa Galili. O la pɨ tə Yahudiya bisɨ o yipɨ yang e Yahuda nɨ pɨbi nɨ sɨn bapɨ pɨ dɨ hũlɨ wə.
english: After these things, Jesus was walking in Galilee, for he wouldn’t walk in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill him.

jenjo: Be hywapɨ nɨnglang le lwang və e yahuda kyã pɨ nɨ,
english: Now the feast of the Jews, the Feast of Booths, was at hand.

jenjo: e hywĩ Yeso tsɨ wə tsa, “A yi a tə Yahudiya, hebilə e mwambwi mə tə bə e nɨngtswe sɨbi nɨ sɨ man tswekə nɨ.
english: His brothers therefore said to him, “Depart from here, and go into Judea, that your disciples also may see your works which you do.

jenjo: Ke ifɨ nɨ sɨn yidi e ifafɨ yilɨ yang, on ywe ku wə lo. A ta Fangwa na sɨ e nɨng nɨ sɨ man tswekə nɨ.”
english: For no one does anything in secret, and himself seeks to be known openly. If you do these things, reveal yourself to the world.”

jenjo: E hywĩ wə nə mambɨ, bisɨ le ma e pənyi sɨ wə lo.
english: For even his brothers didn’t believe in him.

jenjo: Bisɨ mambɨ Yeso tsɨ le tsa, “Hywami tswe lo bɨtsɨng. Be sɨ bə a bə, a donɨ hɛ̃ hĩkwã.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.

jenjo: Fangwa la bəw, be Fangwa sɨn la mi bisɨ sɨ min tsa, nɨng nɨ sen tswekə nɨ hĩ lo.
english: The world can’t hate you, but it hates me, because I testify about it, that its works are evil.

jenjo: Ba tə pɨ nɨnglang de, be mi a mi n chi na lo bɨtsɨng. Sɨ mi a mi hywapɨ tswe lo.”
english: You go up to the feast. I am not yet going up to this feast, because my time is not yet fulfilled.”

jenjo: O nəkə bi nɨ bɨ o tsɨ hywa Galili.
english: Having said these things to them, he stayed in Galilee.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ e hywĩ wə pekə nɨ bɨ o mwə tswa le. Tə o ywe ku wə pɨ nɨnglang de.
english: But when his brothers had gone up to the feast, then he also went up, not publicly, but as it were in secret.

jenjo: Pɨ nɨnglang de e Yahuda sɨn bipɨ wə sen tsa, “Yə ibwi de be?”
english: The Jews therefore sought him at the feast, and said, “Where is he?”

jenjo: Tangsə e ifɨ de pɨbi nɨ, bi sɨn wə kɨng kɨng. E ifɨ akə sɨn tsa, “Wə dɨ ifɨ a pikang” E ifɨ akə kwə sɨn tsa, “Mambɨ lo ku son fɨnwa e ifafɨ.”
english: There was much murmuring among the multitudes concerning him. Some said, “He is a good man.” Others said, “Not so, but he leads the multitude astray.”

jenjo: Be e ifafɨ bibi və e Yahuda en nə bi de be wi lo.
english: Yet no one spoke openly of him for fear of the Jews.

jenjo: Yeso ji be ku wə lo tɛmə dɨ hywapɨnɨ nɨnglang de tsəsə losə nɨ. Bɨ o tə fa Kwə Fi o pəsɔ pɨ nyinasɨnɨng.
english: But when it was now the middle of the feast, Jesus went up into the temple and taught.

jenjo: Sɨbi tswe e Yahuda bɨ e bipɨ sen tsa, “Tswe nwu ifɨ nɨ yinagang nɨng manɨ o sa hu lo?”
english: The Jews therefore marveled, saying, “How does this man know letters, having never been educated?”

jenjo: Yeso kwə le lə tsa, “Dɨ nɨng ku mi sɨ min nyina lə lo. Sɨn wu le sɨ ifɨ nɨ tũ mi kə nɨ.
english: Jesus therefore answered them, “My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me.

jenjo: Ke ifɨ nɨ sɨn yidi pɨ tswe nɨng nɨ Fi sɨn yidi kə ni yang, on yipɨ yi, a dɨ mi be ku mi sɨ min nyi nasɨ nɨng alo sɨn wu le sɨ Fi.
english: If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God, or if I am speaking from myself.

jenjo: Ifɨ nɨ sɨ nə bi ku wə yang son yidi kãli. Be ifɨ nɨ sɨn tswe nwatũ və ifɨ nɨ tũ wəkə nɨ yang, wə dɨ ifɨ bi anɨng o ywang be ayibew.
english: He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory, but he who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.

jenjo: Musa tə bə lenwa lo? Lehɛ̃, ifɨ akə ywang tangsə bə, nɨ mwə tswa lenwa de hywiwə. Tswe nwu sɨ ban yidi pɨ yə mi?”
english: Didn’t Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill me?”

jenjo: E ifafɨ kwə nwa wə tsa, “Nɨngvi tə yang sɨ mə. Yə dɨ wə sɨn kwa mə yidi pɨ yəlɨ de?”
english: The multitude answered, “You have a demon! Who seeks to kill you?”

jenjo: Yeso kwə le lə tsa, “Nɨng bisɨ tsɨng dodo nɨ n tswekə vi hũlɨ nɨ, bə hɛ̃ sɨbi tswe bə yang.
english: Jesus answered them, “I did one work, and you all marvel because of it.

jenjo: Bə ma sɨ ban pyɛ̃chi e yɨ bə lə bɨ Vi Hũli, bisɨ lenwa nɨ Musa tə bə ba pyɛ̃chi e yɨ bə nɨ. Kə bi anɨng, lenwa pyɛ̃lɨ achi de pəsɔ ku Musa lo, be pəsɔ ku e papa və bɨ be tswilɨkə.
english: Moses has given you circumcision (not that it is of Moses, but of the fathers), and on the Sabbath you circumcise a boy.

jenjo: Sɨswenɨ aba en pyɛ̃ imwə vi hũli bisɨ bi ba tswebi sɨ lenwa və Musa yang, tswe nwu sɨ ban be ywa bisɨ n tɨng nɨngshi Vi Hũlɨ?
english: If a boy receives circumcision on the Sabbath, that the law of Moses may not be broken, are you angry with me, because I made a man completely healthy on the Sabbath?

jenjo: Bi ban nə za bisɨ nɨngnɨ nɨng bə bəkə nɨ yɛ, be ba nə za hywiwə.”
english: Don’t judge according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment.”

jenjo: E ifɨ a Urushalima akə bipɨ tsa, “Dɨ ibwi nɨ e ifɨ tsɨkunɨng yidi pɨ yəkə nɨ lo?
english: Therefore some of them of Jerusalem said, “Isn’t this he whom they seek to kill?

jenjo: Dɨ wə ho son nəbi nɨngfa le, be e nə bi akə lo. E ifɨ tsɨkunɨng de kwələ yang dɨ wə kə ifɨ nɨ Fi gbəwə sɔ ho?
english: Behold, he speaks openly, and they say nothing to him. Can it be that the rulers indeed know that this is truly the Christ?

jenjo: Bɨ yi pɨnɨ ibwi nɨ jikə lə nɨ yang. Be aba Kristi a bi anɨng wu yang, ifɨ pa yipɨ pɨnɨ on jikə lə nɨw.”
english: However we know where this man comes from, but when the Christ comes, no one will know where he comes from.”

jenjo: Yeso lə sɨn nyinasɨnɨng fa Kwə Fi. O dɨ wi wə o yikə dzwe bɨ o tsa, “Kə akəng ba yi mi yang, ba yi pɨnɨ n jikə lə yang. Dɨ mi n wu be ku mi pɨnɨ lo, be ifɨ nɨ tũ mi kə nɨ wə dɨ bi anɨng. Ba yi wə lo.
english: Jesus therefore cried out in the temple, teaching and saying, “You both know me, and know where I am from. I have not come of myself, but he who sent me is true, whom you don’t know.

jenjo: Be n yi wə yang, n wu le sɨ wə, fə dɨ wə bɨ o tũ mi.”
english: I know him, because I am from him, and he sent me.”

jenjo: Mambɨ sen yidi pɨ mwə wə, be e pa lo bisɨ hywapɨ o tswe lo.
english: They sought therefore to take him; but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.

jenjo: Lehɛ̃, e ifɨ ihyãnɨng tangsə le pənyi yang sɨ wə sen tsa, “A Kristi de wu yang, on tswe nɨng bisɨ akə yin pe sɨ a pɨnɨ ifɨ nɨ son tswekə nɨ?”
english: But of the multitude, many believed in him. They said, “When the Christ comes, he won’t do more signs than those which this man has done, will he?”

jenjo: E Farisa li nɨng nɨ e ifɨ sɨn nəkə ku wə nɨ. Bɨ e ihyãfɨ hyɔ̃nɨng be e Farisa, tũ e ifɨ tsɨnɨng sɨ kwəfi tsa e mwə wə.
english: The Pharisees heard the multitude murmuring these things concerning him, and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers to arrest him.

jenjo: Yeso tsa, “Mi lə be bə vi tswəni, be fə min tə sɨ ifɨ nɨ tũ mikə nɨ.
english: Then Jesus said, “I will be with you a little while longer, then I go to him who sent me.

jenjo: Yi ban bapɨ mi, be ba chi miw. Pɨnɨ min təkə lə nɨ, ba wu pɨ dew.”
english: You will seek me, and won’t find me; and where I am, you can’t come.”

jenjo: E Yahuda sɨn bisə bwa le sen tsa, “Dɨ pɨ bəde bɨ ifɨ yin təlɨ bɨ bɨ bapɨ wə bɨ chi wa? On tə pɨnɨ e ifɨ və bɨ hywi kukə tangsə e Helina, tə on nyi e Helina nə sɨ hu pɨbi?
english: The Jews therefore said among themselves, “Where will this man go that we won’t find him? Will he go to the Dispersion among the Greeks, and teach the Greeks?

jenjo: Dɨ bə son nəlɨ nɨ o tsɨkə a, ‘Yi ban bapɨ mi be ba chi miw. Pɨnɨ min təkə lə nɨ ba wu pɨ de wa?’ ”
english: What is this word that he said, ‘You will seek me, and won’t find me; and where I am, you can’t come’?”

jenjo: Nyitɨngku vi nɨnglang kə vi a kã nɨ, Yeso nəbi be wi tsa, “Ke ifɨ nɨ lɨng le wə hɛ̃ o wu sɨ mi o nwa.
english: Now on the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out, “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me and drink!

jenjo: Ma nɨng nɨ dəlo nəkə tsa, ke ifɨ nɨ tsɨnyi sɨ mi yang bwabu mɨng nɨ sɨn təkə hũlɨ yin ji sɨ wə.”
english: He who believes in me, as the Scripture has said, from within him will flow rivers of living water.”

jenjo: Son nə bi de ku e ifɨ nɨ tsɨnyi sɨ wə yi en chikə Kwang Fi nɨ. Bisɨ hywapɨnɨ o nəkə bi nɨ Kwang de wu lo bɨtsɨng, fə Fi tə wə kãlɨ o lo bɨtsɨng.
english: But he said this about the Spirit, which those believing in him were to receive. For the Holy Spirit was not yet given, because Jesus wasn’t yet glorified.

jenjo: E ifɨ akə likə bi nɨ Yeso nəkə nɨ bɨ e tsa, “Kə akang dɨ Ilinwa de nɨ”
english: Many of the multitude therefore, when they heard these words, said, “This is truly the prophet.”

jenjo: E ifɨ akə tsa, “Wə dɨ Kristi.” Fə e ifi akə tsa, “Tswe nwu Kristi yin ji Galili lɨ?
english: Others said, “This is the Christ.” But some said, “What, does the Christ come out of Galilee?

jenjo: Dəlo nə tsa Kristi yin wu le lənyɔ və Dauda, fə en chi wə Betalami, pɨnɨ Ivə Dauda kukə lə nɨ lo?
english: Hasn’t the Scripture said that the Christ comes of the offspring of David, and from Bethlehem, the village where David was?”

jenjo: Ku e ifɨ bwi tsɨ tsɨng tsɨng bisɨ Yeso.
english: So there arose a division in the multitude because of him.

jenjo: E ifɨ akə yidi pɨ mwə wə be e chi nɨhyã lo.
english: Some of them would have arrested him, but no one laid hands on him.

jenjo: E yasə nɨ bɨ e ifɨ tsɨnɨng Kwə Fi fə tə sɨ e ivə hyɔ̃nɨng be e Farisa. Bɨ e bi le e tsa, “Tswe nwu ba wu be wə lo?”
english: The officers therefore came to the chief priests and Pharisees, and they said to them, “Why didn’t you bring him?”

jenjo: E itsɨnɨng de kwə nwa le tsa, “Ifafɨ akə mɛdi pɨ nə bi ma ibwi nɨ lo.”
english: The officers answered, “No man ever spoke like this man!”

jenjo: E Farisa bi le tsa, “Bə ma o fɨnwa bə yang bɨ?”
english: The Pharisees therefore answered them, “You aren’t also led astray, are you?

jenjo: Ifɨ akə lə tangsə e itsɨkunɨng alo tangsə e Farisa pənyi yang sɨ wə?
english: Have any of the rulers believed in him, or of the Pharisees?

jenjo: Oho! Be e ifɨ a yalɨ nɨ pwɔsə sɨn mwə nyi wə nɨ, wewe ta le yang. E yi nɨng akə lo sɨ Lenwa və Musa.”
english: But this multitude that doesn’t know the law is accursed.”

jenjo: Bɨ Nikodimus nɨ təkə sɨ Yeso be nvi, fə wə dɨ tsɨng tangsə le nɨ bipɨ tsa,
english: Nicodemus (he who came to him by night, being one of them) said to them,

jenjo: “Sɨ lenwa və bɨ, pa en tsə ifɨ nɨ e kuhywa e nə za ku wə e tsɨ lə lo nɨ?”
english: “Does our law judge a man, unless it first hears from him personally and knows what he does?”

jenjo: E kwə nwa wə e tsa, “E! Ma dɨ mwɛ Galili bɨ? A sa dəlo pikang a bə, Ilinwa akə pa ji Galiliw.”
english: They answered him, “Are you also from Galilee? Search, and see that no prophet has arisen out of Galilee.”

jenjo: Tswa wə, bɨ e yasə, a dɨ wə hɛ̃ tə və wə.
english: Everyone went to his own house,

jenjo: Be Yeso tə kute Zetun.
english: but Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.

jenjo: Be nyinvi a bubu bɨ fə o wu Kwə Fi nɨngpɨfa. E ifafɨ hɛ̃ kwɛ wə le tangsə, o ku hywa son nyi le nasɨ hu.
english: Now very early in the morning, he came again into the temple, and all the people came to him. He sat down, and taught them.

jenjo: Bɨ e inyinasɨ lenwa be e Farisa wu be iye tsəvə akə e mwə wə be ibwi. E tsɨ wə be pu tangsə e ifafɨ.
english: The scribes and the Pharisees brought a woman taken in adultery. Having set her in the middle,

jenjo: Bɨ e tsɨ Yeso e tsa, “Inyinasɨnɨng, bɨ mwə iye nɨ sɨn gbəkə.
english: they told him, “Teacher, we found this woman in adultery, in the very act.

jenjo: Sɨ lenwa və Musa tsa, ke ifɨ nɨ e chi wə sɨn gbəkə yang bɨ gbə wə be te bɨ yə. Yə mə a mə dɨ bə man nə pɨbi?”
english: Now in our law, Moses commanded us to stone such women. What then do you say about her?”

jenjo: E bi wə bi nɨ bisɨ aba nwa wə lenwa o nə bi abe yang e chi e ta pu lə, kə e mwə wə kə. Be Yeso ywɛ hywa pəsɔ pɨ vĩ nɨng hywa be nɨnghywəna.
english: They said this testing him, that they might have something to accuse him of. But Jesus stooped down, and wrote on the ground with his finger.

jenjo: E yɨlə wə be pɨ bipɨ bi, bɨ o tsɨpu o tsɨ le o tsa, “Ke ifɨ nɨ bɨng bə mɛdi pɨ tswe nɨng abe lo yang, dɨ te ochi gbə wəkə.”
english: But when they continued asking him, he looked up and said to them, “He who is without sin among you, let him throw the first stone at her.”

jenjo: Bɨ fə o ywɛhywa son vĩ nɨng.
english: Again he stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground.

jenjo: E likə mambɨ nɨ e ji tsɨng tsɨng e yə pɨ de pəsɔ ku e ihyãfɨ wukə ku e imwə ahang. Dɨ Yeso tsɨng bɨ tsɨ tswa, pɔsɨ iye de tsɨ be pu.
english: They, when they heard it, being convicted by their conscience, went out one by one, beginning from the oldest, even to the last. Jesus was left alone with the woman where she was, in the middle.

jenjo: Bɨ Yeso tsɨpu bi wə tsa, “Iye, le bede? Ifɨ akə le mə lo?”
english: Jesus, standing up, saw her and said, “Woman, where are your accusers? Did no one condemn you?”

jenjo: Iye de kwə tsa, “Oho! Ihyãfɨ.” Yeso tsɨ wə tsa, “Mi ma n le mə lo. A tə bi fə man tswe nɨng abeyɛ.”
english: She said, “No one, Lord.” Jesus said, “Neither do I condemn you. Go your way. From now on, sin no more.”

jenjo: Fə Yeso nəbi be e Farisi tsa, “Dɨ mi kə pə akəlɨ Fangwa, fə ifɨ nɨ mwəkə nyi mi hɛ̃, on chi pɨ akəlɨ o ho bɨng tankuchiw.
english: Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”

jenjo: E Farisa bi nwa wə tsa, “A tsɨ sɨ ma nəbi ku mə be nə mə bi anɨng ywang nwa mə.”
english: The Pharisees therefore said to him, “You testify about yourself. Your testimony is not valid.”

jenjo: Yeso kwə tsa, “Kə a kəng n nəbi yang ku mi fə bi mi dɨ bi anɨng, bisɨ n yi pɨnɨ n jikə lə nɨ yang be pɨnɨ min təkə nɨ. Be ba yi pɨ nɨ n jikə lə nɨ lo, be pɨnɨ min təkə nɨ.
english: Jesus answered them, “Even if I testify about myself, my testimony is true, for I know where I came from, and where I am going; but you don’t know where I came from, or where I am going.

jenjo: Sɨ ban tswe kitə bəlɨ a nɨng e ifafɨ be mi n tswe ifɨ akə kitə lo.
english: You judge according to the flesh. I judge no one.

jenjo: Aba min nə za yang min tswe hywi wə. Bisɨ dɨ mi tsɨng lo, be ta mi nɨ tũ mi nɨ tsung be mikə.
english: Even if I do judge, my judgment is true, for I am not alone, but I am with the Father who sent me.

jenjo: E vĩ tangsə Lenwa və bə tsa, aba bi ji ngwa e ifafɨ bwayung yang tsɨ yang.
english: It’s also written in your law that the testimony of two people is valid.

jenjo: Dɨ mi tsɨng bɨ sɨ min nəbi ku mi; be ifɨ nɨ yin ləkə ngwa mi nɨ dɨ Ta mi, nɨ tũ mi nɨ.”
english: I am one who testifies about myself, and the Father who sent me testifies about me.”

jenjo: E bi wə e tsa, “Ta mə de bede?” Yeso kwə nwa le tsa, “Ba yi mi lo be Ta mi. Sako a ba yi mi yang, ban yi Ta mi yi bɨ.”
english: They said therefore to him, “Where is your Father?” Jesus answered, “You know neither me, nor my Father. If you knew me, you would know my Father also.”

jenjo: Yeso nəbi nɨ le nɨng pɨfa Kwə Fi pəsəpi be pɨnɨ sen lekə wushilə lə nɨ. Lehɛ̃ e mwə wə lo bisɨ hywa wə tswe lo bɨtsɨng.
english: Jesus spoke these words in the treasury, as he taught in the temple. Yet no one arrested him, because his hour had not yet come.

jenjo: Yeso fə nəbi tsɨ le tsa, “Yi min tɨtə, yi ban bapɨ mi, fə ban bwi be nɨng abe və bə. Pɨnɨ min təkə nɨ, pa ba wu pɨ dew.”
english: Jesus said therefore again to them, “I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go, you can’t come.”

jenjo: Nɨng de tswe e iYahuda bipɨ tsa, “On yə ku wə? Dɨ nɨng nɨ tswe o tsa, pɨnɨ min təkə lə nɨ, pa ba wu pɨ dew ho?”
english: The Jews therefore said, “Will he kill himself, because he says, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come’?”

jenjo: O pe hywa be bi o tsa, “Bə dɨ e ifɨ a hywa, be mi ami n wu le dzwe. Bə dɨ e ifɨ a fangwa, mi dɨ ifɨ a fangwa lo.”
english: He said to them, “You are from beneath. I am from above. You are of this world. I am not of this world.

jenjo: N tsɨ ba yi ban bwi be nɨng abe və bə, a ba tsɨnyi tsa Dɨ Mi kə ifɨ nɨ n tsa Mi Dɨ wə nɨ lo yang. Kə akang yi ban bwi be nɨng abe və bə.”
english: I said therefore to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I am he, you will die in your sins.”

jenjo: E bi wə e tsa, “Mə dɨ wə a?” Yeso kwə nwa le tsa, “Mi Dɨ ifɨ nɨ n nə bə lə n tsikə a Mi Dɨ wə nɨ.”
english: They said therefore to him, “Who are you?” Jesus said to them, “Just what I have been saying to you from the beginning.

jenjo: Mi lə be e nɨng nɨ min le bə kə sɨ za a nəli ihyãnɨng, be ifɨ nɨ tũ mi nɨ dɨ ifɨ bi anɨng, dɨ nɨng nɨ o nə mi lə nɨ bɨ sɨ min nə Fangwa lə.”
english: I have many things to speak and to judge concerning you. However he who sent me is true; and the things which I heard from him, these I say to the world.”

jenjo: Be e yipɨ son nə le bi lə ku Ta o lo.
english: They didn’t understand that he spoke to them about the Father.

jenjo: Fə Yeso tsa, “Aba vi nɨ ba pi Yɨ ifafɨ ku gə̃lɨkə ba ta ba kipu yang, kə ba yipɨ kə akang Mi Dɨ ifɨ nɨ n tsɨka Mi Dɨ wə nɨ. Fə n tswe nɨng akə be ku mi lo, be dɨ nɨngnɨ Ta nyi mi nalə nɨ.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he, and I do nothing of myself, but as my Father taught me, I say these things.

jenjo: Ifɨ nɨ tũ mi nɨ tsung be mi, o yə mi be tsɨng mi lo. Bisɨ dɨ nɨng nɨ o yidi nɨ bɨ sɨ min tswelɨ kəvivi.”
english: He who sent me is with me. The Father hasn’t left me alone, for I always do the things that are pleasing to him.”

jenjo: Wə ku bi a nəlɨ, bɨ e ifafɨ ihyãnɨng pənyi sɨ wə.
english: As he spoke these things, many believed in him.

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ e Yahuda nɨ pənyi sɨ we nɨ tsa, “Aba ba tsɨ ku e nɨng nɨ n nyi bə na lə nɨ yang bə dɨ e mwambwi mi kə a kəng.
english: Jesus therefore said to those Jews who had believed him, “If you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples.

jenjo: Ban yipɨ və bi anɨng, fə bi anɨng yin wa bə lɨle.”
english: You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.”

jenjo: E kwə e tsa, “Bɨ dɨ e pɨnyi Ibrahim, bɨ mɛdi pɨ tswe shə və ifɨ akə lo. Tswe ngwu man tsa yin wa bɨ lele?”
english: They answered him, “We are Abraham’s offspring, and have never been in bondage to anyone. How do you say, ‘You will be made free’?”

jenjo: Yeso tsa, “Kə akang sɨ min nə bə lə, ke ifɨ nɨ tswe nɨng abe hɛ̃ wə dɨ shə və nɨng abe.
english: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, everyone who commits sin is the bondservant of sin.

jenjo: Mwənshə pa ku tangvə təkə kə a itsɨng lo. Be yɨ və dɨ və wə.
english: A bondservant doesn’t live in the house forever. A son remains forever.

jenjo: Bisɨ mambɨ ifɨ nɨ ke Yɨ de wə le yang, o chi ku wə a wə yang ho.
english: If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.

jenjo: N yipɨ yang bə dɨ pɨnyi Ibrahim. Be sɨ ban yidi pɨ yə mi, bisɨ bə yidi bi mi lo.
english: I know that you are Abraham’s offspring, yet you seek to kill me, because my word finds no place in you.

jenjo: Sɨ min nə bə lə, dɨ nɨng nɨ n bəkə sɨ Ta mi nɨ, bɨ sɨ min nə lɨ. Be bə abə sɨ ban tswe dɨ nɨng nɨ, ba likə sɨ Ta və bə nɨ.”
english: I say the things which I have seen with my Father; and you also do the things which you have seen with your father.”

jenjo: E kwə nwa wə e tsa, “Ibrahim dɨ ta və bɨ”. Yeso kwə tsa, “A bə dɨ e yɨ Ibrahim yang ke ba tswe nɨng nɨ o tswekə nɨ yang.
english: They answered him, “Our father is Abraham.” Jesus said to them, “If you were Abraham’s children, you would do the works of Abraham.

jenjo: Sɨswenɨ bə mi lə ywa bə. Sɨ ban yidi pɨ yə mi, bisɨ n nəbə bi anɨng və e nɨng nɨ n likə sɨ Fi nɨ lə yang. Ibrahim tswe mambɨ lo!
english: But now you seek to kill me, a man who has told you the truth, which I heard from God. Abraham didn’t do this.

jenjo: Dɨ nɨng nɨ ta və bə tswekə nɨ bɨ sɨ ban tswelɨ.” E kwə e tsa, “Dɨ Fi tsɨng kə ta və bɨ, fə bɨ dɨ e yɨ wə a bi anɨng.”
english: You do the works of your father.” They said to him, “We were not born of sexual immorality. We have one Father, God.”

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ le tsa, “Aba Fi dɨ ta və bə yang ke ba yidi mi yang. Dɨ mi ho nɨ n wu sɨ Fi. Dɨ sambe ku mi bɨn wukə lo, be dɨ Fi tũ mi.
english: Therefore Jesus said to them, “If God were your father, you would love me, for I came out and have come from God. For I haven’t come of myself, but he sent me.

jenjo: Dɨbə tswe ba yipɨ bi mi lo? Bisɨ ba kangtswi sɨ nɨng nɨ sɨ min nyi bə nalə nɨ lo.
english: Why don’t you understand my speech? Because you can’t hear my word.

jenjo: Bə dɨ a və ta və bə Nɨnɨngvi. Fə dɨ nɨng nɨ o yidi nɨ bɨ sɨ ban tswelɨ. Sɨ pəsɔ wə dɨ ifɨ yəbwa. On tsɨ ku bi anɨng lo, bisɨ o ywang be bi anɨng kə. Aba o nə nwayung yang, dɨ nɨng sɨ wə. Wə dɨ ifɨ nwayung, fə ta və e ifɨ nwayung.
english: You are of your father, the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning, and doesn’t stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks on his own; for he is a liar, and the father of lies.

jenjo: N nə bə bi anɨng lə, lehɛ̃ ba tsɨnyi sɨ mi lo.
english: But because I tell the truth, you don’t believe me.

jenjo: Ifɨ akə lə tangsə bə nɨ yin ta mi nə sɨ nɨng abe mi nɨ? A dɨ bi anɨng sɨ min nəlɨ yang, tswe ngwu ba tsɨnyi lə lo?
english: Which of you convicts me of sin? If I tell the truth, why do you not believe me?

jenjo: Ifɨ və Fi sɨn li bi a nəlɨ və Fi. Aba fə man li wi Fi lo yang mə dɨ a o lo.”
english: He who is of God hears the words of God. For this cause you don’t hear, because you are not of God.”

jenjo: E Yahuda kwə nwa wə tsa, “Bi nɨ bɨ tsa Mə dɨ mwɛ Samariya fə sɨ man tswe nwatũ be nɨngvi nɨ, dɨ bi anɨng lo?”
english: Then the Jews answered him, “Don’t we say well that you are a Samaritan, and have a demon?”

jenjo: Bɨ Yeso tsa, “N ywang be nɨngviw! Sɨ min tə Ta mi kãlɨ be sɨ bang bangkə dzung mi.
english: Jesus answered, “I don’t have a demon, but I honor my Father, and you dishonor me.

jenjo: Sɨ min yidi e ifafɨ yənwa sɨ mi lo. Be ifɨ nɨ sɨn yidi e yənwa sɨ mi nɨ dɨ wə bɨ on nə za.
english: But I don’t seek my own glory. There is one who seeks and judges.

jenjo: Kə akang sɨ min nə bə lə ke ifɨ nɨ kangtswi sɨ bi mi hɛ̃ bwa ywang ku we.”
english: Most certainly, I tell you, if a person keeps my word, he will never see death.”

jenjo: E Yahuda nəbi tsa, “Kə bi anɨng sɨswenɨ bɨ yipɨ yang nɨngvi tə yang sɨ mə! Ibrahim be nyɔ e Ilinwa bwi yang. Lehɛ̃ a tsa, ifɨ nɨ li bi mə tswekə nwatũ yang o pang bwilɨw.
english: Then the Jews said to him, “Now we know that you have a demon. Abraham died, and the prophets; and you say, ‘If a man keeps my word, he will never taste of death.’

jenjo: Be mə dɨ wə de? Papa və bɨ Ibrahim bwi yang be e nyɔ e ilinwa a pe le yang?”
english: Are you greater than our father, Abraham, who died? The prophets died. Who do you make yourself out to be?”

jenjo: Yeso kwə tsa, “Aba n tə ku mi kãlɨ yang, kãlɨ mi dɨ nɨng akə lo. Ta mi nɨ ba tswe sɨfɨ̃ ba tsa wə dɨ Ta və bə nɨ, dɨ wə bɨ o tə mi kãlɨ.
english: Jesus answered, “If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing. It is my Father who glorifies me, of whom you say that he is our God.

jenjo: Ba yi wə lo, be n yi wə yang. Aba n tsa n yi wə lo yang, n myɛkə ifɨ nwayung yang ma və bə. Be n yi wə yang, fə sɨ min linwa wə.
english: You have not known him, but I know him. If I said, ‘I don’t know him,’ I would be like you, a liar. But I know him, and keep his word.

jenjo: Ta və bə Ibrahim bɛ bisɨ o bə yɨng a vi wulɨ mi yang. O bə fə o li lalɨ.”
english: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day. He saw it, and was glad.”

jenjo: E Yahuda tsa, “Ha mə tswe nwuyung ji hywə lo, bɨ a tsa a bə Ibrahim yang?”
english: The Jews therefore said to him, “You are not yet fifty years old, and have you seen Abraham?”

jenjo: Yeso kwə tsa, “Pəko chilɨ və Ibrahim, Mi n lə!”
english: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, before Abraham came into existence, I AM.”

jenjo: Bisɨ mambɨ e Yahuda bwi te e yidi pɨ gbə wə yəlɨ. Bɨ o ywe o pa tangsə le o yə Kwə Fi.
english: Therefore they took up stones to throw at him, but Jesus was hidden, and went out of the temple, having gone through the middle of them, and so passed by.

jenjo: Fə Yeso wu sɨn pelɨ ho, bɨ o bə ibwi akə nɨ e chi wə kə inɨnggba.
english: As he passed by, he saw a man blind from birth.

jenjo: E mwambwi o bi wə tsa, “Itwevə, dɨ wə tswe nɨng abe bɨ e chi ibwi nɨ kə inɨnggba? Dɨ wə be ku wə? Alo dɨ e ichilɨ wə?”
english: His disciples asked him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?”

jenjo: Yeso tsa “O tswe nɨng abe lo, e ichilɨ wə tswe lo. Be e chi wə kə inɨnggba hebilə e ta na sɨ nwatũ tsɨkunɨng və Fi ku wə.
english: Jesus answered, “Neither did this man sin, nor his parents; but, that the works of God might be revealed in him.

jenjo: Tɔle bɨ tswe nwatũ və ifɨ nɨ tũ mi kə nɨ, be nyɔ pɨ akəlɨ. Pɨ nvi sɨn wulɨ, ifɨ nɨ yin tswekə nwatũ nɨ ywang.
english: I must work the works of him who sent me, while it is day. The night is coming, when no one can work.

jenjo: Aba n lə Fangwa bɨtsɨng yang, dɨ mi kə pɨ akəlɨ Fangwa.”
english: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”

jenjo: O nə mambɨ nɨ bɨ o tu chichi hywa o bwɛ, o nu ibwi de nɨng wə
english: When he had said this, he spat on the ground, made mud with the saliva, anointed the blind man’s eyes with the mud,

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ wə tsa, “Tə a lo nɨng mə bwa nvɔ Siluwam.” Nwata və dzung de ho kə “Pɨtũpɨ.” Bɨ ibwi de tə lo nɨng wə, o fə o wu son bəpɨ.
english: and said to him, “Go, wash in the pool of Siloam” (which means “Sent”). So he went away, washed, and came back seeing.

jenjo: E ifɨ kwangki o, be e ifɨ nɨ ka akywi yi wə son kũnɨng nɨ bipɨ tsa, “Dɨ ibwi nɨ ku sɨn kũkənɨng tɨtɛ nɨ lo?”
english: The neighbors therefore, and those who saw that he was blind before, said, “Isn’t this he who sat and begged?”

jenjo: E ifɨ akə tsa, “Dɨ wə.” E ifɨ akə tsa, “Oho, e jisə ji.” Be ibwi de be ku wə tsa, “Dɨ mi.”
english: Others were saying, “It is he.” Still others were saying, “He looks like him.” He said, “I am he.”

jenjo: E bi wə e tsa, “Tswe nwu nɨng mə sɨn bəpɨ?”
english: They therefore were asking him, “How were your eyes opened?”

jenjo: O tsa, “Ibwi nɨ sen dzukə a Yeso nɨ, dɨ wə bɨ o bwɛ hywa o nu nɨng mi. O tsɨ mi tə n lo nɨng mi bwa nvɔ Siluwam. Dɨbɨ tə n lo nɨng mi. Lelang bɨ nɨng mi pəsɔ pɨ bəpɨ.”
english: He answered, “A man called Jesus made mud, anointed my eyes, and said to me, ‘Go to the pool of Siloam, and wash.’ So I went away and washed, and I received sight.”

jenjo: E bi wə e tsa, “Yə ibwi de be de?” O tsa, “N yipɨ lo.”
english: Then they asked him, “Where is he?” He said, “I don’t know.”

jenjo: E wu be inɨnggba de sɨ e Farisa.
english: They brought him who had been blind to the Pharisees.

jenjo: Dɨ vi hũlɨ bɨ Yeso bwɛ hywa nu nɨng ibwi de, bɨ nɨng wə be.
english: It was a Sabbath when Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.

jenjo: Bɨ e Farisa fə bi wə tsa, “Tswe nwu nɨng mə sɨn bəpɨlɨ?” O kwə nwa le o tsa, “O bwɛ bɨbɔ o nu nɨng mi, tə n lo nɨng mi bɨ n pəsɔ pɨ bəpɨ.”
english: Again therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he received his sight. He said to them, “He put mud on my eyes, I washed, and I see.”

jenjo: E Farisa akə tsa, “Ibwi nɨ ji le sɨ Fi lo. Bisɨ o kang hywibi lenwa vi hũlɨ lo.” Be e ifɨ akə bipɨ tsa, “Ifɨ nɨng abe pa yin tswe e nɨng bisɨ nɨ tswe?” Nwa le wu tsɨng lo.
english: Some therefore of the Pharisees said, “This man is not from God, because he doesn’t keep the Sabbath.” Others said, “How can a man who is a sinner do such signs?” There was division among them.

jenjo: Bɨ fə e myɛchi sɨ igbanɨng nɨ chikə bəlɨ a pɨ nɨ. E tsa, “Dɨ mə bi ibwi de tswe mə nɨngbisɨ lə. Dɨ bə man nəlɨ ku wə?” Ibwi de tsa, “Wə dɨ Ilinwa.”
english: Therefore they asked the blind man again, “What do you say about him, because he opened your eyes?” He said, “He is a prophet.”

jenjo: Lehɛ̃ e Yahuda kwələ ibwi de dɨ igbanɨng lo. Bɨ fə e tũpɨ sɨ e ichilɨ wə.
english: The Jews therefore did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and had received his sight, until they called the parents of him who had received his sight,

jenjo: E bi e ichilɨ wə e tsa, “Dɨ yɨ bə nɨ? Ba tsa e chi wə kə inɨnggba? Yə tswe nwu fə son bəpɨ?”
english: and asked them, “Is this your son, whom you say was born blind? How then does he now see?”

jenjo: Bɨ e ichilɨ wə tsa, “Nɨng nɨ bɨ yipɨ nɨ, wə dɨ yɨ bɨ. Bɨ chi wə kə inɨnggba.
english: His parents answered them, “We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind;

jenjo: Be nɨhyã nɨ o chikə pɨ bəpɨ nɨ, bɨ yipɨ lo. Fə bɨ yi ifɨ nɨ bekə nɨng wə nɨ lo. Ba bi wə o gbəbang yang. O nə be nwa wə!”
english: but how he now sees, we don’t know; or who opened his eyes, we don’t know. He is of age. Ask him. He will speak for himself.”

jenjo: E ichilɨ wə nə mambɨ bisɨ sen bibi və e Yahuda. Bisɨ e Yahuda tsa, ke ifɨ nɨ tsa dɨ Yeso kə ifɨ nɨ Fi gbə wə sɔ hɛ̃, en nyə wə pɨ kwəsəku və le.
english: His parents said these things because they feared the Jews; for the Jews had already agreed that if any man would confess him as Christ, he would be put out of the synagogue.

jenjo: Dɨbɨ tswe e ichilɨ wə tsa, “O gbəbang yang, ba bi wə.”
english: Therefore his parents said, “He is of age. Ask him.”

jenjo: Bɨ fə e dzupɨ inɨnggba de a nɨng bwayung e tsa, “A bibi və Fi. Bɨ yipɨ yang, ibwi nɨ dɨ ifɨ nɨng abe.”
english: So they called the man who was blind a second time, and said to him, “Give glory to God. We know that this man is a sinner.”

jenjo: Ibwi de tsa, “A wə dɨ ifɨ nɨng abe, alo wə dɨ ifɨ nɨng abe lo, n yipɨ lo. Nɨngnɨ n yikəpɨ nɨ, mi dɨ inɨnggba be sɨswenɨ sɨ min bəpɨ.”
english: He therefore answered, “I don’t know if he is a sinner. One thing I do know: that though I was blind, now I see.”

jenjo: E bi wə e tsa, “Dɨbə o tswe mə lə? O tswe nwu bɨ nɨng mə be?”
english: They said to him again, “What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?”

jenjo: O kwə nwa le o tsa, “N nə bə lə yang, fə ba kwələ lo. Dɨ bə sɨ ban yidi pɨ lilɨ? Ba yidi pɨ myɛkə e mwambwi o bɨ?”
english: He answered them, “I told you already, and you didn’t listen. Why do you want to hear it again? You don’t also want to become his disciples, do you?”

jenjo: E hywã jə wə e tsa, “Dɨ məkə mwambwi və ibwi nɨ! Bɨ dɨ e mwambwi və Musa!
english: They insulted him and said, “You are his disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.

jenjo: Nɨngnɨ bɨ yipɨ nɨ Fi nəbi yang be Musa, be ibwi nɨ bɨ yi pɨnɨ o jikə lə nɨ lo.”
english: We know that God has spoken to Moses. But as for this man, we don’t know where he comes from.”

jenjo: Ibwi de kwə nwa le tsa, “Nɨng tswe sɨbi! Ba yipɨ nɨ o jikə lə nɨ lo, be o be nɨng mi yang!
english: The man answered them, “How amazing! You don’t know where he comes from, yet he opened my eyes.

jenjo: Bɨ hɛ̃ bɨ yipɨ yang Fi sɨn li nwa e ifɨ nɨng abe lo. Be dɨ e ifɨ a pikang nɨ sɨn tswekə nɨng nɨ o yidi nɨ.
english: We know that God doesn’t listen to sinners, but if anyone is a worshiper of God, and does his will, he listens to him.

jenjo: Ba mɛdi pɨ li ifɨ akə be nɨng ifɨ nɨ e chi wə kə inɨnggba nɨ yang?
english: Since the world began it has never been heard of that anyone opened the eyes of someone born blind.

jenjo: A e tsa ibwi nɨ ji sɨ Fi lo yang, ke o pa o tswe nɨng akə lo.”
english: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing.”

jenjo: E kwə nwa wə e tsa, “Dɨ mə be e chi be nɨng abe, fə sɨ man yidi pɨ nyibɨ nasɨ nɨng?” Bɨ e pəku sɨ wə e nyə wə.
english: They answered him, “You were altogether born in sins, and do you teach us?” They threw him out.

jenjo: Yeso li bi və nyəlɨ nɨ e nyəkə ibwi de nɨ yang. Okwəsə be ibwi de bɨ o bi wə o tsa, “A tsɨnyi yang sɨ Yɨ Ifafɨ?”
english: Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, and finding him, he said, “Do you believe in the Son of God?”

jenjo: Ibwi de bi wə tsa, “Itwevə, dɨ wə kə Yɨ Ifafɨ de, a ta mi na sɨ wə yang min tsɨnyi mi tsɨ sɨ wə.”
english: He answered, “Who is he, Lord, that I may believe in him?”

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ wə tsa, “A bə wə yang sɨswenɨ. Kə akəng dɨ wə son nəbi be mə nɨ.”
english: Jesus said to him, “You have both seen him, and it is he who speaks with you.”

jenjo: Bɨ ibwi de tsa, “Itwemi, n tsɨnyi mi yang,” Bɨ fə ibwi de pehywa hyɔ̃ wə.
english: He said, “Lord, I believe!” and he worshiped him.

jenjo: Yeso tsa, “N wu pɨ nə za ku Fangwa, hebilə e inɨnggba bəpɨ. E ifɨ nɨ sɨn bə ma nɨng le sɨn bəpɨlə nɨ, e myɛkə e inɨnggba.”
english: Jesus said, “I came into this world for judgment, that those who don’t see may see; and that those who see may become blind.”

jenjo: E Farisa nɨ tsɨkə pɨbi likə bi o nɨ bipɨ tsa, “Bɨ dɨ e inɨnggba?”
english: Those of the Pharisees who were with him heard these things, and said to him, “Are we also blind?”

jenjo: Yeso tsa, “A sako bə dɨ e inɨnggba yang, ke ba ywang be ayibew. Be a pɨnɨ ba tsa nɨng bə sɨn bəpɨ lə nɨ, bɨ tswe ayibe və bə lə ku bə.”
english: Jesus said to them, “If you were blind, you would have no sin; but now you say, ‘We see.’ Therefore your sin remains.

jenjo: “Kə akang sɨ min nə bə lə ke ifɨ nɨ mwə nwakwə və e nɨngpungga lo hɛ̃, be o mwə ngwa feki yang wə dɨ ifɨ yinɨng be ifɨ lwe ku e ifɨ be nɨngbi.
english: “Most certainly, I tell you, one who doesn’t enter by the door into the sheep fold, but climbs up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.

jenjo: Be ifɨ nɨ mwə na nwakwə yang dɨ itwe nɨngpungga.
english: But one who enters in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

jenjo: Itsɨnɨng sɨn be wə nwakwə lə, e nɨngpungga sɨn li wi wə son dzu le be dzung le. Fə son ji be le pɨfa.
english: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name, and leads them out.

jenjo: A ba o ji be le hɛ̃ yang, o ochi le bɨ e mwə tswa wə. Bisɨ e yi wi wə yang.
english: Whenever he brings out his own sheep, he goes before them, and the sheep follow him, for they know his voice.

jenjo: E kwələ e mwə tswa idzwəwɛw. En hywi idzwəwɛ bisɨ e yi wi wə lo.”
english: They will by no means follow a stranger, but will flee from him; for they don’t know the voice of strangers.”

jenjo: Yeso dɨ nwa nəbi nəkə bi be e yipɨ nɨng de o nəkə nɨ lo.
english: Jesus spoke this parable to them, but they didn’t understand what he was telling them.

jenjo: Yeso fə tsɨ le tsa, “Kə akang sɨ min nə bə lə, dɨ mi kə nwakwə və nɨngpungga de.
english: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Most certainly, I tell you, I am the sheep’s door.

jenjo: E ifɨ nɨ o chi mi wukə nɨ hɛ̃, dɨ e ifɨ yinɨng be e ilwe ku e ifɨ be nɨngbi. Be e nɨngpungga la pɨ kangtswi sɨ le.
english: All who came before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep didn’t listen to them.

jenjo: Mi dɨ nwakwə, ke ifɨ nɨ mwə na sɨ mi yang on jiku ji. On wu tangsə, fə on ji pɨfa pɨ bapɨ nɨngtang.
english: I am the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out, and will find pasture.

jenjo: Ifɨ yinɨng sɨn wu bisɨ yilɨ anɨng, be yəlɨ apɨ be banglɨ a nɨng. N wu bisɨ e chi hũlɨ, e hũ kə a itsɨng.
english: The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.

jenjo: Mi dɨ igbə nɨngtsa a pikang. Igbə nɨngtsa pikang sɨn tə ku wə bisɨ nɨngtsa o.
english: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

jenjo: Itsɨnɨng nɨ e dɨ wə sen fə wə nɨ, nɨngtsa de dɨ a o lo. Bisɨ mambɨ, aba o bə tantswĩ yang, on hywi on yə e nɨngtsa de. tantswĩ wu yin twe akə, fə nyɔ le yasə.
english: He who is a hired hand, and not a shepherd, who doesn’t own the sheep, sees the wolf coming, leaves the sheep, and flees. The wolf snatches the sheep, and scatters them.

jenjo: Itsɨnɨng de yin hywihywi yɨlə wə lo, bisɨ nɨngpungga de dɨ a o lo. E dɨ wə sen fə wə fə.
english: The hired hand flees because he is a hired hand, and doesn’t care for the sheep.

jenjo: “Mi dɨ igbə nɨngpungga a pikang. N yi e nɨngpungga mi yang, fə e nɨngpungga mi yi mi yang.
english: I am the good shepherd. I know my own, and I’m known by my own;

jenjo: Ma yilɨ Ta mi yi mi kə nɨ, n yi Ta de yang. Fə n tə hũlɨ mi yang, bisɨ e nɨngpungga de.
english: even as the Father knows me, and I know the Father. I lay down my life for the sheep.

jenjo: N lə be e nɨngpungga akə bɨnghu, e ywang sɨswenɨ tangsə e tsəlɨ nɨngpungga nɨ. Tɔle n wu be le bɨ. En li wi mi, en myɛkə tsəlɨ nɨngtsa tsɨng fə igbə nɨngtsa tsɨng.
english: I have other sheep, which are not of this fold. I must bring them also, and they will hear my voice. They will become one flock with one shepherd.

jenjo: Nɨngnɨ tswe Ta mi tswekəbi mi nɨ, dɨ bisɨ n tə hũlɨ mi hebilə fə n dɨ.
english: Therefore the Father loves me, because I lay down my life, that I may take it again.

jenjo: Ifɨ nɨ yin dɨkə hũlɨ mi nɨ ywang. Be mi be ku mi bɨ n tə, fə mi lə be tsɨkunɨng dɨlɨ wə. Dɨ nɨng nɨ Ta mi nə mi lə tsa mi n tswekə ho.”
english: No one takes it away from me, but I lay it down by myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. I received this commandment from my Father.”

jenjo: Bi de o nəkə nɨ tswe ku e Yahuda tsɨ tsɨng tsɨng bwa le.
english: Therefore a division arose again among the Jews because of these words.

jenjo: Dzungdzung və le e tsa, “Nɨngvi pĩ ku wə yang, dɨ bi və e ifɨ nɨng dzwinɨng son nəlɨ. Tswe nwu sɨ ban kangtswi sɨ bi o lɨ?”
english: Many of them said, “He has a demon, and is insane! Why do you listen to him?”

jenjo: Be e ifɨ akə tsa, “Bi o nɨ dɨ bi və ifɨ nɨ nɨngvi pĩkə ku wə nɨ lo. Nɨngvi pa yin be nɨng inɨnggba be ɛ?”
english: Others said, “These are not the sayings of one possessed by a demon. It isn’t possible for a demon to open the eyes of the blind, is it?”

jenjo: E wu Nɨnglang Mə Kwə Fi Tsɨ Urushalima hywa nwa ywakwang.
english: It was the Feast of the Dedication at Jerusalem.

jenjo: Yeso lə Kwə Fi, son ho son myɛkə pu lwang və Sulemanu.
english: It was winter, and Jesus was walking in the temple, in Solomon’s porch.

jenjo: E Yahuda wu kwɛ wə le tangsə, e tsa, “A nə bɨ bi anɨng lə, aba kə akang dɨ mə kə Kristi ifɨ nɨ Fi gbə wə sɔ lə nɨ. Bi man yə bɨ bɨng tangkuchi yɛ.
english: The Jews therefore came around him and said to him, “How long will you hold us in suspense? If you are the Christ, tell us plainly.”

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ le tsa, “N nə bə lə yang nwachi, be ba kwələ lo. E nɨng bisɨ nɨ sɨ min tswekə be dzung Ta mi nɨ, ta bə na lə yang mi dɨ wəde.
english: Jesus answered them, “I told you, and you don’t believe. The works that I do in my Father’s name, these testify about me.

jenjo: Be ba kwələ lo bisɨ bə dɨ e nɨngpungga mi lo.
english: But you don’t believe, because you are not of my sheep, as I told you.

jenjo: E nɨngpungga mi yi wi mi yang. N yi le yang, fə sen mwə tswa mi.
english: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.

jenjo: N tə le hũlɨ a kə itsɨng yang, bwa ywang ku le. Ifɨ akə pa twe le bwi na miw,
english: I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.

jenjo: bisɨ Ta mi tə mi le yang. Fə o pe nyɔ le yang hɛ̃ be tsalɨ. Ifɨ nɨ pa yin twe le na Ta mi yin dɨkə nɨ ywang.
english: My Father, who has given them to me, is greater than all. No one is able to snatch them out of my Father’s hand.

jenjo: Mi be ta bɨ dɨ e ifɨ a tsɨng.”
english: I and the Father are one.”

jenjo: Fə e Yahuda bwi te sen yidi pɨ gbə wə yəlɨ.
english: Therefore Jews took up stones again to stone him.

jenjo: Be Yeso tsɨ le tsa, “N tswe e nɨng bisɨ ihyãnɨng sɨ bə nɨ Ta tũ mi bisɨ wun tswekə nɨ. Dɨ bisɨ ake sɨ ban yidi pɨ gbə mi be te bisɨ wə?”
english: Jesus answered them, “I have shown you many good works from my Father. For which of those works do you stone me?”

jenjo: E kwə e tsa, “Dɨ bisɨ nɨng a kang nɨ a tswekə nɨ bɨ sɨ bɨn yidi pɨ gbə mə be te lo, be bisɨ sɨ man yɔ Fi. Mə kə ifafɨ, sɨ man dɨ ku mə kə Fi.
english: The Jews answered him, “We don’t stone you for a good work, but for blasphemy: because you, being a man, make yourself God.”

jenjo: Yeso kwə nwa le tsa, “Nəlɨ nɨ Fi tsa, ‘Dɨ mi n nə, bə dɨ e fi’ nɨ, e vĩ tangsə dəlo Lenwa və bə lo?
english: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t it written in your law, ‘I said, you are gods?’

jenjo: E ifɨ nɨ bi və Fi wukə sɨ le nɨ, son dzu le e fi. Fə bɨ yipɨ yang bi və Fi dɨ bi anɨng.
english: If he called them gods, to whom the word of God came (and the Scripture can’t be broken),

jenjo: Aba mambɨ yang, mi a mi nɨ dɨ Fi bə mi dɨ bɨ tũ mi n wu Fangwa nɨ, tswe nwu ba tsa sɨ min yɔ Fi nɨ n tsa ‘Mi dɨ Yɨ Fi nɨ?’
english: do you say of him whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, ‘You blaspheme,’ because I said, ‘I am the Son of God?’

jenjo: Aba n tswe nwatũ nɨ ta mi tswekə nɨ lo yang, bi ban tsɨnyi sɨ mi yɛ.
english: If I don’t do the works of my Father, don’t believe me.

jenjo: Be aba sɨ mɨn tswe nwatũ və ta mi de, lehɛ̃ ba la pɨ tsɨnyi sɨ mi lɨ yang, ba tsɨnyi sɨ e nɨng bisɨ nɨ sɨ min tswekə nɨ. Hebilə ba bə fə ba yipɨ Ta ku sɨ mi, fə n ku le sɨ wə.”
english: But if I do them, though you don’t believe me, believe the works; that you may know and believe that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.”

jenjo: Bɨ fə e yidi pɨ mwə wə, be o pa tangsə le o ji.
english: They sought again to seize him, and he went out of their hand.

jenjo: Dɨbɨ Yeso fə hyã tə nwa mɨng Urdun pɨnɨ nani Yohana tswe e ifafɨ Bɔtismɔ lə nɨ. Tə o ku pɨbi.
english: He went away again beyond the Jordan into the place where John was baptizing at first, and there he stayed.

jenjo: E ifafɨ kə dzungdzung wu sɨ wə. E tsa, “Yohana tswe e nɨng bisɨ lo be e nɨng nɨ o nəkə ku ibwi nɨ dɨ bi anɨng.”
english: Many came to him. They said, “John indeed did no sign, but everything that John said about this man is true.”

jenjo: E ifafɨ ihyãnɨng tsɨnyi sɨ Yeso pɨbi.
english: Many believed in him there.

jenjo: Ibwi akə dzung wə a Lazaru, o lwe nɨngshi. Dzung və le a Betani pɨnɨ Maryamu be hywĩ wə Mata jikə lə nɨ.
english: Now a certain man was sick, Lazarus from Bethany, of the village of Mary and her sister, Martha.

jenjo: Dɨ Maryamu kə iye nɨ chi nɨ yin se nywi ye mumu tswapu Yeso, fə on nu be tsaku wə nɨ. Dɨ wə bɨ hywĩ wə Lazaru lwe nɨngshi.
english: It was that Mary who had anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother, Lazarus, was sick.

jenjo: Bɨ e hywĩ wə a iye de tũpɨ sɨ Yeso e tsa, “Itwebɨ, ifɨ nɨ sɨ man tswebi o kə achɛ̃ nɨ lwe nɨngshi.”
english: The sisters therefore sent to him, saying, “Lord, behold, he for whom you have great affection is sick.”

jenjo: Yeso tsa, “Nɨngshi nɨ dɨ a tɨng hũlɨ wə lo. Be bisɨ tə Fi kãlɨ, fə nasɨ wə Yɨ Fi chi kãlɨ lə bɨ.”
english: But when Jesus heard it, he said, “This sickness is not to death, but for the glory of God, that God’s Son may be glorified by it.”

jenjo: Yeso sɨn tswebi və Mata be hywĩ wə Maryamu be Lazaru.
english: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.

jenjo: Lehɛ̃ o likə nwa nɨngshi və Lazaru nɨ o zɨngpu vi bwayung pɨbi.
english: When therefore he heard that he was sick, he stayed two days in the place where he was.

jenjo: Bɨ o tsɨ e mwambwi o tsa, “Fə bɨ tə Yahudiya.”
english: Then after this he said to the disciples, “Let’s go into Judea again.”

jenjo: E mwambwi o bi wə tsa, “Itwevə, tswilo nɨ e Yahuda yidi pɨ gbə mə be te pɨbi, bɨ fə a yidi pɨ fə tə pɨde ɛ”
english: The disciples told him, “Rabbi, the Jews were just trying to stone you, and are you going there again?”

jenjo: Yeso kwə nwa le tsa, “Tɨtɛ jilɨ və fi be olɨ wə awa bwahywə ji yung lo? Ke ifɨ nɨ ho be fi yang, pu sɨn gbə wə lo, bisɨ son bə pɨ akəlɨ Fangwa.”
english: Jesus answered, “Aren’t there twelve hours of daylight? If a man walks in the day, he doesn’t stumble, because he sees the light of this world.

jenjo: Be dɨ ifɨ nɨ sɨn hokə be nvi nɨ bɨ pu sɨn gbə wə, bisɨ pɨ akəlɨ ywang sɨ wəw.”
english: But if a man walks in the night, he stumbles, because the light isn’t in him.”

jenjo: Tswa bi de o nəkə nɨ, bɨ o tsɨ e mwambwi o tsa, “Tswə bɨ Lazaru lwe nɨnglwe yang, be tə min yi be wə nɨnglwe.”
english: He said these things, and after that, he said to them, “Our friend, Lazarus, has fallen asleep, but I am going so that I may awake him out of sleep.”

jenjo: E mwambwi o kwə nwa wə tsa, “Itwevə aba o lwe nɨnglwe yang, on yi hywa nɨngshi.”
english: The disciples therefore said, “Lord, if he has fallen asleep, he will recover.”

jenjo: Yeso dɨ nwabi sɨn nəbi a bwilɨ və Lazaru, be e mwambwi o dɨ tsɨkə nɨnglwe.
english: Now Jesus had spoken of his death, but they thought that he spoke of taking rest in sleep.

jenjo: Bɨ o ji nɨngfa o nə le lə o tsa, “Lazaru bwiyang.
english: So Jesus said to them plainly then, “Lazarus is dead.

jenjo: Be n li lalɨ yang nɨ n ywang pɨbi nɨ. Hĩkwã sɨ bə hebilə ba pənyi. Bɨ tə sɨ wə.”
english: I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, so that you may believe. Nevertheless, let’s go to him.”

jenjo: Bɨ Toma nɨ sen dzukə a “Yɨzɛ̃” nɨ tsa, “Bɨ tə, hebilə tə bɨ bwi tsung be wə.”
english: Thomas therefore, who is called Didymus, said to his fellow disciples, “Let’s go also, that we may die with him.”

jenjo: Hywapɨnɨ Yeso wukə nɨ, e chwi Lazaru yang pu wə bwanyə tũ.
english: So when Jesus came, he found that he had been in the tomb four days already.

jenjo: Yilɨ Betani təkə Urushalima tswisəw, nasɨ wə ho kilomita bwatə.
english: Now Bethany was near Jerusalem, about fifteen stadia away.

jenjo: E iYahuda ihyãnɨng wu sɨ Mata be Maryamu pɨ tsa nabwa və hywĩ le.
english: Many of the Jews had joined the women around Martha and Mary, to console them concerning their brother.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ Mata li e tsa Yeso sɨn wukə nɨ, bɨ o ji tə o kwə ku wə. Be Maryamu ku tang ve.
english: Then when Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went and met him, but Mary stayed in the house.

jenjo: Mata tsɨ Yeso tsa, “Itwemi e tsa sako a lə yang ke hywĩ mi bwi lo.
english: Therefore Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.

jenjo: Be n yipɨ yang nɨng nɨ a kũkə sɨ Fi hɛ̃, Fi yin tə mə tə.”
english: Even now I know that, whatever you ask of God, God will give you.”

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ wə tsa, “Hywĩ mə yin yiyi.”
english: Jesus said to her, “Your brother will rise again.”

jenjo: Mata kwə nwa wə tsa, “N yipɨ yang, nyitɨngku vi a yilɨ on yiyi tũ”
english: Martha said to him, “I know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day.”

jenjo: Yeso fə tsɨ Mata tsa, “Dɨ mi be tsɨkunɨng yi be ifɨ tũ, be təlɨ a hũlɨ. Ke ifɨ nɨ pənyi sɨ mi hɛ̃, aba o bwi yang on yiyi.
english: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies.

jenjo: Fə e ifɨ nɨ kulə be hũlɨ fə pənyi sɨ mi nɨ, bwa ywang be tsɨkunɨng ku lew. A kwə bi mi yang?”
english: Whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?”

jenjo: Mata kwə nwa wə o tsa, “N kwələ yang Itwemi. Dɨ mə kə Kristi Yɨ Fi nɨ yin wukə Fangwa nɨ.”
english: She said to him, “Yes, Lord. I have come to believe that you are the Christ, God’s Son, he who comes into the world.”

jenjo: Mata nə bi tɨngkə nɨ bɨ fə tə o dzupɨ hywĩ wə Maryamu nggwa tsɨng. O tsɨ wə o tsa, “Inyinasɨnɨng wu yang fə son bipɨ mə.”
english: When she had said this, she went away, and called Mary, her sister, secretly, saying, “The Teacher is here, and is calling you.”

jenjo: Maryamu likə bi de nɨ, bɨ o holə o tə sɨ wə.
english: When she heard this, she arose quickly, and went to him.

jenjo: Yeso tə tangsə kɔye de lo bɨtsɨng, o tsɨ pɨnɨ Mata yə wə lə nɨ.
english: Now Jesus had not yet come into the village, but was in the place where Martha met him.

jenjo: E Yahuda nɨ kukə tsung pɨ tsa nabwa bə Maryamu holə jikə nɨ, e mwə tswa wə sen tsɨ a le on tə tũ pɨ tata.
english: Then the Jews who were with her in the house, and were consoling her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up quickly and went out, followed her, saying, “She is going to the tomb to weep there.”

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ Maryamu wukə pɨnɨ Yeso pɨbi o bəkə Yeso nɨ, bɨ tə o pə dzwang wə hywa pɨpi we o tsa, “Itwemi, e tsa sako a lə yang ke hywĩ mi bwi lo.”
english: Therefore when Mary came to where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying to him, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.”

jenjo: Hywapɨnɨ Yeso bə son tata, fə e Yahuda nɨ wukə tsung be wə sɨn tata nɨ, bi shi wə kwang wə yi sɨ wə.
english: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews weeping who came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled,

jenjo: O bi le tsa, “Ba tswi wə le pɨ ake?” E tsɨ wa, “Itwebɨ a wu a bə.”
english: and said, “Where have you laid him?” They told him, “Lord, come and see.”

jenjo: Bɨ Yeso ta gə̃mi.
english: Jesus wept.

jenjo: E Yahuda tsa, “Kə o tswebi və Lazaru yang.”
english: The Jews therefore said, “See how much affection he had for him!”

jenjo: Be e ifɨ akə bɨngsə le tsa, “Dɨ ibwi nɨ sɨn be nɨng e inɨnggba lo? Tswe nwu o nyə bwa pɨ dɨ Lazaru lo?”
english: Some of them said, “Couldn’t this man, who opened the eyes of him who was blind, have also kept this man from dying?”

jenjo: Fə bi shi Yeso, bɨ o ho o tə nwa tũ. E ha tũ de sɨ te, bɨ e ke te e chikə nwa bwa de.
english: Jesus therefore, again groaning in himself, came to the tomb. Now it was a cave, and a stone lay against it.

jenjo: O tsa, “Ba ke te ba yə nwa bwa.” Mata iye nɨ bwa yəkə hywĩ wə nɨ tsa, “Itwemi, manɨ o hywi o bangkə yang bisɨ e tswi wə be pu bwanyə jɛnɨ.”
english: Jesus said, “Take away the stone.” Martha, the sister of him who was dead, said to him, “Lord, by this time there is a stench, for he has been dead four days.”

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ wə tsa, “N tsɨ bə a ba pənyi yang, yi ban bə kãlɨ və Fi bə”
english: Jesus said to her, “Didn’t I tell you that if you believed, you would see God’s glory?”

jenjo: Bɨ e ke te e yə nwa bwa. Bɨ Yeso dɨ ku wə yikə dzwe o tsa, “Ta n kã mə bisɨ a li mi yang.
english: So they took away the stone from the place where the dead man was lying. Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, “Father, I thank you that you listened to me.

jenjo: N yipɨ yang sɨ mə li mi kə vivi, be sɨ min nə bi nɨ bisɨ e ifɨ nɨ tsɨkə pɨnɨ. Hebilə e pənyi le tsa dɨ mə bɨ a tũ mi.”
english: I know that you always listen to me, but because of the multitude standing around I said this, that they may believe that you sent me.”

jenjo: O nəbi de tɨngkə nɨ, bɨ o dzupɨ be wi o tsa, “Lazaru, yi a ji.”
english: When he had said this, he cried with a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”

jenjo: Ifɨ nɨ bwikə nɨ ji tũ. Kəna wə be kəpu wə e bɨng be nɨng tswi bwa fə nɨnji akə ki mpwəchi wə. Yeso tsɨ le tsa, “Ba pĩ nɨng tswi bwa, ba le wə na o tə.”
english: He who was dead came out, bound hand and foot with wrappings, and his face was wrapped around with a cloth. Jesus said to them, “Free him, and let him go.”

jenjo: E Yahuda ihyãnɨng nɨ wu pɨ tsa Maryamu bəkə nɨng nɨ Yeso tswekə nɨ, bɨ pənyi sɨ wə.
english: Therefore many of the Jews, who came to Mary and saw what Jesus did, believed in him.

jenjo: Be e ifɨ akə tangsə le tə nə e Farisa e nɨngnɨ YFeso tswekə nɨ lə.
english: But some of them went away to the Pharisees, and told them the things which Jesus had done.

jenjo: Bɨ e ihyãfɨ hyɔ̃nɨng be e Farisa dzupFɨ kulɨ a hywa və e ifɨ Fadə. E bipɨ e tsa, “Dɨ bə kə nwatũ və bɨ a? Ibwi nɨ wu sɨn tswe e nɨng bisɨ ihyãnɨng.
english: The chief priests therefore and the Pharisees gathered a council, and said, “What are we doing? For this man does many signs.

jenjo: Aba bɨ kye bɨ tsɨ nɨng sɨ wə yang, e ifafɨ hɛ̃ yin pənyi sɨ wə. Fə e Roma wu yin bangkə Kwə Fi və bɨ, be e ifɨ və bɨ hɛ̃.”
english: If we leave him alone like this, everyone will believe in him, and the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation.”

jenjo: Tsɨng tangsə le nɨ en dzukə a Kayafa fə dɨ wə kə ivə hyɔ̃nɨng ha de nɨ nəbi tsa, “Ba yipɨ nɨng akə lo!
english: But a certain one of them, Caiaphas, being high priest that year, said to them, “You know nothing at all,

jenjo: Pe bə lə yang, ifɨ tsɨng bwi bisɨ e ifɨ. A pɨnɨ hywa hɛ̃ ku le tə yin lakə nɨ.”
english: nor do you consider that it is advantageous for us that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation not perish.”

jenjo: Bi nɨ Kayafa nəkə nɨ dɨ bi anyilɨ o lo. Be bisɨ dɨ wə kə ihyãfɨ hyɔ̃nɨng a ha de, o o chi o nə nwa bwilɨ və Yeso bisɨ e ifɨ hywa Yahuda hɛ̃.
english: Now he didn’t say this of himself, but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus would die for the nation,

jenjo: Dɨ bisɨ hywa Yahuda yinfa lo, be e nyɔ e ifɨ və Fi nɨ fĩ lopɨ nɨ. Fə o wu be le, e myɛkə e ifɨ a tsɨng.
english: and not for the nation only, but that he might also gather together into one the children of God who are scattered abroad.

jenjo: Dɨlə vi de sen kwa wə pɨ yəlɨ.
english: So from that day forward they took counsel that they might put him to death.

jenjo: Bisɨ mambɨ Yeso ywe ku wə fə o ho nɨngfa lo. Son ho na nwakəhu. O tə və a bɨnghu nɨ en dzukə a Ifremu nɨ, o ku pɨbi be e mwambwi o.
english: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews, but departed from there into the country near the wilderness, to a city called Ephraim. He stayed there with his disciples.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ hywa nɨnglang hyãlɨ və e Yahuda kyə̃pɨ nɨ, e ifafɨ hywa hɛ̃ sen tə Urushalima bisɨ nɨnglang wədzwa kĩlɨ.
english: Now the Passover of the Jews was at hand. Many went up from the country to Jerusalem before the Passover, to purify themselves.

jenjo: Sen bapɨ Yeso nɨng pɨfa Kwə Fi sen bipɨ sen tsa, “Dɨ bə sɨ ban nəlɨ a? O wu pɨ nɨnglang nɨ wa?”
english: Then they sought for Jesus and spoke one with another, as they stood in the temple, “What do you think—that he isn’t coming to the feast at all?”

jenjo: Be e ihyãfɨ hyɔ̃nɨng be e Farisa tənwa tsa, ke ifɨ nɨ bə wə hɛ̃ nə, hebilə e mwə wə.
english: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had commanded that if anyone knew where he was, he should report it, that they might seize him.

jenjo: Nyɔ vi nɨnglang hyãlɨ pu hywĩtsɨng, bɨ Yeso fə tə Betani. Le pɨbɨ bɨ Yeso yi be Lazaru tũ.
english: Then six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, who had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.

jenjo: E ywi nɨngtang pɨbi bisɨ e mwə Yeso dzwəwɛ. Mata sɨn tsə nɨngtang, Lazaru lə tangsə e ifɨ nɨ kukə nwaji be Yeso nɨ.
english: So they made him a supper there. Martha served, but Lazarus was one of those who sat at the table with him.

jenjo: Bɨ hywĩ le Maryamu dɨ la nywi ye mumu wukə. Nywi de e kə̃ be naldi fə sede sɨ wə kã manɨ. O wukə nɨ bɨ o se nywi de kəpu Yeso fə o mwə tsaku wə son nukə. Kũ nywi de dɨ tangvə de hɛ̃.
english: Mary, therefore, took a pound of ointment of pure nard, very precious, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair. The house was filled with the fragrance of the ointment.

jenjo: Be tsɨng tangsə e mwambwi o nɨ en dzukə a Yahuda Iskaliyoti nɨ tswa wu yin təkə mwə o nɨ tsa,
english: Then Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, one of his disciples, who would betray him, said,

jenjo: “Tswe nwu e dɨ nywi nɨ e jə e dɨ sede sɨ wə e pələ e ifɨ ibe lo? Sede sɨ wə lo sede ngwatũ a ha tsɨng yang.”
english: “Why wasn’t this ointment sold for three hundred denarii, and given to the poor?”

jenjo: Bi de o nəkə nɨ, dɨ bisɨ son bəshi və e ibe ifɨ lo. Be wə dɨ ifɨ yinɨng, dɨ wə bɨ ho tsɨ sede na wə. Son dɨlə pɨbi son lakə fɨ ake.
english: Now he said this, not because he cared for the poor, but because he was a thief, and having the money box, used to steal what was put into it.

jenjo: Yeso kwə tsa, “Ba yə nɨhyã və iye nɨ. E tsɨbi sɨ wə tsɨ. O tsɨ nywi nɨ bisɨ vi nɨ en tswi mi kə nɨ.
english: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. She has kept this for the day of my burial.

jenjo: E ibe ifɨ kulə be bə kəvivi. Be mi a mi, min ku be bə min təkə lo.
english: For you always have the poor with you, but you don’t always have me.”

jenjo: E Yahuda ihyãnɨng li e tsa Yeso lə pɨbi nɨ, bɨ e wu. E wu dɨ bisɨ Yeso yinfa lo, be e yidi pɨ wu bə Lazaru nɨ Yeso yikə tũ nɨ.
english: A large crowd therefore of the Jews learned that he was there, and they came, not for Jesus’ sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.

jenjo: Bisɨ mambɨ e ihyãfɨ hyɔ̃nɨng təsə nwa e yidi pɨ yə Lazaru.
english: But the chief priests conspired to put Lazarus to death also,

jenjo: Dɨ bisɨ e Yahuda ihyãnɨng sɨn wu sɨ Yeso fə e pənyi yang sɨ wə.
english: because on account of him many of the Jews went away and believed in Jesus.

jenjo: Pɨ yi kəkə nɨ, bɨ bi o bwajang dzungdzung və e ifafɨ nɨ wukə nɨnglang nɨ, tsa Yeso ku nɨhyã sɨn ku Urushalima.
english: On the next day a great multitude had come to the feast. When they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,

jenjo: Bɨ e bwi yang kəvɨ̃ e ji pɨ tə kwə ku wə nɨhyã. Sen ki nwakwang sen tsa, “Yənwa tsikə a və Fi kəachɛ̃! Ifɨ nɨ Itwebɨ tũkə nɨ, wə dɨ ifɨ parkə!” Ivə və e Israila dɨ ifɨ parkə!”
english: they took the branches of the palm trees, and went out to meet him, and cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord, the King of Israel!”

jenjo: Yeso mwə yɨ wande bɨ pĩ ku ku wə. Nɨng de tswe ma nɨng nɨ e vĩkə tang dəro e tsa,
english: Jesus, having found a young donkey, sat on it. As it is written,

jenjo: “Bi ban bibi yɛ, e ifɨ a Urushalima. Ba bə ivə və bə sɨn wulɨ le. O ku ku yɨ wande.”
english: “Don’t be afraid, daughter of Zion. Behold, your King comes, sitting on a donkey’s colt.”

jenjo: Hywapɨde e mwambwi o yipɨ lo. Be tswa nɨ e yi be Yeso be kãlɨ o nɨ, bɨ bi de o le, ke e nɨngnɨ e vĩkə ku Yeso nɨ, tswe yang kə akang.
english: His disciples didn’t understand these things at first, but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things were written about him, and that they had done these things to him.

jenjo: E ifɨ nɨ tsung be wə hywa pɨnɨ o dzupɨ Lazaru yikə tũ nɨ, sen nəbi o sen myɛkə.
english: The multitude therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of the tomb, and raised him from the dead, was testifying about it.

jenjo: E ifɨ ihyãnɨng likə nɨng tswe sɨbi nɨ o tswekə nɨ, e ji sen tə sɨ wə.
english: For this cause also the multitude went and met him, because they heard that he had done this sign.

jenjo: E Farisa nəsələ bwa le e tsa, “Dɨ ibe anfa sɨ bɨn tswelɨ nɨ. Ba bə e ifɨ hɛ̃ sen mwə tswa wə!”
english: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, “See how you accomplish nothing. Behold, the world has gone after him.”

jenjo: E Helina akə lə tangsə e ifɨ nɨ wukə pɨ nɨnglang hyɔ̃lɨ a Fi nɨ.
english: Now there were certain Greeks among those that went up to worship at the feast.

jenjo: E wu sɨ Filibu mwɛ Basheda hywa Galili. E kũ nɨhyã sɨ wə e tsa, “Ihyãfɨ sɨ bɨn yidi pɨ bə Yeso.”
english: These, therefore, came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida of Galilee, and asked him, saying, “Sir, we want to see Jesus.”

jenjo: Filibu tə nə Andirawu lə. Bɨ Andirawu be Filibu nya tə nə Yeso lə.
english: Philip came and told Andrew, and in turn, Andrew came with Philip, and they told Jesus.

jenjo: Yeso kwə tsa, “Hywapɨ tswe yang nɨ en tə Yɨ Ifafɨ kãlɨ nɨ.
english: Jesus answered them, “The time has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.

jenjo: Kə akəng sɨ min nə bə lə, aba nɨng pyənɨng tə hywa lo fə bwi lo yang, on tsɨ mambɨ yiku wə ywang. Be aba o bwi yang, on tə pyənɨng ihyãnɨng.
english: Most certainly I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains by itself alone. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.

jenjo: Ke ifɨ nɨ kang hũlɨ wə hɛ̃ hũlɨ wə yin lɨla be ifɨ nɨ la hũlɨ wə Fangwa nɨ yang on chi hũlɨ a kə a itsɨng.
english: He who loves his life will lose it. He who hates his life in this world will keep it to eternal life.

jenjo: Ke ifɨ nɨ tswe shə mi hɛ̃ tɔle o mwə tswa mi. Fə pɨnɨ mi pɨbi nɨ, shə mi yin ku pɨbi. Fə Ta mi yin tə ifɨ nɨ tswe shə mi nɨ kãlɨ.
english: If anyone serves me, let him follow me. Where I am, there will my servant also be. If anyone serves me, the Father will honor him.

jenjo: Sɨswenɨ nyi mi tsɨkə dzwa. Yə min nə min tsa bə de? N tsa, ‘Ta a wa mi a le sɨ hywapɨ ibe nɨ? Oho! Kə dɨ nɨngnɨ wu be mi fangwa ho, bisɨ wu n tswe ibe.
english: “Now my soul is troubled. What shall I say? ‘Father, save me from this time?’ But for this cause I came to this time.

jenjo: Ta, a tə dzung mə kãlɨ!” Bɨ e li wi akə dzwe tsa, “N tə dzung mi kãlɨ yang, fə min yiku təlɨ a dzung mi kãlɨ.”
english: Father, glorify your name!” Then there came a voice out of the sky, saying, “I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.”

jenjo: Dzungdzung və e ifafɨ nɨ pɨbi likə wi de nɨ tsa dɨ gafɨ̃ bɨ gba. E ifɨ akə tsa, dɨ ikwətũ və Fi dzwe bɨ nə bi be wə.
english: The multitude therefore, who stood by and heard it, said that it had thundered. Others said, “An angel has spoken to him.”

jenjo: Yeso nə bi tsa, “Wi nɨ wu dɨ bisɨ bə, dɨ bisɨ mi lo.
english: Jesus answered, “This voice hasn’t come for my sake, but for your sakes.

jenjo: Sɨswenɨ dɨ hywa nə za ku fangwa ho. Hywapɨnɨ en nyəkə Nɨnɨngvi itsɨkunɨng Fangwa ku kəzɛ̃ nɨ tswe yang.
english: Now is the judgment of this world. Now the prince of this world will be cast out.

jenjo: Be sapɨnɨ e ta mi e ki pu ku gə̃lɨkə yang, min fɨ e ifafɨ hɛ̃ min wukə sɨ mi.”
english: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.”

jenjo: O nə mambɨ bisɨ o ta na sɨ nɨhyã bwilɨ nɨ on bwikə nɨ.
english: But he said this, signifying by what kind of death he should die.

jenjo: E ifafɨ nəbi tsa, “Bɨ li tangsə Dəlo lenwa e tsa ifɨ nɨ Fi gbə wə sɔ tũkə nɨ wu yin ku kə a itsɨng. Yə tswe nwu a tsa, “Tɔle en ta Yɨ Ifafɨ en yikə dzwe ku gə̃lɨ kə? Dɨ wə kə Yɨ Ifafɨ de?”
english: The multitude answered him, “We have heard out of the law that the Christ remains forever. How do you say, ‘The Son of Man must be lifted up?’ Who is this Son of Man?”

jenjo: Yeso nə le bi lə tsa, “Pɨ akəlɨ lə sɨ bə təkə nalə tswəni. Ba yi ba ho be pɨ akəlɨ bi tangkuchi pə sɨ bə. Bisɨ ifɨ nɨ sɨn hokə bɨng tangkuchi hɛ̃, o yi pɨnɨ son təkə lə nɨ lo.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “Yet a little while the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, that darkness doesn’t overtake you. He who walks in the darkness doesn’t know where he is going.

jenjo: Ba tsɨ nyinyi bə sɨ pɨ akəlɨ sapɨnɨ pɨ akəlɨ lə sɨ bə nɨ. Hebilə ba myɛkə e yɨ pɨ a kəlɨ.” Hywapɨnɨ Yeso nəbi tɨngkə nɨ, bɨ o ho o yə bɨng le tə o ywe ku wə.
english: While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become children of light.” Jesus said these things, and he departed and hid himself from them.

jenjo: Be e nɨng bisɨ be e nɨng tswe sɨbi nɨ Yeso tswekə nɨng le nɨ, lehɛ̃ e tsɨnyi le sɨ wə lo.
english: But though he had done so many signs before them, yet they didn’t believe in him,

jenjo: E nɨng de tswe mambɨ bisɨ nɨng nɨ Dəlo və Ilinwa Ishaya nə tsɨkə, “Itwebɨ, dɨ wə tsɨnyi sɨ bi de bɨ nəkə nɨ? Fə dɨ wə bɨ e ta wə nasɨ nwatũ nɨ kəna Itwebɨ tswekə nɨ?”
english: that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spoke, “Lord, who has believed our report? To whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?”

jenjo: Bisɨ mambɨ e tsɨnyi le lə lo. Kuma nɨng nɨ Ishaya vĩkə pɨ ake tsa,
english: For this cause they couldn’t believe, for Isaiah said again,

jenjo: “Itwebɨ gba nɨng le yang, fə nyinyi le pə tangchi yang. Nɨng le fə sɨn bəpɨ lo lakə bi nyinyi le nyibi. Səko fə e wu sɨ mi n tɨng nɨngshi və le.”
english: “He has blinded their eyes and he hardened their heart, lest they should see with their eyes, and perceive with their heart, and would turn, and I would heal them.”

jenjo: Ishaya nə bi nɨ bisɨ o bə kãlɨ və Yeso yang, bɨ o nəbi ku wə.
english: Isaiah said these things when he saw his glory, and spoke of him.

jenjo: Be bi nɨ Ishaya nəkə ku wə nɨ hɛ̃, e ifɨ ihyãnɨng be e ihyãfɨ akə tangsə le tsɨnyi le sɨ wə. Be e nə nwa le pɨbi lo. Sen bibi bi e Farisa nyə le pɨ kwəsəku və le yɛ.
english: Nevertheless even of the rulers many believed in him, but because of the Pharisees they didn’t confess it, so that they wouldn’t be put out of the synagogue,

jenjo: Bisɨ sen yidi e ifafɨ yənwa sɨ le pesɨ Fi nɨ yin yənwa sɨ le nɨ.
english: for they loved men’s praise more than God’s praise.

jenjo: Bɨ Yeso nə bi be wi tsa, “Ke ifɨ nɨ tsɨ nyi wə sɨ mi yang dɨ mi tsɨng bɨ o tsɨnyi wə sɨ mi lo, be ifɨ nɨ tũ mi kə nɨ.
english: Jesus cried out and said, “Whoever believes in me, believes not in me, but in him who sent me.

jenjo: Aba o tsɨnɨng sɨ mi o bə yang, on bə ifɨ nɨ tũ mi kə nɨ.
english: He who sees me sees him who sent me.

jenjo: Dɨ mi kə pɨ akəlɨ nɨ wukə Fangwa nɨ. Hebilə ifɨ nɨ ke tsɨnyi sɨ mi hɛ̃, bi o ku bɨng tangkuchi yɛ.
english: I have come as a light into the world, that whoever believes in me may not remain in the darkness.

jenjo: “E ifafɨ nɨ likə bi mi tswekə nwatũ lo nɨ, min tswe le dɨ kitə lo. N wu pɨ le Fangwa sɨ kitə lo be bisɨ n wa le n le na sɨ kitə.
english: If anyone listens to my sayings, and doesn’t believe, I don’t judge him. For I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.

jenjo: Ifɨ nɨ la mi fə kwə bi mi lo yang, za anəlɨ lə ku wə. E bi mi nɨ n nəkə nɨ, dɨbɨ yin le wə lɨ vi kitə a kə a itsɨng.
english: He who rejects me, and doesn’t receive my sayings, has one who judges him. The word that I spoke, the same will judge him in the last day.

jenjo: Kə dɨ bi ku mi sɨ min nəlɨ lo, be dɨ nɨng nɨ Ta nɨ tũ mikə nyi mi nalə nɨ bɨ sɨ min nəlɨ be nɨhyã nɨ min nəkə nɨ.
english: For I spoke not from myself, but the Father who sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.

jenjo: N yipɨ yang, bi nɨ sɨn tə hũlɨ a kə itsɨng. Bisɨ mambɨ, e nɨngnɨ hɛ̃ n nəkə nɨ dɨ nɨngnɨ Ta tsɨ mi tsa n nəkə ho.
english: I know that his commandment is eternal life. The things therefore which I speak, even as the Father has said to me, so I speak.”

jenjo: Pəko nɨnglang hyãli kyə̃pi. Yeso yipɨ hywapɨ wu yang nɨ lɨn yəkə Fangwa fə lɨn təkə sɨ Ta nɨ. O tswebi və e ifɨ a o nɨ Fangwa nɨ, o ta le na sɨ kãlɨ tswelɨ a bi o təkə nyitɨngkuwə.
english: Now before the feast of the Passover, Jesus, knowing that his time had come that he would depart from this world to the Father, having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them to the end.

jenjo: Hywa nɨngtang a nandzwi tswe yang. Bɨ Shetan pwə Yahuda Iskariyoti yɨ Sima, bisɨ tə le wə tə.
english: During supper, the devil having already put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray him,

jenjo: Yeso yipɨ yang Ta o tə wə tsɨkunɨng ku nyɔ e nɨng yang hɛ̃. O wu le sɨ Fi fə son tə sɨ Fi.
english: Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he came from God, and was going to God,

jenjo: Bɨ Yeso yi nwa nɨngtang de. O fə nɨng yasɨ o a nɨngfa, bɨ o dɨ nɨngji, o tsə kəji wə.
english: arose from supper, and laid aside his outer garments. He took a towel, and wrapped a towel around his waist.

jenjo: O tsə nɨngji kəji wə de nɨ, bɨ o se mɨng tang tasɔ o pəsɔ pɨ lokə pu e mwambwi o. Fə o mwə nwa nɨngji nɨ o tsəkə nɨ son nukə mɨng de.
english: Then he poured water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples’ feet, and to wipe them with the towel that was wrapped around him.

jenjo: Yeso wu ku Bitulu, bɨ Bitulu tsa, “Itwemi, man lo kəpu mi?”
english: Then he came to Simon Peter. He said to him, “Lord, do you wash my feet?”

jenjo: Yeso kwə tsa, “Sɨswenɨ nɨngnɨ sɨ min tswekə nɨ a yipɨ lo, be chi nɨ yi man yipɨ yi.”
english: Jesus answered him, “You don’t know what I am doing now, but you will understand later.”

jenjo: Bitulu la tsa, “A donɨ hɛ̃, n kwələ a lo pu miw.” Yeso kwə tsa, “Aba n lo mə lo yang, mə dɨ a mi lo.”
english: Peter said to him, “You will never wash my feet!” Jesus answered him, “If I don’t wash you, you have no part with me.”

jenjo: Sima Bitulu fə tsa, “Itwemi, a mambɨ yang dɨ kəpu mi tsɨng man lolɨ lo. A lo be kəna mi be ku mi hɛ̃!”
english: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head!”

jenjo: Yeso kwə nwa wə tsa, “Ifɨ nɨ we mɨng yang, dɨ kəpu wə bɨ sɨn yidi lolɨ, bisɨ nyɔ sɨ wə kĩkĩ. Ba dɨ e ifɨ a kĩlɨ, be n pwɔ bə hɛ̃ lo.
english: Jesus said to him, “Someone who has bathed only needs to have his feet washed, but is completely clean. You are clean, but not all of you.”
