jenjo: O yipɨ yang tsɨng tangsə le bɨ yin le wə təlɨ. Dɨbɨ tswe o tsa n pwɔ bə hɛ̃ kə e ifɨ a kĩlɨ lo.
english: For he knew him who would betray him, therefore he said, “You are not all clean.”

jenjo: O lo kəpu le tɨngkə nɨ, bɨ o dɨ nɨng yasɨ o o ya fə o tə pɨ kulɨ o. Bɨ o bi le o tsa, “Nɨngnɨ n tswe bə lə nɨ ba yipɨ yang?”
english: So when he had washed their feet, put his outer garment back on, and sat down again, he said to them, “Do you know what I have done to you?

jenjo: “Sɨ ban dzu mi a inyinasɨnɨng be Itwebə. Dɨ bi anɨng və bə, bisɨ mambɨ kə akang.
english: You call me, ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord.’ You say so correctly, for so I am.

jenjo: Ma lolɨ mi inyinasɨnɨng be itwebə n lokə kəpu bə nɨ, ba losə kəpu mambɨ.
english: If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet.

jenjo: N le bə nɨhyã hywa ba myɛ sɨ mi, ba tswe ma tswelɨ n tswe bə lə nɨ.
english: For I have given you an example, that you also should do as I have done to you.

jenjo: Bi anɨng sɨ min nə bə lə, shə pe itwevə o lo. Mambɨ ikwətũ pe ifɨ nɨ tũ wəkə nɨ lo.
english: Most certainly I tell you, a servant is not greater than his lord, neither one who is sent greater than he who sent him.

jenjo: Sɨswenɨ nɨ ba yipɨ e nɨngnɨ nɨ, aba ba tswe le yang, ban chi parkə chi.
english: If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.

jenjo: “Sɨ min tsɨ dɨ bə hɛ̃ lo. N yi e ifɨ nɨ n dzukə pɨ le nɨ yang. Be bisɨ nɨng nɨ dəlo nəkə nɨ tsɨkə bi anɨng. Nɨ tsɨkə a, ‘Ifɨ nɨ sɨ min tang nɨng tangji tsung be wə nɨ, jibwi be mi.’
english: I don’t speak concerning all of you. I know whom I have chosen. But that the Scripture may be fulfilled, ‘He who eats bread with me has lifted up his heel against me.’

jenjo: “N wanyi n nə bə lə pəko nɨng de wu tswe. Hebilə a nɨng de wu tswe yang ba kwələ Dɨ Mi kə ifɨ nɨ e Ilinwa vĩkə nɨng ku wə nɨ.
english: From now on, I tell you before it happens, that when it happens, you may believe that I am he.

jenjo: Kə akəng sɨ min nə bə lə, ke ifɨ nɨ kwə bi və ifɨ nɨ n tũkə nɨ yang, o kwə dɨ bi mi. Fə ifɨ nɨ kwə bi mi hɛ̃, o kwə dɨ bi və ifɨ nɨ tũ mikə nɨ.”
english: Most certainly I tell you, he who receives whomever I send, receives me; and he who receives me, receives him who sent me.”

jenjo: O nəbi tɨngkə nɨ kwəng wə yi sɨ wə o tsa, “Kə akəng sɨ min nə bə lə, tsɨng və bə yin le mi tətə.
english: When Jesus had said this, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”

jenjo: E mwambwi o kwang sen bəsə bwa le, bisɨ e yi ifɨ nɨ son tsɨkə a yin le wə təkə nɨ lo.
english: The disciples looked at one another, perplexed about whom he spoke.

jenjo: Tsɨng tangsə e mwambwi nɨ Yeso sɨn yidi wə nɨ, ku yɔ Yeso.
english: One of his disciples, whom Jesus loved, was at the table, leaning against Jesus’ breast.

jenjo: Sima Bitulu nəbi be mwambwi de be kəna tsa, o bi Yeso ifɨ nɨ son nəkə bi ku wə nɨ.”
english: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, and said to him, “Tell us who it is of whom he speaks.”

jenjo: Mwambwi de kə nwa sɨ Yeso, o bi wə o tsa, “Itwebɨ sɨ man tsɨ dɨ wə de?’
english: He, leaning back, as he was, on Jesus’ breast, asked him, “Lord, who is it?”

jenjo: Yeso kwə tsa, “Ifɨ nɨ n dɨkə tswĩlɨ kumpa nɨ n pə sɨ ywa n tə wə na wə yang, dɨ wə.” Bɨ o pə tswĩlɨ kumpa de sɨ ywa, o tə Yahuda Iskariyoti yɨ Sima.
english: Jesus therefore answered, “It is he to whom I will give this piece of bread when I have dipped it.” So when he had dipped the piece of bread, he gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.

jenjo: Yahuda tsɨ na dɨkə nɨ bɨ Shetan dzwi wə. Yeso tsɨ wə tsa, “Nɨngnɨ man tswekə nɨ a tswe pəpi.”
english: After the piece of bread, then Satan entered into him. Then Jesus said to him, “What you do, do quickly.”

jenjo: E ifɨ nɨ nwaji nɨ yipɨ nɨng de tswe Yeso nə wə bi lə mambɨ nɨ lo.
english: Now no man at the table knew why he said this to him.

jenjo: Ku sen tsɨ a le lakə dɨ bisɨ ho tsɨ sede nɨ na Yahuda nɨ, bɨ son yidi o tə o bapɨ nɨngnɨ e ifafɨ yin tangkə sɨ nɨnglang nɨ. Alo yang o tə e ibe ifɨ nɨng akə.
english: For some thought, because Judas had the money box, that Jesus said to him, “Buy what things we need for the feast,” or that he should give something to the poor.

jenjo: Yahuda sɨn dɨ na wə sɨ nɨngtang lɨ, bɨ o ji. Bɨmpo pɨ fɨ yang.
english: Therefore having received that morsel, he went out immediately. It was night.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ o jikə nɨ bɨ Yeso tsa, “Sɨswenɨ, e tə mi Yɨ Ifafɨ kãlɨ yang nɨ fə en bəkə kãlɨ və Fi sɨ mi nɨ.
english: When he had gone out, Jesus said, “Now the Son of Man has been glorified, and God has been glorified in him.

jenjo: Aba e tə Fi kãlɨ bisɨ Yɨ yang, Fi be yidi o yin tə Yɨ kãlɨ nabi.
english: If God has been glorified in him, God will also glorify him in himself, and he will glorify him immediately.

jenjo: E yɨ mi, nyɔ kulɨ mi be bə tswəni. Ma nɨng nɨ n nəkə e Yahuda lə nɨ, bɨ sɨ min nə bə lə. Chi nɨ yi ban bapɨ mi, be pɨnɨ min təkə nɨ ba pa ba tə pɨbɨw.
english: Little children, I will be with you a little while longer. You will seek me, and as I said to the Jews, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come,’ so now I tell you.

jenjo: “Dɨ lenwa a hu sɨ min tə bə. Ba tswesəbi. Ma tswelɨ n tswebi və bə nɨ, tɔle ba tswesəbi mambɨ.
english: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.

jenjo: Aba sɨ ban tswesəbi bwabɛ yang, dɨ nɨng nɨ yin tswe e ifafɨ yipɨ kə a kəng bə dɨ e mwambwi mi ho.”
english: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.”

jenjo: Sima Bitulu bi wə tsa, “Itwevə man tə dɨ pɨ ake?” Yeso tsɨ wə tsa, “Pɨnɨ min təkə nɨ a mwə tswa mi sɨswenɨw, be chi nɨ yi man tɨtə.’
english: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answered, “Where I am going, you can’t follow now, but you will follow afterwards.”

jenjo: Bitulu bipɨ tsa, “Itwevə dɨ bə tswe n mwə nyi mə sɨswenɨ wa? Min tə hũlɨ mi bisɨ mə.”
english: Peter said to him, “Lord, why can’t I follow you now? I will lay down my life for you.”

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ wə tsa, “A pa man tə hũlɨ mə tə bisɨ mi? Kə akang sɨ min nə mə lə, jɛnɨ pa yɛ tatalɨ, man yənwa hywi bwatə a tsa a yi mi lo!”
english: Jesus answered him, “Will you lay down your life for me? Most certainly I tell you, the rooster won’t crow until you have denied me three times.

jenjo: “Bi ban yilə ku bə yɛ. Ba tsɨ nyi sɨ Fi, fə ba tsɨ nyi sɨ mi lɛ.
english: “Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.

jenjo: Pɨ kulɨ lə tangvə Ta mi ihyãnɨng, a dɨbɨ a lo ke n nə bə lə yang. Min tə pɨ mə pɨ kulɨ bisɨ bə.
english: In my Father’s house are many homes. If it weren’t so, I would have told you. I am going to prepare a place for you.

jenjo: Aba tə n mə pɨ bisɨ bə yang, fə wu min dɨ bə min təkə pɨ nɨ n kukə lə nɨ. Hebilə ba ku pɨbi bɨ.
english: If I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and will receive you to myself; that where I am, you may be there also.

jenjo: Pɨnɨ min təkə lə nɨ, ba yi nɨhyã yang.”
english: Where I go, you know, and you know the way.”

jenjo: Tomə kwə nwa wə tsa, “Itwevə, bɨ yi pɨnɨ man təkə lə nɨ lo tswe nwu bɨn yi nɨhyã lɨ?”
english: Thomas said to him, “Lord, we don’t know where you are going. How can we know the way?”

jenjo: Yeso kwə tsa, “Dɨ mi kə nɨhyã, dɨ mi kə bi anɨng, fə dɨ mi kə hũlɨ. Nɨhyã akə ywang nɨ ifɨ mwələ yin təkə sɨ Ta nɨ, tɛmə o mwə na sɨ mi yang hĩ.
english: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.

jenjo: Aba kə akang ba yi mi yang, ban yi Ta mi yi. Sɨswenɨ ba yi wə fə ba bə wə yang.”
english: If you had known me, you would have known my Father also. From now on, you know him, and have seen him.”

jenjo: Bɨ Filibu tsa, “Itwevə a ta bɨ na sɨ Ta de dɨ nɨng nɨ bɨ yidi ho.
english: Philip said to him, “Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us.”

jenjo: Yeso kwə tsa, “Filibu n ku be bə tsung tswi yang, a yi mi lo bɨtsɨng ho? Ke ifɨ nɨ bə mi hɛ̃, o bə Ta yang. Tswe nwu a tsa ‘A ta bɨ na sɨ Ta?’
english: Jesus said to him, “Have I been with you such a long time, and do you not know me, Philip? He who has seen me has seen the Father. How do you say, ‘Show us the Father?’

jenjo: A kwələ dɨ Ta ku tangsə mi, fə mi tangsə wə lo? E bi nɨ n nə bə lə nɨ, dɨ bi ku mi bɨn nə lo. Be dɨ Ta nɨ kukə tangsə sɨ mi nɨ, fə dɨ wə son tswe nwatũ o.
english: Don’t you believe that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? The words that I tell you, I speak not from myself; but the Father who lives in me does his works.

jenjo: Ba tsɨnyi sɨ mi nɨ n tsa mi tangsə Ta fə Ta lə tangsə mi nɨ. A dɨbɨ lo, ba tsɨnyi sɨ mi bisɨ e nwatũ nɨngbisɨ nɨ ba bə sɨ min tswekə nɨ.
english: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me; or else believe me for the very works’ sake.

jenjo: Bi anɨng sɨ min nə bə lə, ke ifɨ nɨ pənyi sɨ mi hɛ̃, e nɨng nɨ sɨ min tswekə nɨ on tswe mambɨ. Be e nɨng nɨ pe mambɨ nɨ, on tswe wə tswe bisɨ fə sɨ min tə sɨ Ta.
english: Most certainly I tell you, he who believes in me, the works that I do, he will do also; and he will do greater works than these, because I am going to my Father.

jenjo: Fə ke e nɨng nɨ ba bipɨ be dzung mi hɛ̃, min tswe wə tswe. Hebilə Ta chi kãlɨ na sɨ Yɨ.
english: Whatever you will ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

jenjo: Ba dɨ dzung mi ba kũkə e nɨng nɨ hɛ̃ sɨ ban yidi nɨ, min tswe bə lə mambɨ.
english: If you will ask anything in my name, I will do it.

jenjo: Aba sɨ ban tswebi mi yang, ban li nwa mi li.
english: If you love me, keep my commandments.

jenjo: Fə yi min kũpɨ sɨ Ta o tə bə ipələ akə nɨ yin ku be bə kə achɛ̃ nɨ.
english: I will pray to the Father, and he will give you another Counselor, that he may be with you forever,—

jenjo: Dɨ wə kə Kwang, ikədzwa sɨ bi anɨng. Fangwa kwəsə be wə lo, bisɨ e mɛdi pɨ bə wə lo, fə e yi wə lo. Be ba yi wə yang, bisɨ o lə sɨ bə, fə on ku tangsə sɨ bə.
english: the Spirit of truth, whom the world can’t receive; for it doesn’t see him, neither knows him. You know him, for he lives with you, and will be in you.

jenjo: Min yə bə ma e yɨ ki lo, be fə min wu sɨ bə wu.
english: I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.

jenjo: Chi nɨ tswəni Fangwa fə bə miw, be ban bə mi bə. Bisɨ n lə be hũlɨ bə ma ban ku be hũlɨ.
english: Yet a little while, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me. Because I live, you will live also.

jenjo: Vi de ban yipɨ n ku tangsə Ta, ba ku tangsə mi, mi bɨmpo tangsə bə.
english: In that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.

jenjo: Ifɨ nɨ tswe nɨng nɨ bi mi nəkə yang, dɨ ifɨ nɨ sɨn tswebi mi ho. Ta mi yin tswebi və ifɨ nɨ sɨn tswebi mi nɨ. Min tswebi və ifɨ de fə min kədzwa min tsɨ wə sɨ mi.
english: One who has my commandments, and keeps them, that person is one who loves me. One who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him, and will reveal myself to him.”

jenjo: Bɨ Yahuda (dɨ Yahuda Iskariyoti lo) tsa, “Itwebɨ, dɨ bə tswe sɨ man yidi dɨ bɨ yinfa bɨn bə mə lɨ? A yidi Fangwa bə mə lo?”
english: Judas (not Iscariot) said to him, “Lord, what has happened that you are about to reveal yourself to us, and not to the world?”

jenjo: Yeso kwə tsa, “Aba ifɨ sɨn tswebi mi yang, on tswe e nɨng nɨ n nyina lə nɨ. Ta mi yin tswebi o, bɨn wu sɨ wə bɨn lwevə tsung be wə.
english: Jesus answered him, “If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and we will come to him, and make our home with him.

jenjo: Ifɨ nɨ sɨn tswebi mi lo nɨ, yin la pɨtswe nɨng nɨ n nyi na lə nɨ. E nɨng nɨ n nyi na lə nɨ, dɨ bi ku mi lo. Be dɨ a və Ta nɨ tũ mi kə nɨ.
english: He who doesn’t love me doesn’t keep my words. The word which you hear isn’t mine, but the Father’s who sent me.

jenjo: N nə bə e nɨngnɨ lə hywapɨ nɨ mi tsung be bə nɨ bɨtsɨng.
english: I have said these things to you, while still living with you.

jenjo: Be Ta mi yin tũ Kwang wə sɨ bə be dzung mi. Dɨ wə kə ipələ nɨ yin nyi bə na sɨ nɨng hɛ̃ nɨ. Fə yi on o bə nyi sɨ e nɨngnɨ hɛ̃ n nə bə kə lə nɨ.
english: But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, he will teach you all things, and will remind you of all that I said to you.

jenjo: Nɨngnɨ n yə bə lə ho, kə nyi atã. Dɨ tãlɨ mi bɨ sɨ min tə bə nɨ. N tə bə ma təlɨ Fangwa sɨn təkə tãlɨ nɨ lo. Bi ban yɨlə ku bə yɛ, fə bi ban bibi yɛ.
english: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, give I to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.

jenjo: N tsɨ ba n tsa, ‘Sɨ min tə a mi tə, fə min wu sɨ bə wu.’ A sɨ ban tswebi mi kə akang yang, ban bɛ təlɨ mi sɨ Ta de, bisɨ Kãlɨ o pe a mi yang.
english: You heard how I told you, ‘I go away, and I come to you.’ If you loved me, you would have rejoiced, because I said ‘I am going to my Father;’ for the Father is greater than I.

jenjo: N nə bə lə yang sɨswenɨ kə e nɨng de wu tswepɨ. Hebilə aba wu tswepɨ yang ba tsɨnyi sɨ mi.
english: Now I have told you before it happens so that, when it happens, you may believe.

jenjo: N chi na nɨ min nəkə bi fĩlɨ be bə nɨ lo, bisɨ itsɨkunɨng Fangwa nɨ sɨn wulɨ. Be o ywang be sambe ku miw.
english: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world comes, and he has nothing in me.

jenjo: Sɨ min tswe nɨngnɨ Ta tũ mi pɨ wu tswelɨ nɨ, hebilə fangwa yipɨ sɨ min tswebi və Ta kə akang. Ba wu, bɨ yə pɨ nɨ.”
english: But that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father commanded me, even so I do. Arise, let us go from here.

jenjo: Mi dɨ kə inabi a kəng, fə Ta mi dɨ itsɨnɨng sɨ kə de.
english: “I am the true vine, and my Father is the farmer.

jenjo: Ke kəna kə nɨ pəkə sɨ mi chi lo hɛ̃, o kwɛ on gbətə. Fə on mə a pɨnɨ sɨn chikə nɨ hebilə fə mə chi ihyãnɨng.
english: Every branch in me that doesn’t bear fruit, he takes away. Every branch that bears fruit, he prunes, that it may bear more fruit.

jenjo: Sɨswenɨ e wə bə dzwa yang, bisɨ bi nɨ n nə bə na lə nɨ.
english: You are already pruned clean because of the word which I have spoken to you.

jenjo: Ba ku tsung be mi, mi bɨmpo mi be bə. Kəna kə pa tsɨ be tsɨng wə chi yɨw, tɛmə o pə le sɨ kə. Mambɨ ba pa ba chi yɨw, tɛma ba ku tsung be mi yang hĩ.
english: Remain in me, and I in you. As the branch can’t bear fruit by itself, unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you, unless you remain in me.

jenjo: Mi dɨ kə inabi, bə dɨ e kəna kə. Ke ifɨ nɨ pə sɨ mi fə mi ku tsung be wə hɛ̃ on chi yɨ ihyãnɨng. Be ifɨ nɨ pə sɨ mi lo yang, o pa o tswe nɨng a akəw.
english: I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me, and I in him, the same bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.

jenjo: Ifɨ nɨ yə sɨ mi hɛ̃ o kuma kəna kə nɨ e kwɛ chikə e dɨ en gbə wə dzwa yin tswə̃kə nɨ.
english: If a man doesn’t remain in me, he is thrown out as a branch, and is withered; and they gather them, throw them into the fire, and they are burned.

jenjo: A ba ku tangsə mi fə bi mi ku nyinyi bə yang, ke nɨng nɨ ba yidi ba kũkə hɛ̃ ban chi wə chi.
english: If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you.

jenjo: Aba ba chi yɨ ihyãnɨng yang, sɨn ta na lə bə dɨ e mwambwi mɨ kə akang. Fə dɨ nɨngnɨ sɨn tə ta mi kãlɨ ho.
english: “In this is my Father glorified, that you bear much fruit; and so you will be my disciples.

jenjo: “Ma tswelɨ Ta mi tswebi mi nɨ, n tswebi və bə mambɨ. Ba ku be nyitsɨng sɨ tswebi nɨ n tswekəbi və bə nɨ.
english: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.

jenjo: A ba li nwa mi yang, ba ku be nyitsɨng yang ho sɨ tswebi nɨ n tswekəbi və bə nɨ, kuma lilɨ nɨ n likə nwa Ta mi fə n ku be nyitsɨng sɨ tswebi nɨ o tswekəbi mi nɨ.
english: If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love; even as I have kept my Father’s commandments, and remain in his love.

jenjo: Sɨ min nə bə bi nɨ lə hebilə ba bɛ ma bɛlɨ mi, fə bɛlɨ və bə yɨlə pyɔpyɔ.
english: I have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be made full.

jenjo: Dɨ lenwa mi ho, ba tswesəbi ma tswelɨ sɨ min tswekə bi və bə nɨ.
english: “This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.

jenjo: Dɨ tswelɨ a bi nɨ pe nyɔ tswebi ho, ifɨ tə ku wə bisɨ e tswə wə.
english: Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.

jenjo: Fə dɨ bə kə e tswə mi, aba ba tswe e nɨng nɨ n nə bə kə lə nɨ yang.
english: You are my friends, if you do whatever I command you.

jenjo: Fə min dzu bə e mwanshə lo, bisɨ mwanshə yi nɨngnɨ itwevə o sɨn tswekə nɨ lo. Be bə a bə n dzu bə e tswə, bisɨ n nə bə e nɨng nɨ lə Ta mi nə mi lə nɨ yang hɛ̃.
english: No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for everything that I heard from my Father, I have made known to you.

jenjo: Dɨ bə ba bapɨ mi lo, be dɨ mi bɨn bapɨ bə. Fə n tə bə nwatũ mə chilɨ a yɨ. Ba tə e yɨ nɨ yin tsɨkə bwabwi le nɨ. Aba ba tswe mambɨ yang, ke nɨng nɨ ba bipɨ sɨ Ta mi be dzung mi hɛ̃, on tə bə tə.
english: You didn’t choose me, but I chose you, and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.

jenjo: Dɨ lenwa mi ho, ba tswesəbi.
english: “I command these things to you, that you may love one another.

jenjo: Aba Fangwa wənyi bə yang, ba yipɨ pəsɔ wənyi dɨ mi.
english: If the world hates you, you know that it has hated me before it hated you.

jenjo: A bə dɨ a və Fangwa yang, ke Fangwa tswebi və bə yang bisɨ bə dɨ a o. Be n bapɨ bə tangsə Fangwa nɨ, fə bə dɨ a və fangwa lo. Dɨbɨ tswe Fangwa wənyi bə.
english: If you were of the world, the world would love its own. But because you are not of the world, since I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.

jenjo: Bi nyi bə chĩ sɨ bi nɨ n nə bə lə nɨ yɛ, ‘Shə mɛdi pɨ pe itwevə o lo.’ Aba e ifafɨ tə mi ibe yang, bə ma en tə bə ibe bɨ. Aba e li bi mi yang, en li bi və bə li bɨ.
english: Remember the word that I said to you: ‘A servant is not greater than his lord.’ If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you. If they kept my word, they will also keep yours.

jenjo: Be en tswe bə e nɨng nɨ hɛ̃, bisɨ bə dɨ a mi. Fə e yi Ifɨ nɨ tũ mi nɨ lo.
english: But all these things will they do to you for my name’s sake, because they don’t know him who sent me.

jenjo: E tsa sako n wu n nə le bi lə lo yang, ayibe nɨng abe və le ywang ku le. Be sɨswenɨ e ywang be kənwa nɨ en tsa nwa ku nɨng abe və le nɨ.
english: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.

jenjo: Ke ifɨ nɨ wənyi mi yang, son wənyi dɨ Ta mi.
english: He who hates me, hates my Father also.

jenjo: E nɨngbisɨ nɨ n tswekə nɨng le nɨ, ifɨ akə mɛdi pɨ tswelɨ lo. Aba e tsa səko n tswe nɨng le lo yang, ke ayibe ywang ku lew. Be e bə yang be nɨng le, lehɛ̃ e wənyi mi be Ta mi.
english: If I hadn’t done among them the works which no one else did, they wouldn’t have had sin. But now have they seen and also hated both me and my Father.

jenjo: Be bisɨ nɨng nɨ e vĩkə tangsə Dəro lenwa və le nɨ tsɨkə bi anɨng: ‘E wənyi mi bisɨ nɨng akə lo.’
english: But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, ‘They hated me without a cause.’

jenjo: “Min tũ Ipələ nɨ sɨ Ta nɨ, on wuwu. Dɨ wə kə Kwang nɨ jikə sɨ ta sɨn kədzwa sɨ bi anɨng nɨ. Hywapɨnɨ o wukə nɨ, on nə bə kəsɛ̃sɛ̃ bi anɨng lə ku mi.
english: “When the Counselor has come, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, who proceeds from the Father, he will testify about me.

jenjo: Fə bə mambɨ yi ban tenwa mi sɨ e ifɨ, bisɨ ba lə tsung be mi sɨ pəsɔ nwatũ mi.
english: You will also testify, because you have been with me from the beginning.

jenjo: “N nə bə e nɨng nɨ lə hɛ̃, hebilə bi ban gã sɨ pənyi və bə yɛ.
english: “I have said these things to you so that you wouldn’t be caused to stumble.

jenjo: En nyə bə pushə və le. Bi anɨng sɨ min nə bə lə, vi lə chi nɨ ifɨ nɨ yə bə hɛ̃ yin tsa sɨ lɨn tswe Fi nwatũ lə.
english: They will put you out of the synagogues. Yes, the time comes that whoever kills you will think that he offers service to God.

jenjo: E ifafɨ yin tswe bə nɨng nɨ hɛ̃, bisɨ e yi Ta lo sako mi.
english: They will do these things because they have not known the Father, nor me.

jenjo: Na nwachi n nə bə lə lo bisɨ mi lə sɨ bə bɨtsɨng. N nə bə lə hebilə aba hywapɨ nɨ nɨng de pəsɔ pɨ tswelɨ yang, ba kyɛ̃ e nɨng de n nə bə lə nɨ.
english: But I have told you these things, so that when the time comes, you may remember that I told you about them. I didn’t tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.

jenjo: “Sɨswenɨ fə min tə sɨ ifɨ nɨ tũ mikə nɨ. Lehɛ̃ ifɨ akə tangsə bə nɨ yin bi mi tsa, ‘Man tə dɨ bəde?’ nɨ ywang
english: But now I am going to him who sent me, and none of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’

jenjo: Bisɨ e bi nɨ n nəkə nɨ, sɨ ban pəshi.
english: But because I have told you these things, sorrow has filled your heart.

jenjo: Be kə akəng sɨ min nə bə lə təlɨ a mi hĩkwã bisɨ bə. Aba n tə lo yang, Ipələ de pa wuw. Be aba n tə yang, kə n tũ wə sɨ bə.
english: Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is to your advantage that I go away, for if I don’t go away, the Counselor won’t come to you. But if I go, I will send him to you.

jenjo: Hywapɨnɨ o wu yang, on ta Fangwa nasɨ ayibe və le ku nɨng abe, be tswelɨ anɨng hywi wə, be za a nəlɨ və Fi.
english: When he has come, he will convict the world about sin, about righteousness, and about judgment;

jenjo: On ta le na tsa le dɨ e ifɨ nɨng abe bisɨ e pənyi sɨ mi lo.
english: about sin, because they don’t believe in me;

jenjo: On ta na sɨ tswelɨ a nɨng hywi wə, bisɨ sɨ min tə sɨ Ta fə ba bə miw.
english: about righteousness, because I am going to my Father, and you won’t see me any more;

jenjo: Fə bi a nyilɨ və le ku za a nəlɨ və Fi hywiwə lo, bisɨ za o chi le itsɨkunɨng fangwa nɨ yang.
english: about judgment, because the prince of this world has been judged.

jenjo: E nyɔ nɨng lə ihyãnɨng nɨ min nə bə kə lə nɨ, be sɨswenɨ ba pə ba mwə hɛ̃w.
english: “I have yet many things to tell you, but you can’t bear them now.

jenjo: Be aba Kwang nɨ sɨn kədzwa sɨ bi anɨng de wu yang, on ta bə na sɨ nɨhyã bi anɨng hɛ̃. Bi nɨ on nəkə nɨ dɨ bi anyilɨ wə lo, be dɨ nɨng nɨ o likə nɨ. Fə on nə bə bi və e nɨng nɨ lə yin wukə chi nɨ.
english: However when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself; but whatever he hears, he will speak. He will declare to you things that are coming.

jenjo: On tə dzung mi kãlɨ, bisɨ dɨ nɨngnɨ kə a mi nɨ bɨ o kədzwa on tsɨ bə lə lɨ.
english: He will glorify me, for he will take from what is mine, and will declare it to you.

jenjo: Nɨngnɨ tsɨkə a və Ta hɛ̃, dɨ a mi. Dɨbɨ tswe n tsa dɨ nɨng nɨ Kwang de likə sɨ mi nɨ, bɨ on nə bə ləlɨ.
english: All things whatever the Father has are mine; therefore I said that he takes of mine, and will declare it to you.

jenjo: Nalə ba bə miw, fə chi nɨ tswəni ban bə mi bə.
english: A little while, and you will not see me. Again a little while, and you will see me.”

jenjo: Bɨ e Mwambwipu o akə bipɨ sen tsa, “Dɨ bi bəde son nəlɨ nɨ o tsɨkə, ‘Nalə tswəni ba bə miw, fə chi tswəni yi ban bə mi bə, fə o tsa bisɨ sɨ min tə sɨ Ta?’ ”
english: Some of his disciples therefore said to one another, “What is this that he says to us, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me;’ and, ‘Because I go to the Father’?”

jenjo: Bi e wədəkə pɨ bisə bwa le, “Dɨ bi bəde son nəlɨ nɨ o tsa, ‘Nalə tswəni?’ Bɨ yi chi bi de lo.”
english: They said therefore, “What is this that he says, ‘A little while’? We don’t know what he is saying.”

jenjo: Yeso yipɨ yang sen yidi pɨ bi wə bi de. Bɨ o tsɨle tsa, “Sɨ ban bipɨ bwa bə ku bi nɨ n tsɨkə a, ‘Nalə ba bə miw, fə chi tswəni ban bə mi bə nɨ?’
english: Therefore Jesus perceived that they wanted to ask him, and he said to them, “Do you inquire among yourselves concerning this, that I said, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me?’

jenjo: Kə a kəng min nə bə lə, ban tata be nwashi hywapɨ nɨ Fangwa sɨn bɛkə nɨ. Ban pəshi, be pəlɨ a shi və bə yin myɛkə bɛlɨ.
english: Most certainly I tell you, that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ ywa sɨn shi iye yang, son li be nɨngshi. Be aba gang bwa tsəsə yang, on li lalɨ. Nyi wə chĩ yang ho sɨ nɨngshi de, bisɨ o chi yɨ o le wu yang Fangwa.
english: A woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow, because her time has come. But when she has delivered the child, she doesn’t remember the anguish any more, for the joy that a human being is born into the world.

jenjo: Bə ma mambɨ. Sɨswenɨ dɨ hywapɨ nyishi və bə nɨ, be fə bɨn bəsə bə. Yi ban bɛbɛ, ifɨ nɨ fə yin dɨkə bɛlɨ və bə nɨ ywang.
english: Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy away from you.

jenjo: Vi a wə, fə ba bipɨ nɨng akə sɨ miw. Kə akəng min nə bə lə, ke nɨng nɨ ba bipɨ be dzung mi hɛ̃ Ta mi yin tə bə tə.
english: “In that day you will ask me no questions. Most certainly I tell you, whatever you may ask of the Father in my name, he will give it to you.

jenjo: Lədə ba bipɨ nɨng akə be dzung mi lo bɨtsɨng. Ba bipɨ ban chi chi, habi bɛlɨ və bə yɨlə pyɔpyɔ ho.
english: Until now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.

jenjo: “N dɨ nwadũ sɨ min nə bə kə bi lə. Be hywapɨ lə sɨn wulɨ nɨ min nə bə bi və Ta mi lə, be nwa ifafɨ nɨ.
english: I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. But the time is coming when I will no more speak to you in figures of speech, but will tell you plainly about the Father.

jenjo: Vi a wə, ban bipɨ nɨng sɨ wə be dzung mi. Na sɨ min tsa yi min bipɨ sɨ Ta bisɨ bə lo.
english: In that day you will ask in my name; and I don’t say to you, that I will pray to the Father for you,

jenjo: Oho! Ta de be ku wə tswebi və bə, bisɨ ba tswebi mi fə ba tsɨnyi bə lə tsa, n wu le sɨ Fi.
english: for the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that I came from God.

jenjo: N ji sɨ Ta bɨ n wu Fangwa. Fə sɨswenɨ n yə Fangwa fə min tə sɨ Ta.”
english: I came from the Father, and have come into the world. Again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.”

jenjo: Bɨ e mwambwi o tsa, “Sɨswenɨ sɨ man nə bi be nwa ifafɨ, a ledũ lo.
english: His disciples said to him, “Behold, now you are speaking plainly, and using no figures of speech.

jenjo: Sɨswenɨ bɨ yipɨ yang, a yipɨ e nɨng yang hɛ̃. Nɨngnɨ bɨ tsɨbi pɨ bi mə nɨ, a ta nwa bɨ a nə yang. Dɨbɨ tswe bɨ tsɨnyi bɨ a wu le sɨ Fi.
english: Now we know that you know all things, and don’t need for anyone to question you. By this we believe that you came from God.”

jenjo: Yeso kwə ngwa le tsa, ‘Ahã, sɨswenɨ ba tsɨnyi bə lə yang.
english: Jesus answered them, “Do you now believe?

jenjo: Be vi lə sɨn wulɨ, wu yang ho nɨ yi ban yasə ban hywãna sɨ mi be tsɨng mi. A dɨ wə fə yin tə və le. Lehɛ̃ mi be tsɨng mi lo, Ta mi tsung be mi.
english: Behold, the time is coming, yes, and has now come, that you will be scattered, everyone to his own place, and you will leave me alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.

jenjo: “N nə bə e nɨng nɨ lə hebilə ba chi tãnyi sɨ mi. Tangsə Fangwa nɨ ban tswe ibe. Be ba tsanyi! N le Fangwa yang.”
english: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have oppression; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.”

jenjo: Tswa bi de o nəkə nɨ, bɨ o dɨ ku wə o yikə ye o pinwa o tsa, “Ta, hywapɨ tswe yang. A tə yɨ mə kãlɨ hebilə yɨ mə nya tə mə kãlɨ.
english: Jesus said these things, and lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said, “Father, the time has come. Glorify your Son, that your Son may also glorify you;

jenjo: A tə wə tsɨkunɨng ku e ifafɨ yang hɛ̃. Hebilə o tə e ifɨ nɨ hɛ̃ a tə wəkə nɨ hũlɨ a kə a itsɨng.
english: even as you gave him authority over all flesh, so he will give eternal life to all whom you have given him.

jenjo: Dɨ hũlɨ a kə a itsɨng ho kə e yi mə kə Fi tsɨng dodo, be Yɨ mə Yeso Kristi nɨ a tũkə nɨ.
english: This is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true God, and him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.

jenjo: N kədzwa n tsɨ sɨ kãlɨ mə Fangwa bə yang, bisɨ nwatũ nɨ a tə mi nɨ n enyi wə yang.
english: I glorified you on the earth. I have accomplished the work which you have given me to do.

jenjo: Sɨswenɨ Ta a tə mi kãlɨ mi nɨ n ləkə hywapɨ nɨ mi sɨ mə nɨ pəko Fangwa pəsɔ.
english: Now, Father, glorify me with your own self with the glory which I had with you before the world existed.

jenjo: “E ifɨ nɨ a tə mikə Fangwa nɨ n kədzwa n tsɨ le sɨ mə yang. Le dɨ e ifɨ a mə, dɨ mə bɨ a tə mi le. Fə e sə̃ bi mə lo.
english: I revealed your name to the people whom you have given me out of the world. They were yours, and you have given them to me. They have kept your word.

jenjo: Sɨswenɨ e yipɨ yang, e nɨngnɨ a tə mi hɛ̃ ji le sɨ mə.
english: Now they have known that all things whatever you have given me are from you,

jenjo: Kə bi nɨ a nə mi lə nɨ, n nə le lə yang fə e kwə bi de yang. E yipɨ yang n ji le sɨ mə. Fə e tsɨnyi le yang kə a kəng dɨ mə bɨ a tũ mi.
english: for the words which you have given me I have given to them, and they received them, and knew for sure that I came from you, and they have believed that you sent me.

jenjo: Sɨ min pinwa bisɨ le, dɨ bisɨ Fangwa lo, be bisɨ e ifɨ nɨ a tə mi kə nɨ. Bisɨ le dɨ e ifɨ a mə.
english: I pray for them. I don’t pray for the world, but for those whom you have given me, for they are yours.

jenjo: E nɨng nɨ hɛ̃ n ləkə nɨ dɨ a mə, fə e nɨng nɨ hɛ̃ a ləkə nɨ dɨ a mi. Fə n chi kãlɨ yang na sɨ le.
english: All things that are mine are yours, and yours are mine, and I am glorified in them.

jenjo: Fə min ku Fangwa be le lo, be e kulə Fangwa, fə sɨ min wu sɨ mə. Ta Ihywisɨ, a kang le be tsalɨ dzung mə nɨ a tə mi kə nɨ. Hebilə e kukə e ifɨ atsɨng, ma kulɨ mi be mə bɨ kukə e ifɨ a tsɨng nɨ.
english: I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, keep them through your name which you have given me, that they may be one, even as we are.

jenjo: Hywapɨ nɨ mi tsung be le nɨ, n kang le yang be dzung nɨ a tə mikə nɨ. Tsɨng tangsə le la lo, tɛmə dɨ ifɨ nɨ e ochi e ta wə do nɨ. Hebilə nɨngnɨ e vĩkə tang Daro nɨ tsɨkə bi anɨng.
english: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name. Those whom you have given me I have kept. None of them is lost, except the son of destruction, that the Scripture might be fulfilled.

jenjo: Fə min tə sɨ mə, be sɨ min kũ e nɨng nɨ n lə Fangwa bɨtsɨng. Hebilə e ifɨ nɨ mwəkə nyi mi nɨ, bɛlɨ və le yɨlə pyɔpyɔ nyinyi le ma bɛlɨ mi.
english: But now I come to you, and I say these things in the world, that they may have my joy made full in themselves.

jenjo: N nə le bi mə lə yang. Fangwa wənyi le yang, bisɨ le dɨ a və Fangwa lo ma mi nɨ mi dɨ a və Fangwa lo nɨ.
english: I have given them your word. The world hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

jenjo: Sɨ min pinwa bisɨ a dɨ le a yə Fangwa lo, be bisɨ a kang le sɨ ikãnyi.
english: I pray not that you would take them from the world, but that you would keep them from the evil one.

jenjo: Le dɨ a və Fangwa lo, ma mi nɨ mi dɨ a və Fangwa lo nɨ.
english: They are not of the world even as I am not of the world.

jenjo: A wə le dzwa e myɛkə a mə nasɨ bi anɨng mə, bisɨ dɨ bi mə bɨ tsɨkə bi anɨng.
english: Sanctify them in your truth. Your word is truth.

jenjo: Ma tũlɨ a tũ mi Fangwa nɨ, n tũ le mambɨ Fangwa.
english: As you sent me into the world, even so I have sent them into the world.

jenjo: N təku mi dɨ bisɨ le, hebilə le ma e wə le dzwa kə akang.
english: For their sakes I sanctify myself, that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.

jenjo: Sɨ min pinwa bisɨ le yinfa lo, pwɔsɨ e ifɨ nɨ yin pənyi sɨ mi bisɨ telɨ a nwa və le nɨ.
english: Not for these only do I pray, but for those also who will believe in me through their word,

jenjo: Hebilə le hɛ̃ e myɛkə e ifɨ a tsɨng. Ta ma kulɨ a kukə tsung be mi, fə mi tsung be mə nɨ, a kwələ e ku tsung be bɨ. Hebilə Fangwa kwələ dɨ mə bɨ a tũ mi be tsɨkunɨng mə.
english: that they may all be one; even as you, Father, are in me, and I in you, that they also may be one in us; that the world may believe that you sent me.

jenjo: N tə le kãlɨ nɨ a tə mi nɨ yang. Hebilə e kukə e ifɨ a tsɨng, ma kulɨ mi be mə bɨ kukə e ifɨ a tsɨng nɨ.
english: The glory which you have given me, I have given to them; that they may be one, even as we are one;

jenjo: Min ku tangsə le, mə bɨmpo a ku tangsə mi. Hebilə e myɛkə e ifɨ a tsɨng kə akang. Habi e ifafɨ yipɨ dɨ mə bɨ a tũ mi, fə e yipɨ a tswebi və le yang, ma tswelɨ a tswekəbi mi nɨ.
english: I in them, and you in me, that they may be perfected into one; that the world may know that you sent me, and loved them, even as you loved me.

jenjo: Ta, sɨ min yidi e ifɨ nɨ a tə mi kə nɨ ku tsung be mi pɨnɨ n kukə lə nɨ. Fə e bə tswĩyiyi mi, tswĩyiyi nɨ a tə bisɨ sɨ man tswebi mi pəko məlɨ a Fangwa nɨ.
english: Father, I desire that they also whom you have given me be with me where I am, that they may see my glory, which you have given me, for you loved me before the foundation of the world.

jenjo: “Fi Ta ifɨ nɨng akang, Fangwa yi mə lo, be mi a mi n yi mə yang. Fə e yipɨ yang dɨ mə bɨ a tũ mi.
english: Righteous Father, the world hasn’t known you, but I knew you; and these knew that you sent me.

jenjo: N ta le nasɨ mə yang, fə min wədəkə pɨ ta le nasɨ mə. Hebilə tswebi nɨ a ta mi nalə nɨ, e chilə fə mi bɨmpo n ku tsung be le bɨ.”
english: I made known to them your name, and will make it known; that the love with which you loved me may be in them, and I in them.”

jenjo: Yeso pinwa tɨngkə nɨ bɨ o hyã pɨ nvɔ Kidron be e mwanbwi o. Nggwa pɨde e təkə nɨ fa kə zetun lə pɨbi, bɨ o tə tangsə fa kə zetun de be e mwambwi o.
english: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went out with his disciples over the brook Kidron, where there was a garden, into which he and his disciples entered.

jenjo: Yahuda nɨ le wə təkə nɨ yi pɨde yang, bisɨ Yeso sɨn kwəsə pɨbi be e mwambwi o tɨtɛ.
english: Now Judas, who betrayed him, also knew the place, for Jesus often met there with his disciples.

jenjo: Bɨ Yahuda bwi e itabwi be e ifɨ tsɨnɨng Kwə Fi, pɔsɨ e ifɨ nɨ ivə hyɔ̃nɨng be e Farisa tũkə nɨ. O təkə pɨbi. E bwi e nɨng tabwi be e dzwa kəpɨ na le.
english: Judas then, having taken a detachment of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and the Pharisees, came there with lanterns, torches, and weapons.

jenjo: Yeso yipɨ e nɨng nɨ yin chi wə nɨ yang hɛ̃, bɨ o ho o tsɨtə chi o bi le o tsa, “Dɨ wə sɨ ban bapɨ lɨ a?”
english: Jesus therefore, knowing all the things that were happening to him, went out, and said to them, “Who are you looking for?”

jenjo: E kwə nwa wə e tsa, “Yeso mwɛ Nazarat.” O kwə nwa le o tsa, “Dɨ mi.” Yahuda nɨ le wə təkə nɨ lə pɨbi.
english: They answered him, “Jesus of Nazareth.” Jesus said to them, “I am he.” Judas also, who betrayed him, was standing with them.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ e likə Yeso tsa, “Dɨ mi” nɨ, e tsɛ na tswa e te hywa hɛ̃.
english: When therefore he said to them, “I am he,” they went backward, and fell to the ground.

jenjo: Bɨ fə o bi le o tsa, “Dɨ wə sɨ ban bapɨ lɨ?” Bɨ e tsa “Yeso mwɛ Nazarat”
english: Again therefore he asked them, “Who are you looking for?” They said, “Jesus of Nazareth.”

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ le tsa, “N nə bə lə yang nwachi n tsa dɨ mi. A dɨ mi sɨ ban bapɨ yang, ba yə nyɔ le tə.”
english: Jesus answered, “I told you that I am he. If therefore you seek me, let these go their way,”

jenjo: E nɨng de tswe mambɨ bisɨ bi nɨ o nəkə nɨ tsikə bi anɨng: “Ta, Tangsə e ifɨ nɨ a tə mikə nɨ tsɨng və le la lo.”
english: that the word might be fulfilled which he spoke, “Of those whom you have given me, I have lost none.”

jenjo: Bɨ Siman Bitulu, hywã hywa kafale tangsə tswə hywa tũkə tswɨ kya nali a və mwambwi və ihyãfɨ hyɔ̃nɨng nɨ en dzukə a Malkus.
english: Simon Peter therefore, having a sword, drew it, and struck the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ Bitulu tsa, “A fə be kafale a so tang tswəhywa. Ji nɨ Ta tə mi nɨ n nwa wə wə a.”
english: Jesus therefore said to Peter, “Put the sword into its sheath. The cup which the Father has given me, shall I not surely drink it?”

jenjo: Bɨ e itabwi be ihyãfɨ və le, pɔsɨ e itsɨnɨng Kwə Fi və e Yahuda mwə Yeso e tsə wə be be.
english: So the detachment, the commanding officer, and the officers of the Jews, seized Jesus and bound him,

jenjo: E tə be wə sɨ Hanana tsa Kayafa. Dɨ Kayafa kə ivə hyɔ̃nɨng ha de.
english: and led him to Annas first, for he was father-in-law to Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.

jenjo: Dɨ Kayafa de bɨ nə e Yahuda bi lə tsa, “Pelə yang ifɨ tsɨng bwi bisɨ nyɔ e ifafɨ hɛ̃.”
english: Now it was Caiaphas who advised the Jews that it was expedient that one man should perish for the people.

jenjo: Sima Bitulu tsung be mwambwi a tsɨng mwə nyi Yeso. Ivə hyɔ̃nɨng yi mwambwi de yang, bɨ o mwə tswa le o təkə tangvə ivə hyɔ̃nɨng.
english: Simon Peter followed Jesus, as did another disciple. Now that disciple was known to the high priest, and entered in with Jesus into the court of the high priest;

jenjo: Bitulu tsɨ pɨfa nwanɨhyã ve, bɨ mwambwi de fə tə nə bi be mwəhe nɨ tsɨ sɨn bekə nwa nɨhyã ve nɨ, bɨ o yə Bitulu wu tangsə.
english: but Peter was standing at the door outside. So the other disciple, who was known to the high priest, went out and spoke to her who kept the door, and brought in Peter.

jenjo: Mwəhe de nwa nɨhyã ve de nɨ bi Bitulu tsa, “Mə dɨ tsɨng tangsə e mwambwi və ibwi nɨ lo?” Bitulu kwə tsa, “N ywang tangsə lew.”
english: Then the maid who kept the door said to Peter, “Are you also one of this man’s disciples?” He said, “I am not.”

jenjo: E mwənshə be e itsɨnɨng wu mə dzwa ku sen bwilɨ. Bɨ Bitulu ho tə sɨ le sɨn bwi dzwa bɨ.
english: Now the servants and the officers were standing there, having made a fire of coals, for it was cold. They were warming themselves. Peter was with them, standing and warming himself.

jenjo: Bɨ ihyãfɨ hyɔ̃nɨng bi Yeso bi və e mwambwi o be nɨngnɨ son nyinalə nɨ.
english: The high priest therefore asked Jesus about his disciples, and about his teaching.

jenjo: Yeso tsa, “Tɨtɛ sɨ min nə e ifɨ Fangwa bi lə nɨngfa, fə sɨ min nyinasɨ nɨng pɨkwəsəku. Akə Kwə Fi pɨnɨ e Yahuda sɨn pwɔsə pɨbi nɨ, n nə bi akə yweywelɨ lo.
english: Jesus answered him, “I spoke openly to the world. I always taught in synagogues, and in the temple, where the Jews always meet. I said nothing in secret.

jenjo: Dɨ bə tswe man bi mi lɨ? A bi e ifafɨ nɨ ləkə nɨ, e li e nɨngnɨ n nəkə nɨ yang.
english: Why do you ask me? Ask those who have heard me what I said to them. Behold, these know the things which I said.”

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ o nəkə mambɨ nɨ, bɨ tsɨng tangsə e itsɨnɨng gbə jang wə be na fə tsa, “Mə dɨ wə man nə ihyãfɨ hyɔ̃nɨng bi lə mambɨ?”
english: When he had said this, one of the officers standing by slapped Jesus with his hand, saying, “Do you answer the high priest like that?”

jenjo: Yeso kwə nwa wə tsa, “Aba bi nɨ n nəkə nɨ dɨ ayibe yang, a ta na sɨ ayibe mi. A dɨ bɨ lo, tswe nwu man gbə jang mi be na lɨ?”
english: Jesus answered him, “If I have spoken evil, testify of the evil; but if well, why do you beat me?”

jenjo: Bɨ Hanana to wə təkə sɨ Kayafa ihyãfɨ hyɔ̃nɨng be be nɨ e tsə wəkə nɨ.
english: Annas sent him bound to Caiaphas, the high priest.

jenjo: Bitulu tsɨ lə sɨn bwi dzwa, e bi wə e tsa, “Mə dɨ tsɨng tangsə e mwambwi o, mambɨ lo?” O yənwa o tsa, “Mi dɨ mwambwi o lo.”
english: Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. They said therefore to him, “You aren’t also one of his disciples, are you?” He denied it, and said, “I am not.”

jenjo: Tsɨng tangsə e itsɨnɨng nɨ e tũkə nɨ kə lənyɔ və ifɨ nɨ Bitulu tũkə tswɨtswi wə nɨ bi wə tsa, “N chi mə tsung be wə Fanɨng de lo?”
english: One of the servants of the high priest, being a relative of him whose ear Peter had cut off, said, “Didn’t I see you in the garden with him?”

jenjo: Fə Bitulu yənwa tsa, “Oho.” Bɨ yɛ tata nabi.
english: Peter therefore denied it again, and immediately the rooster crowed.

jenjo: Be nyinvi a bubu, bɨ e Yahuda ji be Yeso tang və Kayafa, e tə be wə sɨ Klɔ ve Roman. E Yahuda tsɨ na pɨfa e yidi nɨngnɨ bang le fə nyə le sɨ nɨnglang hyãlɨ nɨ lo.
english: They led Jesus therefore from Caiaphas into the Praetorium. It was early, and they themselves didn’t enter into the Praetorium, that they might not be defiled, but might eat the Passover.

jenjo: Bisɨ mambɨ, Bilatus ji wu sɨ le tsa, “Ba ki nwakwang və ibwi nɨ, dɨ bisɨ bəde?”
english: Pilate therefore went out to them, and said, “What accusation do you bring against this man?”

jenjo: E kwə nwa wə e tsa, “Aba ibwi nɨ tswe ayibe lo yang, ke bɨ wu be wə pɨpi mə lo.”
english: They answered him, “If this man weren’t an evildoer, we wouldn’t have delivered him up to you.”

jenjo: Bilatus tsa, “Ba tə ba nə za ku we ma nɨng nɨ lenwa və bə nəkə nɨ.” E Yahuda la tsa, “Lenwa kwə bɨ lə bɨ tũ za nɨ en yəkə ifafɨ nɨ lo.”
english: Pilate therefore said to them, “Take him yourselves, and judge him according to your law.” Therefore the Jews said to him, “It is not lawful for us to put anyone to death,”

jenjo: E nɨng de tswe mambɨ hebilə, e nɨng nɨ Yeso nəkə nwa bwilɨ on bwikə nɨ tsɨkə bi anɨng.
english: that the word of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spoke, signifying by what kind of death he should die.

jenjo: Bilatus fə tə tangsə o bi Yeso o tsa, “Mə dɨ ivə və e Israila?”
english: Pilate therefore entered again into the Praetorium, called Jesus, and said to him, “Are you the King of the Jews?”

jenjo: Yeso bi wə tsa, “Dɨ mə be ku mə sɨ man bi mi nɨ? Alo dɨ e ifɨ akə nə mə bi mi lə?”
english: Jesus answered him, “Do you say this by yourself, or did others tell you about me?”

jenjo: Bilatu kwə tsa, “Mi dɨ mwe Yahuda lo. Be dɨ e ifɨ mə be e ihyãfɨ hyɔ̃nɨng və bə bɨ wu be mə sɨ mi. Dɨ ayibe bə a tswe?”
english: Pilate answered, “I’m not a Jew, am I? Your own nation and the chief priests delivered you to me. What have you done?”

jenjo: Yeso tsa, “Ivə mi dɨ a Fangwa nɨ lo. E tsa ivə mi dɨ a Fangwa nɨ yang ke e mwambwi mi yin tabwi, hebilə bi e Yahuda mwə mi yɛ. Be ivə mi le pɨ akə.
english: Jesus answered, “My Kingdom is not of this world. If my Kingdom were of this world, then my servants would fight, that I wouldn’t be delivered to the Jews. But now my Kingdom is not from here.”

jenjo: Bilatus bi wə tsa, “Mambɨ mə dɨ Ivə ho?” Yeso kwə tsa, “A nə tsɨ yang mi dɨ Ivə. Kə a kəng dɨbɨ tswe e chi mi, dɨbɨ wu be mi Fangwa, bisɨ wu n nə bi a kəng. Ifɨ bi anɨng hɛ̃, sɨn kang tswi sɨ mi.”
english: Pilate therefore said to him, “Are you a king then?” Jesus answered, “You say that I am a king. For this reason I have been born, and for this reason I have come into the world, that I should testify to the truth. Everyone who is of the truth listens to my voice.”

jenjo: Bilatus bi wə tsa, “Dɨ bə kə bi anɨng de?” Bɨ fə o tə sɨ le pɨ fa o tsa, “N chi ayibe sɨ ibwi nɨ min tũkə za ku we nɨ lo.
english: Pilate said to him, “What is truth?” When he had said this, he went out again to the Jews, and said to them, “I find no basis for a charge against him.

jenjo: Be sɨ nwa nɨng hywinɨng və bə tɨtɛ, aba vi nɨnglang hyãlɨ myɛ wu ma a nɨ yang, sɨ min le bə na sɨ ifɨ ayibe tsɨng nɨ sɨ ban yidi nɨ. Sɨ ban yidi n le ‘Ivə və e Yahuda’ na tə?”
english: But you have a custom, that I should release someone to you at the Passover. Therefore, do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”

jenjo: E ki nwakwang be wi kɔ̃kɔ̃ e tsa, “Oho. Dɨ wə lo! A le Barabas na tə!” Barabas nɨ sen nəkə bi sɨ wə nɨ, dɨ ifɨ kandang sɨ e Roma.
english: Then they all shouted again, saying, “Not this man, but Barabbas!” Now Barabbas was a robber.

jenjo: Bɨ Bilatus mwə Yeso tə, e gbə wə be tswe.
english: So Pilate then took Jesus, and flogged him.

jenjo: Bɨ e itabwi kə e hwə, e kwa kə mɛntəlo bɨ e tsɨ wə ku wə. Fə e ya wə nɨng yasɨ a hyɛ̃ və ivə lə.
english: The soldiers twisted thorns into a crown, and put it on his head, and dressed him in a purple garment.

jenjo: E wədəkə pɨ tə sɨ wə sen yɔ wə sen tsa, “Parkə mə ivə və e iYahuda!” Fə sen gbə jang wə be na.
english: They kept saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!” and they kept slapping him.

jenjo: Bɨ Bilatus fə ji tə sɨ e ihyãfɨ Yahuda pɨfa. O tsɨ le o tsa, “Min ji be wə pɨfa bisɨ ba yipɨ n chi wə be ayibe nɨ en yə wəkə nɨ lo.”
english: Then Pilate went out again, and said to them, “Behold, I bring him out to you, that you may know that I find no basis for a charge against him.”

jenjo: Yeso ji be mɛntəlo hwə ku wə, be nɨng yasɨ və ivə sɨ wə. Bilatus tsa, “Dɨ ibwi de ho nɨ!”
english: Jesus therefore came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple garment. Pilate said to them, “Behold, the man!”

jenjo: Bəli e ivə hyɔ̃nɨng be e ihyãfɨ bə wə kə nɨ, bɨ e ki nwakwang e tsa, “Ba pi wə ku kə!” Bilatus kwə tsa, “Ba tə be wə tə ba pi. Be kəna mi ywang pɨbi. N chi wə be ayibe lo.”
english: When therefore the chief priests and the officers saw him, they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify!” Pilate said to them, “Take him yourselves, and crucify him, for I find no basis for a charge against him.”

jenjo: E Yahuda kwə tsa, “Lenwa və bɨ kwələ yang e yə wə, bisɨ o dɨ ku wə ma Yɨ Fi.”
english: The Jews answered him, “We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.”

jenjo: Bilatus likə mambɨ nɨ, bɨ kwang wə fə yi sɨ wə.
english: When therefore Pilate heard this saying, he was more afraid.

jenjo: Bilatus fə be Yeso təkə tangvə bɨ tə bi Yeso tsa, “A wu le bəde?” Yeso kwə nwa wə lo.
english: He entered into the Praetorium again, and said to Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus gave him no answer.

jenjo: Bilatus bi wə tsa, “A la pɨ nə mi bi lə, a yipɨ n lə be tsɨkunɨng aba n yidi yang min le mə na alo tə e pi mə ku kə lo?”
english: Pilate therefore said to him, “Aren’t you speaking to me? Don’t you know that I have power to release you, and have power to crucify you?”

jenjo: Yeso kwə tsa, “A ywang be tsɨkunɨng ku mi, aba e tə mə le dzwe lo yang. Bisɨ mambɨ, ifɨ nɨ mwə mi tə məkə nɨ, dɨ wə bɨ nɨng abe o kã pe.”
english: Jesus answered, “You would have no power at all against me, unless it were given to you from above. Therefore he who delivered me to you has greater sin.”

jenjo: Bilatus likə mambɨ nɨ, bɨ o bapɨ nɨhyã nɨ on lekə Yeso na nɨ. Be e Yahuda tsɨlə sɨn ki nwakwang sen tsa, “Aba a le ibwi nɨ na tə yang, mə dɨ tswə Kayisa lo. Bisɨ ke ifɨ nɨ dɨ ku wə kə ivə hɛ̃, son tswe mbwe və Kayisə ho!”
english: At this, Pilate was seeking to release him, but the Jews cried out, saying, “If you release this man, you aren’t Caesar’s friend! Everyone who makes himself a king speaks against Caesar!”

jenjo: Bilatus likə mambɨ nɨ, bɨ o mwə Yeso o jikə pɨfa. Wu o tsɨ wə o ku ku hywe və inə za, pɨnɨ en dzukə pyənglɨ ku te nɨ. Sen dzwu pɨde be nwa e Yahuda a Gabata.
english: When Pilate therefore heard these words, he brought Jesus out, and sat down on the judgment seat at a place called “The Pavement”, but in Hebrew, “Gabbatha.”

jenjo: Fi wu yang ku vi pilɨ nɨnglang hyãlɨ, bɨ Bilatus tsa, “Dɨ Ivə və bə ho nɨ!”
english: Now it was the Preparation Day of the Passover, at about the sixth hour. He said to the Jews, “Behold, your King!”

jenjo: Be e ki nwakwang sen tsa, “Ba tə be wə! Ba tə be wə! Ba pi wə ku kə!” Bilatus bi le tsa, “N pi Ivə və bə ku kə?” Ivə hyɔ̃nɨng kwə nwa wə tsa, “Dɨ Ivə və bɨ ho kə Kaisar tsɨng.”
english: They cried out, “Away with him! Away with him! Crucify him!” Pilate said to them, “Shall I crucify your King?” The chief priests answered, “We have no king but Caesar!”

jenjo: Bilatus mwə Yeso tə le bisɨ tə e pi wə. Bɨ e itabwi mwə Yeso.
english: So then he delivered him to them to be crucified. So they took Jesus and led him away.

jenjo: O dɨ gə̃lɨ kə be ku wə o təkə pɨ nɨ sen dzukə a Kwangjiku nɨ. (Be nwa e Yahuda sen dzu a Golgota).
english: He went out, bearing his cross, to the place called “The Place of a Skull”, which is called in Hebrew, “Golgotha”,

jenjo: E pi wə pɨbi be e ifɨ bwayung. Ifɨ a tsɨng na wə a nali, ifɨ a tsɨng na wə a nami Yeso tangsə le.
english: where they crucified him, and with him two others, on either side one, and Jesus in the middle.

jenjo: Bilatus vĩ nɨng akə e pi ku gə̃lɨ kə de. Dɨ nɨngnɨ o vĩ kə ho o tsa, “YESU MWƐ NAZARAT IVƏ VƏ E YAHUDA.
english: Pilate wrote a title also, and put it on the cross. There was written, “JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

jenjo: E Yahuda ihyãnɨng sa bisɨ pɨde tswisə be və lo. e vĩ be nwa Yahuda be a və e Roman be nwa e Helina.
english: Therefore many of the Jews read this title, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city; and it was written in Hebrew, in Latin, and in Greek.

jenjo: Bɨ ihyãfɨ hyɔ̃nɨng ho tsɨ tə sɨ Bilatus tsa, “Bi man vĩ a tsa ‘Ivə və e Yahuda yɛ,’ be a tsa, ‘Ibwi nɨ dɨ ku wə kə Ivə və e Yahuda.’ ”
english: The chief priests of the Jews therefore said to Pilate, “Don’t write, ‘The King of the Jews,’ but, ‘he said, “I am King of the Jews.”’”

jenjo: Bilatus tsa, “Nɨngnɨ n vĩkə nɨ, n vĩ yang.”
english: Pilate answered, “What I have written, I have written.”

jenjo: E itabwi pi wə nɨ, bɨ e bwi nɨng tsənɨng o e tsəsə pɨ bwanyə, a dɨ wə hɛ̃ dɨ pɨ tsɨng. Bɨ e dɨ sayikə o nɨ e gbə gbəlɨ wu təkə hywa nɨ.
english: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also the coat. Now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.

jenjo: E nəsələ tsa, “Bi bɨn hyəng yɛ, bɨ gbə nɨngbibɨng ifɨ nɨ shə o ku wə yang, o dɨ.” E Tswe mambɨ bisɨ nɨngnɨ e vĩ tangsə dəro tsa, “E bwi nɨngtsənɨng mi e tsəsə bwa le fə e gbəshə bwa le bisɨ nɨng yasɨ mi.” Dɨbɨ tswe e itabwi tswe mambɨ.
english: Then they said to one another, “Let’s not tear it, but cast lots for it to decide whose it will be,” that the Scripture might be fulfilled, which says, “They parted my garments among them. For my cloak they cast lots.” Therefore the soldiers did these things.

jenjo: E hywĩ na və Yeso a iye be Maryamu na o de, wu tsɨ pəsəpi be gãlɨkə nɨ e pikə Yeso lə nɨ. Fə Maryamu he Kiliyoba pɔsɨ Maryamu iye Magdala lə pɨbi bɨ.
english: But there were standing by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.

jenjo: Yeso bə na o be mwambwi o nɨ o yidi nɨ pɨbi, bɨ o tsɨ na o tsa, “Iye, a dɨ ibwi nɨ myɛkə yɨ mə.”
english: Therefore when Jesus saw his mother, and the disciple whom he loved standing there, he said to his mother, “Woman, behold, your son!”

jenjo: Bɨ fə o tsɨ mwambwi de o tsa, “A dɨ iye nɨ, o myɛkə na mə.” O nəkə mambɨ nɨ bɨ mwambwi de dɨ wə təkə və wə.
english: Then he said to the disciple, “Behold, your mother!” From that hour, the disciple took her to his own home.

jenjo: Yeso yipɨ nɨng nɨ lɨ wukə bisɨ wə nɨ, lɨ tswe tɨng yang. Fə nɨng nɨ Dəlo və Fi nəkə nɨ lɨ tswe wə yang nɨ, bɨ o tsa, “Lɨng le mi yang.”
english: After this, Jesus, seeing that all things were now finished, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, said, “I am thirsty.”

jenjo: La tsɨlə be dzwe mɨng inabi pɨbi. Bɨ e dɨ fɨ̃, e tãlə, e pə nwakə bwi e tsɨ wə ngwa.
english: Now a vessel full of vinegar was set there; so they put a sponge full of the vinegar on hyssop, and held it at his mouth.

jenjo: Yeso pang kə mɨng a ngə̃lɨ de nɨ bɨ o tsa, “Tɨng yang.” Bɨ o ki tswi wə hywa o le hũlɨ wə na.
english: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, “It is finished.” He bowed his head, and gave up his spirit.

jenjo: Bɨ e ihyãfɨ və e Yahuda wu kũ Bilatus o tũpɨ bisɨ tə e wə kəpu e ifɨ nɨ e pikə ku kə nɨ, e wu be le hywa. E tswe mambɨ, bisɨ vi nɨnglang hyãlɨ be Vi Hũlɨ dɨpɨ tsɨ yang. Fə e yidi Vi Hũlɨ de pəsɔ wu chi bwa ku kə lo.
english: Therefore the Jews, because it was the Preparation Day, so that the bodies wouldn’t remain on the cross on the Sabbath (for that Sabbath was a special one), asked of Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.

jenjo: E itabwi wu wə kəpu ifɨ a tsɨng nɨ e pi le tsung be Yeso nɨ, bɨ e pe tə e wə kəpu ifɨ a tsɨng.
english: Therefore the soldiers came, and broke the legs of the first, and of the other who was crucified with him;

jenjo: Be sapɨnɨ e wukə pɨ wu wə kəpu Yeso nɨ, e chi wə o bwi yang. Bɨ e wə kəpu wə lo.
english: but when they came to Jesus, and saw that he was already dead, they didn’t break his legs.

jenjo: Tɛmə dɨ tsɨng tangsə e itabwi bɨ pə nwa nɨngsə wə be bwi. Bɨ hywi be mɨng ji pɨbi.
english: However one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and immediately blood and water came out.

jenjo: Dɨ ifɨ nɨ bəkə nɨ bɨ nə bi sɨ wə, fə nɨngnɨ o nəkə nɨ dɨ bi anɨng. O yipɨ yang nɨngnɨ o nəkə nɨ dɨ bi anɨng, fə o nə bi sɨ wə hebilə bə ma ba pənyi bə sɨ wə bɨ.
english: He who has seen has testified, and his testimony is true. He knows that he tells the truth, that you may believe.

jenjo: E nɨngnɨ tswe mambɨ bisɨ nɨng nɨ Dəlo nəkə nɨ tsɨkə bi anɨng. Nɨ tsɨkə, “A dɨ kuku wə tsɨng hɛ̃ wə lo.”
english: For these things happened, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, “A bone of him will not be broken.”

jenjo: Fə pɨ akə o tsa, “En bə ifɨ nɨ e pə nwa gã wə be bwi nɨ.”
english: Again another Scripture says, “They will look on him whom they pierced.”

jenjo: Tswa bɨ Yusufu mwe Arimatiya wə dɨ mwambwi və Yeso, be o ywe ku wə bisɨ son bibi və e ihyãfɨ və e Yuhuda. Wu o kũ bɨ Bilatus kwə wə lə o dɨ hywə Yeso o təkə.
english: After these things, Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, asked of Pilate that he might take away Jesus’ body. Pilate gave him permission. He came therefore and took away his body.

jenjo: Nikodamus ifɨ nɨ yweywelɨ wukə sɨ Yeso be nvi nɨ tə tsung be wə. Nikodimu wu be nywi yemumu nɨ e kə̃kə sɨ mur be alos nɨ. Mwilɨ sɨ wə tə yang kilo nwutsɨng ji li.
english: Nicodemus, who at first came to Jesus by night, also came bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred Roman pounds.

jenjo: Le bwayung nɨ kwa kwangbwi wə be nɨngji tswi bwa, be nywi yemumu mə nwanɨng hywinɨng və e Yahuda nɨ sen twsikə bwa nɨ.
english: So they took Jesus’ body, and bound it in linen cloths with the spices, as the custom of the Jews is to bury.

jenjo: Pɨnɨ e pi wə lə nɨ Fanɨng lə pɨbi. Tangsə fanɨng de tũ a hu nɨ e pang pɨ tswi ifɨ akə pɨbi lo nɨ lə.
english: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden. In the garden was a new tomb in which no man had ever yet been laid.

jenjo: Bisɨ dɨ vi pilɨ və nwanɨng hywinɨng və e Yahuda, fə tũ de pəsəpi bɨ e le Yeso pɨbi.
english: Then because of the Jews’ Preparation Day (for the tomb was near at hand) they laid Jesus there.

jenjo: Be nyinvi a bubu sɨ pəsɔ vi, pɨ yi sɨn wulɨ. Maryamu iye Magdala wapɨlə tə tũ, tə o chi e kye te yə nwatũ yang.
english: Now on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene went early, while it was still dark, to the tomb, and saw the stone taken away from the tomb.

jenjo: Bɨ o fə be putũ o wu sɨ Sima Bitulu be mwambwi a tsɨng nɨ Yeso yidi nɨ, o tsa, “E dɨ hywə Itwebɨ yang tũ bɨ yi pɨnɨ e təkə lə nɨ lo!”
english: Therefore she ran and came to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple whom Jesus loved, and said to them, “They have taken away the Lord out of the tomb, and we don’t know where they have laid him!”

jenjo: Bɨ Bitulu be mwambwi de mwə nɨhyã tũ.
english: Therefore Peter and the other disciple went out, and they went toward the tomb.

jenjo: Le hɛ̃ sen hywiputũ, be mwambwi de lwe sɨ Bitulu pe ochi tə tũ.
english: They both ran together. The other disciple outran Peter, and came to the tomb first.

jenjo: Tə o gbətsɔ wə hywa o bə dɨ nɨngji nɨ e kye wəkə nɨ, be o tə tangsə tũ lo.
english: Stooping and looking in, he saw the linen cloths lying, yet he didn’t enter in.

jenjo: Sima Bitulu wukə tswa nɨ bɨ pe tə tangsə tũ. Tə o chi dɨ nɨngji nɨ e kye wəkə nɨ.
english: Then Simon Peter came, following him, and entered into the tomb. He saw the linen cloths lying,

jenjo: Be nɨngji tswibwa nɨ e kikə pwəchi Yeso nɨ, kwa lwe be tsɨng wə be a pɨnɨ e ki wəkə nɨ.
english: and the cloth that had been on his head, not lying with the linen cloths, but rolled up in a place by itself.

jenjo: Bɨ mwambwi nɨ ochi təkə tũ nɨ, tə tangsə tũ bɨ. O bə be nɨng wə bɨ o tsɨnyi lə.
english: So then the other disciple who came first to the tomb also entered in, and he saw and believed.

jenjo: Be bɨtsɨng e yipɨ nɨng nɨ Dəlo vĩkə tsa, “Tɔle Yeso yi tũ nɨ lo.”
english: For as yet they didn’t know the Scripture, that he must rise from the dead.

jenjo: E mwambwi de mwənyə tə və.
english: So the disciples went away again to their own homes.

jenjo: Be Maryamu tsɨ nwa tũ de sɨn tata. O gbə tsɔ hywa son bə tangsə tũ ho,
english: But Mary was standing outside at the tomb weeping. So, as she wept, she stooped and looked into the tomb,

jenjo: bɨ o bə e ikwətũ dzwe bwayung ku tangsə tũ de e tsə nɨng a fɨ sɨ le. Ifɨ a tsɨng tsɨ pɨ nɨ e tsɨkə ku Yeso lə nɨ, ifɨ a tsɨng pɨnɨ e sekə kəpu wə lə nɨ.
english: and she saw two angels in white sitting, one at the head, and one at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.

jenjo: E bi wə e tsa, “Iye dɨ bə tswe mə sɨ man tata lɨ?” O tsa, “E dɨ Itwemi fə n yi pɨnɨ e dɨ wə e təkə lə nɨ lo.”
english: They told her, “Woman, why are you weeping?” She said to them, “Because they have taken away my Lord, and I don’t know where they have laid him.”

jenjo: O nəkə mambɨ nɨ, on kwang tswa wə lɨ, bɨ o bə Yeso tsɨ tswa wə, be o yipɨ dɨ wə lo.
english: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing, and didn’t know that it was Jesus.

jenjo: Yeso bi wə tsa, “Iye dɨ bə tswe mə sɨ man tata, dɨ wə sɨ man bapɨ lɨ?’ Bɨ Maryamu bə ma wə dɨ itswenwatũ fanɨng de. Bɨ o bi wə o tsa, ‘Ihyãfɨ a dɨ mə bɨ a dɨ wə yang a ta mi na sɨ pɨde hebilə tə n dɨ wə.
english: Jesus said to her, “Woman, why are you weeping? Who are you looking for?” She, supposing him to be the gardener, said to him, “Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have laid him, and I will take him away.”

jenjo: Yeso dzu dzung wə tsa, “Maryamu.” Bɨ o myɛchi sɨ we o nəbi be nwa e Yahuda o tsa, “Raboni!” Dɨ nwata dzung de ho kə Inyinasinɨng
english: Jesus said to her, “Mary.” She turned and said to him, “Rabboni!” which is to say, “Teacher!”

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ wə tsa, “Bi man mwəna sɨ mi yɛ, n tə sɨ Ta lo bɨtsɨng. Bisɨ mambɨ a fə tə a nə e hywĩ mi lə a tsa, ‘N fə sɨ min tə sɨ Ta mi be Ta və bə, sɨ Fi mi be Fi və bə.’ ”
english: Jesus said to her, “Don’t hold me, for I haven’t yet ascended to my Father; but go to my brothers, and tell them, ‘I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.’”

jenjo: Maryamu iye Magdala fə be bi tə nə e mwambwi lə o tsa, “N bə Itwebɨ yang!” Bɨ o nə le bi nɨ lə o nə wə lə nɨ.
english: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had said these things to her.

jenjo: Be nandzwi pəsɔ hywi vi, hywapɨnɨ e mwambwi o ku pɨ a itsɨng, e chi nwakwə ku le sen bibi və e Yahuda. Bɨ Yeso huji tangsə le tsɨ le tsa, “A tã wu bə lə!”
english: When therefore it was evening, on that day, the first day of the week, and when the doors were locked where the disciples were assembled, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the middle, and said to them, “Peace be to you.”

jenjo: Tswa wə, bɨ o ta le na sɨ kəna wə be nwasə wə. E mwambwi bɛ tswe sɨbi bisɨ e bə Itwele yang.
english: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his side. The disciples therefore were glad when they saw the Lord.

jenjo: Fə Yeso tsɨ le tsa, “A tã ku be bə! Ma tũlɨ Ta tũ mi nɨ, sɨ min tũ bə mambɨ.”
english: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Peace be to you. As the Father has sent me, even so I send you.”

jenjo: Mambɨ bɨ o le bɨbɨ ku le o tsa, “Ba chi Kwang Fi.
english: When he had said this, he breathed on them, and said to them, “Receive the Holy Spirit!

jenjo: Ke Ifɨ nɨ ba e nyi hywa sɨ nɨng abe o yang e yafə wə lə yang. A ba e enyihywa sɨ nɨng abe və le lo yang, e yafə le lə lo.
english: If you forgive anyone’s sins, they have been forgiven them. If you retain anyone’s sins, they have been retained.”

jenjo: Tsɨng tangsə e mwambwi nɨ sen dzukə a Toma nɨ sen dzukə a yɨzɛ̃ nɨ ywang hywapɨnɨ Yeso wukə nɨ.
english: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, wasn’t with them when Jesus came.

jenjo: O wukə nɨ e nyɔ tsɨ wə tsa, “Bɨ bə Itwebɨ yang!” Toma tsa, “Aba n bə bwa kuru nɨ na wə nɨ n so na mi lə lo, fə n so na mi bwa nɨ nwasə wə nɨ lo yang, te n kwələ lo.”
english: The other disciples therefore said to him, “We have seen the Lord!” But he said to them, “Unless I see in his hands the print of the nails, put my finger into the print of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.”

jenjo: Fə hywi vi myɛ wu le hɛ̃ e ku tangve, Toma lə tangsə le. E chi nwakwə ku le. Yeso huji sɨ le o tsa, “A tã wu bə lə!”
english: After eight days again his disciples were inside, and Thomas was with them. Jesus came, the doors being locked, and stood in the middle, and said, “Peace be to you.”

jenjo: Bɨ o dzupɨ Toma o tsa, “Toma a bə nyina mi. Wu a so nɨng hywə na mə lə, yə fə a pang nwasə mi. Bi nyi mə gbəshə bisɨ mi yɛ, a tsɨnyi sɨ mi!”
english: Then he said to Thomas, “Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don’t be unbelieving, but believing.”

jenjo: Tomas tsa, “Itwe mi, be Fi mi!”
english: Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!”

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ wə tsa, “Bisɨ nɨng mə bə mi yang bɨ a tsɨnyi sɨ mi. E ifɨ nɨ bəkə lo be tsɨnyi lə nɨ dɨ e ifɨ pərkə.
english: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen, and have believed.”

jenjo: Yeso tswe e nɨng bisɨ akə ihyãnɨng nɨng e mwambwi o, be e vĩ lo tangsə Dəlo nɨ.
english: Therefore Jesus did many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book;

jenjo: Be e vĩ e a pɨnɨ hebilə ba kwələ dɨ Yeso kə ifɨ nɨ Fi gbə wə sɔ tũkə nɨ, fə dɨ wə kə Yɨ Fi. Aba ba tsɨnyi yang, ban chi hũlɨ chi nasɨ dzung wə.
english: but these are written, that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have life in his name.

jenjo: Tswa Yeso huji sɨ e mwambwi o nwamɨng teku Tibariya. Dɨ nɨngnɨ tswenɨng ho manɨ.
english: After these things, Jesus revealed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias. He revealed himself this way.

jenjo: E mwambwi ihyãnɨng wu ku pɨ atsɨng. Sima Bitulu be Toma (nɨ sen dzu wə Yɨzɛ̃ nɨ), pɔsɨ Nataniyel mwɛ Kana hywa Galili, be e yɨ Zabadi fə pɔsɨ e mwambwi akə bwayung tsung be lekə.
english: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples were together.

jenjo: Bɨ Sima Bitulu tsɨ le tsa, “Min tə pɨ dzwi mɨng.” Bɨ e tsa, “Bɨn tə tsung be mə.” Bɨ e ji tə e pĩ fə, e dzwi mɨng pɨ kə chi le be e mwə hyɨng lo.
english: Simon Peter said to them, “I’m going fishing.” They told him, “We are also coming with you.” They immediately went out, and entered into the boat. That night, they caught nothing.

jenjo: Be nyinvi abubu Yeso wu tsɨ nwa hywahywi, be e mwambwi de yipɨ dɨ wə lo.
english: But when day had already come, Jesus stood on the beach, yet the disciples didn’t know that it was Jesus.

jenjo: O dzupɨ le o tsa, “E tswə mi, ba mwə hyɨng lo?” E kwə e tsa, “O!”
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “Children, have you anything to eat?” They answered him, “No.”

jenjo: Bɨ o tsɨ le o tsa, “Ba le ka nali və bə, ban mwə hyɨng mwə.” E leka fɨlɨ wukə tang fə pe sambe və le, bisɨ dzung dzung və e hyɨng tangsə ka de nɨ.
english: He said to them, “Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.” They cast it therefore, and now they weren’t able to draw it in for the multitude of fish.

jenjo: Bɨ mwambwi nɨ Yeso sɨn tswekə bi wə nɨ tsɨ Bitulu tsa, “Dɨ Itwebɨ!” Bitulu likə o tsa dɨ itswebɨ nɨ bɨ o dɨ nɨng yasɨ o a nɨngfa o ya (bisɨ o ochi o fə yang). Bɨ o hywə o kywi mɨng.
english: That disciple therefore whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It’s the Lord!” So when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he wrapped his coat around him (for he was naked), and threw himself into the sea.

jenjo: Nyɔ e mwambwi de ku tang fə sen fɨ ka na. E ngə fə e wukə nggwa be hyɨng yɨ tangka de, bisɨ tswilɨ pɨde be nggwa tswe yang gbəlɨ a kya nwuhmɨ.
english: But the other disciples came in the little boat (for they were not far from the land, but about two hundred cubits away), dragging the net full of fish.

jenjo: Sapɨnɨ e wukə nwa hywahywi nɨ, bɨ e bə chɛ̃ dzwa be hyɨng dzwa de, be kumpa.
english: So when they got out on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid on it, and bread.

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ le tsa, “Ba bwi hyɨng tangsə e hyɨng nɨ ba mwəkə sɨswenɨ nɨ ba wukə.”
english: Jesus said to them, “Bring some of the fish which you have just caught.”

jenjo: Sima Bitulu pĩ fə fɨ ka wukə nggwa. Hyɨng a kã yi tang ka nwuhywĩyung ji hywə nyang tsɨ hywa bwatə. E hyɨng kã tswe sɨbi lehɛ̃ ka de hyɛng lo.
english: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land, full of great fish, one hundred fifty-three; and even though there were so many, the net wasn’t torn.

jenjo: Yeso tsɨ le tsa, “Ba wu ba hashitə.” Tangsə le ifɨ nɨ bi wə tsɨkə, “Dɨ ma wə?” nɨ ywang. E yipɨ yang dɨ Itwele.
english: Jesus said to them, “Come and eat breakfast.” None of the disciples dared inquire of him, “Who are you?” knowing that it was the Lord.

jenjo: Yeso dɨ kumpa tsə le, o tswe mambɨ be hyɨng.
english: Then Jesus came and took the bread, gave it to them, and the fish likewise.

jenjo: Dɨ nɨng bwatə a hujilɨ və Yeso sɨ e mwambwi o, tswa yilɨ o tũ.
english: This is now the third time that Jesus was revealed to his disciples, after he had risen from the dead.

jenjo: Yeso be e mwambwi o hashitə tɨngkə nɨ, bɨ o dzupɨ Sima Bitulu o tsa, “Sima yɨ Yohana sɨ man tswebi mi pe nyɔ le nɨ yang?” O tsa, “Oh itwemi a yipɨ yang sɨ min tswebi mə.” Yeso tsa, “A tə e nɨngpungga mi nɨngtang.”
english: So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than these?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Feed my lambs.”

jenjo: Fə Yeso tsa, “Siman yɨ Yohana sɨ man tswebi mi lə kə akang?” O kwə tsa, “O, Itwemi a yipɨ yang sɨ min tswebi mə.” Yeso tsa, “A tsɨ nɨng sɨ e nɨngpungga mi.”
english: He said to him again a second time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Tend my sheep.”

jenjo: Yeso fə bi wə a nɨng bwatə tsa, “Sima yɨ Yohana, sɨ man tswebi mi?” Bi de shi Bitulu bisɨ o bi wə a nɨng bwatə o tsa, “Siman sɨ man tswebi mi lə a?” Bɨ o tsa, “Itwemi a yipɨ e nɨng yang hɛ̃, sɨ min tswebi mə.” Yeso tsa, “A tə nɨngpungga mi nɨngtang.”
english: He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?” Peter was grieved because he asked him the third time, “Do you have affection for me?” He said to him, “Lord, you know everything. You know that I have affection for you.” Jesus said to him, “Feed my sheep.

jenjo: Sɨ min nə mə bi anɨng lə hywapɨnɨ mə kə pəsɨ nɨ man tsə sɨ mə pɨ nɨ sɨ man yidi hɛ̃ ma tɨtə, be aba kywilɨ wu yang man chĩ na mə hywa, fə dɨ ifɨ akə yin tsə mə nɨng lə. Ifɨ de yin mwə mə kə on tə be mə pɨnɨ a yidi lo nɨ.
english: Most certainly I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself, and walked where you wanted to. But when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and another will dress you, and carry you where you don’t want to go.”

jenjo: Yeso nə mambɨ bisɨ bwilɨ nɨ Bitulu yin bwikə on tə Fi kãlɨ nɨ. Bɨ o tsɨ wə tsa, “A mwə tswa mi.”
english: Now he said this, signifying by what kind of death he would glorify God. When he had said this, he said to him, “Follow me.”

jenjo: Bitulu kwang bə mwambwi nɨ Yeso tswebi o nɨ, sɨn mwə tswa le. (Dɨ mwambwi de kənwa sɨ Yeso sɨ nɨnglang hyãlɨ bɨ bipɨ tsa, “Itwebɨ dɨ wə yin le mə təlɨ nɨ?”)
english: Then Peter, turning around, saw a disciple following. This was the disciple whom Jesus loved, the one who had also leaned on Jesus’ breast at the supper and asked, “Lord, who is going to betray You?”

jenjo: Bitulu bi Yeso tsa, “Yə ifɨ a pɨnɨ a nɨ?”
english: Peter seeing him, said to Jesus, “Lord, what about this man?”

jenjo: Yeso kwə nwa wə tsa, “Aba sɨ min yidi o ku be hũlɨ dɨlə təkə vi fəlɨ mi yang, dɨ bə kə a mə pɨbi a? Tɔle a mwə tswa mi.”
english: Jesus said to him, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you? You follow me.”

jenjo: Bisɨ mambɨ, bi de lo nwa e ifafɨ hɛ̃ tsa mwambwi de bwiw, be Yeso nə mambɨ lo. O tsa, “Yə a nɨ n yidi o ku be hũlɨ pəko fə n wu yang, dɨ bə kə a mə pɨbi?”
english: This saying therefore went out among the brothers, that this disciple wouldn’t die. Yet Jesus didn’t say to him that he wouldn’t die, but, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you?”

jenjo: Dɨ mwambwi de bɨ nə bi və e nɨngnɨ fə vĩ. Bɨ yipɨ yang bi o de, dɨ bi anɨng.
english: This is the disciple who testifies about these things, and wrote these things. We know that his witness is true.

jenjo: Yeso tswe e nɨng ihyãnɨng. Aba en vĩ e nɨngnɨ hɛ̃ o tswekə nɨ yang, sɨ bəlɨ mi Fangwa hywakĩ pa dɨ e dəlo nɨ en vĩkə de nɨw.
english: There are also many other things which Jesus did, which if they would all be written, I suppose that even the world itself wouldn’t have room for the books that would be written.
